question: A steel bar is fully restrained and heated through 55 deg C. With E = 200 GPa and alpha = 11e-6 /deg C, find the thermal stress in MPa.
solution: Given: dT = 55, E = 200, al = 11 | Formula: sigma = E alpha (dT) | Substitute: sigma = 200000 * 11e-6 * 55 | Answer: 121 MPa

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 400 mm and wall thickness 13 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.7 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 400, t = 13, P = 1.7 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.7*400 / (2*13) | Answer: 26.15 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 980 K and 350 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 980, Tc = 350 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 350/980) * 100 | Answer: 64.29 %

question: A refrigerator works between 256 K (cold) and 312 K (hot). Find the maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 256, Th = 312 | Formula: COP_ref = Tc / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 256 / (312 - 256) | Answer: 4.571

question: A heat pump operates between 278 K and 326 K. Find its maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 278, Th = 326 | Formula: COP_hp = Th / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 326 / (326 - 278) | Answer: 6.792

question: 2.7 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 35 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.7, dT = 35 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 2.7 * 0.718 * 35 | Answer: 67.85 kJ

question: 4.8 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 110 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.8, dT = 110 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 4.8 * 1.005 * 110 | Answer: 530.6 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 2 m^3 at 440 K with mass 5 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 2, Tk = 440, m = 5 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 5*0.287*440 / 2 | Answer: 315.7 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 1.5 kg of air expands isothermally at 360 K from volume V1 to 3*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.5, Tk = 360, ratio = 3 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 1.5*0.287*360*ln(3) | Answer: 170.3 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.9 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.23 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.9, D = 0.23 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.9*0.23 / 0.001 | Answer: 897000

question: Water flows at 1 m/s through a pipe of diameter 270 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Find the gauge pressure at a depth of 1.5 m in water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, g = 9.81 m/s^2), in kPa.
solution: Given: h = 1.5 | Formula: p = rho g h | Substitute: p = 1000*9.81*1.5 / 1000 | Answer: 14.71 kPa

question: Water issues from an orifice under a head of 17.4 m. Taking Cv = 0.97, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 17.4, cv = 0.97 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.97*sqrt(2*9.81*17.4) | Answer: 17.92 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 260 mm) water flows at 2 m/s. It contracts to diameter 140 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 260, d2 = 140, V1 = 2 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2*(260/140)^2 | Answer: 6.898 m/s

question: Water flows at 1.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.14 m and length 390 m. With friction factor f = 0.029, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 27 teeth drives a gear of 53 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1350 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 27, z2 = 53, N1 = 1350 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1350*27 / 53 | Answer: 687.7 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 380 mm rotates at 1500 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 380, N = 1500 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.38)*1500 / 60 | Answer: 29.85 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 30.2 kW at 1200 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 30.2, N = 1200 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(30.2*1000) / (2*pi*1200) | Answer: 240.3 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 3.6 kg rotates at radius 0.3 m at 650 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 11800 N/m and mass 13.9 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 11800, m = 13.9 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(11800/13.9) | Answer: 4.637 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 4.2 m^2 and thickness 0.19 m has conductivity k = 40.2 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 110 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 4.2, L = 0.19, k = 40.2, dT = 110 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 40.2*4.2*110 / 0.19 | Answer: 97749 W

question: A surface of area 5.1 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 100 W/m^2-K to surroundings 85 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 5.1, h = 100, dT = 85 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 100*5.1*85 | Answer: 43350 W

question: In a counter-flow heat exchanger the terminal temperature differences are 55 deg C and 20 deg C. Find the log mean temperature difference (LMTD) in deg C.
solution: Given: dT1 = 55, dT2 = 20 | Formula: LMTD = (dT1 - dT2) / ln(dT1/dT2) | Substitute: LMTD = (55 - 20) / ln(55/20) | Answer: 34.6 deg C

question: In turning, cutting speed = 170 m/min, feed = 0.13 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.7 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 170, f = 0.13, d = 2.7 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*170*0.13*2.7 | Answer: 59670 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 190 mm is turned at 800 rpm with a feed of 0.37 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 190, N = 800, f = 0.37 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 190 / (0.37*800) | Answer: 0.6419 min

question: A resistor of 51 ohm carries a current of 4.1 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 51, I = 4.1 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 4.1 * 51 | Answer: 209.1 V

question: Three resistors 8 ohm, 8 ohm and 83 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 8, R2 = 8, R3 = 83 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 8 + 8 + 83 | Answer: 99 ohm

question: Two resistors 93 ohm and 8 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 93, R2 = 8 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 93*8 / (93+8) | Answer: 7.366 ohm

question: A device draws 11.5 A at 130 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 130, I = 11.5 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 130 * 11.5 | Answer: 1495 W

question: A current of 3.4 A flows through a 134 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 3.4, R = 134 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (3.4)^2 * 134 | Answer: 1549 W

question: Two capacitors 20.4 uF and 26.2 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 20.4, C2 = 26.2 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 20.4*26.2 / (20.4+26.2) | Answer: 11.47 uF

question: A resistor 41 kohm and capacitor 2.7 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 41, C = 2.7 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (41k)(2.7u) = 110.7 ms | Answer: 110.7 ms

question: An inductor 51.7 mH is in series with 178 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 51.7, R = 178 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (51.7e-3) / 178 | Answer: 0.2904 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 59.6 mH inductor at 570 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 59.6, f = 570 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (570)(59.6e-3) | Answer: 213.5 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 10.7 uF capacitor at 440 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 10.7, f = 440 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (440)(10.7e-6)) | Answer: 33.81 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 60 ohm, XL = 52 ohm and XC = 79 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 60, XL = 52, XC = 79 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(60^2 + (52 - 79)^2) | Answer: 65.8 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 76.3 mH and C = 9.5 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 76.3, C = 9.5 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(76.3e-3 * 9.5e-6)) | Answer: 186.9 Hz

question: A capacitor of 34.1 uF is charged to 200 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 34.1, V = 200 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*34.1e-6*(200)^2 | Answer: 682 mJ

question: An alternating voltage has a peak value of 208 V. Find its RMS value.
solution: Given: Vp = 208 | Formula: Vrms = Vp / sqrt(2) | Substitute: Vrms = 208 / sqrt(2) | Answer: 147.1 V

question: A transformer has primary voltage 150 V with 910 primary turns and 250 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 150, N1 = 910, N2 = 250 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 150 * 250/910 | Answer: 41.21 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 190 V and draws an armature current of 6 A. If the armature resistance is 1 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 190, Ia = 6, Ra = 1 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 190 - 6*1 | Answer: 184 V

question: A 6-pole induction motor on a 50 Hz supply runs at 810 rpm. Find the slip (%).
formula: s = (Ns - N) / Ns,  Ns = 120 f / P

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 130 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.81. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 130, VL = 415, pf = 0.81 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*130*0.81 / 1000 | Answer: 75.69 kW

question: A load has real power 25 kW and apparent power 185 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 25, S = 185 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 25 / 185 | Answer: 0.1351

question: A machine delivers 35 kW output while drawing 217 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 35, Pi = 217 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 35/217 * 100 | Answer: 16.13 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 17 V across R1 = 29 ohm and R2 = 30 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 17, R1 = 29, R2 = 30 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 17*30 / (29+30) | Answer: 8.644 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 90 kohm and Rin = 35 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 90, Rin = 35 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 90 / 35 | Answer: 2.571

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 170 kohm and Rg = 44 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 170, Rg = 44 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 170/44 | Answer: 4.864

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 3254. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 3254 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(3254) | Answer: 35.12 dB

question: A first-order system has a time constant of 1.9 s. Find the time (in s) to reach 63.2% of its final value.
solution: For a first-order step response, y = 1 - e^(-t/tau) | y = 0.632 when t = tau | Answer: 1.9 s
formula: At t = tau the response reaches 63.2% (one time constant)

question: A signal is sampled at 178 kHz. According to the Nyquist criterion, what is the maximum signal frequency that can be represented (in kHz)?
solution: Given: fs = 178 | Formula: f_max = fs / 2 | Substitute: f_max = 178 / 2 | Answer: 89 kHz

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.5 m carries a central point load of 35 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 9.5, W = 35 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 35*9.5 / 4 | Answer: 83.12 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.5 m carries a UDL of 15 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.5, w = 15 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 15*(5.5)^2 / 8 | Answer: 56.72 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.3 m carries a point load 75 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.3, W = 75 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 75*5.3 | Answer: 397.5 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 3.6 m carries a UDL of 26 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.6, w = 26 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 26*(3.6)^2 / 2 | Answer: 168.5 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.9 m carries a point load 25 kN at distance 3.7 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 6.9, a = 3.7, W = 25 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 25*(6.9 - 3.7) / 6.9 | Answer: 11.59 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 4.5 m) carries a central point load 40 kN. With E = 30 GPa and I = 410e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=40000 N, L=4500.0 mm, E=30000 MPa, I=410e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 6.174 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 5.9 m carries a UDL of 18 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.9, w = 18 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 18*(5.9)^2 / 12 | Answer: 52.22 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 700 mm, clear cover 25 mm and main bars of diameter 16 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 700, c = 25, dia = 16 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 700 - 25 - 16/2 | Answer: 667 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 34.3 m^2 carrying a factored load of 19.8 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 34.3, w = 19.8 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 19.8 * 34.3 | Answer: 679.1 kN

question: For a bar of diameter 12 mm with design bond stress 2.1 MPa and steel stress 395 MPa, find the development length in mm.
solution: Given: dia = 12, tbd = 2.1, fs = 395 | Formula: Ld = phi fs / (4 tau_bd) | Substitute: Ld = 12*395 / (4*2.1) | Answer: 564.3 mm

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 3 m, unit weight 16 kN/m^3, phi = 30 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: At a depth of 10.6 m in a saturated soil (saturated unit weight 19 kN/m^3, water table at surface), find the effective vertical stress in kPa (gamma_w = 9.81).
solution: Given: z = 10.6, g = 19 | Formula: sigma' = (gamma_sat - gamma_w) z | Substitute: sigma' = (19 - 9.81)*10.6 | Answer: 97.41 kPa

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 8.9e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1.5, area = 2.4e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 8.9, i = 1.5, A = 2.4 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (8.9e-4)*1.5*(2.4e-3) | Answer: 3204 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.8 m, bed slope 0.007 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.024. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.1 m under a head of 0.6 m. Taking Cd = 0.61 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 3.4 m wide carries a discharge of 6.9 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 100 m and design speed 95 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 100, V = 95 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (95)^2 / (127*100) | Answer: 0.7106
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: For a design speed of 85 km/h with allowable superelevation 0.08 and lateral friction 0.14, find the minimum curve radius in m.
A tank of volume 350 m^3 treats a flow of 85 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 350, Q = 85 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 350 / 85 | Answer: 4.118 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 230 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.34 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 6 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 230, k = 0.34, t = 6 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 230*(1 - e^(-0.34*6)) | Answer: 200.1 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.65, rainfall intensity 40 mm/h over a catchment of 11.4 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.65, i = 40, A = 11.4 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.65*40*11.4 / 360 | Answer: 0.8233 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.04 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 320 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.04, M = 320 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 320*(30+0.04)/30 | Answer: 320.4 m

question: Convert the decimal number 93 to binary.
solution: Divide 93 by 2 repeatedly, recording remainders | Reading remainders in reverse gives 1011101 | Answer: 1011101 (binary)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 2 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Convert the decimal number 3288 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 3288 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: CD8 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Convert the 8-bit binary number 00010111 to decimal.
solution: Binary 00010111 = sum of bit-weights | Answer: 23 (decimal)
formula: Sum each bit times its positional weight (2^i)

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 00101010 and 11110100.
solution: XOR: 11011110 | Count of 1s = 6 | Answer: 6
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 100 megabits is sent over a link of 37 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 100, B = 37 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 100 / 37 | Answer: 2.703 s

question: A link has bandwidth 14 Mbps and round-trip time 90 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 14, R = 90 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 14e6 * 90e-3 bits = 1260 kb | Answer: 1260 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.82, cache access time 1 ns and main-memory access time 80 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.82, tc = 1, tm = 80 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.82*1 + (1 - 0.82)*80 | Answer: 15.22 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 862933 elements?
solution: Given: n = 862933 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(862933)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: An O(n^2) algorithm performs c*n^2 basic operations. If c = 1 and n = 1570, how many operations are performed?
solution: Given: n = 1570 | Formula: operations = n^2 | Substitute: = (1570)^2 | Answer: 2464900

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.005, memory access time 180 ns and page-fault service time 3 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 3 ms = 3000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.005)*180 + 0.005*3000000.0 ns | Answer: 15.18 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 1.7 m^3 at 260 kPa and 300 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 1.7, P = 260, Tk = 300 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (260e3)*1.7 / (8.314*300) | Answer: 177.2 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.17 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 2 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.17, t = 2 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.17*2) | Answer: 0.2882

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.18 /min) is to reach 55% conversion in a plug-flow reactor. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.18, X = 55 | Formula: tau = -ln(1 - X) / k | Substitute: tau = -ln(1 - 0.55) / 0.18 | Answer: 4.436 min

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.18 /min) reaches 60% conversion in a CSTR. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.18, X = 60 | Formula: tau = X / (k (1 - X)) | Substitute: tau = 0.6 / (0.18*(1 - 0.6)) | Answer: 8.333 min

question: For a reaction with A = 2e10 /s and activation energy 55 kJ/mol at 390 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 2, Ea = 55, Tk = 390 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 2e10 * exp(-55e3 / (8.314*390)) | Answer: 859.7 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.96 and bottoms xW = 0.09, with relative volatility alpha = 3.5. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.96, xw = 0.09, al = 3.5 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.96/0.04)(0.91/0.09)] / ln(3.5) | Answer: 4.384 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.59 and x = 0.21. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.59, x = 0.21 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.59/0.41) / (0.21/0.79) | Answer: 5.413

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.75 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 95 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.75, Psat = 95 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.75 * 95 | Answer: 71.25 kPa

question: A stream of 5.6 kg/s with specific heat 2.7 kJ/kg-K is heated through 90 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 5.6, cp = 2.7, dT = 90 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 5.6*2.7*90 | Answer: 1361 kW

question: A reactor of volume 3.3 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 2.9 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 3.3, Q = 2.9 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 3.3 / 2.9 | Answer: 1.138 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 9e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 4 mm with a concentration difference of 180 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 9, L = 4, dC = 180 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (9e-9)*180 / (4e-3) | Answer: 405 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 1.1 min and steady-state gain 0.6. For a step input of magnitude 14, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 1.1, K = 0.6, M = 14 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 0.6 * 14 | Answer: 8.4 units

question: A reactor operates at a space time of 13.9 min. Find its space velocity in per hour.
solution: Given: tau = 13.9 | Formula: SV = 60 / tau  (per hour) | Substitute: SV = 60 / 13.9 | Answer: 4.317 /h

question: An aircraft wing of area 40 m^2 flies at 80 m/s (air density 0.4 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.2. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 40, V = 80, rho = 0.4, CL = 1.2 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.4*(80)^2*40*1.2 / 1000 | Answer: 61.44 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 15 m^2 flies at 230 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.08. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 15, V = 230, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.08 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(230)^2*15*0.08 / 1000 | Answer: 12.7 kN

question: Find the dynamic pressure for air of density 0.7 kg/m^3 moving at 250 m/s, in Pa.
solution: Given: rho = 0.7, V = 250 | Formula: q = 0.5 rho V^2 | Substitute: q = 0.5*0.7*(250)^2 | Answer: 21875 Pa

question: An aircraft flies at 550 m/s where the speed of sound is 310 m/s. Find the Mach number.
solution: Given: V = 550, a = 310 | Formula: M = V / a | Substitute: M = 550 / 310 | Answer: 1.774

question: A specimen under stress 380 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.1e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 380, eps = 2.1 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 380 / (2.1e-3) MPa = 181 GPa | Answer: 181 GPa

question: A block of mass 2 kg has a volume of 4.2e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 2, V = 4.2 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 2 / (4.2e-3) | Answer: 476.2 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 900 mm is heated through 95 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 12e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 900, dT = 95, al = 12 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 900*12e-6*95 | Answer: 1.026 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 160 ohm, R2 = 195 ohm and R3 = 460 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 160, R2 = 195, R3 = 460 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 195*460 / 160 | Answer: 560.6 ohm

question: A strain gauge of resistance 120 ohm and gauge factor 2.1 experiences a strain of 500e-6. Find the change in resistance in milliohms.
solution: Given: R = 120, GF = 2.1, eps = 500 | Formula: dR = R * GF * strain | Substitute: dR = 120*2.1*500e-6 | Answer: 126 milliohm

question: A measurement reads 9.19 when the true value is 10. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.19, true = 10 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.19 - 10| / 10 * 100 | Answer: 8.1 %

question: Annual demand is 35000 units, ordering cost 60 per order and holding cost 19 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 35000, S = 60, H = 19 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*35000*60 / 19) | Answer: 470.2 units

question: An asset costs 140000 with salvage value 40000 after 7 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 140000, Sv = 40000, n = 7 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (140000 - 40000) / 7 | Answer: 14286 per year

question: A product sells for 200 per unit with variable cost 80 per unit and fixed costs 135000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 200, V = 80, F = 135000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 135000 / (200 - 80) | Answer: 1125 units

question: Find the present worth of 130000 received 7 years from now at an interest rate of 8% per year.
solution: Given: F = 130000, n = 7, i = 8 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 130000 / (1 + 0.08)^7 | Answer: 75854 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.92, 0.91 and 0.94 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.92, r2 = 0.91, r3 = 0.94 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.92*0.91*0.94 | Answer: 0.787

question: A process produces 6 defective items in a batch of 11000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 6, N = 11000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 6/11000 * 1e6 | Answer: 545.5 PPM

solution: Mean = 35.2 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 10.21

question: Find the slope of the line through (-8, 8) and (6, 4).
solution: Given: x1 = -8, y1 = 8, x2 = 6, y2 = 4 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (4 - 8) / (6 - -8) | Answer: -0.2857

question: Find the distance between the points (-5, -8) and (-6, 8).
solution: Given: x1 = -5, y1 = -8, x2 = -6, y2 = 8 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((-1)^2 + (16)^2) | Answer: 16.03 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (2,8), (6,-5), (4,-7).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 17 sq units

question: Evaluate the number of combinations C(9, 1).
solution: Given: n = 9, r = 1 | Formula: C(n, r) = n! / (r! (n - r)!) | Substitute: C(9, 1) = 9! / (1! * 8!) | Answer: 9

question: Evaluate the number of permutations P(7, 1).
solution: Given: n = 7, r = 1 | Formula: P(n, r) = n! / (n - r)! | Substitute: P(7, 1) = 7! / 6! | Answer: 7

question: Find the 14th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -15 and common difference -2.
solution: Given: a = -15, d = -2, n = 14 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -15 + (14 - 1)*-2 | Answer: -41

question: Find the sum of the first 29 terms of an AP with first term -14 and common difference -5.
Find the simple interest on a principal of 2500 at 11.9% per annum for 4 years.
solution: Given: P = 2500, R = 11.9, Tt = 4 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 2500 * 11.9 * 4 / 100 | Answer: 1190 currency units

question: Find the amount when 18500 is invested at 10% per annum compounded annually for 5 years.
solution: Given: P = 18500, R = 10, Tt = 5 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 18500 * (1 + 10/100)^5 | Answer: 29794 currency units

question: Find the modulus of the complex number 11 + 3i.
solution: Given: a = 11, b = 3 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((11)^2 + (3)^2) | Answer: 11.4

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number -7 + -10i.
solution: Given: a = -7, b = -10 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(-10, -7) | Answer: -125 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = 3x^3 + 2x^2 - x + 3 at x = 5.

question: A circular rod of diameter 17 mm carries an axial tensile load of 51 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 38 mm and length 3000 mm carries an axial load of 15 kN. Take E = 110 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 31 mm transmits a torque of 400 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.

question: A rectangular beam section is 79 mm wide and 200 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.

question: A component of ultimate strength 560 MPa is designed for a working stress of 110 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 560, sw = 110 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 560 / 110 | Answer: 5.091

question: A steel bar is fully restrained and heated through 25 deg C. With E = 210 GPa and alpha = 13e-6 /deg C, find the thermal stress in MPa.
solution: Given: dT = 25, E = 210, al = 13 | Formula: sigma = E alpha (dT) | Substitute: sigma = 210000 * 13e-6 * 25 | Answer: 68.25 MPa

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1500 mm and wall thickness 14 mm carries an internal pressure of 0.6 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1500, t = 14, P = 0.6 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 0.6*1500 / (2*14) | Answer: 32.14 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 1180 K and 360 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 1180, Tc = 360 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 360/1180) * 100 | Answer: 69.49 %

question: A refrigerator works between 260 K (cold) and 320 K (hot). Find the maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 260, Th = 320 | Formula: COP_ref = Tc / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 260 / (320 - 260) | Answer: 4.333

question: A heat pump operates between 280 K and 332 K. Find its maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 280, Th = 332 | Formula: COP_hp = Th / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 332 / (332 - 280) | Answer: 6.385

question: 5.9 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 180 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 5.9, dT = 180 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 5.9 * 0.718 * 180 | Answer: 762.5 kJ

question: 3.4 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 30 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.4, dT = 30 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 3.4 * 1.005 * 30 | Answer: 102.5 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.2 m^3 at 440 K with mass 5.1 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).

question: 1.3 kg of air expands isothermally at 390 K from volume V1 to 3*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.28 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 5, D = 0.28 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*5*0.28 / 0.001 | Answer: 1400000

question: Water flows at 4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 100 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.

question: Water issues from an orifice under a head of 10.2 m. Taking Cv = 0.97, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).

question: A pinion of 40 teeth drives a gear of 113 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1500 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.

question: A pulley of diameter 490 mm rotates at 900 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 490, N = 900 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.49)*900 / 60 | Answer: 23.09 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 11.9 kW at 1250 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 11.9, N = 1250 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(11.9*1000) / (2*pi*1250) | Answer: 90.91 N-m

question: A plane wall of area 7.5 m^2 and thickness 0.18 m has conductivity k = 20.8 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 135 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.

question: A surface of area 2.4 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 175 W/m^2-K to surroundings 125 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 2.4, h = 175, dT = 125 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 175*2.4*125 | Answer: 52500 W

question: In a counter-flow heat exchanger the terminal temperature differences are 60 deg C and 35 deg C. Find the log mean temperature difference (LMTD) in deg C.

question: In turning, cutting speed = 160 m/min, feed = 0.18 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.8 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 160, f = 0.18, d = 2.8 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*160*0.18*2.8 | Answer: 80640 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 300 mm is turned at 750 rpm with a feed of 0.27 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 300, N = 750, f = 0.27 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 300 / (0.27*750) | Answer: 1.481 min

question: A resistor of 44 ohm carries a current of 2.9 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 44, I = 2.9 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 2.9 * 44 | Answer: 127.6 V

question: Three resistors 65 ohm, 45 ohm and 29 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 65, R2 = 45, R3 = 29 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 65 + 45 + 29 | Answer: 139 ohm

question: Two resistors 97 ohm and 12 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 97, R2 = 12 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 97*12 / (97+12) | Answer: 10.68 ohm

question: A device draws 11.9 A at 215 V. Find the power consumed.

question: A current of 7.2 A flows through a 81 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.

question: Two capacitors 23.5 uF and 2.7 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 23.5, C2 = 2.7 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 23.5*2.7 / (23.5+2.7) | Answer: 2.422 uF

question: A resistor 57 kohm and capacitor 1.4 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 57, C = 1.4 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (57k)(1.4u) = 79.8 ms | Answer: 79.8 ms

question: An inductor 385.2 mH is in series with 136 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 385.2, R = 136 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (385.2e-3) / 136 | Answer: 2.832 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 90.3 mH inductor at 730 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 90.3, f = 730 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (730)(90.3e-3) | Answer: 414.2 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 12.5 uF capacitor at 570 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 12.5, f = 570 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (570)(12.5e-6)) | Answer: 22.34 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 15 ohm, XL = 82 ohm and XC = 27 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 15, XL = 82, XC = 27 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(15^2 + (82 - 27)^2) | Answer: 57.01 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 91.3 mH and C = 1.7 uF (in Hz).

question: A capacitor of 73 uF is charged to 200 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 73, V = 200 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*73e-6*(200)^2 | Answer: 1460 mJ

question: An alternating voltage has a peak value of 102 V. Find its RMS value.

question: A transformer has primary voltage 390 V with 1000 primary turns and 160 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 390, N1 = 1000, N2 = 160 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 390 * 160/1000 | Answer: 62.4 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 190 V and draws an armature current of 14 A. If the armature resistance is 1.48 ohm, find the back EMF.

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 65 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.84. Find the total real power in kW.

question: A machine delivers 100 kW output while drawing 152 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 25 V across R1 = 33 ohm and R2 = 48 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 30 kohm and Rin = 12 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 130 kohm and Rg = 47 kohm. Find the voltage gain.

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9013. Express the gain in decibels (power).

question: A first-order system has a time constant of 4.1 s. Find the time (in s) to reach 63.2% of its final value.

question: A signal is sampled at 142 kHz. According to the Nyquist criterion, what is the maximum signal frequency that can be represented (in kHz)?

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.1 m carries a central point load of 110 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.

question: A simply supported beam of span 8 m carries a UDL of 10 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8, w = 10 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 10*(8)^2 / 8 | Answer: 80 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 3.5 m carries a point load 55 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.5, W = 55 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 55*3.5 | Answer: 192.5 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.1 m carries a UDL of 36 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.1, w = 36 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 36*(5.1)^2 / 2 | Answer: 468.2 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 8 m carries a point load 85 kN at distance 2.5 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 8, a = 2.5, W = 85 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 85*(8 - 2.5) / 8 | Answer: 58.44 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 5.8 m) carries a central point load 75 kN. With E = 30 GPa and I = 480e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.

question: A fixed beam of span 4.9 m carries a UDL of 21 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.9, w = 21 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 21*(4.9)^2 / 12 | Answer: 42.02 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 360 mm, clear cover 30 mm and main bars of diameter 25 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 360, c = 30, dia = 25 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 360 - 30 - 25/2 | Answer: 317.5 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 35.1 m^2 carrying a factored load of 17.7 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.

question: For a bar of diameter 16 mm with design bond stress 2.1 MPa and steel stress 435 MPa, find the development length in mm.

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 5.5 m, unit weight 16 kN/m^3, phi = 32 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).

question: At a depth of 10 m in a saturated soil (saturated unit weight 21 kN/m^3, water table at surface), find the effective vertical stress in kPa (gamma_w = 9.81).

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 1.5e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.5, area = 6.8e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.

question: For a design speed of 80 km/h with allowable superelevation 0.08 and lateral friction 0.12, find the minimum curve radius in m.

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 190 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.15 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 6 days.

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.33, rainfall intensity 95 mm/h over a catchment of 23.3 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.06 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 600 m with this tape.

question: A file of 290 megabits is sent over a link of 43 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 290, B = 43 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 290 / 43 | Answer: 6.744 s

question: A link has bandwidth 24 Mbps and round-trip time 130 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 24, R = 130 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 24e6 * 130e-3 bits = 3120 kb | Answer: 3120 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.82, cache access time 1 ns and main-memory access time 160 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.82, tc = 1, tm = 160 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.82*1 + (1 - 0.82)*160 | Answer: 29.62 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 805032 elements?

question: An O(n^2) algorithm performs c*n^2 basic operations. If c = 1 and n = 1330, how many operations are performed?

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.02, memory access time 130 ns and page-fault service time 10 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.8 m^3 at 490 kPa and 530 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.8, P = 490, Tk = 530 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (490e3)*2.8 / (8.314*530) | Answer: 311.4 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.26 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 3 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.26, t = 3 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.26*3) | Answer: 0.5416

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.16 /min) is to reach 55% conversion in a plug-flow reactor. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.16, X = 55 | Formula: tau = -ln(1 - X) / k | Substitute: tau = -ln(1 - 0.55) / 0.16 | Answer: 4.991 min

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.35 /min) reaches 80% conversion in a CSTR. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.35, X = 80 | Formula: tau = X / (k (1 - X)) | Substitute: tau = 0.8 / (0.35*(1 - 0.8)) | Answer: 11.43 min

question: For a reaction with A = 3e10 /s and activation energy 60 kJ/mol at 420 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 3, Ea = 60, Tk = 420 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 3e10 * exp(-60e3 / (8.314*420)) | Answer: 1035 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.93 and bottoms xW = 0.03, with relative volatility alpha = 2. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.93, xw = 0.03, al = 2 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.93/0.07)(0.97/0.03)] / ln(2) | Answer: 8.747 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.74 and x = 0.24. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.75 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 115 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.

question: A stream of 9.3 kg/s with specific heat 1.5 kJ/kg-K is heated through 50 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.

question: A reactor of volume 1.7 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 0.5 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 1.7, Q = 0.5 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 1.7 / 0.5 | Answer: 3.4 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 3.6e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 4 mm with a concentration difference of 160 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 3.6, L = 4, dC = 160 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (3.6e-9)*160 / (4e-3) | Answer: 144 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 8.4 min and steady-state gain 1.8. For a step input of magnitude 8, find the final (steady-state) change in output.

question: A reactor operates at a space time of 14.8 min. Find its space velocity in per hour.

question: An aircraft wing of area 15 m^2 flies at 170 m/s (air density 0.4 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.6. Find the lift force in kN.

question: An aircraft of wing area 40 m^2 flies at 150 m/s (density 1 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.09. Find the drag force in kN.

question: Find the dynamic pressure for air of density 1 kg/m^3 moving at 220 m/s, in Pa.

question: An aircraft flies at 470 m/s where the speed of sound is 340 m/s. Find the Mach number.

question: A specimen under stress 210 MPa shows an elastic strain of 0.9e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.

question: A block of mass 35 kg has a volume of 3.5e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.

question: A rod of length 2400 mm is heated through 40 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 60 ohm, R2 = 10 ohm and R3 = 490 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).

question: A measurement reads 10.18 when the true value is 20. Find the percentage error.

question: Annual demand is 1500 units, ordering cost 120 per order and holding cost 11 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).

question: An asset costs 390000 with salvage value 20000 after 18 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.

question: A product sells for 240 per unit with variable cost 100 per unit and fixed costs 65000. Find the break-even quantity in units.

question: Find the present worth of 20000 received 7 years from now at an interest rate of 6% per year.

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.98, 0.94 and 0.98 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.

question: A process produces 31 defective items in a batch of 18500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).

question: Find the distance between the points (6, 2) and (8, -5).

question: Evaluate the number of combinations C(19, 12).

question: Find the 15th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 3 and common difference -2.

question: Find the 3th term of a geometric progression with first term 6 and common ratio 2.

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 14500 at 8.6% per annum for 8 years.

question: Find the amount when 24000 is invested at 5.7% per annum compounded annually for 2 years.
