solution: Given: h = 26 | Formula: p = rho g h | Substitute: p = 1000*9.81*26 / 1000 | Answer: 255.1 kPa

question: Water issues from an orifice under a head of 2.4 m. Taking Cv = 0.99, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 2.4, cv = 0.99 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.99*sqrt(2*9.81*2.4) | Answer: 6.793 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 400 mm) water flows at 0.6 m/s. It contracts to diameter 70 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 400, d2 = 70, V1 = 0.6 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 0.6*(400/70)^2 | Answer: 19.59 m/s

question: Water flows at 3 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.47 m and length 460 m. With friction factor f = 0.023, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 39 teeth drives a gear of 119 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1200 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 39, z2 = 119, N1 = 1200 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1200*39 / 119 | Answer: 393.3 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 120 mm rotates at 900 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 120, N = 900 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.12)*900 / 60 | Answer: 5.655 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 29 kW at 1300 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 29, N = 1300 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(29*1000) / (2*pi*1300) | Answer: 213 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 3 kg rotates at radius 0.53 m at 250 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 7600 N/m and mass 7.4 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 7600, m = 7.4 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(7600/7.4) | Answer: 5.1 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 1.4 m^2 and thickness 0.1 m has conductivity k = 6.3 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 170 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 1.4, L = 0.1, k = 6.3, dT = 170 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 6.3*1.4*170 / 0.1 | Answer: 14994 W

question: A surface of area 2 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 140 W/m^2-K to surroundings 70 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 2, h = 140, dT = 70 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 140*2*70 | Answer: 19600 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 220 m/min, feed = 0.45 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.1 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 220, f = 0.45, d = 2.1 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*220*0.45*2.1 | Answer: 207900 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 130 mm is turned at 600 rpm with a feed of 0.28 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 130, N = 600, f = 0.28 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 130 / (0.28*600) | Answer: 0.7738 min

question: A resistor of 102 ohm carries a current of 6.6 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 102, I = 6.6 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 6.6 * 102 | Answer: 673.2 V

question: Three resistors 82 ohm, 60 ohm and 93 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 82, R2 = 60, R3 = 93 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 82 + 60 + 93 | Answer: 235 ohm

question: Two resistors 41 ohm and 51 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 41, R2 = 51 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 41*51 / (41+51) | Answer: 22.73 ohm

question: A device draws 9.2 A at 235 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 235, I = 9.2 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 235 * 9.2 | Answer: 2162 W

question: A current of 11.1 A flows through a 109 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 11.1, R = 109 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (11.1)^2 * 109 | Answer: 1343 W

question: Two capacitors 12.4 uF and 6 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 12.4, C2 = 6 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 12.4*6 / (12.4+6) | Answer: 4.043 uF

question: A resistor 32 kohm and capacitor 2.9 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 32, C = 2.9 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (32k)(2.9u) = 92.8 ms | Answer: 92.8 ms

question: An inductor 24.9 mH is in series with 145 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 24.9, R = 145 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (24.9e-3) / 145 | Answer: 0.1717 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 109.5 mH inductor at 490 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 109.5, f = 490 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (490)(109.5e-3) | Answer: 337.1 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 29.7 uF capacitor at 980 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 29.7, f = 980 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (980)(29.7e-6)) | Answer: 5.468 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 66 ohm, XL = 45 ohm and XC = 28 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 66, XL = 45, XC = 28 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(66^2 + (45 - 28)^2) | Answer: 68.15 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 29.9 mH and C = 0.9 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 29.9, C = 0.9 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(29.9e-3 * 0.9e-6)) | Answer: 970.2 Hz

question: A capacitor of 5.3 uF is charged to 120 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 5.3, V = 120 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*5.3e-6*(120)^2 | Answer: 38.16 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 270 V with 510 primary turns and 150 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 270, N1 = 510, N2 = 150 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 270 * 150/510 | Answer: 79.41 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 300 V and draws an armature current of 43 A. If the armature resistance is 0.25 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 300, Ia = 43, Ra = 0.25 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 300 - 43*0.25 | Answer: 289.2 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 155 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.86. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 155, VL = 433, pf = 0.86 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*155*0.86 / 1000 | Answer: 99.97 kW

question: A load has real power 10 kW and apparent power 55 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 10, S = 55 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 10 / 55 | Answer: 0.1818

question: A machine delivers 40 kW output while drawing 57 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 40, Pi = 57 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 40/57 * 100 | Answer: 70.18 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 9 V across R1 = 21 ohm and R2 = 3 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 9, R1 = 21, R2 = 3 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 9*3 / (21+3) | Answer: 1.125 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 220 kohm and Rin = 36 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 220, Rin = 36 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 220 / 36 | Answer: 6.111

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 80 kohm and Rg = 26 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 80, Rg = 26 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 80/26 | Answer: 4.077

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 3260. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 3260 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(3260) | Answer: 35.13 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.5 m carries a central point load of 120 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 9.5, W = 120 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 120*9.5 / 4 | Answer: 285 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.4 m carries a UDL of 35 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 9.4, w = 35 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 35*(9.4)^2 / 8 | Answer: 386.6 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 3 m carries a point load 70 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3, W = 70 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 70*3 | Answer: 210 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 4.8 m carries a UDL of 4 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.8, w = 4 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 4*(4.8)^2 / 2 | Answer: 46.08 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.9 m carries a point load 85 kN at distance 2.5 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 6.9, a = 2.5, W = 85 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 85*(6.9 - 2.5) / 6.9 | Answer: 54.2 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 3.9 m) carries a central point load 75 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 390e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=75000 N, L=3900.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=390e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 9.506 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 8 m carries a UDL of 15 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8, w = 15 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 15*(8)^2 / 12 | Answer: 80 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 590 mm, clear cover 45 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 590, c = 45, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 590 - 45 - 12/2 | Answer: 539 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 30.1 m^2 carrying a factored load of 14.6 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 30.1, w = 14.6 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 14.6 * 30.1 | Answer: 439.5 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 6.2 m, unit weight 19 kN/m^3, phi = 28 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: At a depth of 5.1 m in a saturated soil (saturated unit weight 21 kN/m^3, water table at surface), find the effective vertical stress in kPa (gamma_w = 9.81).
solution: Given: z = 5.1, g = 21 | Formula: sigma' = (gamma_sat - gamma_w) z | Substitute: sigma' = (21 - 9.81)*5.1 | Answer: 57.07 kPa

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 5.3e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1.3, area = 7.2e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 5.3, i = 1.3, A = 7.2 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (5.3e-4)*1.3*(7.2e-3) | Answer: 4961 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.9 m, bed slope 0.002 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.021. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.6 m under a head of 0.8 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.2 m wide carries a discharge of 11.4 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 240 m and design speed 75 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 240, V = 75 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (75)^2 / (127*240) | Answer: 0.1845
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 850 m^3 treats a flow of 100 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 850, Q = 100 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 850 / 100 | Answer: 8.5 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 330 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.17 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 7 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 330, k = 0.17, t = 7 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 330*(1 - e^(-0.17*7)) | Answer: 229.6 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.45, rainfall intensity 115 mm/h over a catchment of 12.7 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.45, i = 115, A = 12.7 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.45*115*12.7 / 360 | Answer: 1.826 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.05 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 330 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.05, M = 330 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 330*(30+0.05)/30 | Answer: 330.6 m

question: Convert the decimal number 1653 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 1653 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 675 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 00110010 and 11111011.
solution: XOR: 11001001 | Count of 1s = 4 | Answer: 4
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 580 megabits is sent over a link of 8 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 580, B = 8 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 580 / 8 | Answer: 72.5 s

question: A link has bandwidth 35 Mbps and round-trip time 130 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 35, R = 130 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 35e6 * 130e-3 bits = 4550 kb | Answer: 4550 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.92, cache access time 1 ns and main-memory access time 130 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.92, tc = 1, tm = 130 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.92*1 + (1 - 0.92)*130 | Answer: 11.32 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 835270 elements?
solution: Given: n = 835270 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(835270)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: An O(n^2) algorithm performs c*n^2 basic operations. If c = 1 and n = 2610, how many operations are performed?
solution: Given: n = 2610 | Formula: operations = n^2 | Substitute: = (2610)^2 | Answer: 6812100

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.001, memory access time 150 ns and page-fault service time 7 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 7 ms = 7000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.001)*150 + 0.001*7000000.0 ns | Answer: 7.15 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 0.9 m^3 at 300 kPa and 360 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 0.9, P = 300, Tk = 360 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (300e3)*0.9 / (8.314*360) | Answer: 90.21 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.33 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 17 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.33, t = 17 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.33*17) | Answer: 0.9963

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.36 /min) is to reach 60% conversion in a plug-flow reactor. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.36, X = 60 | Formula: tau = -ln(1 - X) / k | Substitute: tau = -ln(1 - 0.6) / 0.36 | Answer: 2.545 min

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.27 /min) reaches 60% conversion in a CSTR. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.27, X = 60 | Formula: tau = X / (k (1 - X)) | Substitute: tau = 0.6 / (0.27*(1 - 0.6)) | Answer: 5.556 min

question: For a reaction with A = 1e10 /s and activation energy 55 kJ/mol at 440 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 1, Ea = 55, Tk = 440 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 1e10 * exp(-55e3 / (8.314*440)) | Answer: 2954 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.95 and bottoms xW = 0.05, with relative volatility alpha = 1.9. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.95, xw = 0.05, al = 1.9 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.95/0.05)(0.95/0.05)] / ln(1.9) | Answer: 9.175 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.7 and x = 0.31. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.7, x = 0.31 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.7/0.3) / (0.31/0.69) | Answer: 5.194

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.34 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 90 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.34, Psat = 90 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.34 * 90 | Answer: 30.6 kPa

question: A stream of 6.7 kg/s with specific heat 1.9 kJ/kg-K is heated through 110 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 6.7, cp = 1.9, dT = 110 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 6.7*1.9*110 | Answer: 14 kW

question: A reactor of volume 3.6 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 4.3 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 3.6, Q = 4.3 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 3.6 / 4.3 | Answer: 0.8372 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 2.1e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 4 mm with a concentration difference of 120 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 2.1, L = 4, dC = 120 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (2.1e-9)*120 / (4e-3) | Answer: 63 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 8.6 min and steady-state gain 0.5. For a step input of magnitude 16, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 8.6, K = 0.5, M = 16 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 0.5 * 16 | Answer: 8 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 45 m^2 flies at 110 m/s (air density 1.225 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.3. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 45, V = 110, rho = 1.225, CL = 1.3 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1.225*(110)^2*45*1.3 / 1000 | Answer: 433.6 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 90 m^2 flies at 160 m/s (density 0.7 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.04. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 90, V = 160, rho = 0.7, CD = 0.04 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.7*(160)^2*90*0.04 / 1000 | Answer: 32.26 kN

question: A specimen under stress 130 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.5e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 130, eps = 2.5 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 130 / (2.5e-3) MPa = 52 GPa | Answer: 52 GPa

question: A block of mass 29 kg has a volume of 2.1e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 29, V = 2.1 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 29 / (2.1e-3) | Answer: 1381 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2900 mm is heated through 140 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2900, dT = 140, al = 23 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2900*23e-6*140 | Answer: 9.338 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 185 ohm, R2 = 200 ohm and R3 = 170 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 185, R2 = 200, R3 = 170 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 200*170 / 185 | Answer: 183.8 ohm

question: A measurement reads 10.85 when the true value is 100. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 10.85, true = 100 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |10.85 - 100| / 100 * 100 | Answer: 89.15 %

question: Annual demand is 50000 units, ordering cost 280 per order and holding cost 39 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 50000, S = 280, H = 39 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*50000*280 / 39) | Answer: 847.3 units

question: An asset costs 460000 with salvage value 4000 after 15 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 460000, Sv = 4000, n = 15 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (460000 - 4000) / 15 | Answer: 30400 per year

question: A product sells for 490 per unit with variable cost 20 per unit and fixed costs 175000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 490, V = 20, F = 175000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 175000 / (490 - 20) | Answer: 372.3 units

question: Find the present worth of 135000 received 2 years from now at an interest rate of 7% per year.
solution: Given: F = 135000, n = 2, i = 7 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 135000 / (1 + 0.07)^2 | Answer: 117914 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.97, 0.92 and 0.98 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.97, r2 = 0.92, r3 = 0.98 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.97*0.92*0.98 | Answer: 0.8746

question: A process produces 6 defective items in a batch of 10500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 6, N = 10500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 6/10500 * 1e6 | Answer: 571.4 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = x^3 - x^2 + 3x - 3 evaluated at x = -1.
For f(x) = -5x^3 - 6x^2 - 8x + 8, find f''(x) at x = -5.
Evaluate the definite integral of (2x^2 - 3x + 2) dx from x = 0 to x = 4.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 2x^3/3 + -3x^2/2 + 2x | Evaluate F(4) - F(0) | Answer: 26.67
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 2x^2 + 11x + 2 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[5, 9], [-8, 7]].
solution: Given: a = 5, b = 9, c = -8, d = 7 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (5)(7) - (9)(-8) | Answer: 107

question: Find the determinant of [[5, -4, 2], [-2, 3, 5], [5, 1, 1]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -152

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[-4, -2], [-1, 8]].
solution: Trace tr = 4, Determinant = -34 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 8.164

question: Solve for x: 0x + -2y = -10 and 1x + 1y = 11.
solution: Determinant = 0*1 - -2*1 = 2 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 6 | Answer: x = 6
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 51, 87, 38, 21, 98.
solution: Sum = 295 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 59 | Answer: 59

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 26, 33, 50, 41, 4.

solution: Given: b = 97, h = 120 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 97*(120)^2 / 6 | Answer: 232800 mm^3

question: A component of ultimate strength 700 MPa is designed for a working stress of 60 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 700, sw = 60 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 700 / 60 | Answer: 11.67

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1450 mm and wall thickness 6 mm carries an internal pressure of 2 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.

question: A refrigerator works between 274 K (cold) and 306 K (hot). Find the maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 274, Th = 306 | Formula: COP_ref = Tc / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 274 / (306 - 274) | Answer: 8.562

question: A heat pump operates between 271 K and 332 K. Find its maximum (Carnot) COP.

question: 4.9 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 195 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.9, dT = 195 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 4.9 * 0.718 * 195 | Answer: 686 kJ

question: 5.1 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 165 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 5.1, dT = 165 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 5.1 * 1.005 * 165 | Answer: 845.7 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.1 m^3 at 300 K with mass 2.8 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).

formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 2.2 kg of air expands isothermally at 370 K from volume V1 to 5*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.2, Tk = 370, ratio = 5 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 2.2*0.287*370*ln(5) | Answer: 376 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.33 m. Find the Reynolds number.

question: Water flows at 1.9 m/s through a pipe of diameter 200 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.

question: Water issues from an orifice under a head of 3.6 m. Taking Cv = 0.98, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).

question: In a pipe (diameter 310 mm) water flows at 0.8 m/s. It contracts to diameter 90 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).

solution: Given: z1 = 27, z2 = 111, N1 = 800 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 800*27 / 111 | Answer: 194.6 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 270 mm rotates at 650 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 270, N = 650 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.27)*650 / 60 | Answer: 9.189 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 27.7 kW at 1300 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 27.7, N = 1300 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(27.7*1000) / (2*pi*1300) | Answer: 203.5 N-m

question: A plane wall of area 4.5 m^2 and thickness 0.28 m has conductivity k = 12 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 145 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 4.5, L = 0.28, k = 12, dT = 145 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 12*4.5*145 / 0.28 | Answer: 27964 W

question: A surface of area 0.9 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 190 W/m^2-K to surroundings 150 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.

question: In turning, cutting speed = 170 m/min, feed = 0.38 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.2 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.

question: A workpiece of length 300 mm is turned at 350 rpm with a feed of 0.31 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.

question: A resistor of 172 ohm carries a current of 6.1 A. Find the voltage across it.

question: Three resistors 54 ohm, 46 ohm and 68 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.

question: Two resistors 39 ohm and 109 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.

question: A device draws 9 A at 45 V. Find the power consumed.

question: Two capacitors 47.9 uF and 32.3 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 47.9, C2 = 32.3 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 47.9*32.3 / (47.9+32.3) | Answer: 19.29 uF

question: A resistor 37 kohm and capacitor 10.7 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 98.8 mH inductor at 920 Hz.

question: A capacitor of 10.2 uF is charged to 50 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.

question: A transformer has primary voltage 230 V with 440 primary turns and 450 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.

question: A DC motor is supplied at 290 V and draws an armature current of 12 A. If the armature resistance is 1.01 ohm, find the back EMF.

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 80 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.84. Find the total real power in kW.

question: A simply supported beam of span 9 m carries a central point load of 50 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.1 m carries a point load 25 kN at distance 1.5 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.

question: A fixed beam of span 9 m carries a UDL of 39 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.

question: An RC beam has overall depth 480 mm, clear cover 45 mm and main bars of diameter 16 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 480, c = 45, dia = 16 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 480 - 45 - 16/2 | Answer: 427 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 35.3 m^2 carrying a factored load of 11.9 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.6 m, bed slope 0.004 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.026. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.2 m under a head of 0.7 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 190 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.12 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 6 days.

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.38, rainfall intensity 120 mm/h over a catchment of 27.6 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.

question: A link has bandwidth 2 Mbps and round-trip time 40 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.8, cache access time 1 ns and main-memory access time 120 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.016, memory access time 180 ns and page-fault service time 3 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 1.9 m^3 at 190 kPa and 510 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.49 /min) is to reach 90% conversion in a plug-flow reactor. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.49, X = 90 | Formula: tau = -ln(1 - X) / k | Substitute: tau = -ln(1 - 0.9) / 0.49 | Answer: 4.699 min

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.21 /min) reaches 75% conversion in a CSTR. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.21, X = 75 | Formula: tau = X / (k (1 - X)) | Substitute: tau = 0.75 / (0.21*(1 - 0.75)) | Answer: 14.29 min

question: For a reaction with A = 6e10 /s and activation energy 80 kJ/mol at 500 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 6, Ea = 80, Tk = 500 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 6e10 * exp(-80e3 / (8.314*500)) | Answer: 263.2 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.96 and bottoms xW = 0.03, with relative volatility alpha = 2.5. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.96, xw = 0.03, al = 2.5 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.96/0.04)(0.97/0.03)] / ln(2.5) | Answer: 7.262 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.87 and x = 0.22. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.87, x = 0.22 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.87/0.13) / (0.22/0.78) | Answer: 23.73

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.82 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 80 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.82, Psat = 80 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.82 * 80 | Answer: 65.6 kPa

question: A stream of 9.5 kg/s with specific heat 2.2 kJ/kg-K is heated through 50 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 9.5, cp = 2.2, dT = 50 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 9.5*2.2*50 | Answer: 1045 kW

question: A reactor of volume 4.2 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 4.2 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 4.2, Q = 4.2 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 4.2 / 4.2 | Answer: 1 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 6.3e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 5 mm with a concentration difference of 100 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 6.3, L = 5, dC = 100 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (6.3e-9)*100 / (5e-3) | Answer: 126 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 2 min and steady-state gain 2. For a step input of magnitude 2, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 2, K = 2, M = 2 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 2 * 2 | Answer: 4 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 95 m^2 flies at 200 m/s (air density 0.4 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.4. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 95, V = 200, rho = 0.4, CL = 1.4 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.4*(200)^2*95*1.4 / 1000 | Answer: 1064 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 80 m^2 flies at 260 m/s (density 1 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.09. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 80, V = 260, rho = 1, CD = 0.09 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*1*(260)^2*80*0.09 / 1000 | Answer: 243.4 kN

question: A specimen under stress 200 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.6e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 200, eps = 2.6 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 200 / (2.6e-3) MPa = 76.92 GPa | Answer: 76.92 GPa

question: A block of mass 32 kg has a volume of 0.5e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 32, V = 0.5 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 32 / (0.5e-3) | Answer: 64000 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 1200 mm is heated through 65 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 11e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 1200, dT = 65, al = 11 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 1200*11e-6*65 | Answer: 0.858 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 200 ohm, R2 = 115 ohm and R3 = 85 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 200, R2 = 115, R3 = 85 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 115*85 / 200 | Answer: 48.88 ohm

question: A measurement reads 10.28 when the true value is 100. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 10.28, true = 100 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |10.28 - 100| / 100 * 100 | Answer: 89.72 %

question: Annual demand is 19500 units, ordering cost 300 per order and holding cost 2 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 19500, S = 300, H = 2 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*19500*300 / 2) | Answer: 2419 units

question: An asset costs 400000 with salvage value 8000 after 12 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 400000, Sv = 8000, n = 12 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (400000 - 8000) / 12 | Answer: 32667 per year

question: A product sells for 300 per unit with variable cost 90 per unit and fixed costs 190000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 300, V = 90, F = 190000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 190000 / (300 - 90) | Answer: 904.8 units

question: Find the present worth of 60000 received 5 years from now at an interest rate of 6% per year.
solution: Given: F = 60000, n = 5, i = 6 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 60000 / (1 + 0.06)^5 | Answer: 44835 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.92, 0.92 and 0.94 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.92, r2 = 0.92, r3 = 0.94 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.92*0.92*0.94 | Answer: 0.7956

question: A process produces 33 defective items in a batch of 16000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 33, N = 16000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 33/16000 * 1e6 | Answer: 2062 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 5x^3 - 7x^2 + 5x - 3 evaluated at x = 3.
For f(x) = -2x^3 - 7x^2 + 3x - 1, find f''(x) at x = 1.
Evaluate the definite integral of (x^2 + 4x - 5) dx from x = 1 to x = 3.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 1x^3/3 + 4x^2/2 + -5x | Evaluate F(3) - F(1) | Answer: 14.67
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 6x^2 + 2x - 11 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[2, -5], [-6, -2]].
solution: Given: a = 2, b = -5, c = -6, d = -2 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (2)(-2) - (-5)(-6) | Answer: -34

question: Find the determinant of [[6, -6, -2], [-4, 1, -5], [6, 5, 3]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 328

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[0, 8], [0, -7]].
solution: Trace tr = -7, Determinant = 0 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 0

question: Solve for x: 5x + -3y = 4 and 1x + 3y = 2.
solution: Determinant = 5*3 - -3*1 = 18 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 1 | Answer: x = 1
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 32, 35, 26, 62, 39.
solution: Sum = 194 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 38.8 | Answer: 38.8

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 27, 9, 17, 12, 11.
solution: Mean = 15.2 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 7.225

question: Find the slope of the line through (-7, -6) and (7, 3).
solution: Given: x1 = -7, y1 = -6, x2 = 7, y2 = 3 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (3 - -6) / (7 - -7) | Answer: 0.6429

question: Find the distance between the points (9, 6) and (6, -2).
solution: Given: x1 = 9, y1 = 6, x2 = 6, y2 = -2 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((-3)^2 + (-8)^2) | Answer: 8.544 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (7,8), (1,1), (2,-3).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 15.5 sq units

question: Find the 7th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -10 and common difference -1.
solution: Given: a = -10, d = -1, n = 7 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -10 + (7 - 1)*-1 | Answer: -16

question: Find the sum of the first 16 terms of an AP with first term -13 and common difference 3.
solution: Given: a = -13, d = 3, n = 16 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 16/2 [2*-13 + (16-1)*3] | Answer: 152

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 32000 at 12.2% per annum for 4 years.
solution: Given: P = 32000, R = 12.2, Tt = 4 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 32000 * 12.2 * 4 / 100 | Answer: 15616 currency units

question: Find the amount when 3500 is invested at 5.1% per annum compounded annually for 6 years.
solution: Given: P = 3500, R = 5.1, Tt = 6 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 3500 * (1 + 5.1/100)^6 | Answer: 4717 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (-8, -3, 0) and (-5, -7, 7).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (0, 3, 3) and (2, 1, -2).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 12.37

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (-4, 6, 6) and (0, 6, 6).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 25.24 degrees

question: Find the modulus of the complex number -12 + -4i.
solution: Given: a = -12, b = -4 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((-12)^2 + (-4)^2) | Answer: 12.65

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number -12 + 11i.
solution: Given: a = -12, b = 11 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(11, -12) | Answer: 137.5 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -5x^3 + 3x^2 - 9x + 7 at x = -2.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-59 with initial guess x0=13, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=0.5 and ordinates 4, 1, 6, 6, 6, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 192 and 365.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 192 and 365 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 13 and 27.
solution: Given: a = 13, b = 27 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 13*27 / 1 | Answer: 351
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 34 mm carries an axial tensile load of 106 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 12 mm and length 1100 mm carries an axial load of 72 kN. Take E = 210 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 64 mm transmits a torque of 2450 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 64, Tt = 2450 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2450*1000) / (pi*(64)^3) | Answer: 47.6 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 61 mm and length 1000 mm carries a torque of 1250 N-m. With G = 77 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 113 mm wide and 160 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 113, h = 160 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 113*(160)^2 / 6 | Answer: 482133 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (70 mm x 220 mm) carries a bending moment of 13 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (61 mm x 110 mm) has effective length 2100 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 470 MPa is designed for a working stress of 200 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 470, sw = 200 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 470 / 200 | Answer: 2.35

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1250 mm and wall thickness 9 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.6 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1250, t = 9, P = 1.6 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.6*1250 / (2*9) | Answer: 111.1 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 880 K and 320 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 880, Tc = 320 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 320/880) * 100 | Answer: 63.64 %

question: A refrigerator works between 264 K (cold) and 318 K (hot). Find the maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 264, Th = 318 | Formula: COP_ref = Tc / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 264 / (318 - 264) | Answer: 4.889

question: A heat pump operates between 275 K and 300 K. Find its maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 275, Th = 300 | Formula: COP_hp = Th / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 300 / (300 - 275) | Answer: 12

question: 4 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 70 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4, dT = 70 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 4 * 0.718 * 70 | Answer: 201 kJ

question: 4.6 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 145 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.6, dT = 145 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 4.6 * 1.005 * 145 | Answer: 670.3 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.6 m^3 at 390 K with mass 3 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 3.6, Tk = 390, m = 3 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 3*0.287*390 / 3.6 | Answer: 93.28 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 2.1 kg of air expands isothermally at 480 K from volume V1 to 2*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.1, Tk = 480, ratio = 2 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 2.1*0.287*480*ln(2) | Answer: 200.5 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.3 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.34 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.3, D = 0.34 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.3*0.34 / 0.001 | Answer: 1122000

question: Water flows at 1.2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 70 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 7 m. Taking Cv = 0.97, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 7, cv = 0.97 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.97*sqrt(2*9.81*7) | Answer: 11.37 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 310 mm) water flows at 2.1 m/s. It contracts to diameter 70 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 310, d2 = 70, V1 = 2.1 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2.1*(310/70)^2 | Answer: 41.19 m/s

question: Water flows at 1.6 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.5 m and length 320 m. With friction factor f = 0.026, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 30 teeth drives a gear of 62 teeth. If the pinion runs at 800 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 30, z2 = 62, N1 = 800 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 800*30 / 62 | Answer: 387.1 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 530 mm rotates at 500 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 530, N = 500 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.53)*500 / 60 | Answer: 13.88 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 10.7 kW at 800 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 10.7, N = 800 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(10.7*1000) / (2*pi*800) | Answer: 127.7 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 9.1 kg rotates at radius 0.51 m at 350 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 5100 N/m and mass 8 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 5100, m = 8 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(5100/8) | Answer: 4.018 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 6.7 m^2 and thickness 0.31 m has conductivity k = 47.6 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 185 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 6.7, L = 0.31, k = 47.6, dT = 185 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 47.6*6.7*185 / 0.31 | Answer: 190323 W

question: A surface of area 2.7 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 200 W/m^2-K to surroundings 75 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 2.7, h = 200, dT = 75 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 200*2.7*75 | Answer: 40500 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 160 m/min, feed = 0.38 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.2 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 160, f = 0.38, d = 2.2 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*160*0.38*2.2 | Answer: 133760 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 160 mm is turned at 1100 rpm with a feed of 0.39 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 160, N = 1100, f = 0.39 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 160 / (0.39*1100) | Answer: 0.373 min

question: A resistor of 172 ohm carries a current of 5.7 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 172, I = 5.7 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 5.7 * 172 | Answer: 980.4 V

question: Three resistors 24 ohm, 25 ohm and 45 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 24, R2 = 25, R3 = 45 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 24 + 25 + 45 | Answer: 94 ohm

question: Two resistors 79 ohm and 32 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 79, R2 = 32 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 79*32 / (79+32) | Answer: 22.77 ohm

question: A device draws 6.1 A at 180 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 180, I = 6.1 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 180 * 6.1 | Answer: 1098 W

question: A current of 0.3 A flows through a 85 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 0.3, R = 85 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (0.3)^2 * 85 | Answer: 7.65 W

question: Two capacitors 32.2 uF and 10.9 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 32.2, C2 = 10.9 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 32.2*10.9 / (32.2+10.9) | Answer: 8.143 uF

question: A resistor 78 kohm and capacitor 3.8 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 78, C = 3.8 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (78k)(3.8u) = 296.4 ms | Answer: 296.4 ms

question: An inductor 184.6 mH is in series with 87 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 184.6, R = 87 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (184.6e-3) / 87 | Answer: 2.122 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 26.4 mH inductor at 310 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 26.4, f = 310 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (310)(26.4e-3) | Answer: 51.42 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 28.7 uF capacitor at 550 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 28.7, f = 550 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (550)(28.7e-6)) | Answer: 10.08 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 43 ohm, XL = 139 ohm and XC = 51 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 43, XL = 139, XC = 51 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(43^2 + (139 - 51)^2) | Answer: 97.94 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 34.7 mH and C = 1.7 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 34.7, C = 1.7 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(34.7e-3 * 1.7e-6)) | Answer: 655.3 Hz

question: A capacitor of 78.2 uF is charged to 95 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 78.2, V = 95 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*78.2e-6*(95)^2 | Answer: 352.9 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 200 V with 770 primary turns and 380 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 200, N1 = 770, N2 = 380 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 200 * 380/770 | Answer: 98.7 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 350 V and draws an armature current of 38 A. If the armature resistance is 0.31 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 350, Ia = 38, Ra = 0.31 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 350 - 38*0.31 | Answer: 338.2 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 125 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.91. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 125, VL = 415, pf = 0.91 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*125*0.91 / 1000 | Answer: 81.76 kW

question: A load has real power 130 kW and apparent power 175 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 130, S = 175 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 130 / 175 | Answer: 0.7429

question: A machine delivers 125 kW output while drawing 177 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 125, Pi = 177 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 125/177 * 100 | Answer: 70.62 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 14 V across R1 = 16 ohm and R2 = 5 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 14, R1 = 16, R2 = 5 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 14*5 / (16+5) | Answer: 3.333 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 160 kohm and Rin = 16 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 160, Rin = 16 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 160 / 16 | Answer: 10

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 150 kohm and Rg = 25 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 150, Rg = 25 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 150/25 | Answer: 7

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 4770. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 4770 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(4770) | Answer: 36.79 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.3 m carries a central point load of 15 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6.3, W = 15 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 15*6.3 / 4 | Answer: 23.62 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 8.1 m carries a UDL of 5 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.1, w = 5 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 5*(8.1)^2 / 8 | Answer: 41.01 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.9 m carries a point load 55 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.9, W = 55 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 55*2.9 | Answer: 159.5 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 1.1 m carries a UDL of 14 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 1.1, w = 14 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 14*(1.1)^2 / 2 | Answer: 8.47 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.8 m carries a point load 100 kN at distance 1.4 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 6.8, a = 1.4, W = 100 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 100*(6.8 - 1.4) / 6.8 | Answer: 79.41 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 4.3 m) carries a central point load 80 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 330e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=80000 N, L=4300.0 mm, E=200000 MPa, I=330e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 2.008 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 8.6 m carries a UDL of 12 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.6, w = 12 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 12*(8.6)^2 / 12 | Answer: 73.96 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 380 mm, clear cover 40 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 380, c = 40, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 380 - 40 - 12/2 | Answer: 334 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 21.6 m^2 carrying a factored load of 12.7 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 21.6, w = 12.7 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 12.7 * 21.6 | Answer: 274.3 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 4.4 m, unit weight 20 kN/m^3, phi = 31 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: At a depth of 9.5 m in a saturated soil (saturated unit weight 21 kN/m^3, water table at surface), find the effective vertical stress in kPa (gamma_w = 9.81).
solution: Given: z = 9.5, g = 21 | Formula: sigma' = (gamma_sat - gamma_w) z | Substitute: sigma' = (21 - 9.81)*9.5 | Answer: 106.3 kPa

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 1.2e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.9, area = 7.3e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 1.2, i = 0.9, A = 7.3 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (1.2e-4)*0.9*(7.3e-3) | Answer: 788.4 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1.2 m, bed slope 0.003 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.019. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4.5 m under a head of 0.6 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 5.8 m wide carries a discharge of 27.6 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 490 m and design speed 80 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 490, V = 80 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (80)^2 / (127*490) | Answer: 0.1028
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 930 m^3 treats a flow of 110 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 930, Q = 110 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 930 / 110 | Answer: 8.455 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 160 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.22 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 7 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 160, k = 0.22, t = 7 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 160*(1 - e^(-0.22*7)) | Answer: 125.7 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.67, rainfall intensity 35 mm/h over a catchment of 24.3 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.67, i = 35, A = 24.3 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.67*35*24.3 / 360 | Answer: 1.583 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.04 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 770 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.04, M = 770 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 770*(20+0.04)/20 | Answer: 771.5 m

question: Convert the decimal number 2744 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 2744 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: AB8 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10111001 and 10011011.
solution: XOR: 00100010 | Count of 1s = 2 | Answer: 2
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 570 megabits is sent over a link of 81 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 570, B = 81 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 570 / 81 | Answer: 7.037 s

question: A link has bandwidth 61 Mbps and round-trip time 110 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 61, R = 110 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 61e6 * 110e-3 bits = 6710 kb | Answer: 6710 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.82, cache access time 8 ns and main-memory access time 120 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.82, tc = 8, tm = 120 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.82*8 + (1 - 0.82)*120 | Answer: 28.16 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 998978 elements?
solution: Given: n = 998978 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(998978)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.004, memory access time 160 ns and page-fault service time 6 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 6 ms = 6000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.004)*160 + 0.004*6000000.0 ns | Answer: 24.16 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.6 m^3 at 230 kPa and 350 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.6, P = 230, Tk = 350 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (230e3)*2.6 / (8.314*350) | Answer: 205.5 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.15 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 14 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.15, t = 14 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.15*14) | Answer: 0.8775

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.13 /min) is to reach 70% conversion in a plug-flow reactor. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.13, X = 70 | Formula: tau = -ln(1 - X) / k | Substitute: tau = -ln(1 - 0.7) / 0.13 | Answer: 9.261 min

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.27 /min) reaches 85% conversion in a CSTR. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.27, X = 85 | Formula: tau = X / (k (1 - X)) | Substitute: tau = 0.85 / (0.27*(1 - 0.85)) | Answer: 20.99 min

question: For a reaction with A = 5e10 /s and activation energy 65 kJ/mol at 380 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 5, Ea = 65, Tk = 380 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 5e10 * exp(-65e3 / (8.314*380)) | Answer: 58.05 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.95 and bottoms xW = 0.02, with relative volatility alpha = 3.1. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.95, xw = 0.02, al = 3.1 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.95/0.05)(0.98/0.02)] / ln(3.1) | Answer: 6.042 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.84 and x = 0.27. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.84, x = 0.27 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.84/0.16) / (0.27/0.73) | Answer: 14.19

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.38 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 110 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.38, Psat = 110 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.38 * 110 | Answer: 41.8 kPa

question: A stream of 1.1 kg/s with specific heat 2.7 kJ/kg-K is heated through 60 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 1.1, cp = 2.7, dT = 60 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 1.1*2.7*60 | Answer: 178.2 kW

question: A reactor of volume 5.5 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 1.9 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 5.5, Q = 1.9 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 5.5 / 1.9 | Answer: 2.895 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 6.4e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 3 mm with a concentration difference of 130 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 6.4, L = 3, dC = 130 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (6.4e-9)*130 / (3e-3) | Answer: 277.3 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 5 min and steady-state gain 1.4. For a step input of magnitude 19, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 5, K = 1.4, M = 19 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 1.4 * 19 | Answer: 26.6 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 35 m^2 flies at 70 m/s (air density 1 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.2. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 35, V = 70, rho = 1, CL = 1.2 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1*(70)^2*35*1.2 / 1000 | Answer: 102.9 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 75 m^2 flies at 160 m/s (density 1.225 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.05. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 75, V = 160, rho = 1.225, CD = 0.05 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*1.225*(160)^2*75*0.05 / 1000 | Answer: 58.8 kN

question: A specimen under stress 330 MPa shows an elastic strain of 0.8e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 330, eps = 0.8 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 330 / (0.8e-3) MPa = 412.5 GPa | Answer: 412.5 GPa

question: A block of mass 49 kg has a volume of 2.4e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 49, V = 2.4 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 49 / (2.4e-3) | Answer: 20417 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 1800 mm is heated through 140 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 1800, dT = 140, al = 23 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 1800*23e-6*140 | Answer: 5.796 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 95 ohm, R2 = 160 ohm and R3 = 165 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 95, R2 = 160, R3 = 165 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 160*165 / 95 | Answer: 277.9 ohm

question: A measurement reads 10.31 when the true value is 10. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 10.31, true = 10 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |10.31 - 10| / 10 * 100 | Answer: 3.1 %

question: Annual demand is 40000 units, ordering cost 220 per order and holding cost 21 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 40000, S = 220, H = 21 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*40000*220 / 21) | Answer: 915.5 units

question: An asset costs 180000 with salvage value 16000 after 8 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 180000, Sv = 16000, n = 8 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (180000 - 16000) / 8 | Answer: 20500 per year

question: A product sells for 200 per unit with variable cost 70 per unit and fixed costs 75000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 200, V = 70, F = 75000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 75000 / (200 - 70) | Answer: 576.9 units

question: Find the present worth of 40000 received 8 years from now at an interest rate of 10% per year.
solution: Given: F = 40000, n = 8, i = 10 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 40000 / (1 + 0.1)^8 | Answer: 1866 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.9, 0.92 and 0.93 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.9, r2 = 0.92, r3 = 0.93 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.9*0.92*0.93 | Answer: 0.77

question: A process produces 28 defective items in a batch of 9000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 28, N = 9000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 28/9000 * 1e6 | Answer: 3111 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 5x^3 - 2x^2 - x - 7 evaluated at x = 5.
For f(x) = 4x^3 - 6x^2 + 5x, find f''(x) at x = -2.
Evaluate the definite integral of (5x^2 + 6x + 2) dx from x = -1 to x = 4.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 5x^3/3 + 6x^2/2 + 2x | Evaluate F(4) - F(-1) | Answer: 163.3
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 2x^2 - 10x + 8 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[-3, 1], [-9, -4]].
solution: Given: a = -3, b = 1, c = -9, d = -4 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (-3)(-4) - (1)(-9) | Answer: 21

question: Find the determinant of [[4, 3, 1], [6, 6, -6], [-6, -6, 0]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -36

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[-1, -4], [-2, -8]].
solution: Trace tr = -9, Determinant = 0 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 0

question: Solve for x: -5x + 3y = 9 and -2x + -2y = -12.
solution: Determinant = -5*-2 - 3*-2 = 16 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 1.125 | Answer: x = 1.125
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 1, 23, 88, 37, 27.
solution: Sum = 176 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 35.2 | Answer: 35.2

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 32, 19, 24, 47, 12.
solution: Mean = 26.8 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 13.44

question: Find the slope of the line through (9, -8) and (6, 0).
solution: Given: x1 = 9, y1 = -8, x2 = 6, y2 = 0 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (0 - -8) / (6 - 9) | Answer: -2.667

question: Find the distance between the points (-2, -3) and (5, 4).
solution: Given: x1 = -2, y1 = -3, x2 = 5, y2 = 4 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((7)^2 + (7)^2) | Answer: 9.899 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-7,1), (5,8), (6,2).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 39.5 sq units

question: Find the 15th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 13 and common difference 3.
solution: Given: a = 13, d = 3, n = 15 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 13 + (15 - 1)*3 | Answer: 55

question: Find the sum of the first 20 terms of an AP with first term -6 and common difference 5.
solution: Given: a = -6, d = 5, n = 20 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 20/2 [2*-6 + (20-1)*5] | Answer: 830

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 23500 at 14.4% per annum for 4 years.
solution: Given: P = 23500, R = 14.4, Tt = 4 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 23500 * 14.4 * 4 / 100 | Answer: 13536 currency units

question: Find the amount when 2000 is invested at 4% per annum compounded annually for 6 years.
solution: Given: P = 2000, R = 4, Tt = 6 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 2000 * (1 + 4/100)^6 | Answer: 2531 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (-6, -1, -8) and (2, 2, -7).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (-4, -2, -2) and (-2, 6, 3).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 32.8

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (5, -1, -2) and (-5, 2, -4).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 121.1 degrees

question: Find the modulus of the complex number -10 + 11i.
solution: Given: a = -10, b = 11 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((-10)^2 + (11)^2) | Answer: 14.87

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number 8 + -8i.
solution: Given: a = 8, b = -8 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(-8, 8) | Answer: -45 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = 3x^3 - 5x^2 - 8x - 2 at x = 0.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-60 with initial guess x0=3, find x1 (one iteration).
solution: Given: N = 60, x0 = 3 | Formula: x1 = x0 - (x0^2 - N)/(2 x0) | Substitute: x1 = 3 - ((3)^2 - 60)/(2*3) | Answer: 11.5

question: Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.8 and ordinates 1, 1, 19, 3, 11, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 421 and 284.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 421 and 284 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 45 and 80.
solution: Given: a = 45, b = 80 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 45*80 / 5 | Answer: 720
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 54 mm carries an axial tensile load of 25 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 17 mm and length 800 mm carries an axial load of 60 kN. Take E = 210 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 36 mm transmits a torque of 450 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 36, Tt = 450 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(450*1000) / (pi*(36)^3) | Answer: 49.12 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 53 mm and length 1700 mm carries a torque of 600 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (53)^4 / 32 = 774646 mm^4 | theta = (600*1000)(1700) / (80000 * 774646) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.943 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 74 mm wide and 80 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 74, h = 80 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 74*(80)^2 / 6 | Answer: 78933 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (96 mm x 170 mm) carries a bending moment of 9 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (62 mm x 90 mm) has effective length 3900 mm and E = 200 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 410 MPa is designed for a working stress of 240 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 410, sw = 240 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 410 / 240 | Answer: 1.708

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 350 mm and wall thickness 20 mm carries an internal pressure of 0.9 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 350, t = 20, P = 0.9 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 0.9*350 / (2*20) | Answer: 7.875 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 640 K and 450 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 640, Tc = 450 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 450/640) * 100 | Answer: 29.69 %

question: A refrigerator works between 262 K (cold) and 328 K (hot). Find the maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 262, Th = 328 | Formula: COP_ref = Tc / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 262 / (328 - 262) | Answer: 3.97

question: A heat pump operates between 273 K and 320 K. Find its maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 273, Th = 320 | Formula: COP_hp = Th / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 320 / (320 - 273) | Answer: 6.809

question: 3.8 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 80 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.8, dT = 80 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 3.8 * 0.718 * 80 | Answer: 218.3 kJ

question: 7.9 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 105 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 7.9, dT = 105 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 7.9 * 1.005 * 105 | Answer: 833.6 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1.2 m^3 at 510 K with mass 4.4 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1.2, Tk = 510, m = 4.4 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 4.4*0.287*510 / 1.2 | Answer: 536.7 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 1.6 kg of air expands isothermally at 500 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.6, Tk = 500, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 1.6*0.287*500*ln(4) | Answer: 318.3 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 4.1 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.22 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 4.1, D = 0.22 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*4.1*0.22 / 0.001 | Answer: 902000

question: Water flows at 3.2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 170 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Find the gauge pressure at a depth of 5 m in water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, g = 9.81 m/s^2), in kPa.
