question: A workpiece of length 120 mm is turned at 1050 rpm with a feed of 0.36 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 120, N = 1050, f = 0.36 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 120 / (0.36*1050) | Answer: 0.3175 min

question: A resistor of 192 ohm carries a current of 1 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 192, I = 1 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 1 * 192 | Answer: 192 V

question: Three resistors 90 ohm, 72 ohm and 38 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 90, R2 = 72, R3 = 38 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 90 + 72 + 38 | Answer: 200 ohm

question: Two resistors 80 ohm and 80 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 80, R2 = 80 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 80*80 / (80+80) | Answer: 40 ohm

question: A device draws 12.7 A at 180 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 180, I = 12.7 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 180 * 12.7 | Answer: 2286 W

question: A current of 4.2 A flows through a 138 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 4.2, R = 138 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (4.2)^2 * 138 | Answer: 2434 W

question: Two capacitors 17.6 uF and 5.6 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 17.6, C2 = 5.6 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 17.6*5.6 / (17.6+5.6) | Answer: 4.248 uF

question: A resistor 73 kohm and capacitor 13.4 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 73, C = 13.4 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (73k)(13.4u) = 978.2 ms | Answer: 978.2 ms

question: An inductor 290.8 mH is in series with 151 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 290.8, R = 151 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (290.8e-3) / 151 | Answer: 1.926 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 136.6 mH inductor at 240 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 136.6, f = 240 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (240)(136.6e-3) | Answer: 206 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 9.3 uF capacitor at 430 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 9.3, f = 430 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (430)(9.3e-6)) | Answer: 39.8 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 36 ohm, XL = 126 ohm and XC = 89 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 36, XL = 126, XC = 89 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(36^2 + (126 - 89)^2) | Answer: 51.62 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 63.6 mH and C = 6.2 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 63.6, C = 6.2 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(63.6e-3 * 6.2e-6)) | Answer: 253.5 Hz

question: A capacitor of 4.1 uF is charged to 40 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 4.1, V = 40 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*4.1e-6*(40)^2 | Answer: 3.28 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 320 V with 510 primary turns and 410 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 320, N1 = 510, N2 = 410 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 320 * 410/510 | Answer: 257.3 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 380 V and draws an armature current of 10 A. If the armature resistance is 1 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 380, Ia = 10, Ra = 1 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 380 - 10*1 | Answer: 370 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 130 A at 400 V (line) with a power factor of 0.88. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 130, VL = 400, pf = 0.88 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*400*130*0.88 / 1000 | Answer: 79.26 kW

question: A load has real power 165 kW and apparent power 220 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 165, S = 220 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 165 / 220 | Answer: 0.75

question: A machine delivers 75 kW output while drawing 172 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 75, Pi = 172 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 75/172 * 100 | Answer: 43.6 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 21 V across R1 = 30 ohm and R2 = 27 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 21, R1 = 30, R2 = 27 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 21*27 / (30+27) | Answer: 9.947 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 30 kohm and Rin = 7 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 30, Rin = 7 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 30 / 7 | Answer: 4.286

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 180 kohm and Rg = 33 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 180, Rg = 33 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 180/33 | Answer: 6.455

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 811. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 811 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(811) | Answer: 29.09 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 6 m carries a central point load of 60 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6, W = 60 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 60*6 / 4 | Answer: 90 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.2 m carries a UDL of 50 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.2, w = 50 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 50*(4.2)^2 / 8 | Answer: 110.2 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2 m carries a point load 55 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2, W = 55 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 55*2 | Answer: 110 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 1.3 m carries a UDL of 34 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 1.3, w = 34 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 34*(1.3)^2 / 2 | Answer: 28.73 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.3 m carries a point load 30 kN at distance 3.7 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 5.3, a = 3.7, W = 30 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 30*(5.3 - 3.7) / 5.3 | Answer: 9.057 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 3.6 m) carries a central point load 25 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 120e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=25000 N, L=3600.0 mm, E=200000 MPa, I=120e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 1.012 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 8.8 m carries a UDL of 27 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.8, w = 27 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 27*(8.8)^2 / 12 | Answer: 174.2 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 300 mm, clear cover 45 mm and main bars of diameter 16 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 300, c = 45, dia = 16 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 300 - 45 - 16/2 | Answer: 247 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 34.4 m^2 carrying a factored load of 8.9 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 34.4, w = 8.9 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 8.9 * 34.4 | Answer: 306.2 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 6.4 m, unit weight 17 kN/m^3, phi = 32 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: At a depth of 8.6 m in a saturated soil (saturated unit weight 19 kN/m^3, water table at surface), find the effective vertical stress in kPa (gamma_w = 9.81).
solution: Given: z = 8.6, g = 19 | Formula: sigma' = (gamma_sat - gamma_w) z | Substitute: sigma' = (19 - 9.81)*8.6 | Answer: 79.03 kPa

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 3.2e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.5, area = 3.5e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 3.2, i = 0.5, A = 3.5 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (3.2e-4)*0.5*(3.5e-3) | Answer: 560 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1.1 m, bed slope 0.005 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.025. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 3 m under a head of 1.1 m. Taking Cd = 0.62 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.7 m wide carries a discharge of 8.1 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 360 m and design speed 85 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 360, V = 85 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (85)^2 / (127*360) | Answer: 0.158
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 350 m^3 treats a flow of 110 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 350, Q = 110 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 350 / 110 | Answer: 3.182 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 250 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.21 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 8 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 250, k = 0.21, t = 8 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 250*(1 - e^(-0.21*8)) | Answer: 203.4 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.79, rainfall intensity 80 mm/h over a catchment of 38.5 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.79, i = 80, A = 38.5 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.79*80*38.5 / 360 | Answer: 6.759 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.08 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 680 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.08, M = 680 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 680*(20+0.08)/20 | Answer: 682.7 m

question: Convert the decimal number 498 to hexadecimal (uppercase).

question: Convert the 8-bit binary number 01000011 to decimal.
solution: Binary 01000011 = sum of bit-weights | Answer: 67 (decimal)

question: A file of 820 megabits is sent over a link of 32 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 820, B = 32 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 820 / 32 | Answer: 25.62 s

question: A link has bandwidth 96 Mbps and round-trip time 70 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 96, R = 70 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 96e6 * 70e-3 bits = 6720 kb | Answer: 6720 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.88, cache access time 9 ns and main-memory access time 120 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.88, tc = 9, tm = 120 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.88*9 + (1 - 0.88)*120 | Answer: 22.32 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 609256 elements?
solution: Given: n = 609256 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(609256)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.014, memory access time 110 ns and page-fault service time 8 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 8 ms = 8000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.014)*110 + 0.014*8000000.0 ns | Answer: 112.1 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.5 m^3 at 330 kPa and 410 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.5, P = 330, Tk = 410 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (330e3)*2.5 / (8.314*410) | Answer: 242 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.32 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 20 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.32, t = 20 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.32*20) | Answer: 0.9983

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.38 /min) is to reach 90% conversion in a plug-flow reactor. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.38, X = 90 | Formula: tau = -ln(1 - X) / k | Substitute: tau = -ln(1 - 0.9) / 0.38 | Answer: 6.059 min

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.11 /min) reaches 50% conversion in a CSTR. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.11, X = 50 | Formula: tau = X / (k (1 - X)) | Substitute: tau = 0.5 / (0.11*(1 - 0.5)) | Answer: 9.091 min

question: For a reaction with A = 5e10 /s and activation energy 70 kJ/mol at 380 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 5, Ea = 70, Tk = 380 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 5e10 * exp(-70e3 / (8.314*380)) | Answer: 11.92 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.97 and bottoms xW = 0.08, with relative volatility alpha = 3. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.97, xw = 0.08, al = 3 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.97/0.03)(0.92/0.08)] / ln(3) | Answer: 5.387 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.65 and x = 0.25. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.65, x = 0.25 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.65/0.35) / (0.25/0.75) | Answer: 5.571

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.41 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 105 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.41, Psat = 105 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.41 * 105 | Answer: 43.05 kPa

question: A stream of 4.4 kg/s with specific heat 3.7 kJ/kg-K is heated through 50 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 4.4, cp = 3.7, dT = 50 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 4.4*3.7*50 | Answer: 814 kW

question: A reactor of volume 4 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 4.9 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 4, Q = 4.9 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 4 / 4.9 | Answer: 0.8163 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 5.6e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 2 mm with a concentration difference of 190 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 5.6, L = 2, dC = 190 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (5.6e-9)*190 / (2e-3) | Answer: 532 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 5.3 min and steady-state gain 1.6. For a step input of magnitude 2, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 5.3, K = 1.6, M = 2 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 1.6 * 2 | Answer: 3.2 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 55 m^2 flies at 220 m/s (air density 1.225 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 55, V = 220, rho = 1.225, CL = 1 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1.225*(220)^2*55*1 / 1000 | Answer: 163 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 90 m^2 flies at 170 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.02. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 90, V = 170, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.02 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(170)^2*90*0.02 / 1000 | Answer: 10.4 kN

question: A specimen under stress 220 MPa shows an elastic strain of 1e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 220, eps = 1 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 220 / (1e-3) MPa = 220 GPa | Answer: 220 GPa

question: A block of mass 44 kg has a volume of 0.6e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 44, V = 0.6 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 44 / (0.6e-3) | Answer: 73333 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2700 mm is heated through 120 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 11e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2700, dT = 120, al = 11 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2700*11e-6*120 | Answer: 3.564 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 135 ohm, R2 = 160 ohm and R3 = 430 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 135, R2 = 160, R3 = 430 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 160*430 / 135 | Answer: 509.6 ohm

question: A strain gauge of resistance 350 ohm and gauge factor 2 experiences a strain of 350e-6. Find the change in resistance in milliohms.
solution: Given: R = 350, GF = 2, eps = 350 | Formula: dR = R * GF * strain | Substitute: dR = 350*2*350e-6 | Answer: 245 milliohm

question: A measurement reads 10.42 when the true value is 100. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 10.42, true = 100 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |10.42 - 100| / 100 * 100 | Answer: 89.58 %

question: Annual demand is 32500 units, ordering cost 260 per order and holding cost 10 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 32500, S = 260, H = 10 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*32500*260 / 10) | Answer: 1300 units

question: An asset costs 450000 with salvage value 12000 after 18 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 450000, Sv = 12000, n = 18 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (450000 - 12000) / 18 | Answer: 24333 per year

question: A product sells for 350 per unit with variable cost 180 per unit and fixed costs 150000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 350, V = 180, F = 150000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 150000 / (350 - 180) | Answer: 882.4 units

question: Find the present worth of 140000 received 4 years from now at an interest rate of 5% per year.
solution: Given: F = 140000, n = 4, i = 5 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 140000 / (1 + 0.05)^4 | Answer: 115178 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.96, 0.98 and 0.91 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.96, r2 = 0.98, r3 = 0.91 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.96*0.98*0.91 | Answer: 0.8561

question: A process produces 37 defective items in a batch of 4000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 37, N = 4000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 37/4000 * 1e6 | Answer: 9250 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = x^3 - 3x^2 + 7x + 6 evaluated at x = 1.
For f(x) = -6x^3 + 4x^2 - 3, find f''(x) at x = 4.

question: Find the larger real root of 4x^2 - 7x - 9 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[-2, 8], [-8, -7]].
solution: Given: a = -2, b = 8, c = -8, d = -7 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (-2)(-7) - (8)(-8) | Answer: 78

solution: Trace tr = -2, Determinant = -66 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 7.185

question: Solve for x: 2x + 1y = 3 and -2x + 0y = 12.
solution: Determinant = 2*0 - 1*-2 = 2 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -6 | Answer: x = -6

solution: Mean = 21 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 10.56

question: Find the slope of the line through (-8, 0) and (0, -1).
solution: Given: x1 = -8, y1 = 0, x2 = 0, y2 = -1 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (-1 - 0) / (0 - -8) | Answer: -0.125

question: Find the distance between the points (-2, 1) and (-3, -7).
solution: Given: x1 = -2, y1 = 1, x2 = -3, y2 = -7 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((-1)^2 + (-8)^2) | Answer: 8.062 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-5,-1), (0,-2), (3,0).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 6.5 sq units

question: Find the 17th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 0 and common difference -2.
solution: Given: a = 0, d = -2, n = 17 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 0 + (17 - 1)*-2 | Answer: -32

question: Find the sum of the first 36 terms of an AP with first term -9 and common difference -1.
solution: Given: a = -9, d = -1, n = 36 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 36/2 [2*-9 + (36-1)*-1] | Answer: -954

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 2500 at 8.6% per annum for 9 years.
solution: Given: P = 2500, R = 8.6, Tt = 9 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 2500 * 8.6 * 9 / 100 | Answer: 1935 currency units

question: Find the amount when 26500 is invested at 8.9% per annum compounded annually for 5 years.
solution: Given: P = 26500, R = 8.9, Tt = 5 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 26500 * (1 + 8.9/100)^5 | Answer: 40587 currency units

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (0, -5, -1) and (-2, 3, 3).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 138.8 degrees

question: Find the modulus of the complex number -3 + -12i.
solution: Given: a = -3, b = -12 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((-3)^2 + (-12)^2) | Answer: 12.37

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number -4 + 0i.
solution: Given: a = -4, b = 0 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(0, -4) | Answer: 180 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = 5x^3 - 5x^2 + 3x + 5 at x = 0.
solution: Given: a = 5, b = -5, c = 3, d = 5, x0 = 0 | Formula: f(x0) = a x0^3 + b x0^2 + c x0 + d | Substitute: f(0) = 5(0)^3 + -5(0)^2 + 3(0) + 5 | Answer: 5

question: Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-167 with initial guess x0=5, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1 and ordinates 6, 15, 12, 17, 17, estimate the integral.

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 15 and 76.
solution: Given: a = 15, b = 76 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 15*76 / 1 | Answer: 1140

question: A circular rod of diameter 23 mm carries an axial tensile load of 108 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 39 mm and length 2200 mm carries an axial load of 61 kN. Take E = 210 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 41 mm transmits a torque of 2900 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 41, Tt = 2900 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2900*1000) / (pi*(41)^3) | Answer: 214.3 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 44 mm and length 1400 mm carries a torque of 1400 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (44)^4 / 32 = 367968 mm^4 | theta = (1400*1000)(1400) / (80000 * 367968) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 3.815 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 110 mm wide and 210 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 110, h = 210 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 110*(210)^2 / 6 | Answer: 808500 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (119 mm x 100 mm) carries a bending moment of 18 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (31 mm x 130 mm) has effective length 1900 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 570 MPa is designed for a working stress of 90 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 570, sw = 90 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 570 / 90 | Answer: 6.333

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1250 mm and wall thickness 20 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.8 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1250, t = 20, P = 1.8 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.8*1250 / (2*20) | Answer: 56.25 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 680 K and 420 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 680, Tc = 420 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 420/680) * 100 | Answer: 38.24 %

question: A refrigerator works between 260 K (cold) and 314 K (hot). Find the maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 260, Th = 314 | Formula: COP_ref = Tc / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 260 / (314 - 260) | Answer: 4.815

question: A heat pump operates between 271 K and 328 K. Find its maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 271, Th = 328 | Formula: COP_hp = Th / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 328 / (328 - 271) | Answer: 5.754

question: 3.8 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 150 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.8, dT = 150 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 3.8 * 0.718 * 150 | Answer: 409.3 kJ

question: 7.7 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 45 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 7.7, dT = 45 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 7.7 * 1.005 * 45 | Answer: 348.2 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.5 m^3 at 470 K with mass 4.2 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 3.5, Tk = 470, m = 4.2 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 4.2*0.287*470 / 3.5 | Answer: 161.9 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4.8 kg of air expands isothermally at 480 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.8, Tk = 480, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4.8*0.287*480*ln(4) | Answer: 916.7 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.17 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.2, D = 0.17 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.2*0.17 / 0.001 | Answer: 544000

question: Water flows at 3.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 210 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 10.6 m. Taking Cv = 0.97, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 10.6, cv = 0.97 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.97*sqrt(2*9.81*10.6) | Answer: 13.99 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 290 mm) water flows at 2.6 m/s. It contracts to diameter 50 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 290, d2 = 50, V1 = 2.6 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2.6*(290/50)^2 | Answer: 87.46 m/s

question: Water flows at 2.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.12 m and length 200 m. With friction factor f = 0.03, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 23 teeth drives a gear of 106 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1500 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 23, z2 = 106, N1 = 1500 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1500*23 / 106 | Answer: 325.5 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 320 mm rotates at 1150 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 320, N = 1150 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.32)*1150 / 60 | Answer: 19.27 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 4.9 kW at 1050 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 4.9, N = 1050 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(4.9*1000) / (2*pi*1050) | Answer: 44.56 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 7.9 kg rotates at radius 0.33 m at 800 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 10400 N/m and mass 7.7 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 10400, m = 7.7 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(10400/7.7) | Answer: 5.849 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 9.1 m^2 and thickness 0.23 m has conductivity k = 32.6 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 200 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 9.1, L = 0.23, k = 32.6, dT = 200 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 32.6*9.1*200 / 0.23 | Answer: 257965 W

question: A surface of area 4.7 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 50 W/m^2-K to surroundings 115 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 4.7, h = 50, dT = 115 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 50*4.7*115 | Answer: 27025 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 140 m/min, feed = 0.47 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.4 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 140, f = 0.47, d = 1.4 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*140*0.47*1.4 | Answer: 92120 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 310 mm is turned at 350 rpm with a feed of 0.18 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 310, N = 350, f = 0.18 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 310 / (0.18*350) | Answer: 4.921 min

question: A resistor of 200 ohm carries a current of 8.1 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 200, I = 8.1 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 8.1 * 200 | Answer: 1620 V

question: Three resistors 98 ohm, 76 ohm and 32 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 98, R2 = 76, R3 = 32 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 98 + 76 + 32 | Answer: 206 ohm

question: Two resistors 86 ohm and 43 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 86, R2 = 43 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 86*43 / (86+43) | Answer: 28.67 ohm

question: A device draws 12.4 A at 110 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 110, I = 12.4 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 110 * 12.4 | Answer: 1364 W

question: A current of 9 A flows through a 79 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 9, R = 79 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (9)^2 * 79 | Answer: 6399 W

question: Two capacitors 12.3 uF and 31.5 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 12.3, C2 = 31.5 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 12.3*31.5 / (12.3+31.5) | Answer: 8.846 uF

question: A resistor 29 kohm and capacitor 18 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 29, C = 18 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (29k)(18u) = 522 ms | Answer: 522 ms

question: An inductor 365.4 mH is in series with 191 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 365.4, R = 191 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (365.4e-3) / 191 | Answer: 1.913 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 23.1 mH inductor at 310 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 23.1, f = 310 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (310)(23.1e-3) | Answer: 44.99 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 2.2 uF capacitor at 110 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 2.2, f = 110 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (110)(2.2e-6)) | Answer: 657.7 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 55 ohm, XL = 22 ohm and XC = 97 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 55, XL = 22, XC = 97 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(55^2 + (22 - 97)^2) | Answer: 93.01 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 38.8 mH and C = 7.3 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 38.8, C = 7.3 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(38.8e-3 * 7.3e-6)) | Answer: 299 Hz

question: A capacitor of 77 uF is charged to 300 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 77, V = 300 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*77e-6*(300)^2 | Answer: 3465 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 200 V with 830 primary turns and 50 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 200, N1 = 830, N2 = 50 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 200 * 50/830 | Answer: 12.05 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 190 V and draws an armature current of 34 A. If the armature resistance is 0.82 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 190, Ia = 34, Ra = 0.82 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 190 - 34*0.82 | Answer: 162.1 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 55 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.76. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 55, VL = 433, pf = 0.76 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*55*0.76 / 1000 | Answer: 31.35 kW

question: A load has real power 110 kW and apparent power 115 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 110, S = 115 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 110 / 115 | Answer: 0.9565

question: A machine delivers 20 kW output while drawing 52 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 20, Pi = 52 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 20/52 * 100 | Answer: 38.46 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 25 V across R1 = 40 ohm and R2 = 10 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 25, R1 = 40, R2 = 10 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 25*10 / (40+10) | Answer: 5 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 150 kohm and Rin = 4 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 150, Rin = 4 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 150 / 4 | Answer: 37.5

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 80 kohm and Rg = 27 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 80, Rg = 27 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 80/27 | Answer: 3.963

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9766. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 9766 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(9766) | Answer: 39.9 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.6 m carries a central point load of 15 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 9.6, W = 15 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 15*9.6 / 4 | Answer: 36 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.3 m carries a UDL of 20 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.3, w = 20 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 20*(4.3)^2 / 8 | Answer: 46.22 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.1 m carries a point load 45 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.1, W = 45 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 45*5.1 | Answer: 229.5 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.2 m carries a UDL of 14 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.2, w = 14 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 14*(5.2)^2 / 2 | Answer: 189.3 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.8 m carries a point load 30 kN at distance 3.5 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 9.8, a = 3.5, W = 30 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 30*(9.8 - 3.5) / 9.8 | Answer: 19.29 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 4.3 m) carries a central point load 65 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 230e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=65000 N, L=4300.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=230e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 18.72 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 4 m carries a UDL of 39 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4, w = 39 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 39*(4)^2 / 12 | Answer: 52 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 610 mm, clear cover 25 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 610, c = 25, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 610 - 25 - 12/2 | Answer: 579 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 13.8 m^2 carrying a factored load of 12 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 13.8, w = 12 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 12 * 13.8 | Answer: 165.6 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 5.4 m, unit weight 18 kN/m^3, phi = 34 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: At a depth of 4.1 m in a saturated soil (saturated unit weight 19 kN/m^3, water table at surface), find the effective vertical stress in kPa (gamma_w = 9.81).
solution: Given: z = 4.1, g = 19 | Formula: sigma' = (gamma_sat - gamma_w) z | Substitute: sigma' = (19 - 9.81)*4.1 | Answer: 37.68 kPa

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 3.5e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.4, area = 2.2e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 3.5, i = 0.4, A = 2.2 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (3.5e-4)*0.4*(2.2e-3) | Answer: 308 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 2 m, bed slope 0.004 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.024. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 3.6 m under a head of 0.6 m. Taking Cd = 0.61 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 2.7 m wide carries a discharge of 28.1 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 540 m and design speed 45 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 540, V = 45 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (45)^2 / (127*540) | Answer: 0.02953
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 150 m^3 treats a flow of 20 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 150, Q = 20 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 150 / 20 | Answer: 7.5 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 380 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.31 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 5 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 380, k = 0.31, t = 5 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 380*(1 - e^(-0.31*5)) | Answer: 299.3 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.71, rainfall intensity 115 mm/h over a catchment of 54.2 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.71, i = 115, A = 54.2 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.71*115*54.2 / 360 | Answer: 12.29 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.01 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 670 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.01, M = 670 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 670*(30+0.01)/30 | Answer: 670.2 m

question: Convert the decimal number 279 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 279 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 117 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 00110011 and 11001000.
solution: XOR: 11111011 | Count of 1s = 7 | Answer: 7
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 260 megabits is sent over a link of 61 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 260, B = 61 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 260 / 61 | Answer: 4.262 s

question: A link has bandwidth 58 Mbps and round-trip time 10 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 58, R = 10 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 58e6 * 10e-3 bits = 580 kb | Answer: 580 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.98, cache access time 9 ns and main-memory access time 80 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.98, tc = 9, tm = 80 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.98*9 + (1 - 0.98)*80 | Answer: 10.42 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 369740 elements?
solution: Given: n = 369740 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(369740)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.003, memory access time 160 ns and page-fault service time 10 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 10 ms = 10000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.003)*160 + 0.003*10000000.0 ns | Answer: 30.16 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 1.9 m^3 at 130 kPa and 440 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 1.9, P = 130, Tk = 440 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (130e3)*1.9 / (8.314*440) | Answer: 67.52 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.1 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 5 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.1, t = 5 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.1*5) | Answer: 0.3935

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.22 /min) is to reach 50% conversion in a plug-flow reactor. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.22, X = 50 | Formula: tau = -ln(1 - X) / k | Substitute: tau = -ln(1 - 0.5) / 0.22 | Answer: 3.151 min

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.17 /min) reaches 70% conversion in a CSTR. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.17, X = 70 | Formula: tau = X / (k (1 - X)) | Substitute: tau = 0.7 / (0.17*(1 - 0.7)) | Answer: 13.73 min

question: For a reaction with A = 4e10 /s and activation energy 55 kJ/mol at 400 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 4, Ea = 55, Tk = 400 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 4e10 * exp(-55e3 / (8.314*400)) | Answer: 2627 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.92 and bottoms xW = 0.08, with relative volatility alpha = 3.4. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.92, xw = 0.08, al = 3.4 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.92/0.08)(0.92/0.08)] / ln(3.4) | Answer: 3.991 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.84 and x = 0.34. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.84, x = 0.34 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.84/0.16) / (0.34/0.66) | Answer: 10.19

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.58 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 55 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.58, Psat = 55 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.58 * 55 | Answer: 31.9 kPa

question: A stream of 1.1 kg/s with specific heat 1.4 kJ/kg-K is heated through 90 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 1.1, cp = 1.4, dT = 90 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 1.1*1.4*90 | Answer: 138.6 kW

question: A reactor of volume 12.3 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 3.3 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 12.3, Q = 3.3 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 12.3 / 3.3 | Answer: 3.727 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 3.8e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 1 mm with a concentration difference of 150 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 3.8, L = 1, dC = 150 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (3.8e-9)*150 / (1e-3) | Answer: 570 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 6.2 min and steady-state gain 2.3. For a step input of magnitude 20, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 6.2, K = 2.3, M = 20 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 2.3 * 20 | Answer: 46 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 55 m^2 flies at 190 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 55, V = 190, rho = 0.7, CL = 1 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.7*(190)^2*55*1 / 1000 | Answer: 694.9 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 85 m^2 flies at 100 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.08. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 85, V = 100, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.08 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(100)^2*85*0.08 / 1000 | Answer: 13.6 kN

question: A specimen under stress 230 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.3e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 230, eps = 2.3 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 230 / (2.3e-3) MPa = 100 GPa | Answer: 100 GPa

question: A block of mass 31 kg has a volume of 2.3e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 31, V = 2.3 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 31 / (2.3e-3) | Answer: 13478 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2200 mm is heated through 110 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 11e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2200, dT = 110, al = 11 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2200*11e-6*110 | Answer: 2.662 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 100 ohm, R2 = 175 ohm and R3 = 195 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 100, R2 = 175, R3 = 195 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 175*195 / 100 | Answer: 341.2 ohm

question: A strain gauge of resistance 120 ohm and gauge factor 2 experiences a strain of 1650e-6. Find the change in resistance in milliohms.
solution: Given: R = 120, GF = 2, eps = 1650 | Formula: dR = R * GF * strain | Substitute: dR = 120*2*1650e-6 | Answer: 396 milliohm

question: A measurement reads 9.24 when the true value is 10. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.24, true = 10 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.24 - 10| / 10 * 100 | Answer: 7.6 %

question: Annual demand is 39500 units, ordering cost 260 per order and holding cost 36 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 39500, S = 260, H = 36 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*39500*260 / 36) | Answer: 755.4 units

question: An asset costs 430000 with salvage value 40000 after 7 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 430000, Sv = 40000, n = 7 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (430000 - 40000) / 7 | Answer: 55714 per year

question: A product sells for 470 per unit with variable cost 110 per unit and fixed costs 115000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 470, V = 110, F = 115000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 115000 / (470 - 110) | Answer: 319.4 units

question: Find the present worth of 145000 received 4 years from now at an interest rate of 9% per year.
solution: Given: F = 145000, n = 4, i = 9 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 145000 / (1 + 0.09)^4 | Answer: 102722 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.98, 0.92 and 0.96 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.98, r2 = 0.92, r3 = 0.96 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.98*0.92*0.96 | Answer: 0.8655

question: A process produces 25 defective items in a batch of 9000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 25, N = 9000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 25/9000 * 1e6 | Answer: 2778 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 2x^3 + 6x^2 + 4x - 9 evaluated at x = 1.
For f(x) = -x^3 + 4x - 2, find f''(x) at x = 5.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-x^2 - 4x + 6) dx from x = -3 to x = 6.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -1x^3/3 + -4x^2/2 + 6x | Evaluate F(6) - F(-3) | Answer: -81
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 3x^2 + 3x - 9 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[8, -7], [-9, -5]].
solution: Given: a = 8, b = -7, c = -9, d = -5 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (8)(-5) - (-7)(-9) | Answer: -103

question: Find the determinant of [[6, 0, -3], [-3, 5, -3], [-1, 3, -1]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 36

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[2, -3], [-6, -7]].
solution: Trace tr = -5, Determinant = -32 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 3.685

question: Solve for x: -5x + -2y = -6 and 0x + 1y = -9.
solution: Determinant = -5*1 - -2*0 = -5 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 4.8 | Answer: x = 4.8
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 72, 10, 37, 36, 44.
solution: Sum = 199 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 39.8 | Answer: 39.8

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 4, 2, 7, 13, 17.
solution: Mean = 8.6 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 6.269

question: Find the slope of the line through (3, -3) and (1, 0).
solution: Given: x1 = 3, y1 = -3, x2 = 1, y2 = 0 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (0 - -3) / (1 - 3) | Answer: -1.5

question: Find the distance between the points (9, 0) and (1, 0).
solution: Given: x1 = 9, y1 = 0, x2 = 1, y2 = 0 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((-8)^2 + (0)^2) | Answer: 8 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-8,-2), (5,3), (3,3).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 5 sq units

question: Find the 23th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 7 and common difference 1.
solution: Given: a = 7, d = 1, n = 23 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 7 + (23 - 1)*1 | Answer: 29

question: Find the sum of the first 33 terms of an AP with first term 4 and common difference -5.
solution: Given: a = 4, d = -5, n = 33 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 33/2 [2*4 + (33-1)*-5] | Answer: -2508

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 5000 at 8% per annum for 2 years.
solution: Given: P = 5000, R = 8, Tt = 2 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 5000 * 8 * 2 / 100 | Answer: 800 currency units

question: Find the amount when 27000 is invested at 9.5% per annum compounded annually for 3 years.
solution: Given: P = 27000, R = 9.5, Tt = 3 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 27000 * (1 + 9.5/100)^3 | Answer: 35449 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (6, 5, -3) and (0, -5, 4).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (-1, 1, -2) and (-2, -5, 1).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 12.45

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (6, -1, -6) and (-1, -4, -3).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 68.45 degrees

question: Find the modulus of the complex number 3 + -10i.
solution: Given: a = 3, b = -10 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((3)^2 + (-10)^2) | Answer: 10.44

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number 1 + -10i.
solution: Given: a = 1, b = -10 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(-10, 1) | Answer: -84.29 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -x^3 - x^2 - 5x - 6 at x = 0.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-40 with initial guess x0=9, find x1 (one iteration).
solution: Given: N = 40, x0 = 9 | Formula: x1 = x0 - (x0^2 - N)/(2 x0) | Substitute: x1 = 9 - ((9)^2 - 40)/(2*9) | Answer: 6.722

question: Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=0.6 and ordinates 20, 7, 15, 13, 10, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 356 and 35.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 356 and 35 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 17 and 64.
solution: Given: a = 17, b = 64 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 17*64 / 1 | Answer: 1088
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 45 mm carries an axial tensile load of 8 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 20 mm and length 2600 mm carries an axial load of 51 kN. Take E = 210 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 62 mm transmits a torque of 950 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 62, Tt = 950 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(950*1000) / (pi*(62)^3) | Answer: 20.3 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 70 mm and length 600 mm carries a torque of 1600 N-m. With G = 77 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (70)^4 / 32 = 2357176 mm^4 | theta = (1600*1000)(600) / (77000 * 2357176) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.303 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 106 mm wide and 130 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 106, h = 130 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 106*(130)^2 / 6 | Answer: 298567 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (104 mm x 80 mm) carries a bending moment of 2 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (50 mm x 100 mm) has effective length 3500 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 710 MPa is designed for a working stress of 140 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 710, sw = 140 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 710 / 140 | Answer: 5.071

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1100 mm and wall thickness 6 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.3 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1100, t = 6, P = 1.3 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.3*1100 / (2*6) | Answer: 119.2 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 960 K and 350 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 960, Tc = 350 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 350/960) * 100 | Answer: 63.54 %

question: A refrigerator works between 250 K (cold) and 312 K (hot). Find the maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 250, Th = 312 | Formula: COP_ref = Tc / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 250 / (312 - 250) | Answer: 4.032

question: A heat pump operates between 274 K and 300 K. Find its maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 274, Th = 300 | Formula: COP_hp = Th / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 300 / (300 - 274) | Answer: 11.54

question: 2.7 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 45 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.7, dT = 45 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 2.7 * 0.718 * 45 | Answer: 87.24 kJ

question: 6.3 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 25 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.3, dT = 25 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 6.3 * 1.005 * 25 | Answer: 158.3 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 2.5 m^3 at 430 K with mass 1.9 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 2.5, Tk = 430, m = 1.9 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 1.9*0.287*430 / 2.5 | Answer: 93.79 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 2.3 kg of air expands isothermally at 380 K from volume V1 to 3*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.3, Tk = 380, ratio = 3 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 2.3*0.287*380*ln(3) | Answer: 275.6 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 4.7 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.14 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 4.7, D = 0.14 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*4.7*0.14 / 0.001 | Answer: 658000

question: Water flows at 1.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 250 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 18 m. Taking Cv = 0.95, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 18, cv = 0.95 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.95*sqrt(2*9.81*18) | Answer: 17.85 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 300 mm) water flows at 2.1 m/s. It contracts to diameter 70 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 300, d2 = 70, V1 = 2.1 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2.1*(300/70)^2 | Answer: 38.57 m/s

question: Water flows at 3.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.48 m and length 300 m. With friction factor f = 0.038, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 16 teeth drives a gear of 109 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1400 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 16, z2 = 109, N1 = 1400 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1400*16 / 109 | Answer: 205.5 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 420 mm rotates at 450 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 420, N = 450 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.42)*450 / 60 | Answer: 9.896 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 45.4 kW at 850 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 45.4, N = 850 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(45.4*1000) / (2*pi*850) | Answer: 510 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 2.6 kg rotates at radius 0.57 m at 1150 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 10500 N/m and mass 18.1 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 10500, m = 18.1 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(10500/18.1) | Answer: 3.833 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 8.6 m^2 and thickness 0.15 m has conductivity k = 44.8 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 75 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 8.6, L = 0.15, k = 44.8, dT = 75 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 44.8*8.6*75 / 0.15 | Answer: 192640 W

question: A surface of area 3.1 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 100 W/m^2-K to surroundings 55 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 3.1, h = 100, dT = 55 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 100*3.1*55 | Answer: 17050 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 250 m/min, feed = 0.45 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.8 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 250, f = 0.45, d = 1.8 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*250*0.45*1.8 | Answer: 202500 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 490 mm is turned at 600 rpm with a feed of 0.35 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 490, N = 600, f = 0.35 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 490 / (0.35*600) | Answer: 2.333 min

question: A resistor of 189 ohm carries a current of 1.3 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 189, I = 1.3 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 1.3 * 189 | Answer: 245.7 V

question: Three resistors 72 ohm, 85 ohm and 96 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 72, R2 = 85, R3 = 96 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 72 + 85 + 96 | Answer: 253 ohm

question: Two resistors 99 ohm and 42 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 99, R2 = 42 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 99*42 / (99+42) | Answer: 29.49 ohm

question: A device draws 8 A at 145 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 145, I = 8 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 145 * 8 | Answer: 1160 W

question: A current of 4.8 A flows through a 102 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 4.8, R = 102 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (4.8)^2 * 102 | Answer: 235 W

question: Two capacitors 14.5 uF and 5.5 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 14.5, C2 = 5.5 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 14.5*5.5 / (14.5+5.5) | Answer: 3.987 uF

question: A resistor 92 kohm and capacitor 13.3 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 92, C = 13.3 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (92k)(13.3u) = 1224 ms | Answer: 1224 ms

question: An inductor 337.9 mH is in series with 54 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 337.9, R = 54 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (337.9e-3) / 54 | Answer: 6.257 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 128.3 mH inductor at 650 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 128.3, f = 650 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (650)(128.3e-3) | Answer: 524 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 45.6 uF capacitor at 980 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 45.6, f = 980 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (980)(45.6e-6)) | Answer: 3.561 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 17 ohm, XL = 54 ohm and XC = 73 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 17, XL = 54, XC = 73 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(17^2 + (54 - 73)^2) | Answer: 25.5 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 64.1 mH and C = 4.4 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 64.1, C = 4.4 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(64.1e-3 * 4.4e-6)) | Answer: 299.7 Hz

question: A capacitor of 87.4 uF is charged to 300 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 87.4, V = 300 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*87.4e-6*(300)^2 | Answer: 3933 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 260 V with 400 primary turns and 230 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 260, N1 = 400, N2 = 230 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 260 * 230/400 | Answer: 149.5 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 340 V and draws an armature current of 15 A. If the armature resistance is 0.46 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 340, Ia = 15, Ra = 0.46 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 340 - 15*0.46 | Answer: 333.1 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 180 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.83. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 180, VL = 433, pf = 0.83 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*180*0.83 / 1000 | Answer: 112 kW

question: A load has real power 140 kW and apparent power 180 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 140, S = 180 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 140 / 180 | Answer: 0.7778

question: A machine delivers 95 kW output while drawing 207 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 95, Pi = 207 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 95/207 * 100 | Answer: 45.89 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 8 V across R1 = 22 ohm and R2 = 3 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 8, R1 = 22, R2 = 3 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 8*3 / (22+3) | Answer: 0.96 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 100 kohm and Rin = 7 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 100, Rin = 7 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 100 / 7 | Answer: 14.29

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 50 kohm and Rg = 42 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 50, Rg = 42 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 50/42 | Answer: 2.19

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 7165. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 7165 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(7165) | Answer: 38.55 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.9 m carries a central point load of 40 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.9, W = 40 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 40*4.9 / 4 | Answer: 49 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.4 m carries a UDL of 55 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.4, w = 55 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 55*(5.4)^2 / 8 | Answer: 200.5 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.3 m carries a point load 25 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.3, W = 25 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 25*2.3 | Answer: 57.5 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.7 m carries a UDL of 16 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.7, w = 16 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 16*(5.7)^2 / 2 | Answer: 259.9 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.9 m carries a point load 80 kN at distance 3.6 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 6.9, a = 3.6, W = 80 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 80*(6.9 - 3.6) / 6.9 | Answer: 38.26 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 5.7 m) carries a central point load 70 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 440e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=70000 N, L=5700.0 mm, E=200000 MPa, I=440e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 3.069 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 8.9 m carries a UDL of 39 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.9, w = 39 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 39*(8.9)^2 / 12 | Answer: 257.4 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 360 mm, clear cover 40 mm and main bars of diameter 25 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 360, c = 40, dia = 25 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 360 - 40 - 25/2 | Answer: 307.5 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 33.5 m^2 carrying a factored load of 12.1 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 33.5, w = 12.1 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 12.1 * 33.5 | Answer: 405.3 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 6.3 m, unit weight 17 kN/m^3, phi = 34 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: At a depth of 5 m in a saturated soil (saturated unit weight 19 kN/m^3, water table at surface), find the effective vertical stress in kPa (gamma_w = 9.81).
solution: Given: z = 5, g = 19 | Formula: sigma' = (gamma_sat - gamma_w) z | Substitute: sigma' = (19 - 9.81)*5 | Answer: 45.95 kPa

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 7.3e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.3, area = 6.1e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 7.3, i = 0.3, A = 6.1 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (7.3e-4)*0.3*(6.1e-3) | Answer: 1336 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1.7 m, bed slope 0.002 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.027. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 2.4 m under a head of 0.6 m. Taking Cd = 0.64 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 5.3 m wide carries a discharge of 24.4 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 280 m and design speed 40 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 280, V = 40 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (40)^2 / (127*280) | Answer: 0.04499
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 390 m^3 treats a flow of 165 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 390, Q = 165 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 390 / 165 | Answer: 2.364 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 210 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.3 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 6 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 210, k = 0.3, t = 6 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 210*(1 - e^(-0.3*6)) | Answer: 175.3 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.63, rainfall intensity 50 mm/h over a catchment of 27.3 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.63, i = 50, A = 27.3 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.63*50*27.3 / 360 | Answer: 2.389 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.03 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 410 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.03, M = 410 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 410*(30+0.03)/30 | Answer: 410.4 m

question: Convert the decimal number 2466 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 2466 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 9A2 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 01011100 and 10100011.
solution: XOR: 11111111 | Count of 1s = 8 | Answer: 8
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 300 megabits is sent over a link of 74 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 300, B = 74 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 300 / 74 | Answer: 4.054 s

question: A link has bandwidth 17 Mbps and round-trip time 170 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 17, R = 170 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 17e6 * 170e-3 bits = 2890 kb | Answer: 2890 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.83, cache access time 8 ns and main-memory access time 150 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.83, tc = 8, tm = 150 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.83*8 + (1 - 0.83)*150 | Answer: 32.14 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 804756 elements?
solution: Given: n = 804756 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(804756)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: An O(n^2) algorithm performs c*n^2 basic operations. If c = 1 and n = 2030, how many operations are performed?
solution: Given: n = 2030 | Formula: operations = n^2 | Substitute: = (2030)^2 | Answer: 4120900

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.008, memory access time 80 ns and page-fault service time 9 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 9 ms = 9000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.008)*80 + 0.008*9000000.0 ns | Answer: 72.08 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.7 m^3 at 490 kPa and 490 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.7, P = 490, Tk = 490 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (490e3)*2.7 / (8.314*490) | Answer: 324.8 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.27 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 15 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.27, t = 15 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.27*15) | Answer: 0.9826

question: For a reaction with A = 5e10 /s and activation energy 70 kJ/mol at 500 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 5, Ea = 70, Tk = 500 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 5e10 * exp(-70e3 / (8.314*500)) | Answer: 2431 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.95 and bottoms xW = 0.08, with relative volatility alpha = 1.6. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.95, xw = 0.08, al = 1.6 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.95/0.05)(0.92/0.08)] / ln(1.6) | Answer: 11.46 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.71 and x = 0.29. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.71, x = 0.29 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.71/0.29) / (0.29/0.71) | Answer: 5.994

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.55 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 95 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.55, Psat = 95 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.55 * 95 | Answer: 52.25 kPa

question: A stream of 9.4 kg/s with specific heat 1.4 kJ/kg-K is heated through 65 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 9.4, cp = 1.4, dT = 65 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 9.4*1.4*65 | Answer: 855.4 kW

question: A reactor of volume 15.6 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 1.6 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 15.6, Q = 1.6 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 15.6 / 1.6 | Answer: 9.75 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 5.6e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 1 mm with a concentration difference of 90 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 5.6, L = 1, dC = 90 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (5.6e-9)*90 / (1e-3) | Answer: 504 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 6.4 min and steady-state gain 3.8. For a step input of magnitude 9, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 6.4, K = 3.8, M = 9 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 3.8 * 9 | Answer: 34.2 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 35 m^2 flies at 90 m/s (air density 0.4 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.1. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 35, V = 90, rho = 0.4, CL = 1.1 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.4*(90)^2*35*1.1 / 1000 | Answer: 62.37 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 50 m^2 flies at 80 m/s (density 1 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.07. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 50, V = 80, rho = 1, CD = 0.07 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*1*(80)^2*50*0.07 / 1000 | Answer: 11.2 kN

question: A specimen under stress 150 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.7e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 150, eps = 2.7 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 150 / (2.7e-3) MPa = 55.56 GPa | Answer: 55.56 GPa

question: A block of mass 39 kg has a volume of 1.8e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 39, V = 1.8 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 39 / (1.8e-3) | Answer: 21667 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 700 mm is heated through 30 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 12e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 700, dT = 30, al = 12 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 700*12e-6*30 | Answer: 0.252 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 65 ohm, R2 = 105 ohm and R3 = 245 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 65, R2 = 105, R3 = 245 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 105*245 / 65 | Answer: 395.8 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.56 when the true value is 20. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.56, true = 20 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.56 - 20| / 20 * 100 | Answer: 52.2 %

question: Annual demand is 9500 units, ordering cost 290 per order and holding cost 13 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 9500, S = 290, H = 13 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*9500*290 / 13) | Answer: 651 units

question: An asset costs 120000 with salvage value 14000 after 5 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 120000, Sv = 14000, n = 5 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (120000 - 14000) / 5 | Answer: 21200 per year

question: A product sells for 110 per unit with variable cost 100 per unit and fixed costs 30000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 110, V = 100, F = 30000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 30000 / (110 - 100) | Answer: 3000 units

question: Find the present worth of 130000 received 5 years from now at an interest rate of 8% per year.
solution: Given: F = 130000, n = 5, i = 8 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 130000 / (1 + 0.08)^5 | Answer: 88476 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.91, 0.94 and 0.99 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.91, r2 = 0.94, r3 = 0.99 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.91*0.94*0.99 | Answer: 0.8468

question: A process produces 49 defective items in a batch of 10000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 49, N = 10000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 49/10000 * 1e6 | Answer: 4900 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = -3x^3 - 5x^2 + 6x + 5 evaluated at x = 4.
For f(x) = -6x^3 + 4x^2 - 4x - 8, find f''(x) at x = -1.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-3x^2 - 3x - 6) dx from x = 2 to x = 6.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -3x^3/3 + -3x^2/2 + -6x | Evaluate F(6) - F(2) | Answer: -280
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 6x^2 + 12x - 2 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[-1, -7], [-3, 4]].
solution: Given: a = -1, b = -7, c = -3, d = 4 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (-1)(4) - (-7)(-3) | Answer: -25

question: Find the determinant of [[5, 0, 2], [-1, 3, -2], [5, 0, -2]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -60

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[3, 6], [5, 0]].
solution: Trace tr = 3, Determinant = -30 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 7.179

question: Solve for x: -4x + -2y = 11 and -1x + -1y = 8.
solution: Determinant = -4*-1 - -2*-1 = 2 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 2.5 | Answer: x = 2.5
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 45, 53, 47, 20, 98.
solution: Sum = 263 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 52.6 | Answer: 52.6

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 25, 48, 31, 22, 12.
solution: Mean = 27.6 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 13.32

question: Find the slope of the line through (-8, 5) and (0, 5).
solution: Given: x1 = -8, y1 = 5, x2 = 0, y2 = 5 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (5 - 5) / (0 - -8) | Answer: 0

question: Find the distance between the points (-9, -4) and (-5, -7).
solution: Given: x1 = -9, y1 = -4, x2 = -5, y2 = -7 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((4)^2 + (-3)^2) | Answer: 5 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (1,2), (8,-2), (3,1).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 0.5 sq units

question: Find the 33th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -3 and common difference -9.
solution: Given: a = -3, d = -9, n = 33 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -3 + (33 - 1)*-9 | Answer: -291
