Water issues from an orifice under a head of 10 m. Taking Cv = 0.96, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 10, cv = 0.96 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.96*sqrt(2*9.81*10) | Answer: 13.45 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 270 mm) water flows at 1.2 m/s. It contracts to diameter 90 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 270, d2 = 90, V1 = 1.2 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 1.2*(270/90)^2 | Answer: 10.8 m/s

question: Water flows at 2.2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.34 m and length 140 m. With friction factor f = 0.028, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 36 teeth drives a gear of 108 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1100 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 36, z2 = 108, N1 = 1100 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1100*36 / 108 | Answer: 366.7 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 380 mm rotates at 1050 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 380, N = 1050 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.38)*1050 / 60 | Answer: 20.89 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 32.9 kW at 550 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 32.9, N = 550 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(32.9*1000) / (2*pi*550) | Answer: 571.2 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 6.5 kg rotates at radius 0.56 m at 250 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 14900 N/m and mass 4.9 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 14900, m = 4.9 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(14900/4.9) | Answer: 8.776 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 8.5 m^2 and thickness 0.14 m has conductivity k = 29 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 90 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 8.5, L = 0.14, k = 29, dT = 90 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 29*8.5*90 / 0.14 | Answer: 158464 W

question: A surface of area 3.4 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 45 W/m^2-K to surroundings 50 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 3.4, h = 45, dT = 50 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 45*3.4*50 | Answer: 7650 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 70 m/min, feed = 0.49 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.6 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 70, f = 0.49, d = 1.6 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*70*0.49*1.6 | Answer: 54880 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 430 mm is turned at 300 rpm with a feed of 0.22 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 430, N = 300, f = 0.22 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 430 / (0.22*300) | Answer: 6.515 min

question: A resistor of 186 ohm carries a current of 2.3 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 186, I = 2.3 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 2.3 * 186 | Answer: 427.8 V

question: Three resistors 98 ohm, 46 ohm and 2 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 98, R2 = 46, R3 = 2 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 98 + 46 + 2 | Answer: 146 ohm

question: Two resistors 116 ohm and 4 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 116, R2 = 4 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 116*4 / (116+4) | Answer: 3.867 ohm

question: A device draws 10.7 A at 170 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 170, I = 10.7 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 170 * 10.7 | Answer: 1819 W

question: A current of 7.6 A flows through a 115 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 7.6, R = 115 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (7.6)^2 * 115 | Answer: 6642 W

question: Two capacitors 35.7 uF and 26.5 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 35.7, C2 = 26.5 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 35.7*26.5 / (35.7+26.5) | Answer: 15.21 uF

question: A resistor 35 kohm and capacitor 1.8 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 35, C = 1.8 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (35k)(1.8u) = 63 ms | Answer: 63 ms

question: An inductor 138.5 mH is in series with 19 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 138.5, R = 19 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (138.5e-3) / 19 | Answer: 7.289 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 13.8 mH inductor at 120 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 13.8, f = 120 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (120)(13.8e-3) | Answer: 10.4 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 44.6 uF capacitor at 380 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 44.6, f = 380 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (380)(44.6e-6)) | Answer: 9.391 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 28 ohm, XL = 80 ohm and XC = 130 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 28, XL = 80, XC = 130 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(28^2 + (80 - 130)^2) | Answer: 57.31 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 47.7 mH and C = 3.5 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 47.7, C = 3.5 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(47.7e-3 * 3.5e-6)) | Answer: 389.5 Hz

question: A capacitor of 59.4 uF is charged to 250 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 59.4, V = 250 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*59.4e-6*(250)^2 | Answer: 1856 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 280 V with 890 primary turns and 100 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 280, N1 = 890, N2 = 100 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 280 * 100/890 | Answer: 31.46 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 190 V and draws an armature current of 15 A. If the armature resistance is 0.13 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 190, Ia = 15, Ra = 0.13 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 190 - 15*0.13 | Answer: 188.1 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 40 A at 400 V (line) with a power factor of 0.97. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 40, VL = 400, pf = 0.97 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*400*40*0.97 / 1000 | Answer: 26.88 kW

question: A load has real power 55 kW and apparent power 215 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 55, S = 215 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 55 / 215 | Answer: 0.2558

question: A machine delivers 125 kW output while drawing 142 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 125, Pi = 142 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 125/142 * 100 | Answer: 88.03 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 16 V across R1 = 39 ohm and R2 = 18 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 16, R1 = 39, R2 = 18 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 16*18 / (39+18) | Answer: 5.053 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 130 kohm and Rin = 6 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 130, Rin = 6 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 130 / 6 | Answer: 21.67

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 190 kohm and Rg = 46 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 190, Rg = 46 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 190/46 | Answer: 5.13

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 5561. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 5561 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(5561) | Answer: 37.45 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 8.3 m carries a central point load of 65 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.3, W = 65 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 65*8.3 / 4 | Answer: 134.9 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.1 m carries a UDL of 25 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6.1, w = 25 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 25*(6.1)^2 / 8 | Answer: 116.3 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 4.4 m carries a point load 25 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.4, W = 25 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 25*4.4 | Answer: 110 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2 m carries a UDL of 22 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2, w = 22 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 22*(2)^2 / 2 | Answer: 44 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.7 m carries a point load 45 kN at distance 2.2 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 7.7, a = 2.2, W = 45 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 45*(7.7 - 2.2) / 7.7 | Answer: 32.14 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 4.2 m) carries a central point load 45 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 590e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=45000 N, L=4200.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=590e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 4.709 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 6.6 m carries a UDL of 21 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6.6, w = 21 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 21*(6.6)^2 / 12 | Answer: 76.23 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 370 mm, clear cover 35 mm and main bars of diameter 25 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 370, c = 35, dia = 25 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 370 - 35 - 25/2 | Answer: 322.5 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 32.5 m^2 carrying a factored load of 13 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 32.5, w = 13 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 13 * 32.5 | Answer: 422.5 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 6 m, unit weight 17 kN/m^3, phi = 30 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: At a depth of 2.8 m in a saturated soil (saturated unit weight 18 kN/m^3, water table at surface), find the effective vertical stress in kPa (gamma_w = 9.81).
solution: Given: z = 2.8, g = 18 | Formula: sigma' = (gamma_sat - gamma_w) z | Substitute: sigma' = (18 - 9.81)*2.8 | Answer: 22.93 kPa

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 6.7e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1, area = 7.8e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 6.7, i = 1, A = 7.8 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (6.7e-4)*1*(7.8e-3) | Answer: 5226 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.9 m, bed slope 0.005 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.015. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.8 m under a head of 0.9 m. Taking Cd = 0.62 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.6 m wide carries a discharge of 17.2 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 260 m and design speed 100 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 260, V = 100 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (100)^2 / (127*260) | Answer: 0.3028
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 110 m^3 treats a flow of 175 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 110, Q = 175 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 110 / 175 | Answer: 0.6286 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 200 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.22 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 4 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 200, k = 0.22, t = 4 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 200*(1 - e^(-0.22*4)) | Answer: 117 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.84, rainfall intensity 75 mm/h over a catchment of 5.8 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.84, i = 75, A = 5.8 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.84*75*5.8 / 360 | Answer: 1.015 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.02 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 800 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.02, M = 800 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 800*(20+0.02)/20 | Answer: 800.8 m

question: Convert the decimal number 3055 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 3055 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: BEF (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10100111 and 11101010.
solution: XOR: 01001101 | Count of 1s = 4 | Answer: 4
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 240 megabits is sent over a link of 94 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 240, B = 94 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 240 / 94 | Answer: 2.553 s

question: A link has bandwidth 98 Mbps and round-trip time 180 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 98, R = 180 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 98e6 * 180e-3 bits = 17640 kb | Answer: 17640 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.88, cache access time 8 ns and main-memory access time 90 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.88, tc = 8, tm = 90 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.88*8 + (1 - 0.88)*90 | Answer: 17.84 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 372120 elements?
solution: Given: n = 372120 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(372120)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.003, memory access time 90 ns and page-fault service time 10 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 10 ms = 10000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.003)*90 + 0.003*10000000.0 ns | Answer: 30.09 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 1.1 m^3 at 110 kPa and 380 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 1.1, P = 110, Tk = 380 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (110e3)*1.1 / (8.314*380) | Answer: 38.3 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.2 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 19 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.2, t = 19 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.2*19) | Answer: 0.9776

question: For a reaction with A = 8e10 /s and activation energy 65 kJ/mol at 440 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 8, Ea = 65, Tk = 440 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 8e10 * exp(-65e3 / (8.314*440)) | Answer: 1536 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.93 and bottoms xW = 0.06, with relative volatility alpha = 1.6. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.93, xw = 0.06, al = 1.6 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.93/0.07)(0.94/0.06)] / ln(1.6) | Answer: 11.36 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.77 and x = 0.22. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.77, x = 0.22 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.77/0.23) / (0.22/0.78) | Answer: 11.87

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.36 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 40 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.36, Psat = 40 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.36 * 40 | Answer: 14.4 kPa

question: A stream of 9.4 kg/s with specific heat 4 kJ/kg-K is heated through 85 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 9.4, cp = 4, dT = 85 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 9.4*4*85 | Answer: 3196 kW

question: A reactor of volume 10.1 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 5 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 10.1, Q = 5 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 10.1 / 5 | Answer: 2.02 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 5.9e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 5 mm with a concentration difference of 150 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 5.9, L = 5, dC = 150 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (5.9e-9)*150 / (5e-3) | Answer: 177 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 4.3 min and steady-state gain 2.1. For a step input of magnitude 10, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 4.3, K = 2.1, M = 10 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 2.1 * 10 | Answer: 21 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 85 m^2 flies at 100 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 85, V = 100, rho = 0.7, CL = 1 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.7*(100)^2*85*1 / 1000 | Answer: 297.5 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 25 m^2 flies at 80 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.09. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 25, V = 80, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.09 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(80)^2*25*0.09 / 1000 | Answer: 2.88 kN

question: A specimen under stress 350 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.5e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 350, eps = 2.5 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 350 / (2.5e-3) MPa = 140 GPa | Answer: 140 GPa

question: A block of mass 48 kg has a volume of 0.7e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 48, V = 0.7 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 48 / (0.7e-3) | Answer: 68571 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 1700 mm is heated through 70 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 12e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 1700, dT = 70, al = 12 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 1700*12e-6*70 | Answer: 1.428 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 60 ohm, R2 = 80 ohm and R3 = 295 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 60, R2 = 80, R3 = 295 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 80*295 / 60 | Answer: 393.3 ohm

question: A strain gauge of resistance 120 ohm and gauge factor 2.2 experiences a strain of 1250e-6. Find the change in resistance in milliohms.
solution: Given: R = 120, GF = 2.2, eps = 1250 | Formula: dR = R * GF * strain | Substitute: dR = 120*2.2*1250e-6 | Answer: 330 milliohm

question: A measurement reads 9.87 when the true value is 50. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.87, true = 50 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.87 - 50| / 50 * 100 | Answer: 80.26 %

question: Annual demand is 4500 units, ordering cost 270 per order and holding cost 22 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 4500, S = 270, H = 22 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*4500*270 / 22) | Answer: 332.3 units

question: An asset costs 270000 with salvage value 22000 after 17 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 270000, Sv = 22000, n = 17 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (270000 - 22000) / 17 | Answer: 14588 per year

question: A product sells for 270 per unit with variable cost 130 per unit and fixed costs 50000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 270, V = 130, F = 50000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 50000 / (270 - 130) | Answer: 357.1 units

question: Find the present worth of 180000 received 9 years from now at an interest rate of 12% per year.
solution: Given: F = 180000, n = 9, i = 12 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 180000 / (1 + 0.12)^9 | Answer: 6491 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.91, 0.94 and 0.92 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.91, r2 = 0.94, r3 = 0.92 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.91*0.94*0.92 | Answer: 0.787

question: A process produces 47 defective items in a batch of 17500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 47, N = 17500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 47/17500 * 1e6 | Answer: 2686 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = x^3 - 3x^2 - 3x + 9 evaluated at x = -5.
For f(x) = -5x^3 - 4x^2 - 4x - 9, find f''(x) at x = -2.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-x^2 + 6x + 7) dx from x = 1 to x = 6.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -1x^3/3 + 6x^2/2 + 7x | Evaluate F(6) - F(1) | Answer: 68.33
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 6x^2 - 5x - 2 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[8, 4], [-7, -8]].
solution: Given: a = 8, b = 4, c = -7, d = -8 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (8)(-8) - (4)(-7) | Answer: -36

question: Find the determinant of [[-4, -1, 5], [0, 6, 2], [2, -1, 5]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -192

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[-7, 3], [1, -7]].
solution: Trace tr = -14, Determinant = 46 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: -5.268

question: Solve for x: -3x + -1y = 7 and 5x + -1y = 2.
solution: Determinant = -3*-1 - -1*5 = 8 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -0.625 | Answer: x = -0.625
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 52, 36, 30, 22, 87.
solution: Sum = 227 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 45.4 | Answer: 45.4

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 17, 10, 16, 10, 22.
solution: Mean = 15 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 5.099

question: Find the slope of the line through (7, 5) and (-9, 5).
solution: Given: x1 = 7, y1 = 5, x2 = -9, y2 = 5 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (5 - 5) / (-9 - 7) | Answer: 0

question: Find the distance between the points (-3, 1) and (6, -6).
solution: Given: x1 = -3, y1 = 1, x2 = 6, y2 = -6 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((9)^2 + (-7)^2) | Answer: 11.4 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-6,2), (-5,5), (7,-2).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 21.5 sq units

question: Find the 28th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -7 and common difference 4.
solution: Given: a = -7, d = 4, n = 28 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -7 + (28 - 1)*4 | Answer: 101

question: Find the sum of the first 6 terms of an AP with first term 2 and common difference -8.
solution: Given: a = 2, d = -8, n = 6 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 6/2 [2*2 + (6-1)*-8] | Answer: -108

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 49000 at 13.8% per annum for 5 years.
solution: Given: P = 49000, R = 13.8, Tt = 5 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 49000 * 13.8 * 5 / 100 | Answer: 33810 currency units

question: Find the amount when 31000 is invested at 5.9% per annum compounded annually for 3 years.
solution: Given: P = 31000, R = 5.9, Tt = 3 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 31000 * (1 + 5.9/100)^3 | Answer: 36817 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (-6, -5, -4) and (-8, 0, 8).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (-1, 2, 3) and (-3, -5, 5).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 27.6

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (6, 5, 2) and (0, -3, -6).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 119.9 degrees

question: Find the modulus of the complex number 10 + -7i.
solution: Given: a = 10, b = -7 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((10)^2 + (-7)^2) | Answer: 12.21

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number -10 + 4i.
solution: Given: a = -10, b = 4 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(4, -10) | Answer: 158.2 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -5x^3 - x^2 + 7x - 9 at x = 0.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-72 with initial guess x0=2, find x1 (one iteration).
solution: Given: N = 72, x0 = 2 | Formula: x1 = x0 - (x0^2 - N)/(2 x0) | Substitute: x1 = 2 - ((2)^2 - 72)/(2*2) | Answer: 19

question: Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.4 and ordinates 16, 17, 3, 18, 5, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 82 and 559.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 82 and 559 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 60 and 26.
solution: Given: a = 60, b = 26 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 60*26 / 2 | Answer: 780
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 47 mm carries an axial tensile load of 105 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 12 mm and length 700 mm carries an axial load of 86 kN. Take E = 110 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 55 mm transmits a torque of 2950 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 55, Tt = 2950 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2950*1000) / (pi*(55)^3) | Answer: 90.3 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 35 mm and length 1400 mm carries a torque of 950 N-m. With G = 45 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (35)^4 / 32 = 147324 mm^4 | theta = (950*1000)(1400) / (45000 * 147324) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 11.49 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 85 mm wide and 60 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 85, h = 60 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 85*(60)^2 / 6 | Answer: 51000 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (74 mm x 120 mm) carries a bending moment of 35 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (55 mm x 90 mm) has effective length 2100 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 460 MPa is designed for a working stress of 250 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 460, sw = 250 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 460 / 250 | Answer: 1.84

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1350 mm and wall thickness 12 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.1 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1350, t = 12, P = 1.1 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.1*1350 / (2*12) | Answer: 61.88 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 860 K and 380 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 860, Tc = 380 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 380/860) * 100 | Answer: 55.81 %

question: 2.6 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 35 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.6, dT = 35 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 2.6 * 0.718 * 35 | Answer: 65.34 kJ

question: 7 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 80 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 7, dT = 80 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 7 * 1.005 * 80 | Answer: 562.8 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 2.8 m^3 at 520 K with mass 1.6 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 2.8, Tk = 520, m = 1.6 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 1.6*0.287*520 / 2.8 | Answer: 85.28 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4.1 kg of air expands isothermally at 350 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.1, Tk = 350, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4.1*0.287*350*ln(4) | Answer: 570.9 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 0.7 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.18 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 0.7, D = 0.18 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*0.7*0.18 / 0.001 | Answer: 126000

question: Water flows at 1.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 260 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 17.2 m. Taking Cv = 0.95, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 17.2, cv = 0.95 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.95*sqrt(2*9.81*17.2) | Answer: 17.45 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 250 mm) water flows at 1.5 m/s. It contracts to diameter 120 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 250, d2 = 120, V1 = 1.5 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 1.5*(250/120)^2 | Answer: 6.51 m/s

question: Water flows at 1.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.4 m and length 180 m. With friction factor f = 0.03, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 29 teeth drives a gear of 57 teeth. If the pinion runs at 500 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 29, z2 = 57, N1 = 500 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 500*29 / 57 | Answer: 254.4 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 500 mm rotates at 550 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 500, N = 550 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.5)*550 / 60 | Answer: 14.4 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 13 kW at 1350 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 13, N = 1350 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(13*1000) / (2*pi*1350) | Answer: 91.96 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 7.7 kg rotates at radius 0.57 m at 300 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 20000 N/m and mass 12.2 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 20000, m = 12.2 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(20000/12.2) | Answer: 6.444 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 5.6 m^2 and thickness 0.22 m has conductivity k = 47 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 65 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 5.6, L = 0.22, k = 47, dT = 65 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 47*5.6*65 / 0.22 | Answer: 77764 W

question: A surface of area 0.5 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 10 W/m^2-K to surroundings 60 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 0.5, h = 10, dT = 60 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 10*0.5*60 | Answer: 300 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 250 m/min, feed = 0.2 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.4 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 250, f = 0.2, d = 1.4 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*250*0.2*1.4 | Answer: 70000 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 270 mm is turned at 550 rpm with a feed of 0.32 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 270, N = 550, f = 0.32 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 270 / (0.32*550) | Answer: 1.534 min

question: A resistor of 134 ohm carries a current of 6.8 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 134, I = 6.8 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 6.8 * 134 | Answer: 911.2 V

question: Three resistors 59 ohm, 57 ohm and 75 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 59, R2 = 57, R3 = 75 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 59 + 57 + 75 | Answer: 191 ohm

question: Two resistors 57 ohm and 91 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 57, R2 = 91 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 57*91 / (57+91) | Answer: 35.05 ohm

question: A device draws 4.2 A at 20 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 20, I = 4.2 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 20 * 4.2 | Answer: 84 W

question: A current of 11.2 A flows through a 31 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 11.2, R = 31 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (11.2)^2 * 31 | Answer: 3889 W

question: Two capacitors 27.6 uF and 36.3 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 27.6, C2 = 36.3 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 27.6*36.3 / (27.6+36.3) | Answer: 15.68 uF

question: A resistor 79 kohm and capacitor 3.4 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 79, C = 3.4 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (79k)(3.4u) = 268.6 ms | Answer: 268.6 ms

question: An inductor 442.9 mH is in series with 102 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 442.9, R = 102 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (442.9e-3) / 102 | Answer: 4.342 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 73 mH inductor at 650 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 73, f = 650 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (650)(73e-3) | Answer: 298.1 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 29.6 uF capacitor at 430 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 29.6, f = 430 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (430)(29.6e-6)) | Answer: 12.5 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 55 ohm, XL = 142 ohm and XC = 74 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 55, XL = 142, XC = 74 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(55^2 + (142 - 74)^2) | Answer: 87.46 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 54.6 mH and C = 3.2 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 54.6, C = 3.2 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(54.6e-3 * 3.2e-6)) | Answer: 380.8 Hz

question: A capacitor of 66.2 uF is charged to 120 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 66.2, V = 120 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*66.2e-6*(120)^2 | Answer: 476.6 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 110 V with 530 primary turns and 120 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 110, N1 = 530, N2 = 120 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 110 * 120/530 | Answer: 24.91 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 270 V and draws an armature current of 23 A. If the armature resistance is 0.27 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 270, Ia = 23, Ra = 0.27 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 270 - 23*0.27 | Answer: 263.8 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 115 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.98. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 115, VL = 433, pf = 0.98 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*115*0.98 / 1000 | Answer: 84.52 kW

question: A load has real power 30 kW and apparent power 210 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 30, S = 210 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 30 / 210 | Answer: 0.1429

question: A machine delivers 165 kW output while drawing 177 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 165, Pi = 177 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 165/177 * 100 | Answer: 93.22 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 23 V across R1 = 2 ohm and R2 = 10 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 23, R1 = 2, R2 = 10 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 23*10 / (2+10) | Answer: 19.17 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 50 kohm and Rin = 34 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 50, Rin = 34 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 50 / 34 | Answer: 1.471

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 80 kohm and Rg = 7 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 80, Rg = 7 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 80/7 | Answer: 12.43

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 5281. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 5281 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(5281) | Answer: 37.23 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 8.6 m carries a central point load of 95 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.6, W = 95 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 95*8.6 / 4 | Answer: 204.2 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 3.4 m carries a UDL of 60 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.4, w = 60 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 60*(3.4)^2 / 8 | Answer: 86.7 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5 m carries a point load 65 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5, W = 65 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 65*5 | Answer: 325 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.9 m carries a point load 45 kN at distance 1.3 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 5.9, a = 1.3, W = 45 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 45*(5.9 - 1.3) / 5.9 | Answer: 35.08 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 6.1 m) carries a central point load 30 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 510e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=30000 N, L=6100.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=510e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 11.13 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 5.4 m carries a UDL of 21 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.4, w = 21 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 21*(5.4)^2 / 12 | Answer: 51.03 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 410 mm, clear cover 25 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 410, c = 25, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 410 - 25 - 12/2 | Answer: 379 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 36.1 m^2 carrying a factored load of 15.4 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 36.1, w = 15.4 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 15.4 * 36.1 | Answer: 555.9 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 5.6 m, unit weight 17 kN/m^3, phi = 38 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 4.8e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.2, area = 6e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 4.8, i = 0.2, A = 6 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (4.8e-4)*0.2*(6e-3) | Answer: 576 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 2.2 m, bed slope 0.006 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.027. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 3.9 m under a head of 0.7 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.4 m wide carries a discharge of 21.8 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 380 m and design speed 75 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 380, V = 75 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (75)^2 / (127*380) | Answer: 0.1166
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 630 m^3 treats a flow of 85 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 630, Q = 85 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 630 / 85 | Answer: 7.412 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 360 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.28 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 3 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 360, k = 0.28, t = 3 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 360*(1 - e^(-0.28*3)) | Answer: 204.6 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.65, rainfall intensity 60 mm/h over a catchment of 33.1 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.65, i = 60, A = 33.1 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.65*60*33.1 / 360 | Answer: 3.586 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.03 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 180 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.03, M = 180 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 180*(30+0.03)/30 | Answer: 180.2 m

question: Convert the decimal number 371 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 371 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 173 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10110001 and 10111110.
solution: XOR: 00001111 | Count of 1s = 4 | Answer: 4
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 910 megabits is sent over a link of 70 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 910, B = 70 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 910 / 70 | Answer: 13 s

question: A link has bandwidth 97 Mbps and round-trip time 120 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 97, R = 120 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 97e6 * 120e-3 bits = 11640 kb | Answer: 11640 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.95, cache access time 4 ns and main-memory access time 90 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.95, tc = 4, tm = 90 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.95*4 + (1 - 0.95)*90 | Answer: 8.3 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 69547 elements?
solution: Given: n = 69547 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(69547)) + 1 | Answer: 17

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.018, memory access time 170 ns and page-fault service time 5 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 5 ms = 5000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.018)*170 + 0.018*5000000.0 ns | Answer: 90.17 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 0.2 m^3 at 170 kPa and 480 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 0.2, P = 170, Tk = 480 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (170e3)*0.2 / (8.314*480) | Answer: 8.52 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.33 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 8 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.33, t = 8 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.33*8) | Answer: 0.9286

question: For a reaction with A = 7e10 /s and activation energy 60 kJ/mol at 400 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 7, Ea = 60, Tk = 400 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 7e10 * exp(-60e3 / (8.314*400)) | Answer: 1022 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.93 and bottoms xW = 0.04, with relative volatility alpha = 2.9. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.93, xw = 0.04, al = 2.9 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.93/0.07)(0.96/0.04)] / ln(2.9) | Answer: 5.414 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.8 and x = 0.39. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.8, x = 0.39 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.8/0.2) / (0.39/0.61) | Answer: 6.256

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.18 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 35 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.18, Psat = 35 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.18 * 35 | Answer: 6.3 kPa

question: A stream of 9.7 kg/s with specific heat 2.9 kJ/kg-K is heated through 90 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 9.7, cp = 2.9, dT = 90 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 9.7*2.9*90 | Answer: 2532 kW

question: A reactor of volume 4.8 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 4 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 4.8, Q = 4 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 4.8 / 4 | Answer: 1.2 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 4.6e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 4 mm with a concentration difference of 150 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 4.6, L = 4, dC = 150 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (4.6e-9)*150 / (4e-3) | Answer: 172.5 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 8 min and steady-state gain 3.6. For a step input of magnitude 2, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 8, K = 3.6, M = 2 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 3.6 * 2 | Answer: 7.2 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 35 m^2 flies at 90 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.2. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 35, V = 90, rho = 0.7, CL = 1.2 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.7*(90)^2*35*1.2 / 1000 | Answer: 119.1 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 80 m^2 flies at 90 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.11. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 80, V = 90, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.11 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(90)^2*80*0.11 / 1000 | Answer: 14.26 kN

question: A specimen under stress 260 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.2e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 260, eps = 2.2 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 260 / (2.2e-3) MPa = 118.2 GPa | Answer: 118.2 GPa

question: A block of mass 17 kg has a volume of 1.8e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 17, V = 1.8 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 17 / (1.8e-3) | Answer: 9444 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 500 mm is heated through 70 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 11e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 500, dT = 70, al = 11 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 500*11e-6*70 | Answer: 0.385 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 10 ohm, R2 = 200 ohm and R3 = 450 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 10, R2 = 200, R3 = 450 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 200*450 / 10 | Answer: 9000 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.33 when the true value is 50. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.33, true = 50 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.33 - 50| / 50 * 100 | Answer: 81.34 %

question: Annual demand is 2500 units, ordering cost 180 per order and holding cost 11 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 2500, S = 180, H = 11 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*2500*180 / 11) | Answer: 286 units

question: An asset costs 400000 with salvage value 24000 after 17 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 400000, Sv = 24000, n = 17 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (400000 - 24000) / 17 | Answer: 22118 per year

question: A product sells for 470 per unit with variable cost 140 per unit and fixed costs 25000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 470, V = 140, F = 25000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 25000 / (470 - 140) | Answer: 75.76 units

question: Find the present worth of 30000 received 10 years from now at an interest rate of 6% per year.
solution: Given: F = 30000, n = 10, i = 6 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 30000 / (1 + 0.06)^10 | Answer: 16752 currency units

question: A process produces 23 defective items in a batch of 17500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 23, N = 17500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 23/17500 * 1e6 | Answer: 1314 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = -2x^3 + 2x^2 + 7x + 6 evaluated at x = 4.
For f(x) = -6x^3 + x^2 + 9x + 7, find f''(x) at x = 5.
Evaluate the definite integral of (x^2 - 2x + 8) dx from x = 1 to x = 4.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 1x^3/3 + -2x^2/2 + 8x | Evaluate F(4) - F(1) | Answer: 30
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 6x^2 + 5x = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[-8, -1], [-3, -2]].
solution: Given: a = -8, b = -1, c = -3, d = -2 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (-8)(-2) - (-1)(-3) | Answer: 13

question: Find the determinant of [[5, -4, 4], [6, 1, 5], [-2, -4, -4]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -64

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[0, -8], [0, 7]].
solution: Trace tr = 7, Determinant = 0 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 7

question: Solve for x: -2x + 0y = 1 and -2x + 6y = 4.
solution: Determinant = -2*6 - 0*-2 = -12 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -0.5 | Answer: x = -0.5
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 20, 64, 94, 31, 78.
solution: Sum = 287 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 57.4 | Answer: 57.4

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 13, 43, 19, 35, 32.
solution: Mean = 28.4 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 12.2

question: Find the slope of the line through (-5, -5) and (-3, -3).
solution: Given: x1 = -5, y1 = -5, x2 = -3, y2 = -3 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (-3 - -5) / (-3 - -5) | Answer: 1

question: Find the distance between the points (-8, 4) and (-4, 0).
solution: Given: x1 = -8, y1 = 4, x2 = -4, y2 = 0 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((4)^2 + (-4)^2) | Answer: 5.657 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (6,2), (-6,7), (2,4).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 2 sq units

question: Find the 38th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -14 and common difference -5.
solution: Given: a = -14, d = -5, n = 38 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -14 + (38 - 1)*-5 | Answer: -199

question: Find the sum of the first 22 terms of an AP with first term -4 and common difference -4.
solution: Given: a = -4, d = -4, n = 22 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 22/2 [2*-4 + (22-1)*-4] | Answer: -1012

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 15500 at 13.1% per annum for 3 years.
solution: Given: P = 15500, R = 13.1, Tt = 3 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 15500 * 13.1 * 3 / 100 | Answer: 6092 currency units

question: Find the amount when 32000 is invested at 10.8% per annum compounded annually for 5 years.
solution: Given: P = 32000, R = 10.8, Tt = 5 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 32000 * (1 + 10.8/100)^5 | Answer: 53438 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (-2, 4, 0) and (-2, -6, -7).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (-5, 6, 0) and (-5, 1, -5).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 46.37

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (3, -1, 5) and (-5, -3, -1).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 119.1 degrees

question: Find the modulus of the complex number -8 + -2i.
solution: Given: a = -8, b = -2 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((-8)^2 + (-2)^2) | Answer: 8.246

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number 7 + 12i.
solution: Given: a = 7, b = 12 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(12, 7) | Answer: 59.74 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = 2x^3 + 3x^2 + 3x - 4 at x = 5.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-59 with initial guess x0=12, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1 and ordinates 12, 19, 7, 2, 14, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 282 and 204.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 282 and 204 | Answer: GCD = 6

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 26 and 42.
solution: Given: a = 26, b = 42 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 26*42 / 2 | Answer: 546
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 56 mm carries an axial tensile load of 99 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 39 mm and length 2600 mm carries an axial load of 11 kN. Take E = 200 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 21 mm transmits a torque of 2650 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 21, Tt = 2650 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2650*1000) / (pi*(21)^3) | Answer: 1457 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 68 mm and length 1800 mm carries a torque of 1350 N-m. With G = 45 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (68)^4 / 32 = 2099112 mm^4 | theta = (1350*1000)(1800) / (45000 * 2099112) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 1.474 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 115 mm wide and 250 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 115, h = 250 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 115*(250)^2 / 6 | Answer: 1197917 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (76 mm x 100 mm) carries a bending moment of 32 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (38 mm x 150 mm) has effective length 1600 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 300 MPa is designed for a working stress of 200 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 300, sw = 200 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 300 / 200 | Answer: 1.5

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 650 mm and wall thickness 11 mm carries an internal pressure of 2.1 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 650, t = 11, P = 2.1 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 2.1*650 / (2*11) | Answer: 62.05 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 1200 K and 400 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 1200, Tc = 400 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 400/1200) * 100 | Answer: 66.67 %

question: A refrigerator works between 260 K (cold) and 328 K (hot). Find the maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 260, Th = 328 | Formula: COP_ref = Tc / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 260 / (328 - 260) | Answer: 3.824

question: A heat pump operates between 279 K and 308 K. Find its maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 279, Th = 308 | Formula: COP_hp = Th / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 308 / (308 - 279) | Answer: 10.62

question: 4 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 160 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4, dT = 160 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 4 * 0.718 * 160 | Answer: 459.5 kJ

question: 4.9 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 25 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.9, dT = 25 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 4.9 * 1.005 * 25 | Answer: 123.1 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1.4 m^3 at 470 K with mass 4 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1.4, Tk = 470, m = 4 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 4*0.287*470 / 1.4 | Answer: 385.4 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 2.6 kg of air expands isothermally at 300 K from volume V1 to 3*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.6, Tk = 300, ratio = 3 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 2.6*0.287*300*ln(3) | Answer: 245.9 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 1.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.21 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 1.5, D = 0.21 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*1.5*0.21 / 0.001 | Answer: 315000

question: Water flows at 3.7 m/s through a pipe of diameter 180 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 12.6 m. Taking Cv = 0.96, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 12.6, cv = 0.96 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.96*sqrt(2*9.81*12.6) | Answer: 15.09 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 190 mm) water flows at 0.7 m/s. It contracts to diameter 140 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
Water flows at 3.3 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.32 m and length 150 m. With friction factor f = 0.029, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 25 teeth drives a gear of 92 teeth. If the pinion runs at 850 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 25, z2 = 92, N1 = 850 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 850*25 / 92 | Answer: 231 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 300 mm rotates at 300 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 300, N = 300 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.3)*300 / 60 | Answer: 4.712 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 24.3 kW at 450 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 24.3, N = 450 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(24.3*1000) / (2*pi*450) | Answer: 515.7 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 3.8 kg rotates at radius 0.49 m at 850 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 17700 N/m and mass 10.2 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 17700, m = 10.2 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(17700/10.2) | Answer: 6.63 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 5.5 m^2 and thickness 0.39 m has conductivity k = 3.4 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 130 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 5.5, L = 0.39, k = 3.4, dT = 130 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 3.4*5.5*130 / 0.39 | Answer: 6233 W

question: A surface of area 0.6 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 10 W/m^2-K to surroundings 140 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 0.6, h = 10, dT = 140 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 10*0.6*140 | Answer: 840 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 220 m/min, feed = 0.16 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.2 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 220, f = 0.16, d = 1.2 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*220*0.16*1.2 | Answer: 42240 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 300 mm is turned at 800 rpm with a feed of 0.38 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 300, N = 800, f = 0.38 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 300 / (0.38*800) | Answer: 0.9868 min

question: A resistor of 188 ohm carries a current of 0.3 A. Find the voltage across it.

question: Three resistors 52 ohm, 12 ohm and 91 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 52, R2 = 12, R3 = 91 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 52 + 12 + 91 | Answer: 155 ohm

question: Two resistors 109 ohm and 16 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 109, R2 = 16 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 109*16 / (109+16) | Answer: 13.95 ohm

question: A device draws 11.3 A at 170 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 170, I = 11.3 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 170 * 11.3 | Answer: 1921 W

question: A current of 2.5 A flows through a 82 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 2.5, R = 82 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (2.5)^2 * 82 | Answer: 512.5 W

question: Two capacitors 5.7 uF and 31.4 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 5.7, C2 = 31.4 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 5.7*31.4 / (5.7+31.4) | Answer: 4.824 uF

question: A resistor 84 kohm and capacitor 5.4 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 84, C = 5.4 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (84k)(5.4u) = 453.6 ms | Answer: 453.6 ms

question: An inductor 33 mH is in series with 139 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 33, R = 139 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (33e-3) / 139 | Answer: 0.2374 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 109.1 mH inductor at 670 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 109.1, f = 670 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (670)(109.1e-3) | Answer: 459.3 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 2.6 uF capacitor at 480 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 2.6, f = 480 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (480)(2.6e-6)) | Answer: 127.5 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 55 ohm, XL = 63 ohm and XC = 17 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 55, XL = 63, XC = 17 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(55^2 + (63 - 17)^2) | Answer: 71.7 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 69.8 mH and C = 9.2 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 69.8, C = 9.2 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(69.8e-3 * 9.2e-6)) | Answer: 198.6 Hz

question: A capacitor of 26.2 uF is charged to 100 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 26.2, V = 100 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*26.2e-6*(100)^2 | Answer: 131 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 280 V with 270 primary turns and 300 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 280, N1 = 270, N2 = 300 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 280 * 300/270 | Answer: 311.1 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 270 V and draws an armature current of 38 A. If the armature resistance is 0.41 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 270, Ia = 38, Ra = 0.41 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 270 - 38*0.41 | Answer: 254.4 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 20 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.8. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 20, VL = 433, pf = 0.8 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*20*0.8 / 1000 | Answer: 12 kW

question: A load has real power 85 kW and apparent power 95 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 85, S = 95 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 85 / 95 | Answer: 0.8947

question: A machine delivers 50 kW output while drawing 102 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 50, Pi = 102 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 50/102 * 100 | Answer: 49.02 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 27 V across R1 = 3 ohm and R2 = 26 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 27, R1 = 3, R2 = 26 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 27*26 / (3+26) | Answer: 24.21 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 10 kohm and Rin = 11 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 10, Rin = 11 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 10 / 11 | Answer: 0.9091

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 985. Express the gain in decibels (power).

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.9 m carries a central point load of 25 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.1 m carries a UDL of 40 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.1, w = 40 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 40*(5.1)^2 / 8 | Answer: 130 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.7 m carries a point load 80 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.7, W = 80 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 80*2.7 | Answer: 216 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.8 m carries a UDL of 12 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.8, w = 12 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 12*(2.8)^2 / 2 | Answer: 47.04 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.9 m carries a point load 15 kN at distance 3 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 9.9, a = 3, W = 15 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 15*(9.9 - 3) / 9.9 | Answer: 10.45 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 3.9 m) carries a central point load 40 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 190e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.

question: A fixed beam of span 8.8 m carries a UDL of 30 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.8, w = 30 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 30*(8.8)^2 / 12 | Answer: 193.6 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 430 mm, clear cover 40 mm and main bars of diameter 16 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 430, c = 40, dia = 16 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 430 - 40 - 16/2 | Answer: 382 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 15.3 m^2 carrying a factored load of 8.1 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.

question: A tank of volume 410 m^3 treats a flow of 105 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 410, Q = 105 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 410 / 105 | Answer: 3.905 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 360 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.31 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 6 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 360, k = 0.31, t = 6 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 360*(1 - e^(-0.31*6)) | Answer: 304 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.8, rainfall intensity 80 mm/h over a catchment of 58.7 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.8, i = 80, A = 58.7 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.8*80*58.7 / 360 | Answer: 10.44 m^3/s

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.06 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 770 m with this tape.

question: A file of 310 megabits is sent over a link of 25 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.

question: A link has bandwidth 49 Mbps and round-trip time 90 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.87, cache access time 10 ns and main-memory access time 60 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.87, tc = 10, tm = 60 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.87*10 + (1 - 0.87)*60 | Answer: 16.5 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 870926 elements?
solution: Given: n = 870926 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(870926)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.01, memory access time 170 ns and page-fault service time 5 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 1.5 m^3 at 340 kPa and 370 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.31 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 10 minutes.

question: For a reaction with A = 8e10 /s and activation energy 75 kJ/mol at 450 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.97 and bottoms xW = 0.1, with relative volatility alpha = 3. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.97, xw = 0.1, al = 3 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.97/0.03)(0.9/0.1)] / ln(3) | Answer: 5.164 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.69 and x = 0.3. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.57 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 110 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.

question: A stream of 9.1 kg/s with specific heat 2.3 kJ/kg-K is heated through 65 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 9.1, cp = 2.3, dT = 65 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 9.1*2.3*65 | Answer: 136 kW

question: A reactor of volume 18.5 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 1.5 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 5.5e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 4 mm with a concentration difference of 170 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.

question: A first-order process has time constant 1.6 min and steady-state gain 3. For a step input of magnitude 10, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 1.6, K = 3, M = 10 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 3 * 10 | Answer: 30 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 120 m^2 flies at 250 m/s (air density 1 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.4. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 120, V = 250, rho = 1, CL = 1.4 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1*(250)^2*120*1.4 / 1000 | Answer: 5250 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 70 m^2 flies at 230 m/s (density 1 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.05. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 70, V = 230, rho = 1, CD = 0.05 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*1*(230)^2*70*0.05 / 1000 | Answer: 92.58 kN

question: A specimen under stress 170 MPa shows an elastic strain of 0.8e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.

question: A block of mass 29 kg has a volume of 4.4e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.

question: A rod of length 1300 mm is heated through 25 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 17e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 90 ohm, R2 = 135 ohm and R3 = 295 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 90, R2 = 135, R3 = 295 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 135*295 / 90 | Answer: 442.5 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.99 when the true value is 10. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.99, true = 10 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.99 - 10| / 10 * 100 | Answer: 0.1 %

question: Annual demand is 34000 units, ordering cost 100 per order and holding cost 24 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 34000, S = 100, H = 24 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*34000*100 / 24) | Answer: 532.3 units

question: An asset costs 450000 with salvage value 40000 after 14 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.

question: A product sells for 130 per unit with variable cost 20 per unit and fixed costs 165000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 130, V = 20, F = 165000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 165000 / (130 - 20) | Answer: 1500 units

question: Find the present worth of 125000 received 3 years from now at an interest rate of 5% per year.
solution: Given: F = 125000, n = 3, i = 5 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 125000 / (1 + 0.05)^3 | Answer: 10798 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.9, 0.98 and 0.96 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.9, r2 = 0.98, r3 = 0.96 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.9*0.98*0.96 | Answer: 0.8467

question: A process produces 13 defective items in a batch of 1000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 13, N = 1000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 13/1000 * 1e6 | Answer: 13000 PPM

question: Find the distance between the points (-2, 0) and (3, -2).

question: Find the 17th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -2 and common difference -2.

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 35500 at 8.3% per annum for 6 years.

question: Find the amount when 18500 is invested at 5.9% per annum compounded annually for 2 years.

formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 50 mm carries an axial tensile load of 117 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 26 mm and length 800 mm carries an axial load of 89 kN. Take E = 200 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 73 mm transmits a torque of 2050 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 73, Tt = 2050 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2050*1000) / (pi*(73)^3) | Answer: 26.84 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 57 mm and length 1100 mm carries a torque of 750 N-m. With G = 45 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (57)^4 / 32 = 1036333 mm^4 | theta = (750*1000)(1100) / (45000 * 1036333) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 1.014 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 146 mm wide and 260 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 146, h = 260 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 146*(260)^2 / 6 | Answer: 1644933 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (49 mm x 260 mm) carries a bending moment of 5 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (67 mm x 90 mm) has effective length 2000 mm and E = 200 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 870 MPa is designed for a working stress of 180 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 870, sw = 180 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 870 / 180 | Answer: 4.833

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 300 mm and wall thickness 12 mm carries an internal pressure of 0.8 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 300, t = 12, P = 0.8 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 0.8*300 / (2*12) | Answer: 10 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 700 K and 430 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 700, Tc = 430 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 430/700) * 100 | Answer: 38.57 %

question: A heat pump operates between 282 K and 306 K. Find its maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 282, Th = 306 | Formula: COP_hp = Th / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 306 / (306 - 282) | Answer: 12.75

question: 1.8 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 55 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.8, dT = 55 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 1.8 * 0.718 * 55 | Answer: 71.08 kJ

question: 1.8 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 140 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.8, dT = 140 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 1.8 * 1.005 * 140 | Answer: 253.3 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 2.7 m^3 at 600 K with mass 3.3 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 2.7, Tk = 600, m = 3.3 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 3.3*0.287*600 / 2.7 | Answer: 210.5 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 3.6 kg of air expands isothermally at 400 K from volume V1 to 5*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.6, Tk = 400, ratio = 5 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 3.6*0.287*400*ln(5) | Answer: 665.1 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.7 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.31 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.7, D = 0.31 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.7*0.31 / 0.001 | Answer: 1147000

question: Water issues from an orifice under a head of 4.2 m. Taking Cv = 0.99, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 4.2, cv = 0.99 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.99*sqrt(2*9.81*4.2) | Answer: 8.987 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 270 mm) water flows at 2.3 m/s. It contracts to diameter 110 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
Water flows at 2.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.32 m and length 160 m. With friction factor f = 0.032, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 22 teeth drives a gear of 47 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1250 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 22, z2 = 47, N1 = 1250 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1250*22 / 47 | Answer: 585.1 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 130 mm rotates at 1400 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 130, N = 1400 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.13)*1400 / 60 | Answer: 9.529 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 29.5 kW at 1250 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 29.5, N = 1250 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(29.5*1000) / (2*pi*1250) | Answer: 225.4 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 1.4 kg rotates at radius 0.52 m at 700 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 5000 N/m and mass 18.9 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 5000, m = 18.9 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(5000/18.9) | Answer: 2.589 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 5.2 m^2 and thickness 0.25 m has conductivity k = 42.1 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 155 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 5.2, L = 0.25, k = 42.1, dT = 155 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 42.1*5.2*155 / 0.25 | Answer: 13573 W
