question: In a pipe (diameter 240 mm) water flows at 2.2 m/s. It contracts to diameter 100 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
Water flows at 3.3 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.32 m and length 340 m. With friction factor f = 0.025, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 28 teeth drives a gear of 107 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1200 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 28, z2 = 107, N1 = 1200 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1200*28 / 107 | Answer: 314 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 140 mm rotates at 200 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 140, N = 200 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.14)*200 / 60 | Answer: 1.466 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 16.2 kW at 1200 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 16.2, N = 1200 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(16.2*1000) / (2*pi*1200) | Answer: 128.9 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 8.1 kg rotates at radius 0.34 m at 900 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 3500 N/m and mass 7.5 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 3500, m = 7.5 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(3500/7.5) | Answer: 3.438 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 3 m^2 and thickness 0.15 m has conductivity k = 42.6 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 85 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 3, L = 0.15, k = 42.6, dT = 85 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 42.6*3*85 / 0.15 | Answer: 72420 W

question: A surface of area 3.8 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 50 W/m^2-K to surroundings 140 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 3.8, h = 50, dT = 140 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 50*3.8*140 | Answer: 26600 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 240 m/min, feed = 0.21 mm/rev, depth of cut = 0.8 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 240, f = 0.21, d = 0.8 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*240*0.21*0.8 | Answer: 40320 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 340 mm is turned at 650 rpm with a feed of 0.33 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 340, N = 650, f = 0.33 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 340 / (0.33*650) | Answer: 1.585 min

question: A resistor of 71 ohm carries a current of 7.4 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 71, I = 7.4 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 7.4 * 71 | Answer: 525.4 V

question: Three resistors 68 ohm, 59 ohm and 65 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 68, R2 = 59, R3 = 65 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 68 + 59 + 65 | Answer: 192 ohm

question: Two resistors 26 ohm and 116 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 26, R2 = 116 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 26*116 / (26+116) | Answer: 21.24 ohm

question: A device draws 13.9 A at 30 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 30, I = 13.9 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 30 * 13.9 | Answer: 417 W

question: A current of 9.6 A flows through a 45 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 9.6, R = 45 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (9.6)^2 * 45 | Answer: 4147 W

question: Two capacitors 20.4 uF and 34.1 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 20.4, C2 = 34.1 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 20.4*34.1 / (20.4+34.1) | Answer: 12.76 uF

question: A resistor 52 kohm and capacitor 11.7 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 52, C = 11.7 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (52k)(11.7u) = 608.4 ms | Answer: 608.4 ms

question: An inductor 257.2 mH is in series with 93 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 257.2, R = 93 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (257.2e-3) / 93 | Answer: 2.766 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 85.5 mH inductor at 810 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 85.5, f = 810 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (810)(85.5e-3) | Answer: 435.1 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 47.1 uF capacitor at 630 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 47.1, f = 630 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (630)(47.1e-6)) | Answer: 5.364 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 30 ohm, XL = 36 ohm and XC = 90 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 30, XL = 36, XC = 90 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(30^2 + (36 - 90)^2) | Answer: 61.77 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 12.8 mH and C = 3.8 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 12.8, C = 3.8 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(12.8e-3 * 3.8e-6)) | Answer: 721.6 Hz

question: A capacitor of 15.8 uF is charged to 380 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 15.8, V = 380 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*15.8e-6*(380)^2 | Answer: 1141 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 280 V with 380 primary turns and 150 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 280, N1 = 380, N2 = 150 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 280 * 150/380 | Answer: 110.5 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 280 V and draws an armature current of 35 A. If the armature resistance is 1.07 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 280, Ia = 35, Ra = 1.07 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 280 - 35*1.07 | Answer: 242.6 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 190 A at 400 V (line) with a power factor of 0.78. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 190, VL = 400, pf = 0.78 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*400*190*0.78 / 1000 | Answer: 102.7 kW

question: A load has real power 30 kW and apparent power 50 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 30, S = 50 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 30 / 50 | Answer: 0.6

question: A machine delivers 100 kW output while drawing 187 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 100, Pi = 187 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 100/187 * 100 | Answer: 53.48 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 11 V across R1 = 14 ohm and R2 = 50 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 11, R1 = 14, R2 = 50 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 11*50 / (14+50) | Answer: 8.594 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 80 kohm and Rin = 25 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 80, Rin = 25 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 80 / 25 | Answer: 3.2

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 130 kohm and Rg = 27 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 130, Rg = 27 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 130/27 | Answer: 5.815

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 4534. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 4534 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(4534) | Answer: 36.56 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 3 m carries a central point load of 40 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3, W = 40 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 40*3 / 4 | Answer: 30 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.6 m carries a UDL of 30 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 9.6, w = 30 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 30*(9.6)^2 / 8 | Answer: 345.6 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 1.5 m carries a point load 60 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 1.5, W = 60 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 60*1.5 | Answer: 90 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.4 m carries a UDL of 32 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.4, w = 32 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 32*(5.4)^2 / 2 | Answer: 466.6 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.8 m carries a point load 85 kN at distance 2.4 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 4.8, a = 2.4, W = 85 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 85*(4.8 - 2.4) / 4.8 | Answer: 42.5 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 5.7 m) carries a central point load 50 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 510e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=50000 N, L=5700.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=510e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 15.13 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 5 m carries a UDL of 36 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5, w = 36 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 36*(5)^2 / 12 | Answer: 75 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 380 mm, clear cover 50 mm and main bars of diameter 16 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 380, c = 50, dia = 16 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 380 - 50 - 16/2 | Answer: 322 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 10.1 m^2 carrying a factored load of 16.1 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 10.1, w = 16.1 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 16.1 * 10.1 | Answer: 162.6 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 5.5 m, unit weight 16 kN/m^3, phi = 31 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 5.5e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.8, area = 7.3e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 5.5, i = 0.8, A = 7.3 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (5.5e-4)*0.8*(7.3e-3) | Answer: 3212 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.8 m, bed slope 0.009 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.029. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4.1 m under a head of 0.8 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 3.3 m wide carries a discharge of 17.9 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 340 m and design speed 65 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 340, V = 65 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (65)^2 / (127*340) | Answer: 0.09785
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 520 m^3 treats a flow of 175 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 520, Q = 175 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 520 / 175 | Answer: 2.971 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 280 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.1 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 3 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 280, k = 0.1, t = 3 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 280*(1 - e^(-0.1*3)) | Answer: 72.57 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.46, rainfall intensity 105 mm/h over a catchment of 56 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.46, i = 105, A = 56 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.46*105*56 / 360 | Answer: 7.513 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.04 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 400 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.04, M = 400 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 400*(20+0.04)/20 | Answer: 400.8 m

question: Convert the decimal number 3759 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 3759 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: EAF (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 11010111 and 00011000.
solution: XOR: 11001111 | Count of 1s = 6 | Answer: 6
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 90 megabits is sent over a link of 48 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 90, B = 48 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 90 / 48 | Answer: 1.875 s

question: A link has bandwidth 75 Mbps and round-trip time 10 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 75, R = 10 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 75e6 * 10e-3 bits = 750 kb | Answer: 750 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.88, cache access time 9 ns and main-memory access time 160 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.88, tc = 9, tm = 160 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.88*9 + (1 - 0.88)*160 | Answer: 27.12 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 517628 elements?
solution: Given: n = 517628 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(517628)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.014, memory access time 160 ns and page-fault service time 4 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 4 ms = 4000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.014)*160 + 0.014*4000000.0 ns | Answer: 56.16 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 1.7 m^3 at 180 kPa and 500 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 1.7, P = 180, Tk = 500 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (180e3)*1.7 / (8.314*500) | Answer: 73.61 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 5e10 /s and activation energy 90 kJ/mol at 400 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 5, Ea = 90, Tk = 400 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 5e10 * exp(-90e3 / (8.314*400)) | Answer: 0.08826 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.9 and bottoms xW = 0.07, with relative volatility alpha = 1.7. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.9, xw = 0.07, al = 1.7 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.9/0.1)(0.93/0.07)] / ln(1.7) | Answer: 9.016 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.56 and x = 0.45. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.56, x = 0.45 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.56/0.44) / (0.45/0.55) | Answer: 1.556

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.41 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 45 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.41, Psat = 45 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.41 * 45 | Answer: 18.45 kPa

question: A stream of 7.1 kg/s with specific heat 1.6 kJ/kg-K is heated through 20 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 7.1, cp = 1.6, dT = 20 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 7.1*1.6*20 | Answer: 227.2 kW

question: A reactor of volume 4.1 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 2.7 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 4.1, Q = 2.7 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 4.1 / 2.7 | Answer: 1.519 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 6.7e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 4 mm with a concentration difference of 60 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 6.7, L = 4, dC = 60 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (6.7e-9)*60 / (4e-3) | Answer: 100.5 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 3.6 min and steady-state gain 1.6. For a step input of magnitude 18, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 3.6, K = 1.6, M = 18 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 1.6 * 18 | Answer: 28.8 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 65 m^2 flies at 240 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.2. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 65, V = 240, rho = 0.7, CL = 1.2 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.7*(240)^2*65*1.2 / 1000 | Answer: 1572 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 55 m^2 flies at 150 m/s (density 1.225 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.02. Find the drag force in kN.
A specimen under stress 200 MPa shows an elastic strain of 3e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 200, eps = 3 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 200 / (3e-3) MPa = 66.67 GPa | Answer: 66.67 GPa

question: A block of mass 11 kg has a volume of 4.7e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 11, V = 4.7 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 11 / (4.7e-3) | Answer: 234 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2000 mm is heated through 35 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2000, dT = 35, al = 23 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2000*23e-6*35 | Answer: 1.61 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 135 ohm, R2 = 130 ohm and R3 = 470 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 135, R2 = 130, R3 = 470 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 130*470 / 135 | Answer: 452.6 ohm

question: A measurement reads 10.39 when the true value is 10. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 10.39, true = 10 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |10.39 - 10| / 10 * 100 | Answer: 3.9 %

question: Annual demand is 3500 units, ordering cost 260 per order and holding cost 8 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 3500, S = 260, H = 8 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*3500*260 / 8) | Answer: 477 units

question: An asset costs 50000 with salvage value 14000 after 7 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 50000, Sv = 14000, n = 7 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (50000 - 14000) / 7 | Answer: 5143 per year

question: A product sells for 480 per unit with variable cost 140 per unit and fixed costs 85000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 480, V = 140, F = 85000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 85000 / (480 - 140) | Answer: 250 units

question: Find the present worth of 30000 received 3 years from now at an interest rate of 6% per year.
solution: Given: F = 30000, n = 3, i = 6 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 30000 / (1 + 0.06)^3 | Answer: 25189 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.93, 0.97 and 0.96 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.93, r2 = 0.97, r3 = 0.96 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.93*0.97*0.96 | Answer: 0.866

question: A process produces 20 defective items in a batch of 12500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 20, N = 12500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 20/12500 * 1e6 | Answer: 1600 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = x^3 + 2x^2 - 2x - 3 evaluated at x = 5.
For f(x) = 4x^3 + 6x^2 + 7x + 5, find f''(x) at x = 2.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-4x^2 - 6x + 6) dx from x = 2 to x = 3.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -4x^3/3 + -6x^2/2 + 6x | Evaluate F(3) - F(2) | Answer: -34.33
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of x^2 - 9x = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[-2, 2], [-2, 2]].
solution: Given: a = -2, b = 2, c = -2, d = 2 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (-2)(2) - (2)(-2) | Answer: 0

question: Find the determinant of [[5, -4, -1], [-1, 5, -2], [3, 1, 2]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 92

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[6, -2], [-1, 8]].
solution: Trace tr = 14, Determinant = 46 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 8.732

question: Solve for x: -4x + -4y = 10 and -2x + -4y = -5.
solution: Determinant = -4*-4 - -4*-2 = 8 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -7.5 | Answer: x = -7.5
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 70, 24, 76, 46, 50.
solution: Sum = 266 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 53.2 | Answer: 53.2

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 37, 32, 14, 50, 4.
solution: Mean = 27.4 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 18.38

question: Find the slope of the line through (6, -9) and (-8, 8).
solution: Given: x1 = 6, y1 = -9, x2 = -8, y2 = 8 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (8 - -9) / (-8 - 6) | Answer: -1.214

question: Find the distance between the points (-5, -7) and (4, 1).
solution: Given: x1 = -5, y1 = -7, x2 = 4, y2 = 1 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((9)^2 + (8)^2) | Answer: 12.04 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-3,7), (1,0), (-4,7).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 3.5 sq units

question: Find the 9th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 11 and common difference 0.
solution: Given: a = 11, d = 0, n = 9 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 11 + (9 - 1)*0 | Answer: 11

question: Find the sum of the first 20 terms of an AP with first term 2 and common difference -7.
solution: Given: a = 2, d = -7, n = 20 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 20/2 [2*2 + (20-1)*-7] | Answer: -1290

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 9000 at 10.4% per annum for 3 years.
solution: Given: P = 9000, R = 10.4, Tt = 3 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 9000 * 10.4 * 3 / 100 | Answer: 2808 currency units

question: Find the amount when 10500 is invested at 7.5% per annum compounded annually for 3 years.
solution: Given: P = 10500, R = 7.5, Tt = 3 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 10500 * (1 + 7.5/100)^3 | Answer: 13044 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (-2, 2, 7) and (4, 5, -5).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (4, 1, 3) and (1, -1, 2).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 8.66

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (-6, 1, 4) and (3, 4, -5).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 131.3 degrees

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number 12 + 3i.
solution: Given: a = 12, b = 3 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(3, 12) | Answer: 14.04 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -4x^3 + 4x^2 - 5x - 2 at x = 4.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-163 with initial guess x0=13, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=0.6 and ordinates 15, 6, 12, 13, 13, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 345 and 387.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 345 and 387 | Answer: GCD = 3

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 37 and 7.
solution: Given: a = 37, b = 7 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 37*7 / 1 | Answer: 259
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 11 mm carries an axial tensile load of 113 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 13 mm and length 1100 mm carries an axial load of 81 kN. Take E = 70 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 35 mm transmits a torque of 2600 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 35, Tt = 2600 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2600*1000) / (pi*(35)^3) | Answer: 308.8 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 39 mm and length 800 mm carries a torque of 450 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (39)^4 / 32 = 227122 mm^4 | theta = (450*1000)(800) / (80000 * 227122) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 1.135 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 114 mm wide and 190 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 114, h = 190 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 114*(190)^2 / 6 | Answer: 685900 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (99 mm x 110 mm) carries a bending moment of 11 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (53 mm x 110 mm) has effective length 3900 mm and E = 200 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 580 MPa is designed for a working stress of 220 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 580, sw = 220 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 580 / 220 | Answer: 2.636

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1200 mm and wall thickness 10 mm carries an internal pressure of 2.4 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1200, t = 10, P = 2.4 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 2.4*1200 / (2*10) | Answer: 144 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 1000 K and 360 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 1000, Tc = 360 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 360/1000) * 100 | Answer: 64 %

question: A heat pump operates between 276 K and 332 K. Find its maximum (Carnot) COP.
solution: Given: Tc = 276, Th = 332 | Formula: COP_hp = Th / (Th - Tc) | Substitute: COP = 332 / (332 - 276) | Answer: 5.929

question: 4.4 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 85 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.4, dT = 85 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 4.4 * 0.718 * 85 | Answer: 268.5 kJ

question: 5.1 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 170 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 5.1, dT = 170 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 5.1 * 1.005 * 170 | Answer: 871.3 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 0.7 m^3 at 400 K with mass 2.3 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 0.7, Tk = 400, m = 2.3 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 2.3*0.287*400 / 0.7 | Answer: 377.2 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4.7 kg of air expands isothermally at 390 K from volume V1 to 5*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.7, Tk = 390, ratio = 5 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4.7*0.287*390*ln(5) | Answer: 846.7 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.13 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.8, D = 0.13 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.8*0.13 / 0.001 | Answer: 494000

question: Water flows at 2.7 m/s through a pipe of diameter 260 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 19.8 m. Taking Cv = 0.96, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 19.8, cv = 0.96 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.96*sqrt(2*9.81*19.8) | Answer: 18.92 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 180 mm) water flows at 2 m/s. It contracts to diameter 60 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 180, d2 = 60, V1 = 2 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2*(180/60)^2 | Answer: 18 m/s

question: Water flows at 1.2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.38 m and length 380 m. With friction factor f = 0.03, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 24 teeth drives a gear of 71 teeth. If the pinion runs at 300 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 24, z2 = 71, N1 = 300 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 300*24 / 71 | Answer: 101.4 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 440 mm rotates at 1350 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 440, N = 1350 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.44)*1350 / 60 | Answer: 31.1 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 40.7 kW at 850 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 40.7, N = 850 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(40.7*1000) / (2*pi*850) | Answer: 457.2 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 3 kg rotates at radius 0.27 m at 600 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 6200 N/m and mass 12.3 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 6200, m = 12.3 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(6200/12.3) | Answer: 3.573 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 3.2 m^2 and thickness 0.22 m has conductivity k = 35.2 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 90 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 3.2, L = 0.22, k = 35.2, dT = 90 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 35.2*3.2*90 / 0.22 | Answer: 46080 W

question: A surface of area 2.8 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 200 W/m^2-K to surroundings 105 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 2.8, h = 200, dT = 105 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 200*2.8*105 | Answer: 58800 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 180 m/min, feed = 0.47 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.5 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 180, f = 0.47, d = 2.5 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*180*0.47*2.5 | Answer: 211500 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 230 mm is turned at 400 rpm with a feed of 0.16 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 230, N = 400, f = 0.16 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 230 / (0.16*400) | Answer: 3.594 min

question: A resistor of 115 ohm carries a current of 7.9 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 115, I = 7.9 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 7.9 * 115 | Answer: 908.5 V

question: Three resistors 14 ohm, 5 ohm and 6 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 14, R2 = 5, R3 = 6 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 14 + 5 + 6 | Answer: 25 ohm

question: Two resistors 108 ohm and 89 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 108, R2 = 89 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 108*89 / (108+89) | Answer: 48.79 ohm

question: A device draws 5.7 A at 170 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 170, I = 5.7 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 170 * 5.7 | Answer: 969 W

question: A current of 7.3 A flows through a 27 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 7.3, R = 27 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (7.3)^2 * 27 | Answer: 1439 W

question: Two capacitors 12.8 uF and 41.1 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 12.8, C2 = 41.1 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 12.8*41.1 / (12.8+41.1) | Answer: 9.76 uF

question: A resistor 21 kohm and capacitor 15.4 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 21, C = 15.4 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (21k)(15.4u) = 323.4 ms | Answer: 323.4 ms

question: An inductor 99.2 mH is in series with 199 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 99.2, R = 199 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (99.2e-3) / 199 | Answer: 0.4985 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 96.9 mH inductor at 670 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 96.9, f = 670 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (670)(96.9e-3) | Answer: 407.9 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 28.9 uF capacitor at 190 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 28.9, f = 190 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (190)(28.9e-6)) | Answer: 28.98 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 24 ohm, XL = 83 ohm and XC = 114 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 24, XL = 83, XC = 114 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(24^2 + (83 - 114)^2) | Answer: 39.2 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 39.6 mH and C = 6.5 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 39.6, C = 6.5 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(39.6e-3 * 6.5e-6)) | Answer: 313.7 Hz

question: A capacitor of 24.1 uF is charged to 290 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 24.1, V = 290 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*24.1e-6*(290)^2 | Answer: 1013 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 190 V with 220 primary turns and 450 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 190, N1 = 220, N2 = 450 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 190 * 450/220 | Answer: 388.6 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 180 V and draws an armature current of 9 A. If the armature resistance is 1.14 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 180, Ia = 9, Ra = 1.14 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 180 - 9*1.14 | Answer: 169.7 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 135 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.92. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 135, VL = 433, pf = 0.92 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*135*0.92 / 1000 | Answer: 93.15 kW

question: A load has real power 170 kW and apparent power 220 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 170, S = 220 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 170 / 220 | Answer: 0.7727

question: A machine delivers 25 kW output while drawing 27 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 25, Pi = 27 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 25/27 * 100 | Answer: 92.59 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 28 V across R1 = 25 ohm and R2 = 7 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 28, R1 = 25, R2 = 7 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 28*7 / (25+7) | Answer: 6.125 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 170 kohm and Rin = 43 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 170, Rin = 43 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 170 / 43 | Answer: 3.953

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 140 kohm and Rg = 10 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 140, Rg = 10 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 140/10 | Answer: 15

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 2641. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 2641 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(2641) | Answer: 34.22 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.3 m carries a central point load of 115 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.3, W = 115 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 115*5.3 / 4 | Answer: 152.4 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.9 m carries a point load 65 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.9, W = 65 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 65*2.9 | Answer: 188.5 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 4.9 m carries a UDL of 24 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.9, w = 24 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 24*(4.9)^2 / 2 | Answer: 288.1 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.1 m carries a point load 90 kN at distance 1.6 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 5.1, a = 1.6, W = 90 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 90*(5.1 - 1.6) / 5.1 | Answer: 61.76 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 7.3 m) carries a central point load 75 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 450e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=75000 N, L=7300.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=450e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 54.03 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 4 m carries a UDL of 21 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4, w = 21 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 21*(4)^2 / 12 | Answer: 28 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 620 mm, clear cover 30 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 620, c = 30, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 620 - 30 - 12/2 | Answer: 584 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 28.7 m^2 carrying a factored load of 8.7 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 28.7, w = 8.7 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 8.7 * 28.7 | Answer: 249.7 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 6.9 m, unit weight 19 kN/m^3, phi = 37 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 3.7e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1.3, area = 2.3e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 3.7, i = 1.3, A = 2.3 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (3.7e-4)*1.3*(2.3e-3) | Answer: 1106 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1.2 m, bed slope 0.008 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.023. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4.1 m under a head of 0.7 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 2.7 m wide carries a discharge of 27.9 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 300 m and design speed 75 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 300, V = 75 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (75)^2 / (127*300) | Answer: 0.1476
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 790 m^3 treats a flow of 10 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 790, Q = 10 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 790 / 10 | Answer: 79 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 190 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.22 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 4 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 190, k = 0.22, t = 4 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 190*(1 - e^(-0.22*4)) | Answer: 111.2 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.85, rainfall intensity 40 mm/h over a catchment of 26 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.85, i = 40, A = 26 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.85*40*26 / 360 | Answer: 2.456 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.05 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 360 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.05, M = 360 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 360*(20+0.05)/20 | Answer: 360.9 m

question: Convert the decimal number 1697 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 1697 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 6A1 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 01010001 and 10110111.
solution: XOR: 11100110 | Count of 1s = 5 | Answer: 5
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 230 megabits is sent over a link of 15 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 230, B = 15 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 230 / 15 | Answer: 15.33 s

question: A link has bandwidth 24 Mbps and round-trip time 80 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 24, R = 80 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 24e6 * 80e-3 bits = 1920 kb | Answer: 1920 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.91, cache access time 3 ns and main-memory access time 110 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.91, tc = 3, tm = 110 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.91*3 + (1 - 0.91)*110 | Answer: 12.63 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 447589 elements?
solution: Given: n = 447589 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(447589)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.006, memory access time 90 ns and page-fault service time 6 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 6 ms = 6000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.006)*90 + 0.006*6000000.0 ns | Answer: 36.09 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.8 m^3 at 290 kPa and 480 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.8, P = 290, Tk = 480 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (290e3)*2.8 / (8.314*480) | Answer: 203.5 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.1 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 2 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.1, t = 2 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.1*2) | Answer: 0.1813

question: A first-order liquid reaction (k = 0.2 /min) is to reach 85% conversion in a plug-flow reactor. Find the required space time in minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.2, X = 85 | Formula: tau = -ln(1 - X) / k | Substitute: tau = -ln(1 - 0.85) / 0.2 | Answer: 9.486 min

question: For a reaction with A = 3e10 /s and activation energy 75 kJ/mol at 340 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 3, Ea = 75, Tk = 340 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 3e10 * exp(-75e3 / (8.314*340)) | Answer: 0.09002 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.99 and bottoms xW = 0.06, with relative volatility alpha = 2.4. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.99, xw = 0.06, al = 2.4 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.99/0.01)(0.94/0.06)] / ln(2.4) | Answer: 8.392 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.83 and x = 0.2. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.83, x = 0.2 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.83/0.17) / (0.2/0.8) | Answer: 19.53

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.72 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 105 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.72, Psat = 105 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.72 * 105 | Answer: 75.6 kPa

question: A stream of 7.7 kg/s with specific heat 3.2 kJ/kg-K is heated through 45 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 7.7, cp = 3.2, dT = 45 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 7.7*3.2*45 | Answer: 1109 kW

question: A reactor of volume 15.8 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 4.4 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 15.8, Q = 4.4 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 15.8 / 4.4 | Answer: 3.591 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 5.7e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 5 mm with a concentration difference of 110 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 5.7, L = 5, dC = 110 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (5.7e-9)*110 / (5e-3) | Answer: 125.4 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 1.5 min and steady-state gain 0.9. For a step input of magnitude 17, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 1.5, K = 0.9, M = 17 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 0.9 * 17 | Answer: 15.3 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 80 m^2 flies at 80 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.2. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 80, V = 80, rho = 0.7, CL = 1.2 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.7*(80)^2*80*1.2 / 1000 | Answer: 215 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 25 m^2 flies at 100 m/s (density 1.225 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.11. Find the drag force in kN.
A specimen under stress 210 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.5e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 210, eps = 2.5 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 210 / (2.5e-3) MPa = 84 GPa | Answer: 84 GPa

question: A block of mass 23 kg has a volume of 3.7e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 23, V = 3.7 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 23 / (3.7e-3) | Answer: 6216 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2500 mm is heated through 80 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2500, dT = 80, al = 23 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2500*23e-6*80 | Answer: 4.6 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 110 ohm, R2 = 160 ohm and R3 = 155 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 110, R2 = 160, R3 = 155 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 160*155 / 110 | Answer: 225.5 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.66 when the true value is 10. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.66, true = 10 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.66 - 10| / 10 * 100 | Answer: 3.4 %

question: Annual demand is 49500 units, ordering cost 110 per order and holding cost 31 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 49500, S = 110, H = 31 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*49500*110 / 31) | Answer: 592.7 units

question: An asset costs 430000 with salvage value 2000 after 20 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 430000, Sv = 2000, n = 20 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (430000 - 2000) / 20 | Answer: 21400 per year

question: A product sells for 310 per unit with variable cost 50 per unit and fixed costs 50000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 310, V = 50, F = 50000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 50000 / (310 - 50) | Answer: 192.3 units

question: Find the present worth of 105000 received 2 years from now at an interest rate of 11% per year.
solution: Given: F = 105000, n = 2, i = 11 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 105000 / (1 + 0.11)^2 | Answer: 8522 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.92, 0.98 and 0.97 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.92, r2 = 0.98, r3 = 0.97 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.92*0.98*0.97 | Answer: 0.8746

question: A process produces 34 defective items in a batch of 13500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 34, N = 13500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 34/13500 * 1e6 | Answer: 2519 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 4x^3 + 4x^2 + 9x evaluated at x = 2.
For f(x) = -6x^3 + 3x^2 + 6x - 8, find f''(x) at x = 3.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-4x^2 + x - 3) dx from x = 1 to x = 5.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -4x^3/3 + 1x^2/2 + -3x | Evaluate F(5) - F(1) | Answer: -165.3
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 3x^2 - 6x - 7 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[-5, 7], [-3, 2]].
solution: Given: a = -5, b = 7, c = -3, d = 2 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (-5)(2) - (7)(-3) | Answer: 11

question: Find the determinant of [[6, 3, 2], [0, 4, -1], [-4, 3, 6]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 206

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[-7, 8], [7, -5]].
solution: Trace tr = -12, Determinant = -21 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 1.55

question: Solve for x: -2x + 2y = 1 and -6x + 1y = 2.
solution: Determinant = -2*1 - 2*-6 = 10 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -0.3 | Answer: x = -0.3
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 32, 88, 89, 12, 96.
solution: Sum = 317 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 63.4 | Answer: 63.4

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 42, 43, 46, 37, 44.
solution: Mean = 42.4 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 3.362

question: Find the slope of the line through (7, -9) and (-9, -2).
Find the distance between the points (-5, -8) and (-4, -6).
solution: Given: x1 = -5, y1 = -8, x2 = -4, y2 = -6 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((1)^2 + (2)^2) | Answer: 2.236 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (8,0), (-5,-3), (2,5).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 41.5 sq units

question: Find the 29th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -14 and common difference 1.
solution: Given: a = -14, d = 1, n = 29 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -14 + (29 - 1)*1 | Answer: 14

question: Find the sum of the first 6 terms of an AP with first term -7 and common difference 7.
solution: Given: a = -7, d = 7, n = 6 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 6/2 [2*-7 + (6-1)*7] | Answer: 63

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 22500 at 6.9% per annum for 4 years.
solution: Given: P = 22500, R = 6.9, Tt = 4 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 22500 * 6.9 * 4 / 100 | Answer: 6210 currency units

question: Find the amount when 37000 is invested at 11.6% per annum compounded annually for 2 years.
solution: Given: P = 37000, R = 11.6, Tt = 2 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 37000 * (1 + 11.6/100)^2 | Answer: 46082 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (5, -1, 2) and (5, -4, 7).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (-6, 2, 4) and (-3, -2, 5).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 31.18

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (-4, 6, 0) and (-2, 0, -3).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 72.08 degrees

question: Find the modulus of the complex number -9 + 9i.
solution: Given: a = -9, b = 9 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((-9)^2 + (9)^2) | Answer: 12.73

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number -5 + 2i.
solution: Given: a = -5, b = 2 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(2, -5) | Answer: 158.2 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -2x^3 + 5x^2 + 5 at x = -4.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-57 with initial guess x0=8, find x1 (one iteration).
solution: Given: N = 57, x0 = 8 | Formula: x1 = x0 - (x0^2 - N)/(2 x0) | Substitute: x1 = 8 - ((8)^2 - 57)/(2*8) | Answer: 7.562

question: Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=2 and ordinates 1, 7, 17, 10, 15, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 282 and 515.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 282 and 515 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 45 and 11.
solution: Given: a = 45, b = 11 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 45*11 / 1 | Answer: 495
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 11 mm carries an axial tensile load of 12 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 34 mm and length 1300 mm carries an axial load of 37 kN. Take E = 200 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 47 mm transmits a torque of 2250 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 47, Tt = 2250 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2250*1000) / (pi*(47)^3) | Answer: 110.4 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 58 mm and length 600 mm carries a torque of 2000 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (58)^4 / 32 = 1110994 mm^4 | theta = (2000*1000)(600) / (80000 * 1110994) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.7736 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 50 mm wide and 180 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 50, h = 180 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 50*(180)^2 / 6 | Answer: 270000 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (63 mm x 220 mm) carries a bending moment of 13 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (33 mm x 110 mm) has effective length 1800 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 370 MPa is designed for a working stress of 100 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 370, sw = 100 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 370 / 100 | Answer: 3.7

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 550 mm and wall thickness 7 mm carries an internal pressure of 2.6 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 550, t = 7, P = 2.6 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 2.6*550 / (2*7) | Answer: 102.1 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 960 K and 370 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 960, Tc = 370 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 370/960) * 100 | Answer: 61.46 %

question: 5 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 135 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 5, dT = 135 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 5 * 0.718 * 135 | Answer: 484.6 kJ

question: 3 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 30 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3, dT = 30 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 3 * 1.005 * 30 | Answer: 90.45 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 2.5 m^3 at 540 K with mass 3.3 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 2.5, Tk = 540, m = 3.3 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 3.3*0.287*540 / 2.5 | Answer: 204.6 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 3.9 kg of air expands isothermally at 480 K from volume V1 to 2*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.9, Tk = 480, ratio = 2 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 3.9*0.287*480*ln(2) | Answer: 372.4 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 2.7 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.06 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 2.7, D = 0.06 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*2.7*0.06 / 0.001 | Answer: 162000

question: Water flows at 3.2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 140 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
