question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 22 and 28.
solution: Given: a = 22, b = 28 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 22*28 / 2 | Answer: 308
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 60 mm carries an axial tensile load of 51 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 39 mm and length 1600 mm carries an axial load of 64 kN. Take E = 200 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 69 mm transmits a torque of 2550 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 69, Tt = 2550 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2550*1000) / (pi*(69)^3) | Answer: 39.53 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 59 mm and length 2000 mm carries a torque of 900 N-m. With G = 77 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (59)^4 / 32 = 1189619 mm^4 | theta = (900*1000)(2000) / (77000 * 1189619) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 1.126 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 119 mm wide and 60 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 119, h = 60 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 119*(60)^2 / 6 | Answer: 71400 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (112 mm x 120 mm) carries a bending moment of 14 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (48 mm x 110 mm) has effective length 2200 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 330 MPa is designed for a working stress of 250 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 330, sw = 250 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 330 / 250 | Answer: 1.32

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1500 mm and wall thickness 15 mm carries an internal pressure of 2.7 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1500, t = 15, P = 2.7 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 2.7*1500 / (2*15) | Answer: 135 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 1100 K and 370 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 1100, Tc = 370 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 370/1100) * 100 | Answer: 66.36 %

question: 2.7 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 120 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.7, dT = 120 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 2.7 * 0.718 * 120 | Answer: 232.6 kJ

question: 2.7 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 180 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.7, dT = 180 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 2.7 * 1.005 * 180 | Answer: 488.4 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1.6 m^3 at 590 K with mass 5.4 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1.6, Tk = 590, m = 5.4 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 5.4*0.287*590 / 1.6 | Answer: 571.5 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 2.1 kg of air expands isothermally at 470 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.1, Tk = 470, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 2.1*0.287*470*ln(4) | Answer: 392.7 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 2.3 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.29 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 2.3, D = 0.29 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*2.3*0.29 / 0.001 | Answer: 667000

question: Water flows at 1.9 m/s through a pipe of diameter 170 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 5.5 m. Taking Cv = 0.95, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 5.5, cv = 0.95 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.95*sqrt(2*9.81*5.5) | Answer: 9.869 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 390 mm) water flows at 2.1 m/s. It contracts to diameter 70 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 390, d2 = 70, V1 = 2.1 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2.1*(390/70)^2 | Answer: 65.19 m/s

question: Water flows at 2.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.45 m and length 160 m. With friction factor f = 0.032, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 22 teeth drives a gear of 94 teeth. If the pinion runs at 350 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 22, z2 = 94, N1 = 350 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 350*22 / 94 | Answer: 81.91 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 320 mm rotates at 1000 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 320, N = 1000 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.32)*1000 / 60 | Answer: 16.76 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 18.8 kW at 1500 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 18.8, N = 1500 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(18.8*1000) / (2*pi*1500) | Answer: 119.7 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 9.2 kg rotates at radius 0.5 m at 300 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 7400 N/m and mass 7.8 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 7400, m = 7.8 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(7400/7.8) | Answer: 4.902 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 8 m^2 and thickness 0.36 m has conductivity k = 38.8 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 195 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 8, L = 0.36, k = 38.8, dT = 195 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 38.8*8*195 / 0.36 | Answer: 168133 W

question: A surface of area 2.2 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 170 W/m^2-K to surroundings 95 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 2.2, h = 170, dT = 95 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 170*2.2*95 | Answer: 35530 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 180 m/min, feed = 0.32 mm/rev, depth of cut = 0.9 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 180, f = 0.32, d = 0.9 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*180*0.32*0.9 | Answer: 51840 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 280 mm is turned at 350 rpm with a feed of 0.17 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 280, N = 350, f = 0.17 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 280 / (0.17*350) | Answer: 4.706 min

question: A resistor of 129 ohm carries a current of 4.1 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 129, I = 4.1 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 4.1 * 129 | Answer: 528.9 V

question: Three resistors 31 ohm, 61 ohm and 93 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 31, R2 = 61, R3 = 93 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 31 + 61 + 93 | Answer: 185 ohm

question: Two resistors 21 ohm and 24 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 21, R2 = 24 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 21*24 / (21+24) | Answer: 11.2 ohm

question: A device draws 3.1 A at 100 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 100, I = 3.1 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 100 * 3.1 | Answer: 310 W

question: A current of 10.8 A flows through a 71 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 10.8, R = 71 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (10.8)^2 * 71 | Answer: 8281 W

question: Two capacitors 27.8 uF and 4 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 27.8, C2 = 4 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 27.8*4 / (27.8+4) | Answer: 3.497 uF

question: A resistor 42 kohm and capacitor 10.4 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 42, C = 10.4 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (42k)(10.4u) = 436.8 ms | Answer: 436.8 ms

question: An inductor 40.8 mH is in series with 24 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 40.8, R = 24 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (40.8e-3) / 24 | Answer: 1.7 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 38.9 mH inductor at 110 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 38.9, f = 110 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (110)(38.9e-3) | Answer: 26.89 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 30.7 uF capacitor at 520 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 30.7, f = 520 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (520)(30.7e-6)) | Answer: 9.97 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 52 ohm, XL = 44 ohm and XC = 133 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 52, XL = 44, XC = 133 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(52^2 + (44 - 133)^2) | Answer: 103.1 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 42 mH and C = 1.7 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 42, C = 1.7 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(42e-3 * 1.7e-6)) | Answer: 595.6 Hz

question: A capacitor of 22.1 uF is charged to 155 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 22.1, V = 155 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*22.1e-6*(155)^2 | Answer: 265.5 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 320 V with 670 primary turns and 420 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 320, N1 = 670, N2 = 420 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 320 * 420/670 | Answer: 200.6 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 320 V and draws an armature current of 48 A. If the armature resistance is 1.27 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 320, Ia = 48, Ra = 1.27 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 320 - 48*1.27 | Answer: 259 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 100 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.98. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 100, VL = 415, pf = 0.98 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*100*0.98 / 1000 | Answer: 70.44 kW

question: A load has real power 90 kW and apparent power 115 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 90, S = 115 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 90 / 115 | Answer: 0.7826

question: A machine delivers 35 kW output while drawing 97 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 35, Pi = 97 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 35/97 * 100 | Answer: 36.08 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 14 V across R1 = 30 ohm and R2 = 2 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 14, R1 = 30, R2 = 2 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 14*2 / (30+2) | Answer: 0.875 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 200 kohm and Rin = 25 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 200, Rin = 25 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 200 / 25 | Answer: 8

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 50 kohm and Rg = 24 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 50, Rg = 24 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 50/24 | Answer: 3.083

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 4737. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 4737 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(4737) | Answer: 36.76 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.5 m carries a central point load of 55 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6.5, W = 55 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 55*6.5 / 4 | Answer: 89.38 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.3 m carries a point load 65 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.3, W = 65 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 65*2.3 | Answer: 149.5 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.4 m carries a UDL of 18 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.4, w = 18 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 18*(2.4)^2 / 2 | Answer: 51.84 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 8.8 m carries a point load 70 kN at distance 3.2 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 8.8, a = 3.2, W = 70 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 70*(8.8 - 3.2) / 8.8 | Answer: 44.55 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 6.6 m) carries a central point load 55 kN. With E = 30 GPa and I = 560e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=55000 N, L=6600.0 mm, E=30000 MPa, I=560e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 19.61 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 490 mm, clear cover 30 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 490, c = 30, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 490 - 30 - 12/2 | Answer: 454 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 22 m^2 carrying a factored load of 13.7 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 22, w = 13.7 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 13.7 * 22 | Answer: 301.4 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 3.3 m, unit weight 17 kN/m^3, phi = 32 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 6.2e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.5, area = 2.2e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 6.2, i = 0.5, A = 2.2 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (6.2e-4)*0.5*(2.2e-3) | Answer: 682 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.7 m, bed slope 0.004 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.022. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4.4 m under a head of 0.9 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.6 m wide carries a discharge of 3.7 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 450 m^3 treats a flow of 110 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 450, Q = 110 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 450 / 110 | Answer: 4.091 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 350 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.33 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 8 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 350, k = 0.33, t = 8 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 350*(1 - e^(-0.33*8)) | Answer: 325 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.88, rainfall intensity 30 mm/h over a catchment of 54.3 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.88, i = 30, A = 54.3 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.88*30*54.3 / 360 | Answer: 3.982 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.01 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 490 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.01, M = 490 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 490*(30+0.01)/30 | Answer: 490.2 m

question: Convert the decimal number 2593 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 2593 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: A21 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 00001010 and 00000000.
solution: XOR: 00001010 | Count of 1s = 2 | Answer: 2
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 760 megabits is sent over a link of 7 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 760, B = 7 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 760 / 7 | Answer: 108.6 s

question: A link has bandwidth 67 Mbps and round-trip time 90 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 67, R = 90 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 67e6 * 90e-3 bits = 6030 kb | Answer: 6030 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.92, cache access time 5 ns and main-memory access time 200 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.92, tc = 5, tm = 200 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.92*5 + (1 - 0.92)*200 | Answer: 20.6 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 959800 elements?
solution: Given: n = 959800 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(959800)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.01, memory access time 110 ns and page-fault service time 7 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 7 ms = 7000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.01)*110 + 0.01*7000000.0 ns | Answer: 70.11 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 1.6 m^3 at 240 kPa and 450 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 1.6, P = 240, Tk = 450 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (240e3)*1.6 / (8.314*450) | Answer: 102.6 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.28 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 7 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.28, t = 7 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.28*7) | Answer: 0.8591

question: For a reaction with A = 2e10 /s and activation energy 55 kJ/mol at 490 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 2, Ea = 55, Tk = 490 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 2e10 * exp(-55e3 / (8.314*490)) | Answer: 274 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.97 and bottoms xW = 0.05, with relative volatility alpha = 2.2. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.97, xw = 0.05, al = 2.2 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.97/0.03)(0.95/0.05)] / ln(2.2) | Answer: 8.143 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.71 and x = 0.42. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.71, x = 0.42 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.71/0.29) / (0.42/0.58) | Answer: 3.381

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.22 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 40 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.22, Psat = 40 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.22 * 40 | Answer: 8.8 kPa

question: A stream of 7.8 kg/s with specific heat 4.1 kJ/kg-K is heated through 80 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 7.8, cp = 4.1, dT = 80 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 7.8*4.1*80 | Answer: 2558 kW

question: A reactor of volume 16.9 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 4.6 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 16.9, Q = 4.6 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 16.9 / 4.6 | Answer: 3.674 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 5.3e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 5 mm with a concentration difference of 190 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 5.3, L = 5, dC = 190 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (5.3e-9)*190 / (5e-3) | Answer: 201.4 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 1.6 min and steady-state gain 1.5. For a step input of magnitude 15, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 1.6, K = 1.5, M = 15 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 1.5 * 15 | Answer: 22.5 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 35 m^2 flies at 260 m/s (air density 1.225 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.4. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 35, V = 260, rho = 1.225, CL = 0.4 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1.225*(260)^2*35*0.4 / 1000 | Answer: 579.7 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 70 m^2 flies at 160 m/s (density 0.7 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.04. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 70, V = 160, rho = 0.7, CD = 0.04 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.7*(160)^2*70*0.04 / 1000 | Answer: 25.09 kN

question: A specimen under stress 260 MPa shows an elastic strain of 1.8e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 260, eps = 1.8 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 260 / (1.8e-3) MPa = 144.4 GPa | Answer: 144.4 GPa

question: A block of mass 41 kg has a volume of 1.6e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 41, V = 1.6 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 41 / (1.6e-3) | Answer: 25625 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2000 mm is heated through 45 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 17e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2000, dT = 45, al = 17 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2000*17e-6*45 | Answer: 1.53 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 100 ohm, R2 = 180 ohm and R3 = 450 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 100, R2 = 180, R3 = 450 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 180*450 / 100 | Answer: 810 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.4 when the true value is 50. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.4, true = 50 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.4 - 50| / 50 * 100 | Answer: 81.2 %

question: Annual demand is 40000 units, ordering cost 260 per order and holding cost 28 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 40000, S = 260, H = 28 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*40000*260 / 28) | Answer: 861.9 units

question: An asset costs 60000 with salvage value 8000 after 6 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 60000, Sv = 8000, n = 6 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (60000 - 8000) / 6 | Answer: 8667 per year

question: A product sells for 400 per unit with variable cost 110 per unit and fixed costs 80000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 400, V = 110, F = 80000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 80000 / (400 - 110) | Answer: 275.9 units

question: Find the present worth of 75000 received 4 years from now at an interest rate of 11% per year.
solution: Given: F = 75000, n = 4, i = 11 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 75000 / (1 + 0.11)^4 | Answer: 49405 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.91, 0.98 and 0.94 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.91, r2 = 0.98, r3 = 0.94 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.91*0.98*0.94 | Answer: 0.8383

question: A process produces 21 defective items in a batch of 11500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 21, N = 11500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 21/11500 * 1e6 | Answer: 1826 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = -3x^3 - 5x^2 + x + 2 evaluated at x = 4.
For f(x) = -4x^3 + 4x^2 + 9x + 7, find f''(x) at x = 2.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-x^2 - x + 4) dx from x = 0 to x = 6.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -1x^3/3 + -1x^2/2 + 4x | Evaluate F(6) - F(0) | Answer: -66
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 3x^2 + 2x - 7 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[3, -5], [8, -2]].
solution: Given: a = 3, b = -5, c = 8, d = -2 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (3)(-2) - (-5)(8) | Answer: 34

question: Find the determinant of [[-1, -4, -4], [-1, 4, 6], [-6, 5, 2]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 82

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[-5, 0], [-4, 8]].
solution: Trace tr = 3, Determinant = -40 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 8

question: Solve for x: 5x + -5y = 0 and -6x + 4y = 0.
solution: Determinant = 5*4 - -5*-6 = -10 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 0 | Answer: x = 0
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 30, 73, 65, 95, 38.
solution: Sum = 301 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 60.2 | Answer: 60.2

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 40, 32, 12, 39, 3.
solution: Mean = 25.2 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 16.75

question: Find the slope of the line through (-2, 6) and (-9, -4).
solution: Given: x1 = -2, y1 = 6, x2 = -9, y2 = -4 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (-4 - 6) / (-9 - -2) | Answer: 1.429

question: Find the distance between the points (-1, 7) and (9, 9).
solution: Given: x1 = -1, y1 = 7, x2 = 9, y2 = 9 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((10)^2 + (2)^2) | Answer: 10.2 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (8,0), (-3,1), (-7,-1).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 13 sq units

question: Find the 19th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 3 and common difference 4.
solution: Given: a = 3, d = 4, n = 19 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 3 + (19 - 1)*4 | Answer: 75

question: Find the sum of the first 40 terms of an AP with first term -15 and common difference 8.
solution: Given: a = -15, d = 8, n = 40 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 40/2 [2*-15 + (40-1)*8] | Answer: 5640

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 14500 at 14.8% per annum for 7 years.
solution: Given: P = 14500, R = 14.8, Tt = 7 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 14500 * 14.8 * 7 / 100 | Answer: 15022 currency units

question: Find the amount when 5500 is invested at 9.3% per annum compounded annually for 6 years.
solution: Given: P = 5500, R = 9.3, Tt = 6 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 5500 * (1 + 9.3/100)^6 | Answer: 9377 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (2, -6, -5) and (-5, 3, -6).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (-4, 5, -4) and (-6, 0, -5).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 39.26

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (-3, -6, -4) and (5, 4, -1).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 133.7 degrees

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number -3 + 10i.
solution: Given: a = -3, b = 10 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(10, -3) | Answer: 106.7 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -5x^3 - 7x^2 - 4x + 9 at x = 5.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-23 with initial guess x0=13, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.1 and ordinates 17, 5, 10, 17, 2, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 468 and 89.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 468 and 89 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 6 and 10.
solution: Given: a = 6, b = 10 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 6*10 / 2 | Answer: 30
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 20 mm carries an axial tensile load of 82 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 39 mm and length 1300 mm carries an axial load of 66 kN. Take E = 70 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 37 mm transmits a torque of 800 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 37, Tt = 800 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(800*1000) / (pi*(37)^3) | Answer: 80.44 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 31 mm and length 600 mm carries a torque of 450 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (31)^4 / 32 = 90666 mm^4 | theta = (450*1000)(600) / (80000 * 90666) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 2.133 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 54 mm wide and 240 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 54, h = 240 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 54*(240)^2 / 6 | Answer: 518400 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (87 mm x 230 mm) carries a bending moment of 6 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (51 mm x 150 mm) has effective length 2600 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 410 MPa is designed for a working stress of 160 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 410, sw = 160 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 410 / 160 | Answer: 2.562

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 900 mm and wall thickness 18 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.1 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 900, t = 18, P = 1.1 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.1*900 / (2*18) | Answer: 27.5 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 700 K and 440 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 700, Tc = 440 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 440/700) * 100 | Answer: 37.14 %

question: 5 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 190 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 5, dT = 190 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 5 * 0.718 * 190 | Answer: 682.1 kJ

question: 6.2 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 170 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.2, dT = 170 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 6.2 * 1.005 * 170 | Answer: 1059 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1.2 m^3 at 350 K with mass 3.6 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1.2, Tk = 350, m = 3.6 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 3.6*0.287*350 / 1.2 | Answer: 301.3 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 1.5 kg of air expands isothermally at 430 K from volume V1 to 3*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.5, Tk = 430, ratio = 3 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 1.5*0.287*430*ln(3) | Answer: 203.4 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.14 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 4, D = 0.14 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*4*0.14 / 0.001 | Answer: 560000

question: Water flows at 2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 110 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 16.2 m. Taking Cv = 0.98, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 16.2, cv = 0.98 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.98*sqrt(2*9.81*16.2) | Answer: 17.47 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 250 mm) water flows at 0.6 m/s. It contracts to diameter 70 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 250, d2 = 70, V1 = 0.6 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 0.6*(250/70)^2 | Answer: 7.653 m/s

question: Water flows at 2.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.28 m and length 280 m. With friction factor f = 0.03, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 30 teeth drives a gear of 114 teeth. If the pinion runs at 350 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 30, z2 = 114, N1 = 350 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 350*30 / 114 | Answer: 92.11 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 440 mm rotates at 350 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 440, N = 350 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.44)*350 / 60 | Answer: 8.063 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 17.4 kW at 600 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 17.4, N = 600 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(17.4*1000) / (2*pi*600) | Answer: 276.9 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 3.8 kg rotates at radius 0.34 m at 300 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 10200 N/m and mass 3.2 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 10200, m = 3.2 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(10200/3.2) | Answer: 8.986 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 8.3 m^2 and thickness 0.28 m has conductivity k = 11 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 115 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 8.3, L = 0.28, k = 11, dT = 115 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 11*8.3*115 / 0.28 | Answer: 37498 W

question: A surface of area 2.7 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 120 W/m^2-K to surroundings 140 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 2.7, h = 120, dT = 140 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 120*2.7*140 | Answer: 45360 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 90 m/min, feed = 0.34 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.6 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 90, f = 0.34, d = 2.6 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*90*0.34*2.6 | Answer: 79560 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 480 mm is turned at 350 rpm with a feed of 0.32 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 480, N = 350, f = 0.32 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 480 / (0.32*350) | Answer: 4.286 min

question: A resistor of 192 ohm carries a current of 2.2 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 192, I = 2.2 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 2.2 * 192 | Answer: 422.4 V

question: Three resistors 66 ohm, 27 ohm and 92 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 66, R2 = 27, R3 = 92 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 66 + 27 + 92 | Answer: 185 ohm

question: Two resistors 2 ohm and 74 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 2, R2 = 74 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 2*74 / (2+74) | Answer: 1.947 ohm

question: A device draws 13 A at 40 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 40, I = 13 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 40 * 13 | Answer: 520 W

question: A current of 5.1 A flows through a 27 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 5.1, R = 27 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (5.1)^2 * 27 | Answer: 702.3 W

question: Two capacitors 4.2 uF and 40 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 4.2, C2 = 40 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 4.2*40 / (4.2+40) | Answer: 3.801 uF

question: A resistor 76 kohm and capacitor 19.4 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 76, C = 19.4 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (76k)(19.4u) = 1474 ms | Answer: 1474 ms

question: An inductor 257.7 mH is in series with 151 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 257.7, R = 151 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (257.7e-3) / 151 | Answer: 1.707 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 12.6 mH inductor at 100 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 12.6, f = 100 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (100)(12.6e-3) | Answer: 7.917 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 48.7 uF capacitor at 730 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 48.7, f = 730 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (730)(48.7e-6)) | Answer: 4.477 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 53 ohm, XL = 64 ohm and XC = 17 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 53, XL = 64, XC = 17 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(53^2 + (64 - 17)^2) | Answer: 70.84 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 99.1 mH and C = 4.2 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 99.1, C = 4.2 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(99.1e-3 * 4.2e-6)) | Answer: 246.7 Hz

question: A capacitor of 35.6 uF is charged to 60 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 35.6, V = 60 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*35.6e-6*(60)^2 | Answer: 64.08 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 380 V with 510 primary turns and 70 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 380, N1 = 510, N2 = 70 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 380 * 70/510 | Answer: 52.16 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 340 V and draws an armature current of 5 A. If the armature resistance is 1.08 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 340, Ia = 5, Ra = 1.08 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 340 - 5*1.08 | Answer: 334.6 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 195 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.88. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 195, VL = 433, pf = 0.88 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*195*0.88 / 1000 | Answer: 128.7 kW

question: A load has real power 35 kW and apparent power 45 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 35, S = 45 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 35 / 45 | Answer: 0.7778

question: A machine delivers 60 kW output while drawing 142 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 60, Pi = 142 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 60/142 * 100 | Answer: 42.25 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 25 V across R1 = 44 ohm and R2 = 48 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 25, R1 = 44, R2 = 48 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 25*48 / (44+48) | Answer: 13.04 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 210 kohm and Rin = 24 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 210, Rin = 24 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 210 / 24 | Answer: 8.75

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 180 kohm and Rg = 29 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 180, Rg = 29 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 180/29 | Answer: 7.207

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9308. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 9308 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(9308) | Answer: 39.69 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.8 m carries a central point load of 90 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.8, W = 90 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 90*4.8 / 4 | Answer: 108 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 3.4 m carries a UDL of 30 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.4, w = 30 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 30*(3.4)^2 / 8 | Answer: 43.35 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 4.2 m carries a point load 35 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.2, W = 35 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 35*4.2 | Answer: 147 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 3.8 m carries a UDL of 4 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.8, w = 4 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 4*(3.8)^2 / 2 | Answer: 28.88 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.1 m carries a point load 35 kN at distance 3.3 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 4.1, a = 3.3, W = 35 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 35*(4.1 - 3.3) / 4.1 | Answer: 6.829 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 4.2 m) carries a central point load 35 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 80e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=35000 N, L=4200.0 mm, E=200000 MPa, I=80e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 3.376 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 520 mm, clear cover 40 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 520, c = 40, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 520 - 40 - 12/2 | Answer: 474 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 33 m^2 carrying a factored load of 10.1 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 33, w = 10.1 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 10.1 * 33 | Answer: 333.3 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 4.6 m, unit weight 16 kN/m^3, phi = 38 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 4e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1, area = 3.7e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 4, i = 1, A = 3.7 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (4e-4)*1*(3.7e-3) | Answer: 1480 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1 m, bed slope 0.009 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.016. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.6 m under a head of 0.7 m. Taking Cd = 0.61 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4 m wide carries a discharge of 21.2 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 500 m^3 treats a flow of 185 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 500, Q = 185 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 500 / 185 | Answer: 2.703 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 400 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.13 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 8 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 400, k = 0.13, t = 8 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 400*(1 - e^(-0.13*8)) | Answer: 258.6 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.57, rainfall intensity 70 mm/h over a catchment of 24.2 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.57, i = 70, A = 24.2 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.57*70*24.2 / 360 | Answer: 2.682 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.03 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 630 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.03, M = 630 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 630*(20+0.03)/20 | Answer: 630.9 m

question: Convert the decimal number 155 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 155 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 9B (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10100001 and 10101000.
solution: XOR: 00001001 | Count of 1s = 2 | Answer: 2
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 90 megabits is sent over a link of 34 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 90, B = 34 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 90 / 34 | Answer: 2.647 s

question: A link has bandwidth 11 Mbps and round-trip time 190 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 11, R = 190 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 11e6 * 190e-3 bits = 2090 kb | Answer: 2090 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.92, cache access time 2 ns and main-memory access time 160 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.92, tc = 2, tm = 160 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.92*2 + (1 - 0.92)*160 | Answer: 14.64 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 846057 elements?
solution: Given: n = 846057 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(846057)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.015, memory access time 160 ns and page-fault service time 3 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 3 ms = 3000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.015)*160 + 0.015*3000000.0 ns | Answer: 45.16 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 1.4 m^3 at 230 kPa and 570 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 1.4, P = 230, Tk = 570 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (230e3)*1.4 / (8.314*570) | Answer: 67.95 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 1e10 /s and activation energy 80 kJ/mol at 440 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 1, Ea = 80, Tk = 440 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 1e10 * exp(-80e3 / (8.314*440)) | Answer: 3.18 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.98 and bottoms xW = 0.08, with relative volatility alpha = 2.4. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.98, xw = 0.08, al = 2.4 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.98/0.02)(0.92/0.08)] / ln(2.4) | Answer: 7.235 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.7 and x = 0.34. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.7, x = 0.34 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.7/0.3) / (0.34/0.66) | Answer: 4.529

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.79 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 95 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.79, Psat = 95 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.79 * 95 | Answer: 75.05 kPa

question: A stream of 8.2 kg/s with specific heat 3.9 kJ/kg-K is heated through 55 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 8.2, cp = 3.9, dT = 55 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 8.2*3.9*55 | Answer: 1759 kW

question: A reactor of volume 8.2 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 2.3 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 8.2, Q = 2.3 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 8.2 / 2.3 | Answer: 3.565 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 8e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 3 mm with a concentration difference of 70 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 8, L = 3, dC = 70 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (8e-9)*70 / (3e-3) | Answer: 186.7 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 8.5 min and steady-state gain 0.7. For a step input of magnitude 17, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 8.5, K = 0.7, M = 17 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 0.7 * 17 | Answer: 11.9 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 65 m^2 flies at 230 m/s (air density 1.225 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.9. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 65, V = 230, rho = 1.225, CL = 0.9 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1.225*(230)^2*65*0.9 / 1000 | Answer: 1895 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 15 m^2 flies at 80 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.02. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 15, V = 80, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.02 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(80)^2*15*0.02 / 1000 | Answer: 0.384 kN

question: A specimen under stress 360 MPa shows an elastic strain of 1.2e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 360, eps = 1.2 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 360 / (1.2e-3) MPa = 300 GPa | Answer: 300 GPa

question: A block of mass 43 kg has a volume of 3.9e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 43, V = 3.9 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 43 / (3.9e-3) | Answer: 11026 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2000 mm is heated through 65 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 11e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2000, dT = 65, al = 11 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2000*11e-6*65 | Answer: 1.43 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 50 ohm, R2 = 115 ohm and R3 = 265 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 50, R2 = 115, R3 = 265 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 115*265 / 50 | Answer: 609.5 ohm

question: Annual demand is 20000 units, ordering cost 130 per order and holding cost 38 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 20000, S = 130, H = 38 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*20000*130 / 38) | Answer: 369.9 units

question: An asset costs 390000 with salvage value 34000 after 14 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 390000, Sv = 34000, n = 14 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (390000 - 34000) / 14 | Answer: 25429 per year

question: A product sells for 100 per unit with variable cost 20 per unit and fixed costs 100000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 100, V = 20, F = 100000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 100000 / (100 - 20) | Answer: 1250 units

question: Find the present worth of 55000 received 3 years from now at an interest rate of 10% per year.
solution: Given: F = 55000, n = 3, i = 10 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 55000 / (1 + 0.1)^3 | Answer: 41322 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.93, 0.98 and 0.91 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.93, r2 = 0.98, r3 = 0.91 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.93*0.98*0.91 | Answer: 0.8294

question: A process produces 21 defective items in a batch of 3500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 21, N = 3500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 21/3500 * 1e6 | Answer: 6000 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = -4x^3 + 2x^2 + 5x - 1 evaluated at x = -5.
For f(x) = -x^3 - 3x + 5, find f''(x) at x = 4.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-x^2 - 2) dx from x = -1 to x = 4.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -1x^3/3 + 0x^2/2 + -2x | Evaluate F(4) - F(-1) | Answer: -31.67
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 2x^2 + 9x - 7 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[7, 1], [-1, 2]].
solution: Given: a = 7, b = 1, c = -1, d = 2 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (7)(2) - (1)(-1) | Answer: 15

question: Find the determinant of [[4, -2, -3], [-5, -2, -5], [6, -4, -5]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -26

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[2, -4], [-7, -1]].
solution: Trace tr = 1, Determinant = -30 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 6

question: Solve for x: -1x + 4y = 7 and -1x + 2y = -5.
solution: Determinant = -1*2 - 4*-1 = 2 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 17 | Answer: x = 17
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 6, 59, 25, 80, 25.
solution: Sum = 195 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 39 | Answer: 39

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 11, 45, 9, 33, 30.
solution: Mean = 25.6 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 15.32

question: Find the slope of the line through (1, -2) and (4, -8).
solution: Given: x1 = 1, y1 = -2, x2 = 4, y2 = -8 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (-8 - -2) / (4 - 1) | Answer: -2

question: Find the distance between the points (-4, 8) and (2, 2).
solution: Given: x1 = -4, y1 = 8, x2 = 2, y2 = 2 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((6)^2 + (-6)^2) | Answer: 8.485 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (8,-7), (-1,-3), (0,1).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 20 sq units

question: Find the 11th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 5 and common difference -8.
solution: Given: a = 5, d = -8, n = 11 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 5 + (11 - 1)*-8 | Answer: -75

question: Find the sum of the first 14 terms of an AP with first term 2 and common difference 6.
solution: Given: a = 2, d = 6, n = 14 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 14/2 [2*2 + (14-1)*6] | Answer: 574

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 21500 at 4.8% per annum for 2 years.
solution: Given: P = 21500, R = 4.8, Tt = 2 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 21500 * 4.8 * 2 / 100 | Answer: 2064 currency units

question: Find the amount when 24000 is invested at 7.3% per annum compounded annually for 5 years.
solution: Given: P = 24000, R = 7.3, Tt = 5 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 24000 * (1 + 7.3/100)^5 | Answer: 34136 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (-4, -4, 4) and (6, 0, 3).

question: Find the modulus of the complex number 9 + -3i.
solution: Given: a = 9, b = -3 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((9)^2 + (-3)^2) | Answer: 9.487

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number -6 + -1i.
solution: Given: a = -6, b = -1 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(-1, -6) | Answer: -170.5 degrees

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 65 and 20.

question: A circular rod of diameter 37 mm carries an axial tensile load of 9 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 17 mm and length 2000 mm carries an axial load of 51 kN. Take E = 210 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 72 mm transmits a torque of 2750 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.

question: A shaft of diameter 27 mm and length 1600 mm carries a torque of 300 N-m. With G = 45 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (27)^4 / 32 = 52174 mm^4 | theta = (300*1000)(1600) / (45000 * 52174) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 11.71 degrees

question: A rectangular beam section is 52 mm wide and 80 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 52, h = 80 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 52*(80)^2 / 6 | Answer: 55467 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (87 mm x 120 mm) carries a bending moment of 35 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (54 mm x 150 mm) has effective length 1900 mm and E = 200 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 890 MPa is designed for a working stress of 80 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 890, sw = 80 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 890 / 80 | Answer: 11.12

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 700 mm and wall thickness 9 mm carries an internal pressure of 2.9 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 700, t = 9, P = 2.9 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 2.9*700 / (2*9) | Answer: 112.8 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 1020 K and 310 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 1020, Tc = 310 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 310/1020) * 100 | Answer: 69.61 %

question: 4.7 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 40 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.7, dT = 40 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 4.7 * 0.718 * 40 | Answer: 135 kJ

question: 5.5 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 170 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 5.5, dT = 170 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 5.5 * 1.005 * 170 | Answer: 939.7 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.6 m^3 at 340 K with mass 1.1 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 3.6, Tk = 340, m = 1.1 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 1.1*0.287*340 / 3.6 | Answer: 29.82 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 3.7 kg of air expands isothermally at 410 K from volume V1 to 5*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.7, Tk = 410, ratio = 5 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 3.7*0.287*410*ln(5) | Answer: 700.7 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 2.1 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.37 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 2.1, D = 0.37 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*2.1*0.37 / 0.001 | Answer: 777000

question: Water flows at 2.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 300 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 6.9 m. Taking Cv = 0.98, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 6.9, cv = 0.98 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.98*sqrt(2*9.81*6.9) | Answer: 11.4 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 250 mm) water flows at 0.8 m/s. It contracts to diameter 70 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 250, d2 = 70, V1 = 0.8 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 0.8*(250/70)^2 | Answer: 10.2 m/s

question: Water flows at 1.3 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.47 m and length 120 m. With friction factor f = 0.033, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 34 teeth drives a gear of 62 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1100 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 34, z2 = 62, N1 = 1100 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1100*34 / 62 | Answer: 603.2 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 490 mm rotates at 400 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 490, N = 400 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.49)*400 / 60 | Answer: 10.26 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 23.6 kW at 400 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 23.6, N = 400 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(23.6*1000) / (2*pi*400) | Answer: 563.4 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 5.1 kg rotates at radius 0.46 m at 700 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 7700 N/m and mass 1.4 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 7700, m = 1.4 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(7700/1.4) | Answer: 11.8 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 2.1 m^2 and thickness 0.25 m has conductivity k = 14.7 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 140 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 2.1, L = 0.25, k = 14.7, dT = 140 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 14.7*2.1*140 / 0.25 | Answer: 17287 W

question: A surface of area 2.8 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 145 W/m^2-K to surroundings 110 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 2.8, h = 145, dT = 110 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 145*2.8*110 | Answer: 44660 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 80 m/min, feed = 0.38 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.8 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 80, f = 0.38, d = 1.8 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*80*0.38*1.8 | Answer: 54720 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 390 mm is turned at 300 rpm with a feed of 0.16 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 390, N = 300, f = 0.16 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 390 / (0.16*300) | Answer: 8.125 min

question: A resistor of 198 ohm carries a current of 7.7 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 198, I = 7.7 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 7.7 * 198 | Answer: 1525 V

question: Three resistors 25 ohm, 46 ohm and 45 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 25, R2 = 46, R3 = 45 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 25 + 46 + 45 | Answer: 116 ohm

question: Two resistors 27 ohm and 48 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 27, R2 = 48 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 27*48 / (27+48) | Answer: 17.28 ohm

question: A device draws 6.1 A at 200 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 200, I = 6.1 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 200 * 6.1 | Answer: 1220 W

question: A current of 7.9 A flows through a 98 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 7.9, R = 98 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (7.9)^2 * 98 | Answer: 6116 W

question: Two capacitors 49.9 uF and 34.8 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 49.9, C2 = 34.8 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 49.9*34.8 / (49.9+34.8) | Answer: 20.5 uF

question: A resistor 94 kohm and capacitor 16 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 94, C = 16 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (94k)(16u) = 1504 ms | Answer: 1504 ms

question: An inductor 209 mH is in series with 195 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 209, R = 195 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (209e-3) / 195 | Answer: 1.072 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 19.3 mH inductor at 740 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 19.3, f = 740 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (740)(19.3e-3) | Answer: 89.74 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 32.2 uF capacitor at 490 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 32.2, f = 490 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (490)(32.2e-6)) | Answer: 10.09 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 99 ohm, XL = 136 ohm and XC = 89 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 99, XL = 136, XC = 89 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(99^2 + (136 - 89)^2) | Answer: 109.6 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 62.9 mH and C = 5.1 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 62.9, C = 5.1 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(62.9e-3 * 5.1e-6)) | Answer: 281 Hz

question: A capacitor of 1.2 uF is charged to 365 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 1.2, V = 365 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*1.2e-6*(365)^2 | Answer: 79.93 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 380 V with 410 primary turns and 270 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 380, N1 = 410, N2 = 270 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 380 * 270/410 | Answer: 250.2 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 300 V and draws an armature current of 8 A. If the armature resistance is 0.19 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 300, Ia = 8, Ra = 0.19 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 300 - 8*0.19 | Answer: 298.5 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 5 A at 400 V (line) with a power factor of 0.72. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 5, VL = 400, pf = 0.72 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*400*5*0.72 / 1000 | Answer: 2.494 kW

question: A load has real power 110 kW and apparent power 175 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 110, S = 175 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 110 / 175 | Answer: 0.6286

question: A machine delivers 100 kW output while drawing 177 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 100, Pi = 177 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 100/177 * 100 | Answer: 56.5 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 21 V across R1 = 50 ohm and R2 = 12 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 21, R1 = 50, R2 = 12 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 21*12 / (50+12) | Answer: 4.065 V

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 90 kohm and Rg = 39 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 90, Rg = 39 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 90/39 | Answer: 3.308

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 688. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 688 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(688) | Answer: 28.38 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 8.2 m carries a central point load of 110 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.2, W = 110 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 110*8.2 / 4 | Answer: 225.5 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.9 m carries a UDL of 10 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.9, w = 10 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 10*(4.9)^2 / 8 | Answer: 30.01 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.9 m carries a point load 15 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.9, W = 15 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 15*2.9 | Answer: 43.5 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 6 m carries a UDL of 20 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6, w = 20 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 20*(6)^2 / 2 | Answer: 360 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.5 m carries a point load 10 kN at distance 3 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 6.5, a = 3, W = 10 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 10*(6.5 - 3) / 6.5 | Answer: 5.385 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 5.3 m) carries a central point load 45 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 140e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=45000 N, L=5300.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=140e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 39.88 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 8.7 m carries a UDL of 27 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.7, w = 27 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 27*(8.7)^2 / 12 | Answer: 170.3 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 300 mm, clear cover 35 mm and main bars of diameter 20 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 300, c = 35, dia = 20 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 300 - 35 - 20/2 | Answer: 255 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 25.8 m^2 carrying a factored load of 14.2 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 25.8, w = 14.2 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 14.2 * 25.8 | Answer: 366.4 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 5.9 m, unit weight 19 kN/m^3, phi = 29 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 1.3e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1.1, area = 6.7e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 1.3, i = 1.1, A = 6.7 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (1.3e-4)*1.1*(6.7e-3) | Answer: 958.1 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.5 m, bed slope 0.009 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.018. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4.3 m under a head of 1 m. Taking Cd = 0.61 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4 m wide carries a discharge of 18.5 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 240 m and design speed 40 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 240, V = 40 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (40)^2 / (127*240) | Answer: 0.05249
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 590 m^3 treats a flow of 140 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 590, Q = 140 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 590 / 140 | Answer: 4.214 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 300 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.28 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 8 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 300, k = 0.28, t = 8 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 300*(1 - e^(-0.28*8)) | Answer: 268.1 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.31, rainfall intensity 70 mm/h over a catchment of 46.2 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.31, i = 70, A = 46.2 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.31*70*46.2 / 360 | Answer: 2.785 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.07 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 740 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.07, M = 740 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 740*(20+0.07)/20 | Answer: 742.6 m

question: Convert the decimal number 3939 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 3939 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: F63 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10011011 and 01000011.
solution: XOR: 11011000 | Count of 1s = 4 | Answer: 4
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 690 megabits is sent over a link of 78 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 690, B = 78 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 690 / 78 | Answer: 8.846 s

question: A link has bandwidth 28 Mbps and round-trip time 10 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 28, R = 10 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 28e6 * 10e-3 bits = 280 kb | Answer: 280 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.9, cache access time 1 ns and main-memory access time 140 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.9, tc = 1, tm = 140 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.9*1 + (1 - 0.9)*140 | Answer: 14.9 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 969836 elements?
solution: Given: n = 969836 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(969836)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.003, memory access time 160 ns and page-fault service time 9 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 9 ms = 9000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.003)*160 + 0.003*9000000.0 ns | Answer: 27.16 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 0.3 m^3 at 480 kPa and 550 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 0.3, P = 480, Tk = 550 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (480e3)*0.3 / (8.314*550) | Answer: 31.49 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.12 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 4 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.12, t = 4 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.12*4) | Answer: 0.3812

question: For a reaction with A = 8e10 /s and activation energy 50 kJ/mol at 310 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 8, Ea = 50, Tk = 310 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 8e10 * exp(-50e3 / (8.314*310)) | Answer: 300.5 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.98 and bottoms xW = 0.07, with relative volatility alpha = 1.8. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.98, xw = 0.07, al = 1.8 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.98/0.02)(0.93/0.07)] / ln(1.8) | Answer: 11.02 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.58 and x = 0.33. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.58, x = 0.33 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.58/0.42) / (0.33/0.67) | Answer: 2.804

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.47 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 105 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.47, Psat = 105 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.47 * 105 | Answer: 49.35 kPa

question: A stream of 6.1 kg/s with specific heat 3.4 kJ/kg-K is heated through 90 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 6.1, cp = 3.4, dT = 90 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 6.1*3.4*90 | Answer: 1867 kW

question: A reactor of volume 7.9 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 0.9 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 7.9, Q = 0.9 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 7.9 / 0.9 | Answer: 8.778 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 1.2e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 3 mm with a concentration difference of 140 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 1.2, L = 3, dC = 140 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (1.2e-9)*140 / (3e-3) | Answer: 56 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 7.2 min and steady-state gain 3.3. For a step input of magnitude 15, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 7.2, K = 3.3, M = 15 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 3.3 * 15 | Answer: 49.5 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 80 m^2 flies at 260 m/s (air density 0.4 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.2. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 80, V = 260, rho = 0.4, CL = 1.2 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.4*(260)^2*80*1.2 / 1000 | Answer: 1298 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 25 m^2 flies at 220 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.09. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 25, V = 220, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.09 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(220)^2*25*0.09 / 1000 | Answer: 21.78 kN

question: A specimen under stress 320 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 320, eps = 2 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 320 / (2e-3) MPa = 160 GPa | Answer: 160 GPa

question: A block of mass 34 kg has a volume of 5.8e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 34, V = 5.8 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 34 / (5.8e-3) | Answer: 5862 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 1900 mm is heated through 115 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 17e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 1900, dT = 115, al = 17 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 1900*17e-6*115 | Answer: 3.715 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 200 ohm, R2 = 145 ohm and R3 = 245 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 200, R2 = 145, R3 = 245 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 145*245 / 200 | Answer: 177.6 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.01 when the true value is 20. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.01, true = 20 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.01 - 20| / 20 * 100 | Answer: 54.95 %

question: Annual demand is 11500 units, ordering cost 300 per order and holding cost 12 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 11500, S = 300, H = 12 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*11500*300 / 12) | Answer: 758.3 units

question: An asset costs 480000 with salvage value 32000 after 14 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 480000, Sv = 32000, n = 14 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (480000 - 32000) / 14 | Answer: 32000 per year

question: A product sells for 190 per unit with variable cost 20 per unit and fixed costs 15000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 190, V = 20, F = 15000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 15000 / (190 - 20) | Answer: 88.24 units

question: Find the present worth of 150000 received 5 years from now at an interest rate of 11% per year.
solution: Given: F = 150000, n = 5, i = 11 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 150000 / (1 + 0.11)^5 | Answer: 89018 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.94, 0.92 and 0.9 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.94, r2 = 0.92, r3 = 0.9 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.94*0.92*0.9 | Answer: 0.7783

question: A process produces 22 defective items in a batch of 13000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 22, N = 13000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 22/13000 * 1e6 | Answer: 1692 PPM
