solution: Given: d = 30, Tt = 2900 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2900*1000) / (pi*(30)^3) | Answer: 547 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 57 mm and length 1200 mm carries a torque of 1650 N-m. With G = 45 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (57)^4 / 32 = 1036333 mm^4 | theta = (1650*1000)(1200) / (45000 * 1036333) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 2.433 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 87 mm wide and 140 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 87, h = 140 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 87*(140)^2 / 6 | Answer: 284200 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (76 mm x 210 mm) carries a bending moment of 10 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (34 mm x 130 mm) has effective length 2900 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 740 MPa is designed for a working stress of 150 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 740, sw = 150 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 740 / 150 | Answer: 4.933

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 400 mm and wall thickness 14 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.8 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 400, t = 14, P = 1.8 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.8*400 / (2*14) | Answer: 25.71 MPa

question: A Carnot engine operates between 1000 K and 380 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 1000, Tc = 380 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 380/1000) * 100 | Answer: 62 %

question: 7.2 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 120 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 7.2, dT = 120 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 7.2 * 0.718 * 120 | Answer: 620.4 kJ

question: 6.6 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 70 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.6, dT = 70 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 6.6 * 1.005 * 70 | Answer: 464.3 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1 m^3 at 420 K with mass 4.7 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1, Tk = 420, m = 4.7 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 4.7*0.287*420 / 1 | Answer: 566.5 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 2.5 kg of air expands isothermally at 300 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.5, Tk = 300, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 2.5*0.287*300*ln(4) | Answer: 298.4 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 2.1 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.39 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 2.1, D = 0.39 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*2.1*0.39 / 0.001 | Answer: 819000

question: Water flows at 1.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 140 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.

question: In a pipe (diameter 290 mm) water flows at 1.8 m/s. It contracts to diameter 70 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 290, d2 = 70, V1 = 1.8 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 1.8*(290/70)^2 | Answer: 30.89 m/s

question: Water flows at 1.9 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.13 m and length 80 m. With friction factor f = 0.036, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 37 teeth drives a gear of 59 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1400 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 37, z2 = 59, N1 = 1400 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1400*37 / 59 | Answer: 878 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 110 mm rotates at 1250 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 110, N = 1250 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.11)*1250 / 60 | Answer: 7.199 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 26.5 kW at 1100 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 26.5, N = 1100 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(26.5*1000) / (2*pi*1100) | Answer: 230.1 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 6.6 kg rotates at radius 0.25 m at 750 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 4500 N/m and mass 4.9 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 4500, m = 4.9 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(4500/4.9) | Answer: 4.823 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 9.1 m^2 and thickness 0.36 m has conductivity k = 33 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 100 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 9.1, L = 0.36, k = 33, dT = 100 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 33*9.1*100 / 0.36 | Answer: 83417 W

question: A surface of area 4.5 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 155 W/m^2-K to surroundings 90 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 4.5, h = 155, dT = 90 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 155*4.5*90 | Answer: 62775 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 180 m/min, feed = 0.49 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.6 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 180, f = 0.49, d = 2.6 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*180*0.49*2.6 | Answer: 229320 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 480 mm is turned at 850 rpm with a feed of 0.23 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 480, N = 850, f = 0.23 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 480 / (0.23*850) | Answer: 2.455 min

question: A resistor of 58 ohm carries a current of 8.4 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 58, I = 8.4 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 8.4 * 58 | Answer: 487.2 V

question: Three resistors 93 ohm, 24 ohm and 71 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 93, R2 = 24, R3 = 71 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 93 + 24 + 71 | Answer: 188 ohm

question: Two resistors 11 ohm and 51 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 11, R2 = 51 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 11*51 / (11+51) | Answer: 9.048 ohm

question: A device draws 2.4 A at 205 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 205, I = 2.4 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 205 * 2.4 | Answer: 492 W

question: A current of 5.2 A flows through a 42 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 5.2, R = 42 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (5.2)^2 * 42 | Answer: 1136 W

question: Two capacitors 46.5 uF and 10.4 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 46.5, C2 = 10.4 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 46.5*10.4 / (46.5+10.4) | Answer: 8.499 uF

question: A resistor 73 kohm and capacitor 12.9 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 73, C = 12.9 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (73k)(12.9u) = 941.7 ms | Answer: 941.7 ms

question: An inductor 219.2 mH is in series with 42 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 219.2, R = 42 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (219.2e-3) / 42 | Answer: 5.219 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 30.5 mH inductor at 70 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 30.5, f = 70 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (70)(30.5e-3) | Answer: 13.41 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 44.3 uF capacitor at 590 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 44.3, f = 590 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (590)(44.3e-6)) | Answer: 6.089 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 42 ohm, XL = 141 ohm and XC = 105 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 42, XL = 141, XC = 105 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(42^2 + (141 - 105)^2) | Answer: 55.32 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 39.3 mH and C = 9.1 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 39.3, C = 9.1 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(39.3e-3 * 9.1e-6)) | Answer: 266.1 Hz

question: A capacitor of 84.9 uF is charged to 365 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 84.9, V = 365 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*84.9e-6*(365)^2 | Answer: 5655 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 130 V with 650 primary turns and 400 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 130, N1 = 650, N2 = 400 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 130 * 400/650 | Answer: 80 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 240 V and draws an armature current of 51 A. If the armature resistance is 1.46 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 240, Ia = 51, Ra = 1.46 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 240 - 51*1.46 | Answer: 165.5 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 40 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.96. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 40, VL = 433, pf = 0.96 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*40*0.96 / 1000 | Answer: 28.8 kW

question: A load has real power 145 kW and apparent power 155 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 145, S = 155 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 145 / 155 | Answer: 0.9355

question: A machine delivers 25 kW output while drawing 52 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 25, Pi = 52 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 25/52 * 100 | Answer: 48.08 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 23 V across R1 = 46 ohm and R2 = 40 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 23, R1 = 46, R2 = 40 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 23*40 / (46+40) | Answer: 10.7 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 190 kohm and Rin = 5 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 190, Rin = 5 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 190 / 5 | Answer: 38

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 200 kohm and Rg = 14 kohm. Find the voltage gain.

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9656. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 9656 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(9656) | Answer: 39.85 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 3.1 m carries a central point load of 120 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.1, W = 120 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 120*3.1 / 4 | Answer: 93 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6 m carries a UDL of 5 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6, w = 5 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 5*(6)^2 / 8 | Answer: 22.5 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5 m carries a point load 25 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5, W = 25 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 25*5 | Answer: 125 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.2 m carries a UDL of 26 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.2, w = 26 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 26*(2.2)^2 / 2 | Answer: 62.92 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.4 m carries a point load 20 kN at distance 2.5 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 6.4, a = 2.5, W = 20 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 20*(6.4 - 2.5) / 6.4 | Answer: 12.19 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 4.5 m) carries a central point load 55 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 130e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=55000 N, L=4500.0 mm, E=200000 MPa, I=130e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 4.016 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 540 mm, clear cover 45 mm and main bars of diameter 16 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 540, c = 45, dia = 16 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 540 - 45 - 16/2 | Answer: 487 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 10.1 m^2 carrying a factored load of 19.4 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 10.1, w = 19.4 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 19.4 * 10.1 | Answer: 195.9 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 3.5 m, unit weight 17 kN/m^3, phi = 30 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 7.4e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1, area = 5.5e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 7.4, i = 1, A = 5.5 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (7.4e-4)*1*(5.5e-3) | Answer: 4070 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.7 m, bed slope 0.008 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.02. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4.1 m under a head of 0.3 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.2 m wide carries a discharge of 28.6 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).

solution: Given: R = 370, V = 80 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (80)^2 / (127*370) | Answer: 0.1362
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 570 m^3 treats a flow of 100 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 570, Q = 100 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 570 / 100 | Answer: 5.7 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 290 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.24 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 4 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 290, k = 0.24, t = 4 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 290*(1 - e^(-0.24*4)) | Answer: 179 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.39, rainfall intensity 100 mm/h over a catchment of 42.7 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.39, i = 100, A = 42.7 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.39*100*42.7 / 360 | Answer: 4.626 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.03 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 450 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.03, M = 450 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 450*(20+0.03)/20 | Answer: 450.7 m

question: Convert the decimal number 2041 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 2041 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 7F9 (hex)

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 01101101 and 00111011.
solution: XOR: 01010110 | Count of 1s = 4 | Answer: 4
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 740 megabits is sent over a link of 34 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 740, B = 34 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 740 / 34 | Answer: 21.76 s

question: A link has bandwidth 54 Mbps and round-trip time 190 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 54, R = 190 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 54e6 * 190e-3 bits = 10260 kb | Answer: 10260 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.9, cache access time 6 ns and main-memory access time 170 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.9, tc = 6, tm = 170 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.9*6 + (1 - 0.9)*170 | Answer: 22.4 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 666845 elements?
solution: Given: n = 666845 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(666845)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.008, memory access time 110 ns and page-fault service time 4 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 4 ms = 4000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.008)*110 + 0.008*4000000.0 ns | Answer: 32.11 microseconds

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.2 m^3 at 490 kPa and 600 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.2, P = 490, Tk = 600 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (490e3)*2.2 / (8.314*600) | Answer: 216.1 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 5e10 /s and activation energy 75 kJ/mol at 440 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 5, Ea = 75, Tk = 440 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 5e10 * exp(-75e3 / (8.314*440)) | Answer: 62.38 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.95 and bottoms xW = 0.04, with relative volatility alpha = 3.1. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.95, xw = 0.04, al = 3.1 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.95/0.05)(0.96/0.04)] / ln(3.1) | Answer: 5.411 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.81 and x = 0.42. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.81, x = 0.42 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.81/0.19) / (0.42/0.58) | Answer: 5.887

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.43 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 70 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.43, Psat = 70 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.43 * 70 | Answer: 30.1 kPa

question: A stream of 9.4 kg/s with specific heat 2.1 kJ/kg-K is heated through 95 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 9.4, cp = 2.1, dT = 95 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 9.4*2.1*95 | Answer: 1875 kW

question: A reactor of volume 17.9 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 2.3 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 17.9, Q = 2.3 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 17.9 / 2.3 | Answer: 7.783 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 4.9e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 5 mm with a concentration difference of 140 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 4.9, L = 5, dC = 140 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (4.9e-9)*140 / (5e-3) | Answer: 137.2 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 5.8 min and steady-state gain 1.2. For a step input of magnitude 9, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 5.8, K = 1.2, M = 9 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 1.2 * 9 | Answer: 10.8 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 85 m^2 flies at 220 m/s (air density 1.225 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.8. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 85, V = 220, rho = 1.225, CL = 0.8 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1.225*(220)^2*85*0.8 / 1000 | Answer: 2016 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 30 m^2 flies at 180 m/s (density 1.225 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.09. Find the drag force in kN.
A specimen under stress 200 MPa shows an elastic strain of 1.2e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 200, eps = 1.2 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 200 / (1.2e-3) MPa = 166.7 GPa | Answer: 166.7 GPa

question: A block of mass 25 kg has a volume of 3.5e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 25, V = 3.5 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 25 / (3.5e-3) | Answer: 7143 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 1200 mm is heated through 30 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 1200, dT = 30, al = 23 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 1200*23e-6*30 | Answer: 0.828 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 140 ohm, R2 = 170 ohm and R3 = 450 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 140, R2 = 170, R3 = 450 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 170*450 / 140 | Answer: 546.4 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.32 when the true value is 10. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.32, true = 10 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.32 - 10| / 10 * 100 | Answer: 6.8 %

question: Annual demand is 33500 units, ordering cost 200 per order and holding cost 34 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 33500, S = 200, H = 34 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*33500*200 / 34) | Answer: 627.8 units

question: An asset costs 440000 with salvage value 4000 after 18 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 440000, Sv = 4000, n = 18 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (440000 - 4000) / 18 | Answer: 24222 per year

question: A product sells for 470 per unit with variable cost 160 per unit and fixed costs 120000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 470, V = 160, F = 120000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 120000 / (470 - 160) | Answer: 387.1 units

question: Find the present worth of 145000 received 8 years from now at an interest rate of 10% per year.
solution: Given: F = 145000, n = 8, i = 10 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 145000 / (1 + 0.1)^8 | Answer: 67644 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.92, 0.94 and 0.97 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.92, r2 = 0.94, r3 = 0.97 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.92*0.94*0.97 | Answer: 0.8389

question: A process produces 30 defective items in a batch of 19500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 30, N = 19500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 30/19500 * 1e6 | Answer: 1538 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = x^3 + 2x + 6 evaluated at x = 4.

Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[0, 5], [-7, 4]].

question: Find the slope of the line through (-3, 9) and (8, 7).

question: Find the distance between the points (-1, -2) and (-4, -4).

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-3,-7), (-8,4), (-5,8).

question: Find the 9th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -18 and common difference -1.
solution: Given: a = -18, d = -1, n = 9 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -18 + (9 - 1)*-1 | Answer: -26

question: Find the sum of the first 38 terms of an AP with first term 8 and common difference -5.
solution: Given: a = 8, d = -5, n = 38 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 38/2 [2*8 + (38-1)*-5] | Answer: -3211

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 22000 at 14.6% per annum for 1 years.
solution: Given: P = 22000, R = 14.6, Tt = 1 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 22000 * 14.6 * 1 / 100 | Answer: 3212 currency units

question: Find the amount when 38500 is invested at 6.2% per annum compounded annually for 4 years.
solution: Given: P = 38500, R = 6.2, Tt = 4 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 38500 * (1 + 6.2/100)^4 | Answer: 48973 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (3, -6, -8) and (2, 0, 4).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (-2, 1, -2) and (-2, 6, 5).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 24.19

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (-2, 6, -4) and (3, 5, -1).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 50.77 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = x^3 - 6x^2 + 6x - 6 at x = -1.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-175 with initial guess x0=12, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.4 and ordinates 18, 11, 15, 1, 0, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 247 and 160.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 247 and 160 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 43 and 59.
solution: Given: a = 43, b = 59 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 43*59 / 1 | Answer: 2537
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 60 mm carries an axial tensile load of 119 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 13 mm and length 2800 mm carries an axial load of 61 kN. Take E = 210 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 47 mm transmits a torque of 2300 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 47, Tt = 2300 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2300*1000) / (pi*(47)^3) | Answer: 112.8 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 67 mm and length 1300 mm carries a torque of 300 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (67)^4 / 32 = 1978332 mm^4 | theta = (300*1000)(1300) / (80000 * 1978332) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.1412 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 49 mm wide and 270 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 49, h = 270 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 49*(270)^2 / 6 | Answer: 595350 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (94 mm x 80 mm) carries a bending moment of 11 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (67 mm x 130 mm) has effective length 1700 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 700 MPa is designed for a working stress of 190 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 700, sw = 190 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 700 / 190 | Answer: 3.684

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1250 mm and wall thickness 11 mm carries an internal pressure of 2.9 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1250, t = 11, P = 2.9 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 2.9*1250 / (2*11) | Answer: 164.8 MPa

question: 2.7 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 55 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.7, dT = 55 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 2.7 * 0.718 * 55 | Answer: 106.6 kJ

question: 6.8 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 195 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.8, dT = 195 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 6.8 * 1.005 * 195 | Answer: 1333 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 2.2 m^3 at 500 K with mass 2.4 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 2.2, Tk = 500, m = 2.4 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 2.4*0.287*500 / 2.2 | Answer: 156.5 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 3 kg of air expands isothermally at 400 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3, Tk = 400, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 3*0.287*400*ln(4) | Answer: 477.4 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 0.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.39 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 0.8, D = 0.39 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*0.8*0.39 / 0.001 | Answer: 312000

question: Water flows at 3.6 m/s through a pipe of diameter 70 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
In a pipe (diameter 230 mm) water flows at 2 m/s. It contracts to diameter 130 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 230, d2 = 130, V1 = 2 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2*(230/130)^2 | Answer: 6.26 m/s

question: Water flows at 3.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.47 m and length 400 m. With friction factor f = 0.035, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 26 teeth drives a gear of 96 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1350 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 26, z2 = 96, N1 = 1350 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1350*26 / 96 | Answer: 365.6 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 150 mm rotates at 1450 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 150, N = 1450 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.15)*1450 / 60 | Answer: 11.39 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 23.6 kW at 200 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 23.6, N = 200 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(23.6*1000) / (2*pi*200) | Answer: 1127 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 2.5 kg rotates at radius 0.17 m at 650 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 3100 N/m and mass 19.4 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 3100, m = 19.4 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(3100/19.4) | Answer: 2.012 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 7 m^2 and thickness 0.31 m has conductivity k = 37.1 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 145 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 7, L = 0.31, k = 37.1, dT = 145 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 37.1*7*145 / 0.31 | Answer: 121473 W

question: A surface of area 4.5 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 30 W/m^2-K to surroundings 95 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 4.5, h = 30, dT = 95 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 30*4.5*95 | Answer: 12825 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 170 m/min, feed = 0.48 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.2 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 170, f = 0.48, d = 2.2 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*170*0.48*2.2 | Answer: 179520 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 110 mm is turned at 800 rpm with a feed of 0.4 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 110, N = 800, f = 0.4 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 110 / (0.4*800) | Answer: 0.3438 min

question: A resistor of 181 ohm carries a current of 1.5 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 181, I = 1.5 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 1.5 * 181 | Answer: 271.5 V

question: Three resistors 61 ohm, 32 ohm and 83 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 61, R2 = 32, R3 = 83 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 61 + 32 + 83 | Answer: 176 ohm

question: Two resistors 59 ohm and 79 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 59, R2 = 79 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 59*79 / (59+79) | Answer: 33.78 ohm

question: A device draws 3.5 A at 110 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 110, I = 3.5 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 110 * 3.5 | Answer: 385 W

question: A current of 2.6 A flows through a 66 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 2.6, R = 66 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (2.6)^2 * 66 | Answer: 446.2 W

question: Two capacitors 16.2 uF and 47.2 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 16.2, C2 = 47.2 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 16.2*47.2 / (16.2+47.2) | Answer: 12.06 uF

question: A resistor 61 kohm and capacitor 18.2 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 61, C = 18.2 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (61k)(18.2u) = 111 ms | Answer: 111 ms

question: An inductor 436.4 mH is in series with 8 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 436.4, R = 8 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (436.4e-3) / 8 | Answer: 54.55 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 64.9 mH inductor at 930 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 64.9, f = 930 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (930)(64.9e-3) | Answer: 379.2 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 23.6 uF capacitor at 780 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 23.6, f = 780 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (780)(23.6e-6)) | Answer: 8.646 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 84 ohm, XL = 12 ohm and XC = 118 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 84, XL = 12, XC = 118 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(84^2 + (12 - 118)^2) | Answer: 135.2 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 4.4 mH and C = 5.2 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 4.4, C = 5.2 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(4.4e-3 * 5.2e-6)) | Answer: 1052 Hz

question: A capacitor of 6 uF is charged to 125 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 6, V = 125 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*6e-6*(125)^2 | Answer: 46.88 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 120 V with 980 primary turns and 120 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 120, N1 = 980, N2 = 120 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 120 * 120/980 | Answer: 14.69 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 310 V and draws an armature current of 49 A. If the armature resistance is 0.83 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 310, Ia = 49, Ra = 0.83 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 310 - 49*0.83 | Answer: 269.3 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 65 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.85. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 65, VL = 415, pf = 0.85 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*65*0.85 / 1000 | Answer: 39.71 kW

question: A load has real power 95 kW and apparent power 150 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 95, S = 150 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 95 / 150 | Answer: 0.6333

question: A machine delivers 40 kW output while drawing 137 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 40, Pi = 137 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 40/137 * 100 | Answer: 29.2 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 18 V across R1 = 42 ohm and R2 = 16 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 18, R1 = 42, R2 = 16 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 18*16 / (42+16) | Answer: 4.966 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 40 kohm and Rin = 5 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 40, Rin = 5 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 40 / 5 | Answer: 8

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 40 kohm and Rg = 31 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 40, Rg = 31 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 40/31 | Answer: 2.29

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9273. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 9273 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(9273) | Answer: 39.67 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 8.7 m carries a central point load of 85 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.7, W = 85 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 85*8.7 / 4 | Answer: 184.9 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.8 m carries a UDL of 45 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.8, w = 45 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 45*(5.8)^2 / 8 | Answer: 189.2 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.1 m carries a point load 60 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.1, W = 60 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 60*5.1 | Answer: 306 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 3.6 m carries a UDL of 40 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.6, w = 40 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 40*(3.6)^2 / 2 | Answer: 259.2 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.5 m carries a point load 60 kN at distance 3.7 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 9.5, a = 3.7, W = 60 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 60*(9.5 - 3.7) / 9.5 | Answer: 36.63 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 5.2 m) carries a central point load 50 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 210e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=50000 N, L=5200.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=210e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 27.9 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 4.5 m carries a UDL of 27 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.5, w = 27 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 27*(4.5)^2 / 12 | Answer: 45.56 kN-m

question: A column supports a floor area of 30.2 m^2 carrying a factored load of 17.8 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 30.2, w = 17.8 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 17.8 * 30.2 | Answer: 537.6 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 5.3 m, unit weight 19 kN/m^3, phi = 31 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 5e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.8, area = 1e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 5, i = 0.8, A = 1 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (5e-4)*0.8*(1e-3) | Answer: 400 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.5 m, bed slope 0.009 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.024. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4 m under a head of 1 m. Taking Cd = 0.64 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
solution: Given: L = 4, H = 1, cd = 0.64 | Formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2) | Substitute: Q = (2/3)*0.64*sqrt(2*9.81)*4*(1)^1.5 | Answer: 7.56 m^3/s
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 2.2 m wide carries a discharge of 6.5 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 320 m^3 treats a flow of 85 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 320, Q = 85 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 320 / 85 | Answer: 3.765 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 190 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.29 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 6 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 190, k = 0.29, t = 6 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 190*(1 - e^(-0.29*6)) | Answer: 156.7 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.86, rainfall intensity 80 mm/h over a catchment of 50.9 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.86, i = 80, A = 50.9 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.86*80*50.9 / 360 | Answer: 9.728 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.02 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 400 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.02, M = 400 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 400*(20+0.02)/20 | Answer: 400.4 m

question: Convert the decimal number 729 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 729 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 2D9 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 01101111 and 01000000.
solution: XOR: 00101111 | Count of 1s = 5 | Answer: 5
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 150 megabits is sent over a link of 89 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 150, B = 89 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 150 / 89 | Answer: 1.685 s

question: A link has bandwidth 35 Mbps and round-trip time 30 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 35, R = 30 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 35e6 * 30e-3 bits = 1050 kb | Answer: 1050 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.8, cache access time 9 ns and main-memory access time 170 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.8, tc = 9, tm = 170 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.8*9 + (1 - 0.8)*170 | Answer: 41.2 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 284893 elements?
solution: Given: n = 284893 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(284893)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.01, memory access time 170 ns and page-fault service time 9 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 9 ms = 9000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.01)*170 + 0.01*9000000.0 ns | Answer: 90.17 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.9 m^3 at 220 kPa and 590 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.9, P = 220, Tk = 590 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (220e3)*2.9 / (8.314*590) | Answer: 130.1 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 6e10 /s and activation energy 75 kJ/mol at 370 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 6, Ea = 75, Tk = 370 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 6e10 * exp(-75e3 / (8.314*370)) | Answer: 1.548 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.94 and bottoms xW = 0.07, with relative volatility alpha = 3.3. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.94, xw = 0.07, al = 3.3 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.94/0.06)(0.93/0.07)] / ln(3.3) | Answer: 4.471 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.69 and x = 0.25. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.69, x = 0.25 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.69/0.31) / (0.25/0.75) | Answer: 6.677

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.38 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 105 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.38, Psat = 105 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.38 * 105 | Answer: 39.9 kPa

question: A stream of 4.2 kg/s with specific heat 2.6 kJ/kg-K is heated through 75 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 4.2, cp = 2.6, dT = 75 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 4.2*2.6*75 | Answer: 819 kW

question: A reactor of volume 7.1 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 3.4 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 7.1, Q = 3.4 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 7.1 / 3.4 | Answer: 2.088 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 2.4e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 3 mm with a concentration difference of 80 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 2.4, L = 3, dC = 80 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (2.4e-9)*80 / (3e-3) | Answer: 64 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 9.2 min and steady-state gain 2.7. For a step input of magnitude 2, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 9.2, K = 2.7, M = 2 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 2.7 * 2 | Answer: 5.4 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 90 m^2 flies at 100 m/s (air density 1.225 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.7. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 90, V = 100, rho = 1.225, CL = 0.7 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1.225*(100)^2*90*0.7 / 1000 | Answer: 385.9 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 100 m^2 flies at 110 m/s (density 1.225 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.1. Find the drag force in kN.
A specimen under stress 390 MPa shows an elastic strain of 1.1e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 390, eps = 1.1 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 390 / (1.1e-3) MPa = 354.5 GPa | Answer: 354.5 GPa

question: A block of mass 41 kg has a volume of 1.4e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 41, V = 1.4 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 41 / (1.4e-3) | Answer: 29286 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2100 mm is heated through 90 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2100, dT = 90, al = 23 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2100*23e-6*90 | Answer: 4.347 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 190 ohm, R2 = 145 ohm and R3 = 330 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 190, R2 = 145, R3 = 330 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 145*330 / 190 | Answer: 251.8 ohm

question: A measurement reads 10.44 when the true value is 100. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 10.44, true = 100 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |10.44 - 100| / 100 * 100 | Answer: 89.56 %

question: Annual demand is 7500 units, ordering cost 20 per order and holding cost 36 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 7500, S = 20, H = 36 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*7500*20 / 36) | Answer: 91.29 units

question: An asset costs 140000 with salvage value 34000 after 20 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 140000, Sv = 34000, n = 20 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (140000 - 34000) / 20 | Answer: 5300 per year

question: A product sells for 200 per unit with variable cost 190 per unit and fixed costs 155000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 200, V = 190, F = 155000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 155000 / (200 - 190) | Answer: 15500 units

question: Find the present worth of 15000 received 6 years from now at an interest rate of 9% per year.
solution: Given: F = 15000, n = 6, i = 9 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 15000 / (1 + 0.09)^6 | Answer: 8944 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.98, 0.92 and 0.99 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.98, r2 = 0.92, r3 = 0.99 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.98*0.92*0.99 | Answer: 0.8926

question: A process produces 4 defective items in a batch of 13000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 4, N = 13000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 4/13000 * 1e6 | Answer: 307.7 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = x^3 - 7x^2 + 2x + 6 evaluated at x = 3.
For f(x) = 5x^3 - 5x^2 + 2x - 9, find f''(x) at x = 5.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-3x^2 + 4x + 4) dx from x = 1 to x = 4.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -3x^3/3 + 4x^2/2 + 4x | Evaluate F(4) - F(1) | Answer: -21

question: Find the larger real root of 3x^2 + 11x - 7 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[1, 3], [-1, -5]].
solution: Given: a = 1, b = 3, c = -1, d = -5 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (1)(-5) - (3)(-1) | Answer: -2

question: Find the determinant of [[5, 0, 0], [6, -5, 6], [-3, 3, 4]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -190

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[0, -6], [0, 6]].
solution: Trace tr = 6, Determinant = 0 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 6

question: Solve for x: 6x + 1y = -11 and -2x + -4y = 0.
solution: Determinant = 6*-4 - 1*-2 = -22 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -2 | Answer: x = -2
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 75, 47, 98, 36, 57.
solution: Sum = 313 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 62.6 | Answer: 62.6

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 12, 43, 9, 25, 9.
solution: Mean = 19.6 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 14.66

question: Find the slope of the line through (9, 8) and (7, 4).
solution: Given: x1 = 9, y1 = 8, x2 = 7, y2 = 4 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (4 - 8) / (7 - 9) | Answer: 2

question: Find the distance between the points (6, 8) and (-1, -1).
solution: Given: x1 = 6, y1 = 8, x2 = -1, y2 = -1 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((-7)^2 + (-9)^2) | Answer: 11.4 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (8,-4), (-8,-2), (7,-5).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 9 sq units

question: Find the 22th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -4 and common difference -5.
solution: Given: a = -4, d = -5, n = 22 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -4 + (22 - 1)*-5 | Answer: -109

question: Find the sum of the first 17 terms of an AP with first term -10 and common difference 1.
solution: Given: a = -10, d = 1, n = 17 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 17/2 [2*-10 + (17-1)*1] | Answer: -34

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 11500 at 6.7% per annum for 8 years.
solution: Given: P = 11500, R = 6.7, Tt = 8 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 11500 * 6.7 * 8 / 100 | Answer: 6164 currency units

question: Find the amount when 30000 is invested at 8.2% per annum compounded annually for 3 years.
solution: Given: P = 30000, R = 8.2, Tt = 3 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 30000 * (1 + 8.2/100)^3 | Answer: 38002 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (8, -8, -5) and (2, -3, -3).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (4, 0, -1) and (2, 3, 2).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 15.91

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (-2, -3, 4) and (-4, 2, 5).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 52.48 degrees

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number -12 + -1i.
solution: Given: a = -12, b = -1 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(-1, -12) | Answer: -175.2 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = x^3 + 5x^2 + 3x + 8 at x = -5.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-175 with initial guess x0=11, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.7 and ordinates 3, 2, 6, 6, 20, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 410 and 535.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 410 and 535 | Answer: GCD = 5

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 68 and 34.
solution: Given: a = 68, b = 34 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 68*34 / 34 | Answer: 68
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 55 mm carries an axial tensile load of 61 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 13 mm and length 1300 mm carries an axial load of 60 kN. Take E = 110 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 65 mm transmits a torque of 1150 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 65, Tt = 1150 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(1150*1000) / (pi*(65)^3) | Answer: 21.33 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 67 mm and length 900 mm carries a torque of 1550 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (67)^4 / 32 = 1978332 mm^4 | theta = (1550*1000)(900) / (80000 * 1978332) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.505 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 114 mm wide and 110 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 114, h = 110 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 114*(110)^2 / 6 | Answer: 229900 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (77 mm x 120 mm) carries a bending moment of 23 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (54 mm x 100 mm) has effective length 2500 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 660 MPa is designed for a working stress of 140 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 660, sw = 140 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 660 / 140 | Answer: 4.714

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 550 mm and wall thickness 11 mm carries an internal pressure of 2 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 550, t = 11, P = 2 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 2*550 / (2*11) | Answer: 50 MPa

question: 2.8 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 95 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.8, dT = 95 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 2.8 * 0.718 * 95 | Answer: 191 kJ

question: 4.1 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 25 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.1, dT = 25 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 4.1 * 1.005 * 25 | Answer: 103 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 2 m^3 at 430 K with mass 1.3 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 2, Tk = 430, m = 1.3 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 1.3*0.287*430 / 2 | Answer: 80.22 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 2.2 kg of air expands isothermally at 500 K from volume V1 to 5*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.2, Tk = 500, ratio = 5 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 2.2*0.287*500*ln(5) | Answer: 508.1 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 2.6 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.15 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 2.6, D = 0.15 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*2.6*0.15 / 0.001 | Answer: 390000

question: Water flows at 2.6 m/s through a pipe of diameter 230 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 10.5 m. Taking Cv = 0.95, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 10.5, cv = 0.95 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.95*sqrt(2*9.81*10.5) | Answer: 13.64 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 340 mm) water flows at 1.5 m/s. It contracts to diameter 110 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
Water flows at 3.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.14 m and length 270 m. With friction factor f = 0.02, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 27 teeth drives a gear of 114 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1400 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 27, z2 = 114, N1 = 1400 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1400*27 / 114 | Answer: 331.6 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 560 mm rotates at 1300 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 560, N = 1300 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.56)*1300 / 60 | Answer: 38.12 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 24.7 kW at 950 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 24.7, N = 950 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(24.7*1000) / (2*pi*950) | Answer: 248.3 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 3.6 kg rotates at radius 0.37 m at 400 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 4800 N/m and mass 18.7 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 4800, m = 18.7 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(4800/18.7) | Answer: 2.55 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 6 m^2 and thickness 0.31 m has conductivity k = 17.9 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 25 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 6, L = 0.31, k = 17.9, dT = 25 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 17.9*6*25 / 0.31 | Answer: 8661 W

question: A surface of area 4 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 105 W/m^2-K to surroundings 115 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 4, h = 105, dT = 115 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 105*4*115 | Answer: 48300 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 180 m/min, feed = 0.45 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.4 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 180, f = 0.45, d = 2.4 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*180*0.45*2.4 | Answer: 194400 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 140 mm is turned at 700 rpm with a feed of 0.24 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 140, N = 700, f = 0.24 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 140 / (0.24*700) | Answer: 0.8333 min

question: A resistor of 75 ohm carries a current of 6.5 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 75, I = 6.5 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 6.5 * 75 | Answer: 487.5 V

question: Three resistors 26 ohm, 18 ohm and 26 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 26, R2 = 18, R3 = 26 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 26 + 18 + 26 | Answer: 70 ohm

question: Two resistors 110 ohm and 64 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 110, R2 = 64 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 110*64 / (110+64) | Answer: 40.46 ohm

question: A device draws 14 A at 215 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 215, I = 14 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 215 * 14 | Answer: 3010 W

question: A current of 2.8 A flows through a 86 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 2.8, R = 86 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (2.8)^2 * 86 | Answer: 674.2 W

question: Two capacitors 12.5 uF and 40.6 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 12.5, C2 = 40.6 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 12.5*40.6 / (12.5+40.6) | Answer: 9.557 uF

question: A resistor 68 kohm and capacitor 14.6 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 68, C = 14.6 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (68k)(14.6u) = 992.8 ms | Answer: 992.8 ms

question: An inductor 335 mH is in series with 57 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 335, R = 57 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (335e-3) / 57 | Answer: 5.877 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 24.5 mH inductor at 610 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 24.5, f = 610 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (610)(24.5e-3) | Answer: 93.9 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 31.1 uF capacitor at 400 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 31.1, f = 400 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (400)(31.1e-6)) | Answer: 12.79 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 59 ohm, XL = 140 ohm and XC = 106 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 59, XL = 140, XC = 106 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(59^2 + (140 - 106)^2) | Answer: 68.1 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 2.3 mH and C = 0.5 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 2.3, C = 0.5 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(2.3e-3 * 0.5e-6)) | Answer: 4693 Hz

question: A capacitor of 50.9 uF is charged to 330 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 50.9, V = 330 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*50.9e-6*(330)^2 | Answer: 2772 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 220 V with 710 primary turns and 180 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 220, N1 = 710, N2 = 180 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 220 * 180/710 | Answer: 55.77 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 310 V and draws an armature current of 37 A. If the armature resistance is 1.04 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 310, Ia = 37, Ra = 1.04 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 310 - 37*1.04 | Answer: 271.5 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 50 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.88. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 50, VL = 415, pf = 0.88 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*50*0.88 / 1000 | Answer: 31.63 kW

question: A load has real power 80 kW and apparent power 140 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 80, S = 140 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 80 / 140 | Answer: 0.5714

question: A machine delivers 55 kW output while drawing 72 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 55, Pi = 72 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 55/72 * 100 | Answer: 76.39 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 28 V across R1 = 43 ohm and R2 = 42 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 28, R1 = 43, R2 = 42 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 28*42 / (43+42) | Answer: 13.84 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 60 kohm and Rin = 45 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 60, Rin = 45 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 60 / 45 | Answer: 1.333

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 150 kohm and Rg = 42 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 150, Rg = 42 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 150/42 | Answer: 4.571

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 4076. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 4076 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(4076) | Answer: 36.1 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 3.2 m carries a central point load of 10 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.2, W = 10 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 10*3.2 / 4 | Answer: 8 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.7 m carries a UDL of 20 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6.7, w = 20 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 20*(6.7)^2 / 8 | Answer: 112.2 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 1.6 m carries a point load 40 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 1.6, W = 40 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 40*1.6 | Answer: 64 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 3.8 m carries a UDL of 32 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.8, w = 32 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 32*(3.8)^2 / 2 | Answer: 231 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.8 m carries a point load 85 kN at distance 1.3 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 7.8, a = 1.3, W = 85 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 85*(7.8 - 1.3) / 7.8 | Answer: 70.83 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 6.3 m) carries a central point load 20 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 130e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=20000 N, L=6300.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=130e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 32.06 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 520 mm, clear cover 30 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 520, c = 30, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 520 - 30 - 12/2 | Answer: 484 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 11.1 m^2 carrying a factored load of 14.4 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 11.1, w = 14.4 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 14.4 * 11.1 | Answer: 159.8 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 3.8 m, unit weight 17 kN/m^3, phi = 34 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 1.2e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.5, area = 1.4e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 1.2, i = 0.5, A = 1.4 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (1.2e-4)*0.5*(1.4e-3) | Answer: 84 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1.2 m, bed slope 0.005 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.016. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.8 m under a head of 0.6 m. Taking Cd = 0.64 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.4 m wide carries a discharge of 19.9 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 550 m and design speed 50 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 550, V = 50 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (50)^2 / (127*550) | Answer: 0.03579
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 530 m^3 treats a flow of 180 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 530, Q = 180 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 530 / 180 | Answer: 2.944 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 210 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.34 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 3 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 210, k = 0.34, t = 3 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 210*(1 - e^(-0.34*3)) | Answer: 134.3 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.58, rainfall intensity 75 mm/h over a catchment of 17.6 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.58, i = 75, A = 17.6 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.58*75*17.6 / 360 | Answer: 2.127 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.06 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 100 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.06, M = 100 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 100*(20+0.06)/20 | Answer: 100.3 m

question: Convert the decimal number 2086 to hexadecimal (uppercase).

question: A file of 460 megabits is sent over a link of 37 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 460, B = 37 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 460 / 37 | Answer: 12.43 s

question: A link has bandwidth 21 Mbps and round-trip time 170 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 21, R = 170 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 21e6 * 170e-3 bits = 3570 kb | Answer: 3570 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.84, cache access time 2 ns and main-memory access time 180 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.84, tc = 2, tm = 180 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.84*2 + (1 - 0.84)*180 | Answer: 30.48 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 167261 elements?
solution: Given: n = 167261 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(167261)) + 1 | Answer: 18

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.014, memory access time 80 ns and page-fault service time 5 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 5 ms = 5000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.014)*80 + 0.014*5000000.0 ns | Answer: 70.08 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.5 m^3 at 350 kPa and 600 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.5, P = 350, Tk = 600 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (350e3)*2.5 / (8.314*600) | Answer: 175.4 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.19 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 19 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.19, t = 19 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.19*19) | Answer: 0.9729

question: For a reaction with A = 7e10 /s and activation energy 65 kJ/mol at 320 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 7, Ea = 65, Tk = 320 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 7e10 * exp(-65e3 / (8.314*320)) | Answer: 1.716 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.9 and bottoms xW = 0.09, with relative volatility alpha = 2.8. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.9, xw = 0.09, al = 2.8 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.9/0.1)(0.91/0.09)] / ln(2.8) | Answer: 4.381 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.77 and x = 0.26. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.77, x = 0.26 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.77/0.23) / (0.26/0.74) | Answer: 9.528

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.67 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 60 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.67, Psat = 60 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.67 * 60 | Answer: 40.2 kPa

question: A stream of 3.1 kg/s with specific heat 2.8 kJ/kg-K is heated through 100 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 3.1, cp = 2.8, dT = 100 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 3.1*2.8*100 | Answer: 868 kW

question: A reactor of volume 2.5 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 2.2 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 2.5, Q = 2.2 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 2.5 / 2.2 | Answer: 1.136 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 5e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 5 mm with a concentration difference of 30 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 5, L = 5, dC = 30 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (5e-9)*30 / (5e-3) | Answer: 30 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 2.3 min and steady-state gain 1.5. For a step input of magnitude 17, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 2.3, K = 1.5, M = 17 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 1.5 * 17 | Answer: 25.5 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 100 m^2 flies at 260 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.8. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 100, V = 260, rho = 0.7, CL = 0.8 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.7*(260)^2*100*0.8 / 1000 | Answer: 1893 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 95 m^2 flies at 110 m/s (density 1 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.05. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 95, V = 110, rho = 1, CD = 0.05 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*1*(110)^2*95*0.05 / 1000 | Answer: 28.74 kN

question: A specimen under stress 210 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.6e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 210, eps = 2.6 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 210 / (2.6e-3) MPa = 80.77 GPa | Answer: 80.77 GPa

question: A block of mass 14 kg has a volume of 5e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 14, V = 5 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 14 / (5e-3) | Answer: 2800 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2000 mm is heated through 115 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2000, dT = 115, al = 23 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2000*23e-6*115 | Answer: 5.29 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 190 ohm, R2 = 60 ohm and R3 = 485 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 190, R2 = 60, R3 = 485 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 60*485 / 190 | Answer: 153.2 ohm

question: A measurement reads 10.65 when the true value is 10. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 10.65, true = 10 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |10.65 - 10| / 10 * 100 | Answer: 6.5 %

question: Annual demand is 18000 units, ordering cost 260 per order and holding cost 20 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 18000, S = 260, H = 20 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*18000*260 / 20) | Answer: 684.1 units

question: An asset costs 200000 with salvage value 26000 after 6 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 200000, Sv = 26000, n = 6 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (200000 - 26000) / 6 | Answer: 29000 per year

question: A product sells for 470 per unit with variable cost 150 per unit and fixed costs 50000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 470, V = 150, F = 50000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 50000 / (470 - 150) | Answer: 156.2 units

question: Find the present worth of 180000 received 2 years from now at an interest rate of 12% per year.

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.95, 0.96 and 0.99 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.95, r2 = 0.96, r3 = 0.99 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.95*0.96*0.99 | Answer: 0.9029

question: A process produces 36 defective items in a batch of 5000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 36, N = 5000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 36/5000 * 1e6 | Answer: 7200 PPM

question: Find the 23th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 17 and common difference -9.

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 44000 at 7.5% per annum for 9 years.

question: A circular rod of diameter 53 mm carries an axial tensile load of 41 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.

question: 4.3 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 180 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.

solution: Given: m = 4.5, dT = 100 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 4.5 * 1.005 * 100 | Answer: 452.2 kJ

question: 1.1 kg of air expands isothermally at 430 K from volume V1 to 2*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.1, Tk = 430, ratio = 2 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 1.1*0.287*430*ln(2) | Answer: 94.1 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 2.9 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.21 m. Find the Reynolds number.

question: Water flows at 1.3 m/s through a pipe of diameter 230 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.

question: In a pipe (diameter 390 mm) water flows at 1 m/s. It contracts to diameter 50 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).

question: A plane wall of area 2.9 m^2 and thickness 0.2 m has conductivity k = 41.3 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 75 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.

question: A surface of area 5.8 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 10 W/m^2-K to surroundings 105 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.

question: In turning, cutting speed = 60 m/min, feed = 0.11 mm/rev, depth of cut = 0.7 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 60, f = 0.11, d = 0.7 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*60*0.11*0.7 | Answer: 4620 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 190 mm is turned at 600 rpm with a feed of 0.27 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.

question: A resistor of 74 ohm carries a current of 6.6 A. Find the voltage across it.

question: Three resistors 98 ohm, 97 ohm and 37 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.

question: Two resistors 46 ohm and 8 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.

question: A device draws 7.5 A at 195 V. Find the power consumed.

question: A current of 4.2 A flows through a 96 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.

question: Two capacitors 32.1 uF and 35.3 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 32.1, C2 = 35.3 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 32.1*35.3 / (32.1+35.3) | Answer: 16.81 uF

question: A resistor 37 kohm and capacitor 12.8 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.

question: An inductor 291.2 mH is in series with 138 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 47 mH inductor at 330 Hz.

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 27.9 uF capacitor at 440 Hz.

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 55 ohm, XL = 53 ohm and XC = 33 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.

question: A capacitor of 34.7 uF is charged to 300 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.

question: A transformer has primary voltage 110 V with 600 primary turns and 200 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.

question: A DC motor is supplied at 130 V and draws an armature current of 42 A. If the armature resistance is 0.7 ohm, find the back EMF.

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 190 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.87. Find the total real power in kW.
