question: Find the slope of the line through (-6, 7) and (-5, -6).
solution: Given: x1 = -6, y1 = 7, x2 = -5, y2 = -6 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (-6 - 7) / (-5 - -6) | Answer: -13

question: Find the distance between the points (-6, 3) and (1, 6).
solution: Given: x1 = -6, y1 = 3, x2 = 1, y2 = 6 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((7)^2 + (3)^2) | Answer: 7.616 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-4,-2), (5,-5), (7,-3).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 12 sq units

question: Find the 11th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -18 and common difference 7.
solution: Given: a = -18, d = 7, n = 11 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -18 + (11 - 1)*7 | Answer: 52

question: Find the sum of the first 5 terms of an AP with first term -15 and common difference 5.
solution: Given: a = -15, d = 5, n = 5 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 5/2 [2*-15 + (5-1)*5] | Answer: -25

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 14000 at 10.9% per annum for 7 years.
solution: Given: P = 14000, R = 10.9, Tt = 7 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 14000 * 10.9 * 7 / 100 | Answer: 10682 currency units

question: Find the amount when 17500 is invested at 9.9% per annum compounded annually for 4 years.
solution: Given: P = 17500, R = 9.9, Tt = 4 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 17500 * (1 + 9.9/100)^4 | Answer: 25529 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (-2, 6, 3) and (-6, -4, 4).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (2, -1, 0) and (-5, -3, -5).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 15.68

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (4, -4, -5) and (-3, 2, 3).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 171.3 degrees

question: Find the modulus of the complex number 7 + -8i.
solution: Given: a = 7, b = -8 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((7)^2 + (-8)^2) | Answer: 10.63

question: Evaluate f(x) = -x^3 - x^2 - 9x - 3 at x = 3.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-195 with initial guess x0=12, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=0.7 and ordinates 11, 18, 8, 1, 2, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 275 and 326.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 275 and 326 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 22 and 59.
solution: Given: a = 22, b = 59 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 22*59 / 1 | Answer: 1298
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 21 mm carries an axial tensile load of 98 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 22 mm and length 2200 mm carries an axial load of 37 kN. Take E = 210 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 50 mm transmits a torque of 2000 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 50, Tt = 2000 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2000*1000) / (pi*(50)^3) | Answer: 81.49 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 31 mm and length 1900 mm carries a torque of 1250 N-m. With G = 77 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (31)^4 / 32 = 90666 mm^4 | theta = (1250*1000)(1900) / (77000 * 90666) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 19.49 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 96 mm wide and 70 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 96, h = 70 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 96*(70)^2 / 6 | Answer: 78400 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (102 mm x 80 mm) carries a bending moment of 2 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (37 mm x 140 mm) has effective length 2700 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 640 MPa is designed for a working stress of 120 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 640, sw = 120 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 640 / 120 | Answer: 5.333

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 600 mm and wall thickness 13 mm carries an internal pressure of 0.9 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 600, t = 13, P = 0.9 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 0.9*600 / (2*13) | Answer: 20.77 MPa

question: 3.5 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 200 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.5, dT = 200 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 3.5 * 0.718 * 200 | Answer: 502.6 kJ

question: 4 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 155 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4, dT = 155 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 4 * 1.005 * 155 | Answer: 623.1 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.9 m^3 at 480 K with mass 1.3 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 3.9, Tk = 480, m = 1.3 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 1.3*0.287*480 / 3.9 | Answer: 45.92 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4 kg of air expands isothermally at 390 K from volume V1 to 2*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4, Tk = 390, ratio = 2 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4*0.287*390*ln(2) | Answer: 310.3 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 4.2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.19 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 4.2, D = 0.19 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*4.2*0.19 / 0.001 | Answer: 798000

question: Water flows at 3.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 270 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 10.3 m. Taking Cv = 0.96, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 10.3, cv = 0.96 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.96*sqrt(2*9.81*10.3) | Answer: 13.65 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 260 mm) water flows at 2.2 m/s. It contracts to diameter 130 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 260, d2 = 130, V1 = 2.2 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2.2*(260/130)^2 | Answer: 8.8 m/s

question: Water flows at 2.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.19 m and length 220 m. With friction factor f = 0.028, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 19 teeth drives a gear of 85 teeth. If the pinion runs at 550 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 19, z2 = 85, N1 = 550 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 550*19 / 85 | Answer: 122.9 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 300 mm rotates at 950 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 300, N = 950 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.3)*950 / 60 | Answer: 14.92 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 44.2 kW at 350 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 44.2, N = 350 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(44.2*1000) / (2*pi*350) | Answer: 1206 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 5.9 kg rotates at radius 0.42 m at 350 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 16300 N/m and mass 18.6 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 16300, m = 18.6 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(16300/18.6) | Answer: 4.711 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 8.2 m^2 and thickness 0.28 m has conductivity k = 24.1 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 45 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 8.2, L = 0.28, k = 24.1, dT = 45 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 24.1*8.2*45 / 0.28 | Answer: 3176 W

question: A surface of area 4.5 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 155 W/m^2-K to surroundings 125 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 4.5, h = 155, dT = 125 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 155*4.5*125 | Answer: 87188 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 70 m/min, feed = 0.47 mm/rev, depth of cut = 0.5 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 70, f = 0.47, d = 0.5 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*70*0.47*0.5 | Answer: 16450 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 340 mm is turned at 250 rpm with a feed of 0.14 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 340, N = 250, f = 0.14 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 340 / (0.14*250) | Answer: 9.714 min

question: A resistor of 127 ohm carries a current of 3.6 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 127, I = 3.6 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 3.6 * 127 | Answer: 457.2 V

question: Three resistors 25 ohm, 10 ohm and 53 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 25, R2 = 10, R3 = 53 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 25 + 10 + 53 | Answer: 88 ohm

question: Two resistors 22 ohm and 35 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 22, R2 = 35 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 22*35 / (22+35) | Answer: 13.51 ohm

question: A device draws 9 A at 115 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 115, I = 9 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 115 * 9 | Answer: 1035 W

question: A current of 5.3 A flows through a 31 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 5.3, R = 31 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (5.3)^2 * 31 | Answer: 870.8 W

question: Two capacitors 8.1 uF and 30.7 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 8.1, C2 = 30.7 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 8.1*30.7 / (8.1+30.7) | Answer: 6.409 uF

question: A resistor 54 kohm and capacitor 0.9 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 54, C = 0.9 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (54k)(0.9u) = 48.6 ms | Answer: 48.6 ms

question: An inductor 281.8 mH is in series with 63 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 281.8, R = 63 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (281.8e-3) / 63 | Answer: 4.473 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 183.8 mH inductor at 540 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 183.8, f = 540 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (540)(183.8e-3) | Answer: 623.6 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 25.4 uF capacitor at 650 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 25.4, f = 650 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (650)(25.4e-6)) | Answer: 9.64 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 56 ohm, XL = 95 ohm and XC = 105 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 56, XL = 95, XC = 105 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(56^2 + (95 - 105)^2) | Answer: 56.89 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 69.9 mH and C = 9.6 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 69.9, C = 9.6 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(69.9e-3 * 9.6e-6)) | Answer: 194.3 Hz

question: A capacitor of 88.1 uF is charged to 295 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 88.1, V = 295 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*88.1e-6*(295)^2 | Answer: 3833 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 360 V with 470 primary turns and 300 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 360, N1 = 470, N2 = 300 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 360 * 300/470 | Answer: 229.8 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 370 V and draws an armature current of 17 A. If the armature resistance is 0.48 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 370, Ia = 17, Ra = 0.48 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 370 - 17*0.48 | Answer: 361.8 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 95 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.82. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 95, VL = 433, pf = 0.82 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*95*0.82 / 1000 | Answer: 58.42 kW

question: A load has real power 155 kW and apparent power 170 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 155, S = 170 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 155 / 170 | Answer: 0.9118

question: A machine delivers 35 kW output while drawing 172 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 35, Pi = 172 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 35/172 * 100 | Answer: 20.35 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 25 V across R1 = 36 ohm and R2 = 11 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 25, R1 = 36, R2 = 11 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 25*11 / (36+11) | Answer: 5.851 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 190 kohm and Rin = 9 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 190, Rin = 9 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 190 / 9 | Answer: 21.11

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 40 kohm and Rg = 42 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 40, Rg = 42 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 40/42 | Answer: 1.952

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9736. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 9736 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(9736) | Answer: 39.88 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.2 m carries a central point load of 50 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.2, W = 50 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 50*5.2 / 4 | Answer: 65 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.6 m carries a UDL of 20 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 7.6, w = 20 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 20*(7.6)^2 / 8 | Answer: 144.4 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 3.6 m carries a point load 40 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.6, W = 40 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 40*3.6 | Answer: 144 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.9 m carries a point load 25 kN at distance 2.4 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 6.9, a = 2.4, W = 25 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 25*(6.9 - 2.4) / 6.9 | Answer: 16.3 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 5.5 m) carries a central point load 30 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 520e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=30000 N, L=5500.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=520e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 7.999 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 510 mm, clear cover 45 mm and main bars of diameter 20 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 510, c = 45, dia = 20 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 510 - 45 - 20/2 | Answer: 455 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 37.3 m^2 carrying a factored load of 13.3 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 37.3, w = 13.3 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 13.3 * 37.3 | Answer: 496.1 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 6.4 m, unit weight 20 kN/m^3, phi = 28 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 8.5e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.4, area = 7.8e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 8.5, i = 0.4, A = 7.8 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (8.5e-4)*0.4*(7.8e-3) | Answer: 2652 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1 m, bed slope 0.008 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.013. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.8 m under a head of 0.4 m. Taking Cd = 0.61 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 5.4 m wide carries a discharge of 11.2 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 490 m and design speed 75 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 490, V = 75 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (75)^2 / (127*490) | Answer: 0.09039
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 150 m^3 treats a flow of 45 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 150, Q = 45 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 150 / 45 | Answer: 3.333 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 370 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.3 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 3 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 370, k = 0.3, t = 3 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 370*(1 - e^(-0.3*3)) | Answer: 219.6 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.44, rainfall intensity 40 mm/h over a catchment of 32.3 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.44, i = 40, A = 32.3 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.44*40*32.3 / 360 | Answer: 1.579 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.08 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 170 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.08, M = 170 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 170*(20+0.08)/20 | Answer: 170.7 m

question: Convert the decimal number 2258 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 2258 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 8D2 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 01000011 and 11100111.
solution: XOR: 10100100 | Count of 1s = 3 | Answer: 3
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 420 megabits is sent over a link of 76 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 420, B = 76 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 420 / 76 | Answer: 5.526 s

question: A link has bandwidth 37 Mbps and round-trip time 20 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 37, R = 20 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 37e6 * 20e-3 bits = 740 kb | Answer: 740 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.8, cache access time 1 ns and main-memory access time 90 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.8, tc = 1, tm = 90 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.8*1 + (1 - 0.8)*90 | Answer: 18.8 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 308940 elements?
solution: Given: n = 308940 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(308940)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.006, memory access time 150 ns and page-fault service time 4 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 4 ms = 4000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.006)*150 + 0.006*4000000.0 ns | Answer: 24.15 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2 m^3 at 180 kPa and 440 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2, P = 180, Tk = 440 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (180e3)*2 / (8.314*440) | Answer: 98.41 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.34 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 4 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.34, t = 4 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.34*4) | Answer: 0.7433

question: For a reaction with A = 4e10 /s and activation energy 90 kJ/mol at 360 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 4, Ea = 90, Tk = 360 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 4e10 * exp(-90e3 / (8.314*360)) | Answer: 0.003491 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.92 and bottoms xW = 0.06, with relative volatility alpha = 3.2. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.92, xw = 0.06, al = 3.2 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.92/0.08)(0.94/0.06)] / ln(3.2) | Answer: 4.465 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.85 and x = 0.36. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.85, x = 0.36 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.85/0.15) / (0.36/0.64) | Answer: 10.07

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.88 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 65 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.88, Psat = 65 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.88 * 65 | Answer: 57.2 kPa

question: A stream of 3.9 kg/s with specific heat 2.4 kJ/kg-K is heated through 35 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 3.9, cp = 2.4, dT = 35 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 3.9*2.4*35 | Answer: 327.6 kW

question: A reactor of volume 6.1 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 0.4 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 6.1, Q = 0.4 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 6.1 / 0.4 | Answer: 15.25 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 7.2e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 3 mm with a concentration difference of 60 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 7.2, L = 3, dC = 60 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (7.2e-9)*60 / (3e-3) | Answer: 144 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 3.9 min and steady-state gain 2.9. For a step input of magnitude 14, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 3.9, K = 2.9, M = 14 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 2.9 * 14 | Answer: 40.6 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 120 m^2 flies at 170 m/s (air density 0.4 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.4. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 120, V = 170, rho = 0.4, CL = 0.4 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.4*(170)^2*120*0.4 / 1000 | Answer: 277.4 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 65 m^2 flies at 230 m/s (density 1 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.12. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 65, V = 230, rho = 1, CD = 0.12 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*1*(230)^2*65*0.12 / 1000 | Answer: 206.3 kN

question: A block of mass 8 kg has a volume of 1.2e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 8, V = 1.2 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 8 / (1.2e-3) | Answer: 6667 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 1400 mm is heated through 125 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 1400, dT = 125, al = 23 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 1400*23e-6*125 | Answer: 4.025 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 50 ohm, R2 = 25 ohm and R3 = 355 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 50, R2 = 25, R3 = 355 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 25*355 / 50 | Answer: 177.5 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.2 when the true value is 100. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.2, true = 100 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.2 - 100| / 100 * 100 | Answer: 90.8 %

question: Annual demand is 16000 units, ordering cost 280 per order and holding cost 15 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 16000, S = 280, H = 15 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*16000*280 / 15) | Answer: 772.9 units

question: An asset costs 410000 with salvage value 10000 after 8 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 410000, Sv = 10000, n = 8 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (410000 - 10000) / 8 | Answer: 50000 per year

question: A product sells for 290 per unit with variable cost 160 per unit and fixed costs 10000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 290, V = 160, F = 10000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 10000 / (290 - 160) | Answer: 76.92 units

question: Find the present worth of 145000 received 10 years from now at an interest rate of 7% per year.
solution: Given: F = 145000, n = 10, i = 7 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 145000 / (1 + 0.07)^10 | Answer: 73711 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.98, 0.92 and 0.95 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.98, r2 = 0.92, r3 = 0.95 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.98*0.92*0.95 | Answer: 0.8565

question: A process produces 23 defective items in a batch of 4500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 23, N = 4500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 23/4500 * 1e6 | Answer: 5111 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 2x^3 - 6x + 9 evaluated at x = 1.
For f(x) = -x^3 + 7x^2 - 9x - 8, find f''(x) at x = 5.
Evaluate the definite integral of (2x + 8) dx from x = 2 to x = 6.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 0x^3/3 + 2x^2/2 + 8x | Evaluate F(6) - F(2) | Answer: 64

question: Find the larger real root of 6x^2 + 2x - 7 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[-5, 0], [-9, -8]].
solution: Given: a = -5, b = 0, c = -9, d = -8 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (-5)(-8) - (0)(-9) | Answer: 40

question: Find the determinant of [[-2, 1, 1], [2, 5, -1], [-3, 5, 3]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -18

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[1, 1], [-8, 8]].
solution: Trace tr = 9, Determinant = 16 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 6.562

question: Solve for x: -6x + 6y = -4 and -4x + 3y = 11.
solution: Determinant = -6*3 - 6*-4 = 6 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -13 | Answer: x = -13

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 97, 56, 49, 56, 92.
solution: Sum = 350 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 70 | Answer: 70

solution: Mean = 18 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 11.47

question: Find the slope of the line through (4, 2) and (-8, 7).
solution: Given: x1 = 4, y1 = 2, x2 = -8, y2 = 7 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (7 - 2) / (-8 - 4) | Answer: -0.4167

question: Find the distance between the points (-6, -8) and (-7, 4).
solution: Given: x1 = -6, y1 = -8, x2 = -7, y2 = 4 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((-1)^2 + (12)^2) | Answer: 12.04 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (5,-3), (-8,8), (4,-4).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 12 sq units

question: Find the 40th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -12 and common difference 7.
solution: Given: a = -12, d = 7, n = 40 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -12 + (40 - 1)*7 | Answer: 261

question: Find the sum of the first 16 terms of an AP with first term -15 and common difference -7.
Find the simple interest on a principal of 47500 at 4.6% per annum for 3 years.
solution: Given: P = 47500, R = 4.6, Tt = 3 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 47500 * 4.6 * 3 / 100 | Answer: 6555 currency units

question: Find the amount when 20000 is invested at 6.5% per annum compounded annually for 6 years.
solution: Given: P = 20000, R = 6.5, Tt = 6 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 20000 * (1 + 6.5/100)^6 | Answer: 29183 currency units

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (1, 3, 5) and (6, 4, 5).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 29.09

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (-6, 2, 6) and (-5, 0, -4).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 83.83 degrees

question: Find the modulus of the complex number -8 + -7i.
solution: Given: a = -8, b = -7 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((-8)^2 + (-7)^2) | Answer: 10.63

question: Evaluate f(x) = x^3 - 6x^2 + x + 2 at x = 4.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-42 with initial guess x0=4, find x1 (one iteration).
solution: Given: N = 42, x0 = 4 | Formula: x1 = x0 - (x0^2 - N)/(2 x0) | Substitute: x1 = 4 - ((4)^2 - 42)/(2*4) | Answer: 7.25

question: Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=0.7 and ordinates 7, 2, 8, 5, 6, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 533 and 323.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 533 and 323 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 48 and 59.
solution: Given: a = 48, b = 59 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 48*59 / 1 | Answer: 2832
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 36 mm carries an axial tensile load of 56 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 20 mm and length 900 mm carries an axial load of 72 kN. Take E = 210 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 74 mm transmits a torque of 100 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 74, Tt = 100 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(100*1000) / (pi*(74)^3) | Answer: 1.257 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 70 mm and length 700 mm carries a torque of 1750 N-m. With G = 45 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (70)^4 / 32 = 2357176 mm^4 | theta = (1750*1000)(700) / (45000 * 2357176) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.6617 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 125 mm wide and 170 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 125, h = 170 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 125*(170)^2 / 6 | Answer: 602083 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (117 mm x 230 mm) carries a bending moment of 23 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (49 mm x 90 mm) has effective length 2600 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 600 MPa is designed for a working stress of 180 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 600, sw = 180 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 600 / 180 | Answer: 3.333

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1000 mm and wall thickness 16 mm carries an internal pressure of 0.7 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1000, t = 16, P = 0.7 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 0.7*1000 / (2*16) | Answer: 21.88 MPa

question: 6.1 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 100 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.1, dT = 100 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 6.1 * 0.718 * 100 | Answer: 438 kJ

question: 4.8 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 190 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.8, dT = 190 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 4.8 * 1.005 * 190 | Answer: 916.6 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1.4 m^3 at 320 K with mass 3.2 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1.4, Tk = 320, m = 3.2 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 3.2*0.287*320 / 1.4 | Answer: 209.9 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 1 kg of air expands isothermally at 380 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1, Tk = 380, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 1*0.287*380*ln(4) | Answer: 151.2 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 0.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.23 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 0.8, D = 0.23 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*0.8*0.23 / 0.001 | Answer: 184000

question: Water flows at 3.3 m/s through a pipe of diameter 160 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 16.7 m. Taking Cv = 0.98, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 16.7, cv = 0.98 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.98*sqrt(2*9.81*16.7) | Answer: 17.74 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 200 mm) water flows at 0.9 m/s. It contracts to diameter 120 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 200, d2 = 120, V1 = 0.9 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 0.9*(200/120)^2 | Answer: 2.5 m/s

question: Water flows at 3.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.3 m and length 250 m. With friction factor f = 0.037, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 36 teeth drives a gear of 92 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1050 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 36, z2 = 92, N1 = 1050 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1050*36 / 92 | Answer: 410.9 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 530 mm rotates at 1150 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 530, N = 1150 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.53)*1150 / 60 | Answer: 31.91 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 47.5 kW at 550 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 47.5, N = 550 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(47.5*1000) / (2*pi*550) | Answer: 824.7 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 9.5 kg rotates at radius 0.41 m at 450 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 8200 N/m and mass 3.1 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 8200, m = 3.1 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(8200/3.1) | Answer: 8.186 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 5.3 m^2 and thickness 0.2 m has conductivity k = 2 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 160 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 5.3, L = 0.2, k = 2, dT = 160 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 2*5.3*160 / 0.2 | Answer: 8480 W

question: A surface of area 2 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 125 W/m^2-K to surroundings 50 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 2, h = 125, dT = 50 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 125*2*50 | Answer: 12500 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 80 m/min, feed = 0.39 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.9 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 80, f = 0.39, d = 2.9 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*80*0.39*2.9 | Answer: 90480 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 450 mm is turned at 950 rpm with a feed of 0.13 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 450, N = 950, f = 0.13 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 450 / (0.13*950) | Answer: 3.644 min

question: A resistor of 50 ohm carries a current of 4.3 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 50, I = 4.3 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 4.3 * 50 | Answer: 215 V

question: Three resistors 15 ohm, 91 ohm and 55 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 15, R2 = 91, R3 = 55 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 15 + 91 + 55 | Answer: 161 ohm

question: Two resistors 81 ohm and 85 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 81, R2 = 85 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 81*85 / (81+85) | Answer: 41.48 ohm

question: A device draws 12.9 A at 40 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 40, I = 12.9 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 40 * 12.9 | Answer: 516 W

question: A current of 4.6 A flows through a 108 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 4.6, R = 108 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (4.6)^2 * 108 | Answer: 2285 W

question: Two capacitors 1.4 uF and 3.6 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 1.4, C2 = 3.6 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 1.4*3.6 / (1.4+3.6) | Answer: 1.008 uF

question: A resistor 28 kohm and capacitor 16.2 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 28, C = 16.2 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (28k)(16.2u) = 453.6 ms | Answer: 453.6 ms

question: An inductor 498.6 mH is in series with 131 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 498.6, R = 131 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (498.6e-3) / 131 | Answer: 3.806 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 152.2 mH inductor at 400 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 152.2, f = 400 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (400)(152.2e-3) | Answer: 382.5 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 1.2 uF capacitor at 780 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 1.2, f = 780 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (780)(1.2e-6)) | Answer: 170 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 49 ohm, XL = 68 ohm and XC = 150 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 49, XL = 68, XC = 150 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(49^2 + (68 - 150)^2) | Answer: 95.52 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 87.5 mH and C = 6.5 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 87.5, C = 6.5 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(87.5e-3 * 6.5e-6)) | Answer: 211 Hz

question: A capacitor of 71.6 uF is charged to 15 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 71.6, V = 15 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*71.6e-6*(15)^2 | Answer: 8.055 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 400 V with 460 primary turns and 390 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 400, N1 = 460, N2 = 390 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 400 * 390/460 | Answer: 339.1 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 370 V and draws an armature current of 57 A. If the armature resistance is 0.57 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 370, Ia = 57, Ra = 0.57 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 370 - 57*0.57 | Answer: 337.5 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 15 A at 400 V (line) with a power factor of 0.8. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 15, VL = 400, pf = 0.8 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*400*15*0.8 / 1000 | Answer: 8.314 kW

question: A load has real power 100 kW and apparent power 120 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 100, S = 120 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 100 / 120 | Answer: 0.8333

question: A machine delivers 60 kW output while drawing 197 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 60, Pi = 197 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 60/197 * 100 | Answer: 30.46 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 13 V across R1 = 39 ohm and R2 = 9 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 13, R1 = 39, R2 = 9 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 13*9 / (39+9) | Answer: 2.438 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 70 kohm and Rin = 10 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 70, Rin = 10 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 70 / 10 | Answer: 7

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 180 kohm and Rg = 11 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 180, Rg = 11 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 180/11 | Answer: 17.36

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 7917. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 7917 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(7917) | Answer: 38.99 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.6 m carries a central point load of 80 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 7.6, W = 80 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 80*7.6 / 4 | Answer: 152 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.4 m carries a UDL of 50 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.4, w = 50 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 50*(4.4)^2 / 8 | Answer: 121 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 4.3 m carries a point load 30 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.3, W = 30 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 30*4.3 | Answer: 129 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.5 m carries a UDL of 34 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.5, w = 34 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 34*(5.5)^2 / 2 | Answer: 514.2 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.3 m carries a point load 55 kN at distance 4 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 5.3, a = 4, W = 55 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 55*(5.3 - 4) / 5.3 | Answer: 13.49 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 5.9 m) carries a central point load 80 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 470e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=80000 N, L=5900.0 mm, E=200000 MPa, I=470e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 3.641 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 300 mm, clear cover 50 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 300, c = 50, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 300 - 50 - 12/2 | Answer: 244 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 35.1 m^2 carrying a factored load of 18.1 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 35.1, w = 18.1 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 18.1 * 35.1 | Answer: 635.3 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 4.2 m, unit weight 20 kN/m^3, phi = 29 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 1.1e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.6, area = 1.3e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 1.1, i = 0.6, A = 1.3 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (1.1e-4)*0.6*(1.3e-3) | Answer: 85.8 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.7 m, bed slope 0.005 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.014. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.2 m under a head of 0.6 m. Taking Cd = 0.62 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.

question: A rectangular channel 5.5 m wide carries a discharge of 8 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 230 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.13 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 6 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 230, k = 0.13, t = 6 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 230*(1 - e^(-0.13*6)) | Answer: 124.6 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.32, rainfall intensity 40 mm/h over a catchment of 43.1 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.32, i = 40, A = 43.1 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.32*40*43.1 / 360 | Answer: 1.532 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

solution: XOR: 11111000 | Count of 1s = 5 | Answer: 5

question: A file of 280 megabits is sent over a link of 58 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 280, B = 58 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 280 / 58 | Answer: 4.828 s

question: A link has bandwidth 21 Mbps and round-trip time 10 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 21, R = 10 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 21e6 * 10e-3 bits = 210 kb | Answer: 210 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.81, cache access time 5 ns and main-memory access time 90 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.81, tc = 5, tm = 90 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.81*5 + (1 - 0.81)*90 | Answer: 21.15 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 728119 elements?
solution: Given: n = 728119 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(728119)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.011, memory access time 110 ns and page-fault service time 6 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 6 ms = 6000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.011)*110 + 0.011*6000000.0 ns | Answer: 66.11 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 0.3 m^3 at 370 kPa and 320 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 0.3, P = 370, Tk = 320 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (370e3)*0.3 / (8.314*320) | Answer: 41.72 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.32 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 6 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.32, t = 6 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.32*6) | Answer: 0.8534

question: For a reaction with A = 2e10 /s and activation energy 60 kJ/mol at 420 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 2, Ea = 60, Tk = 420 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 2e10 * exp(-60e3 / (8.314*420)) | Answer: 689.7 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.91 and bottoms xW = 0.05, with relative volatility alpha = 2.2. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.91, xw = 0.05, al = 2.2 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.91/0.09)(0.95/0.05)] / ln(2.2) | Answer: 6.669 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.57 and x = 0.41. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.57, x = 0.41 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.57/0.43) / (0.41/0.59) | Answer: 1.908

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.31 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 20 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.31, Psat = 20 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.31 * 20 | Answer: 6.2 kPa

question: A stream of 2.7 kg/s with specific heat 3.6 kJ/kg-K is heated through 65 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 2.7, cp = 3.6, dT = 65 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 2.7*3.6*65 | Answer: 631.8 kW

question: A reactor of volume 18.1 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 3.5 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 18.1, Q = 3.5 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 18.1 / 3.5 | Answer: 5.171 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 7.1e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 5 mm with a concentration difference of 30 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 7.1, L = 5, dC = 30 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (7.1e-9)*30 / (5e-3) | Answer: 42.6 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 5.9 min and steady-state gain 3.8. For a step input of magnitude 7, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 5.9, K = 3.8, M = 7 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 3.8 * 7 | Answer: 26.6 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 85 m^2 flies at 80 m/s (air density 1.225 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 85, V = 80, rho = 1.225, CL = 1 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1.225*(80)^2*85*1 / 1000 | Answer: 333.2 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 90 m^2 flies at 230 m/s (density 1 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.03. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 90, V = 230, rho = 1, CD = 0.03 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*1*(230)^2*90*0.03 / 1000 | Answer: 71.42 kN

question: A block of mass 27 kg has a volume of 0.9e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 27, V = 0.9 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 27 / (0.9e-3) | Answer: 30000 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 700 mm is heated through 75 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 12e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 700, dT = 75, al = 12 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 700*12e-6*75 | Answer: 0.63 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 45 ohm, R2 = 180 ohm and R3 = 230 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 45, R2 = 180, R3 = 230 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 180*230 / 45 | Answer: 920 ohm

question: A measurement reads 10.12 when the true value is 10. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 10.12, true = 10 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |10.12 - 10| / 10 * 100 | Answer: 1.2 %

question: Annual demand is 20000 units, ordering cost 290 per order and holding cost 8 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 20000, S = 290, H = 8 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*20000*290 / 8) | Answer: 1204 units

question: An asset costs 180000 with salvage value 22000 after 13 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 180000, Sv = 22000, n = 13 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (180000 - 22000) / 13 | Answer: 12154 per year

question: A product sells for 310 per unit with variable cost 60 per unit and fixed costs 30000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 310, V = 60, F = 30000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 30000 / (310 - 60) | Answer: 120 units

question: Find the present worth of 90000 received 6 years from now at an interest rate of 6% per year.

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.92, 0.9 and 0.91 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.92, r2 = 0.9, r3 = 0.91 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.92*0.9*0.91 | Answer: 0.7535

question: A process produces 3 defective items in a batch of 15000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 3, N = 15000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 3/15000 * 1e6 | Answer: 200 PPM

question: Find the larger real root of 3x^2 - 8x + 2 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[9, 9], [-3, -4]].

question: Find the slope of the line through (-4, -8) and (-6, -4).

question: Find the distance between the points (2, -5) and (-1, 9).
solution: Given: x1 = 2, y1 = -5, x2 = -1, y2 = 9 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((-3)^2 + (14)^2) | Answer: 14.32 units

question: Find the 8th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -11 and common difference 6.
solution: Given: a = -11, d = 6, n = 8 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -11 + (8 - 1)*6 | Answer: 31

question: Find the sum of the first 34 terms of an AP with first term 15 and common difference -6.

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 44000 at 13.7% per annum for 8 years.

question: A circular rod of diameter 27 mm carries an axial tensile load of 92 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.

A solid shaft of diameter 34 mm transmits a torque of 1800 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.

question: A shaft of diameter 70 mm and length 1900 mm carries a torque of 1700 N-m. With G = 77 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.

question: A rectangular beam section is 113 mm wide and 100 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 350 mm and wall thickness 20 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.8 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.

question: A Carnot engine operates between 1020 K and 430 K. Find its thermal efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Th = 1020, Tc = 430 | Formula: eta = 1 - Tc/Th | Substitute: eta = (1 - 430/1020) * 100 | Answer: 57.84 %

question: 3.6 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 135 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.6, dT = 135 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 3.6 * 0.718 * 135 | Answer: 348.9 kJ

question: 5.5 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 50 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 5.5, dT = 50 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 5.5 * 1.005 * 50 | Answer: 276.4 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.8 m^3 at 510 K with mass 3.6 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).

question: 2.5 kg of air expands isothermally at 350 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.5, Tk = 350, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 2.5*0.287*350*ln(4) | Answer: 348.1 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.3 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.16 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.3, D = 0.16 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.3*0.16 / 0.001 | Answer: 528000

question: Water flows at 2.7 m/s through a pipe of diameter 90 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.

question: A pinion of 23 teeth drives a gear of 59 teeth. If the pinion runs at 600 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.

question: A pulley of diameter 360 mm rotates at 1200 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 360, N = 1200 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.36)*1200 / 60 | Answer: 22.62 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 33.1 kW at 700 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 14900 N/m and mass 5.9 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.

question: A plane wall of area 4.3 m^2 and thickness 0.32 m has conductivity k = 20.1 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 45 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 4.3, L = 0.32, k = 20.1, dT = 45 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 20.1*4.3*45 / 0.32 | Answer: 12154 W

question: A surface of area 2.6 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 185 W/m^2-K to surroundings 135 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 2.6, h = 185, dT = 135 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 185*2.6*135 | Answer: 64935 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 250 m/min, feed = 0.15 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.4 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 250, f = 0.15, d = 1.4 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*250*0.15*1.4 | Answer: 52500 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 230 mm is turned at 350 rpm with a feed of 0.36 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 230, N = 350, f = 0.36 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 230 / (0.36*350) | Answer: 1.825 min

question: A resistor of 158 ohm carries a current of 6.3 A. Find the voltage across it.

question: Three resistors 79 ohm, 62 ohm and 29 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 79, R2 = 62, R3 = 29 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 79 + 62 + 29 | Answer: 170 ohm

question: Two resistors 18 ohm and 45 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.

question: A device draws 3.9 A at 210 V. Find the power consumed.

question: A current of 0.4 A flows through a 90 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.

question: Two capacitors 21.6 uF and 10.4 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 21.6, C2 = 10.4 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 21.6*10.4 / (21.6+10.4) | Answer: 7.02 uF

question: An inductor 241 mH is in series with 171 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 45.7 mH inductor at 260 Hz.

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 5 uF capacitor at 750 Hz.

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 77 ohm, XL = 10 ohm and XC = 126 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 25.3 mH and C = 9.8 uF (in Hz).

question: A capacitor of 87.8 uF is charged to 90 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 87.8, V = 90 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*87.8e-6*(90)^2 | Answer: 355.6 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 290 V with 610 primary turns and 280 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 290, N1 = 610, N2 = 280 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 290 * 280/610 | Answer: 133.1 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 280 V and draws an armature current of 28 A. If the armature resistance is 0.52 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 280, Ia = 28, Ra = 0.52 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 280 - 28*0.52 | Answer: 265.4 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 35 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.86. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 35, VL = 433, pf = 0.86 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*35*0.86 / 1000 | Answer: 22.57 kW

question: A load has real power 10 kW and apparent power 40 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 10, S = 40 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 10 / 40 | Answer: 0.25

question: A machine delivers 105 kW output while drawing 192 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 105, Pi = 192 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 105/192 * 100 | Answer: 54.69 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 11 V across R1 = 3 ohm and R2 = 26 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 11, R1 = 3, R2 = 26 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 11*26 / (3+26) | Answer: 9.862 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 70 kohm and Rin = 21 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 70, Rin = 21 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 70 / 21 | Answer: 3.333

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 50 kohm and Rg = 45 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 50, Rg = 45 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 50/45 | Answer: 2.111

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 4662. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 4662 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(4662) | Answer: 36.69 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.9 m carries a central point load of 115 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6.9, W = 115 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 115*6.9 / 4 | Answer: 198.4 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.1 m carries a UDL of 55 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.1, w = 55 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 55*(5.1)^2 / 8 | Answer: 178.8 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.4 m carries a point load 5 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.4, W = 5 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 5*2.4 | Answer: 12 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 3 m carries a UDL of 28 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3, w = 28 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 28*(3)^2 / 2 | Answer: 126 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.2 m carries a point load 85 kN at distance 3.8 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 7.2, a = 3.8, W = 85 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 85*(7.2 - 3.8) / 7.2 | Answer: 40.14 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 3.9 m) carries a central point load 45 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 310e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=45000 N, L=3900.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=310e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 7.176 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 6 m carries a UDL of 9 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6, w = 9 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 9*(6)^2 / 12 | Answer: 27 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 680 mm, clear cover 25 mm and main bars of diameter 20 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 680, c = 25, dia = 20 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 680 - 25 - 20/2 | Answer: 645 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 38.4 m^2 carrying a factored load of 11 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 38.4, w = 11 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 11 * 38.4 | Answer: 422.4 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 4.6 m, unit weight 18 kN/m^3, phi = 32 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 7.2e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.6, area = 1e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 7.2, i = 0.6, A = 1 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (7.2e-4)*0.6*(1e-3) | Answer: 432 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 2.4 m, bed slope 0.005 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.017. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 3.3 m under a head of 0.2 m. Taking Cd = 0.61 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.9 m wide carries a discharge of 29.1 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 170 m^3 treats a flow of 145 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 170, Q = 145 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 170 / 145 | Answer: 1.172 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 390 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.13 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 8 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 390, k = 0.13, t = 8 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 390*(1 - e^(-0.13*8)) | Answer: 252.2 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.34, rainfall intensity 30 mm/h over a catchment of 54.6 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.34, i = 30, A = 54.6 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.34*30*54.6 / 360 | Answer: 1.547 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.07 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 510 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.07, M = 510 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 510*(30+0.07)/30 | Answer: 511.2 m

question: Convert the decimal number 3520 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 3520 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: DC0 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10101011 and 10010101.
solution: XOR: 00111110 | Count of 1s = 5 | Answer: 5
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 470 megabits is sent over a link of 36 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 470, B = 36 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 470 / 36 | Answer: 13.06 s

question: A link has bandwidth 37 Mbps and round-trip time 200 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 37, R = 200 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 37e6 * 200e-3 bits = 7400 kb | Answer: 7400 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.93, cache access time 5 ns and main-memory access time 80 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.93, tc = 5, tm = 80 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.93*5 + (1 - 0.93)*80 | Answer: 10.25 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 518911 elements?
solution: Given: n = 518911 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(518911)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.009, memory access time 90 ns and page-fault service time 6 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 6 ms = 6000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.009)*90 + 0.009*6000000.0 ns | Answer: 54.09 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.1 m^3 at 370 kPa and 550 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.1, P = 370, Tk = 550 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (370e3)*2.1 / (8.314*550) | Answer: 169.9 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.37 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 7 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.37, t = 7 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.37*7) | Answer: 0.925

question: For a reaction with A = 8e10 /s and activation energy 85 kJ/mol at 330 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 8, Ea = 85, Tk = 330 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 8e10 * exp(-85e3 / (8.314*330)) | Answer: 0.002807 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.9 and bottoms xW = 0.09, with relative volatility alpha = 2. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.9, xw = 0.09, al = 2 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.9/0.1)(0.91/0.09)] / ln(2) | Answer: 6.508 stages

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.64 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 75 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.64, Psat = 75 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.64 * 75 | Answer: 48 kPa

question: A stream of 5.6 kg/s with specific heat 1.1 kJ/kg-K is heated through 35 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 5.6, cp = 1.1, dT = 35 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 5.6*1.1*35 | Answer: 215.6 kW

question: A reactor of volume 9.4 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 4.7 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 9.4, Q = 4.7 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 9.4 / 4.7 | Answer: 2 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 7.5e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 5 mm with a concentration difference of 20 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 7.5, L = 5, dC = 20 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (7.5e-9)*20 / (5e-3) | Answer: 30 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 6.4 min and steady-state gain 0.9. For a step input of magnitude 3, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 6.4, K = 0.9, M = 3 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 0.9 * 3 | Answer: 2.7 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 100 m^2 flies at 240 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.5. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 100, V = 240, rho = 0.7, CL = 0.5 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.7*(240)^2*100*0.5 / 1000 | Answer: 1008 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 40 m^2 flies at 220 m/s (density 0.7 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.09. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 40, V = 220, rho = 0.7, CD = 0.09 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.7*(220)^2*40*0.09 / 1000 | Answer: 60.98 kN

question: A block of mass 24 kg has a volume of 1.3e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 24, V = 1.3 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 24 / (1.3e-3) | Answer: 18462 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 1600 mm is heated through 100 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 17e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 1600, dT = 100, al = 17 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 1600*17e-6*100 | Answer: 2.72 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 15 ohm, R2 = 80 ohm and R3 = 215 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 15, R2 = 80, R3 = 215 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 80*215 / 15 | Answer: 1147 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.34 when the true value is 50. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.34, true = 50 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.34 - 50| / 50 * 100 | Answer: 81.32 %

question: Annual demand is 2500 units, ordering cost 260 per order and holding cost 13 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 2500, S = 260, H = 13 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*2500*260 / 13) | Answer: 316.2 units

question: An asset costs 400000 with salvage value 12000 after 15 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 400000, Sv = 12000, n = 15 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (400000 - 12000) / 15 | Answer: 25867 per year

question: A product sells for 440 per unit with variable cost 20 per unit and fixed costs 130000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 440, V = 20, F = 130000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 130000 / (440 - 20) | Answer: 309.5 units

question: Find the present worth of 200000 received 8 years from now at an interest rate of 12% per year.
solution: Given: F = 200000, n = 8, i = 12 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 200000 / (1 + 0.12)^8 | Answer: 80777 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.93, 0.95 and 0.95 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.93, r2 = 0.95, r3 = 0.95 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.93*0.95*0.95 | Answer: 0.8393

question: A process produces 41 defective items in a batch of 14500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 41, N = 14500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 41/14500 * 1e6 | Answer: 2828 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = x^3 + 4x^2 + 9x - 6 evaluated at x = 4.
For f(x) = 4x^3 - 4x^2 + 5x - 1, find f''(x) at x = 0.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-3x^2 + 6) dx from x = -3 to x = 7.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -3x^3/3 + 0x^2/2 + 6x | Evaluate F(7) - F(-3) | Answer: -310
