question: A rectangular column (66 mm x 150 mm) has effective length 3000 mm and E = 200 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 380 MPa is designed for a working stress of 190 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 380, sw = 190 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 380 / 190 | Answer: 2

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 750 mm and wall thickness 13 mm carries an internal pressure of 3 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 750, t = 13, P = 3 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 3*750 / (2*13) | Answer: 86.54 MPa

question: 1.1 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 110 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.1, dT = 110 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 1.1 * 0.718 * 110 | Answer: 86.88 kJ

question: 7 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 145 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 7, dT = 145 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 7 * 1.005 * 145 | Answer: 102 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.8 m^3 at 560 K with mass 3.9 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 3.8, Tk = 560, m = 3.9 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 3.9*0.287*560 / 3.8 | Answer: 164.9 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4.1 kg of air expands isothermally at 310 K from volume V1 to 2*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.1, Tk = 310, ratio = 2 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4.1*0.287*310*ln(2) | Answer: 252.8 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.3 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.26 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.3, D = 0.26 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.3*0.26 / 0.001 | Answer: 858000

question: Water flows at 1.1 m/s through a pipe of diameter 110 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 13.3 m. Taking Cv = 0.99, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 13.3, cv = 0.99 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.99*sqrt(2*9.81*13.3) | Answer: 15.99 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 270 mm) water flows at 1.5 m/s. It contracts to diameter 140 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
Water flows at 3.1 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.49 m and length 370 m. With friction factor f = 0.03, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 21 teeth drives a gear of 72 teeth. If the pinion runs at 300 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 21, z2 = 72, N1 = 300 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 300*21 / 72 | Answer: 87.5 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 560 mm rotates at 850 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 560, N = 850 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.56)*850 / 60 | Answer: 24.92 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 12.3 kW at 600 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 12.3, N = 600 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(12.3*1000) / (2*pi*600) | Answer: 195.8 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 6.1 kg rotates at radius 0.13 m at 700 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 10500 N/m and mass 14.1 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 10500, m = 14.1 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(10500/14.1) | Answer: 4.343 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 3.7 m^2 and thickness 0.13 m has conductivity k = 33.3 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 175 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 3.7, L = 0.13, k = 33.3, dT = 175 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 33.3*3.7*175 / 0.13 | Answer: 16586 W

question: A surface of area 4.6 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 45 W/m^2-K to surroundings 25 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 4.6, h = 45, dT = 25 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 45*4.6*25 | Answer: 5175 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 160 m/min, feed = 0.12 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.5 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 160, f = 0.12, d = 2.5 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*160*0.12*2.5 | Answer: 48000 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 390 mm is turned at 700 rpm with a feed of 0.2 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 390, N = 700, f = 0.2 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 390 / (0.2*700) | Answer: 2.786 min

question: A resistor of 130 ohm carries a current of 0.3 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 130, I = 0.3 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 0.3 * 130 | Answer: 39 V

question: Three resistors 48 ohm, 45 ohm and 41 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 48, R2 = 45, R3 = 41 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 48 + 45 + 41 | Answer: 134 ohm

question: Two resistors 77 ohm and 89 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 77, R2 = 89 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 77*89 / (77+89) | Answer: 41.28 ohm

question: A device draws 14.8 A at 165 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 165, I = 14.8 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 165 * 14.8 | Answer: 2442 W

question: A current of 4.3 A flows through a 8 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 4.3, R = 8 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (4.3)^2 * 8 | Answer: 147.9 W

question: Two capacitors 47.2 uF and 35.2 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 47.2, C2 = 35.2 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 47.2*35.2 / (47.2+35.2) | Answer: 20.16 uF

question: A resistor 33 kohm and capacitor 8.2 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 33, C = 8.2 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (33k)(8.2u) = 270.6 ms | Answer: 270.6 ms

question: An inductor 313.5 mH is in series with 41 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 313.5, R = 41 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (313.5e-3) / 41 | Answer: 7.646 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 181.2 mH inductor at 900 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 181.2, f = 900 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (900)(181.2e-3) | Answer: 1025 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 49.7 uF capacitor at 190 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 49.7, f = 190 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (190)(49.7e-6)) | Answer: 16.85 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 40 ohm, XL = 43 ohm and XC = 74 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 40, XL = 43, XC = 74 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(40^2 + (43 - 74)^2) | Answer: 50.61 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 45.8 mH and C = 1 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 45.8, C = 1 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(45.8e-3 * 1e-6)) | Answer: 743.7 Hz

question: A capacitor of 20.6 uF is charged to 50 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 20.6, V = 50 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*20.6e-6*(50)^2 | Answer: 25.75 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 240 V with 560 primary turns and 80 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 240, N1 = 560, N2 = 80 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 240 * 80/560 | Answer: 34.29 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 170 V and draws an armature current of 28 A. If the armature resistance is 1.28 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 170, Ia = 28, Ra = 1.28 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 170 - 28*1.28 | Answer: 134.2 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 160 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.95. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 160, VL = 415, pf = 0.95 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*160*0.95 / 1000 | Answer: 109.3 kW

question: A load has real power 55 kW and apparent power 125 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 55, S = 125 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 55 / 125 | Answer: 0.44

question: A machine delivers 25 kW output while drawing 147 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 25, Pi = 147 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 25/147 * 100 | Answer: 17.01 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 28 V across R1 = 11 ohm and R2 = 28 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 28, R1 = 11, R2 = 28 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 28*28 / (11+28) | Answer: 20.1 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 180 kohm and Rin = 43 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 180, Rin = 43 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 180 / 43 | Answer: 4.186

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 5928. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 5928 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(5928) | Answer: 37.73 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 7 m carries a central point load of 100 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 7, W = 100 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 100*7 / 4 | Answer: 175 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 8.6 m carries a UDL of 40 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.6, w = 40 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 40*(8.6)^2 / 8 | Answer: 369.8 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 4.4 m carries a UDL of 10 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.4, w = 10 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 10*(4.4)^2 / 2 | Answer: 96.8 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.8 m carries a point load 55 kN at distance 2.7 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 4.8, a = 2.7, W = 55 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 55*(4.8 - 2.7) / 4.8 | Answer: 24.06 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 5.6 m) carries a central point load 35 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 100e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=35000 N, L=5600.0 mm, E=200000 MPa, I=100e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 6.403 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 7 m carries a UDL of 21 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 7, w = 21 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 21*(7)^2 / 12 | Answer: 85.75 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 490 mm, clear cover 50 mm and main bars of diameter 25 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 490, c = 50, dia = 25 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 490 - 50 - 25/2 | Answer: 427.5 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 12.7 m^2 carrying a factored load of 19.5 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 12.7, w = 19.5 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 19.5 * 12.7 | Answer: 247.6 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 5.9 m, unit weight 18 kN/m^3, phi = 32 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 8.5e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.6, area = 6.7e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 8.5, i = 0.6, A = 6.7 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (8.5e-4)*0.6*(6.7e-3) | Answer: 3417 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1 m, bed slope 0.008 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.02. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4.8 m under a head of 1 m. Taking Cd = 0.6 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
solution: Given: L = 4.8, H = 1, cd = 0.6 | Formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2) | Substitute: Q = (2/3)*0.6*sqrt(2*9.81)*4.8*(1)^1.5 | Answer: 8.505 m^3/s
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 3.9 m wide carries a discharge of 20.7 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 530 m^3 treats a flow of 20 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 530, Q = 20 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 530 / 20 | Answer: 26.5 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 350 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.18 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 7 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 350, k = 0.18, t = 7 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 350*(1 - e^(-0.18*7)) | Answer: 250.7 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.85, rainfall intensity 75 mm/h over a catchment of 35.7 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.85, i = 75, A = 35.7 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.85*75*35.7 / 360 | Answer: 6.322 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.07 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 290 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.07, M = 290 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 290*(20+0.07)/20 | Answer: 291 m

question: Convert the decimal number 976 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 976 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 3D0 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10001111 and 00101010.
solution: XOR: 10100101 | Count of 1s = 4 | Answer: 4
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 570 megabits is sent over a link of 75 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 570, B = 75 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 570 / 75 | Answer: 7.6 s

question: A link has bandwidth 2 Mbps and round-trip time 110 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 2, R = 110 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 2e6 * 110e-3 bits = 220 kb | Answer: 220 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.85, cache access time 8 ns and main-memory access time 140 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.85, tc = 8, tm = 140 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.85*8 + (1 - 0.85)*140 | Answer: 27.8 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 417534 elements?
solution: Given: n = 417534 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(417534)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.01, memory access time 100 ns and page-fault service time 9 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 9 ms = 9000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.01)*100 + 0.01*9000000.0 ns | Answer: 90.1 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 1.9 m^3 at 150 kPa and 330 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 1.9, P = 150, Tk = 330 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (150e3)*1.9 / (8.314*330) | Answer: 103.9 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.14 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 18 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.14, t = 18 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.14*18) | Answer: 0.9195

question: For a reaction with A = 9e10 /s and activation energy 60 kJ/mol at 350 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 9, Ea = 60, Tk = 350 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 9e10 * exp(-60e3 / (8.314*350)) | Answer: 99.86 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.93 and bottoms xW = 0.08, with relative volatility alpha = 1.9. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.93, xw = 0.08, al = 1.9 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.93/0.07)(0.92/0.08)] / ln(1.9) | Answer: 7.835 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.62 and x = 0.4. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.62, x = 0.4 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.62/0.38) / (0.4/0.6) | Answer: 2.447

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.57 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 80 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.57, Psat = 80 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.57 * 80 | Answer: 45.6 kPa

question: A stream of 7.4 kg/s with specific heat 1.6 kJ/kg-K is heated through 120 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 7.4, cp = 1.6, dT = 120 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 7.4*1.6*120 | Answer: 1421 kW

question: A reactor of volume 14.4 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 3.2 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 14.4, Q = 3.2 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 14.4 / 3.2 | Answer: 4.5 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 6.9e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 4 mm with a concentration difference of 40 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 6.9, L = 4, dC = 40 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (6.9e-9)*40 / (4e-3) | Answer: 69 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 3.2 min and steady-state gain 3. For a step input of magnitude 8, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 3.2, K = 3, M = 8 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 3 * 8 | Answer: 24 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 50 m^2 flies at 60 m/s (air density 0.4 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.3. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 50, V = 60, rho = 0.4, CL = 1.3 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.4*(60)^2*50*1.3 / 1000 | Answer: 46.8 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 110 m^2 flies at 150 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.06. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 110, V = 150, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.06 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(150)^2*110*0.06 / 1000 | Answer: 29.7 kN

question: A specimen under stress 260 MPa shows an elastic strain of 1.4e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 260, eps = 1.4 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 260 / (1.4e-3) MPa = 185.7 GPa | Answer: 185.7 GPa

question: A block of mass 8 kg has a volume of 4.5e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 8, V = 4.5 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 8 / (4.5e-3) | Answer: 1778 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 900 mm is heated through 115 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 11e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 900, dT = 115, al = 11 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 900*11e-6*115 | Answer: 1.138 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 85 ohm, R2 = 140 ohm and R3 = 65 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 85, R2 = 140, R3 = 65 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 140*65 / 85 | Answer: 107.1 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.22 when the true value is 20. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.22, true = 20 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.22 - 20| / 20 * 100 | Answer: 53.9 %

question: Annual demand is 42500 units, ordering cost 90 per order and holding cost 19 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 42500, S = 90, H = 19 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*42500*90 / 19) | Answer: 634.5 units

question: An asset costs 400000 with salvage value 26000 after 12 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 400000, Sv = 26000, n = 12 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (400000 - 26000) / 12 | Answer: 31167 per year

question: A product sells for 430 per unit with variable cost 120 per unit and fixed costs 160000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 430, V = 120, F = 160000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 160000 / (430 - 120) | Answer: 516.1 units

question: Find the present worth of 145000 received 3 years from now at an interest rate of 7% per year.
solution: Given: F = 145000, n = 3, i = 7 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 145000 / (1 + 0.07)^3 | Answer: 118363 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.93, 0.99 and 0.93 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.93, r2 = 0.99, r3 = 0.93 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.93*0.99*0.93 | Answer: 0.8563

question: A process produces 41 defective items in a batch of 13000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 41, N = 13000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 41/13000 * 1e6 | Answer: 3154 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = -5x^3 - 3x^2 + 7x + 8 evaluated at x = -5.
For f(x) = 5x^3 - 4x^2 + 7x + 2, find f''(x) at x = -5.
Evaluate the definite integral of (5x^2 - x + 5) dx from x = 2 to x = 7.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 5x^3/3 + -1x^2/2 + 5x | Evaluate F(7) - F(2) | Answer: 560.8
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 2x^2 - 6x - 10 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[0, -5], [6, 7]].
solution: Given: a = 0, b = -5, c = 6, d = 7 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (0)(7) - (-5)(6) | Answer: 30

question: Find the determinant of [[-4, 1, 3], [5, 4, 0], [6, 5, -4]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 87

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[-5, 8], [3, 6]].
solution: Trace tr = 1, Determinant = -54 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 7.865

question: Solve for x: -5x + 2y = -11 and -3x + 6y = -9.
solution: Determinant = -5*6 - 2*-3 = -24 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 2 | Answer: x = 2
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 44, 16, 42, 59, 49.
solution: Sum = 210 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 42 | Answer: 42

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 15, 19, 16, 20, 26.
solution: Mean = 19.2 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 4.324

question: Find the slope of the line through (-9, -6) and (7, 2).
solution: Given: x1 = -9, y1 = -6, x2 = 7, y2 = 2 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (2 - -6) / (7 - -9) | Answer: 0.5

question: Find the distance between the points (7, 6) and (7, -5).
solution: Given: x1 = 7, y1 = 6, x2 = 7, y2 = -5 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((0)^2 + (-11)^2) | Answer: 11 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-3,-2), (4,-2), (-6,3).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 17.5 sq units

question: Find the 37th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -8 and common difference 0.
solution: Given: a = -8, d = 0, n = 37 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -8 + (37 - 1)*0 | Answer: -8

question: Find the sum of the first 23 terms of an AP with first term 11 and common difference 7.
solution: Given: a = 11, d = 7, n = 23 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 23/2 [2*11 + (23-1)*7] | Answer: 2024

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 4000 at 11.3% per annum for 2 years.
solution: Given: P = 4000, R = 11.3, Tt = 2 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 4000 * 11.3 * 2 / 100 | Answer: 904 currency units

question: Find the amount when 6500 is invested at 6.1% per annum compounded annually for 6 years.
solution: Given: P = 6500, R = 6.1, Tt = 6 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 6500 * (1 + 6.1/100)^6 | Answer: 9273 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (-1, -8, -2) and (-5, 7, -2).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (1, -3, -3) and (-2, -6, 6).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 37.95

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (0, 4, 5) and (3, 0, 5).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 47.96 degrees

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number 7 + -5i.
solution: Given: a = 7, b = -5 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(-5, 7) | Answer: -35.54 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = 5x^3 - x^2 + x + 5 at x = -2.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-102 with initial guess x0=6, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=0.5 and ordinates 14, 20, 12, 17, 20, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 45 and 447.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 45 and 447 | Answer: GCD = 3

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 30 and 52.
solution: Given: a = 30, b = 52 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 30*52 / 2 | Answer: 780
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 18 mm carries an axial tensile load of 76 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 21 mm and length 1100 mm carries an axial load of 79 kN. Take E = 200 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 22 mm transmits a torque of 1750 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 22, Tt = 1750 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(1750*1000) / (pi*(22)^3) | Answer: 837 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 54 mm and length 1600 mm carries a torque of 1500 N-m. With G = 45 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (54)^4 / 32 = 834786 mm^4 | theta = (1500*1000)(1600) / (45000 * 834786) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 3.661 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 45 mm wide and 290 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 45, h = 290 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 45*(290)^2 / 6 | Answer: 630750 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (61 mm x 120 mm) carries a bending moment of 17 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (50 mm x 140 mm) has effective length 3800 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 490 MPa is designed for a working stress of 210 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 490, sw = 210 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 490 / 210 | Answer: 2.333

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 450 mm and wall thickness 10 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.5 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 450, t = 10, P = 1.5 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.5*450 / (2*10) | Answer: 33.75 MPa

question: 3.4 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 145 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.4, dT = 145 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 3.4 * 0.718 * 145 | Answer: 354 kJ

question: 6.3 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 155 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.3, dT = 155 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 6.3 * 1.005 * 155 | Answer: 981.4 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.3 m^3 at 480 K with mass 1.6 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 3.3, Tk = 480, m = 1.6 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 1.6*0.287*480 / 3.3 | Answer: 66.79 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4.2 kg of air expands isothermally at 430 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.2, Tk = 430, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4.2*0.287*430*ln(4) | Answer: 718.5 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 2.6 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.31 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 2.6, D = 0.31 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*2.6*0.31 / 0.001 | Answer: 806000

question: Water flows at 0.9 m/s through a pipe of diameter 300 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 11.1 m. Taking Cv = 0.99, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 11.1, cv = 0.99 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.99*sqrt(2*9.81*11.1) | Answer: 14.61 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 230 mm) water flows at 1.7 m/s. It contracts to diameter 100 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
Water flows at 2.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.18 m and length 470 m. With friction factor f = 0.031, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 30 teeth drives a gear of 66 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1450 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 30, z2 = 66, N1 = 1450 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1450*30 / 66 | Answer: 659.1 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 350 mm rotates at 1350 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 350, N = 1350 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.35)*1350 / 60 | Answer: 24.74 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 4.1 kW at 1250 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 4.1, N = 1250 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(4.1*1000) / (2*pi*1250) | Answer: 31.32 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 7.6 kg rotates at radius 0.11 m at 250 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 8700 N/m and mass 5.6 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 8700, m = 5.6 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(8700/5.6) | Answer: 6.273 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 8.9 m^2 and thickness 0.26 m has conductivity k = 19 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 45 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 8.9, L = 0.26, k = 19, dT = 45 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 19*8.9*45 / 0.26 | Answer: 29267 W

question: A surface of area 4.5 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 80 W/m^2-K to surroundings 45 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 4.5, h = 80, dT = 45 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 80*4.5*45 | Answer: 16200 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 70 m/min, feed = 0.26 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.9 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 70, f = 0.26, d = 1.9 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*70*0.26*1.9 | Answer: 34580 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 500 mm is turned at 300 rpm with a feed of 0.1 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 500, N = 300, f = 0.1 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 500 / (0.1*300) | Answer: 16.67 min

question: A resistor of 179 ohm carries a current of 2.1 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 179, I = 2.1 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 2.1 * 179 | Answer: 375.9 V

question: Three resistors 66 ohm, 51 ohm and 14 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 66, R2 = 51, R3 = 14 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 66 + 51 + 14 | Answer: 131 ohm

question: Two resistors 41 ohm and 66 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 41, R2 = 66 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 41*66 / (41+66) | Answer: 25.29 ohm

question: A device draws 7.9 A at 5 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 5, I = 7.9 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 5 * 7.9 | Answer: 39.5 W

question: A current of 7.1 A flows through a 144 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 7.1, R = 144 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (7.1)^2 * 144 | Answer: 7259 W

question: Two capacitors 17.8 uF and 1.8 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 17.8, C2 = 1.8 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 17.8*1.8 / (17.8+1.8) | Answer: 1.635 uF

question: A resistor 41 kohm and capacitor 14.4 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 41, C = 14.4 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (41k)(14.4u) = 590.4 ms | Answer: 590.4 ms

question: An inductor 320 mH is in series with 179 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 320, R = 179 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (320e-3) / 179 | Answer: 1.788 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 195 mH inductor at 170 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 195, f = 170 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (170)(195e-3) | Answer: 208.3 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 27.9 uF capacitor at 190 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 27.9, f = 190 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (190)(27.9e-6)) | Answer: 30.02 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 21 ohm, XL = 91 ohm and XC = 141 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 21, XL = 91, XC = 141 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(21^2 + (91 - 141)^2) | Answer: 54.23 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 99.1 mH and C = 3.4 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 99.1, C = 3.4 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(99.1e-3 * 3.4e-6)) | Answer: 274.2 Hz

question: A capacitor of 68.1 uF is charged to 130 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 68.1, V = 130 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*68.1e-6*(130)^2 | Answer: 575.4 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 330 V with 930 primary turns and 450 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 330, N1 = 930, N2 = 450 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 330 * 450/930 | Answer: 159.7 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 200 V and draws an armature current of 21 A. If the armature resistance is 0.14 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 200, Ia = 21, Ra = 0.14 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 200 - 21*0.14 | Answer: 197.1 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 170 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.76. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 170, VL = 415, pf = 0.76 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*170*0.76 / 1000 | Answer: 92.87 kW

question: A machine delivers 95 kW output while drawing 202 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 95, Pi = 202 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 95/202 * 100 | Answer: 47.03 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 6 V across R1 = 28 ohm and R2 = 47 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 6, R1 = 28, R2 = 47 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 6*47 / (28+47) | Answer: 3.76 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 80 kohm and Rin = 19 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 80, Rin = 19 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 80 / 19 | Answer: 4.211

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 120 kohm and Rg = 36 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 120, Rg = 36 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 120/36 | Answer: 4.333

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 5762. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 5762 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(5762) | Answer: 37.61 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.6 m carries a central point load of 50 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 7.6, W = 50 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 50*7.6 / 4 | Answer: 95 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.4 m carries a point load 55 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.4, W = 55 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 55*5.4 | Answer: 297 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 3.5 m carries a UDL of 16 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.5, w = 16 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 16*(3.5)^2 / 2 | Answer: 98 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.7 m carries a point load 25 kN at distance 1.9 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 4.7, a = 1.9, W = 25 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 25*(4.7 - 1.9) / 4.7 | Answer: 14.89 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 8 m) carries a central point load 35 kN. With E = 30 GPa and I = 510e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=35000 N, L=8000.0 mm, E=30000 MPa, I=510e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 24.4 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 550 mm, clear cover 50 mm and main bars of diameter 20 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 550, c = 50, dia = 20 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 550 - 50 - 20/2 | Answer: 490 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 19.5 m^2 carrying a factored load of 17 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 19.5, w = 17 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 17 * 19.5 | Answer: 331.5 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 6.2 m, unit weight 17 kN/m^3, phi = 35 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 5.2e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.5, area = 3.2e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 5.2, i = 0.5, A = 3.2 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (5.2e-4)*0.5*(3.2e-3) | Answer: 832 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1.4 m, bed slope 0.004 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.027. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 2.5 m under a head of 0.8 m. Taking Cd = 0.64 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 5.8 m wide carries a discharge of 16.1 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 830 m^3 treats a flow of 140 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 830, Q = 140 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 830 / 140 | Answer: 5.929 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 150 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.32 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 7 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 150, k = 0.32, t = 7 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 150*(1 - e^(-0.32*7)) | Answer: 134 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.51, rainfall intensity 45 mm/h over a catchment of 39.1 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.51, i = 45, A = 39.1 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.51*45*39.1 / 360 | Answer: 2.493 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.03 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 790 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.03, M = 790 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 790*(20+0.03)/20 | Answer: 791.2 m

question: Convert the decimal number 3399 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 3399 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: D47 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 00001000 and 00001111.
solution: XOR: 00000111 | Count of 1s = 3 | Answer: 3
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 510 megabits is sent over a link of 63 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 510, B = 63 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 510 / 63 | Answer: 8.095 s

question: A link has bandwidth 30 Mbps and round-trip time 180 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 30, R = 180 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 30e6 * 180e-3 bits = 5400 kb | Answer: 5400 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.94, cache access time 1 ns and main-memory access time 50 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.94, tc = 1, tm = 50 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.94*1 + (1 - 0.94)*50 | Answer: 3.94 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 631375 elements?
solution: Given: n = 631375 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(631375)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.006, memory access time 110 ns and page-fault service time 8 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 8 ms = 8000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.006)*110 + 0.006*8000000.0 ns | Answer: 48.11 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.4 m^3 at 130 kPa and 340 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.4, P = 130, Tk = 340 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (130e3)*2.4 / (8.314*340) | Answer: 110.4 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 6e10 /s and activation energy 80 kJ/mol at 350 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 6, Ea = 80, Tk = 350 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 6e10 * exp(-80e3 / (8.314*350)) | Answer: 0.06892 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.95 and bottoms xW = 0.1, with relative volatility alpha = 1.7. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.95, xw = 0.1, al = 1.7 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.95/0.05)(0.9/0.1)] / ln(1.7) | Answer: 9.69 stages

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.16 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 100 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.16, Psat = 100 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.16 * 100 | Answer: 16 kPa

question: A stream of 3.4 kg/s with specific heat 4.1 kJ/kg-K is heated through 105 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 3.4, cp = 4.1, dT = 105 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 3.4*4.1*105 | Answer: 1464 kW

question: A reactor of volume 8.1 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 0.8 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 8.1, Q = 0.8 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 8.1 / 0.8 | Answer: 10.12 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 2.8e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 3 mm with a concentration difference of 20 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 2.8, L = 3, dC = 20 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (2.8e-9)*20 / (3e-3) | Answer: 18.67 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 6.6 min and steady-state gain 2.1. For a step input of magnitude 16, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 6.6, K = 2.1, M = 16 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 2.1 * 16 | Answer: 33.6 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 95 m^2 flies at 140 m/s (air density 1 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.1. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 95, V = 140, rho = 1, CL = 1.1 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1*(140)^2*95*1.1 / 1000 | Answer: 1024 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 90 m^2 flies at 210 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.09. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 90, V = 210, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.09 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(210)^2*90*0.09 / 1000 | Answer: 71.44 kN

question: A block of mass 24 kg has a volume of 1.1e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 24, V = 1.1 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 24 / (1.1e-3) | Answer: 21818 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 1100 mm is heated through 130 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 17e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 1100, dT = 130, al = 17 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 1100*17e-6*130 | Answer: 2.431 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 130 ohm, R2 = 65 ohm and R3 = 95 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 130, R2 = 65, R3 = 95 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 65*95 / 130 | Answer: 47.5 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.73 when the true value is 50. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.73, true = 50 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.73 - 50| / 50 * 100 | Answer: 80.54 %

question: Annual demand is 36000 units, ordering cost 270 per order and holding cost 17 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 36000, S = 270, H = 17 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*36000*270 / 17) | Answer: 1069 units

question: An asset costs 120000 with salvage value 34000 after 15 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 120000, Sv = 34000, n = 15 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (120000 - 34000) / 15 | Answer: 5733 per year

question: A product sells for 200 per unit with variable cost 130 per unit and fixed costs 75000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 200, V = 130, F = 75000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 75000 / (200 - 130) | Answer: 1071 units

question: Find the present worth of 50000 received 9 years from now at an interest rate of 10% per year.
solution: Given: F = 50000, n = 9, i = 10 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 50000 / (1 + 0.1)^9 | Answer: 21205 currency units

question: A process produces 46 defective items in a batch of 11000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 46, N = 11000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 46/11000 * 1e6 | Answer: 4182 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = -2x^3 - 4x^2 + 7x + 3 evaluated at x = 4.
For f(x) = -x^3 - 4x^2 + 3, find f''(x) at x = 1.
Evaluate the definite integral of (2x^2 - 5) dx from x = -3 to x = 5.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 2x^3/3 + 0x^2/2 + -5x | Evaluate F(5) - F(-3) | Answer: 61.33
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 4x^2 + 9x + 1 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[0, 5], [-8, 7]].
solution: Given: a = 0, b = 5, c = -8, d = 7 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (0)(7) - (5)(-8) | Answer: 40

question: Find the determinant of [[2, 0, 3], [3, -1, 5], [0, -1, 4]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -7

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[-2, 5], [8, 5]].
solution: Trace tr = 3, Determinant = -50 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 8.728

question: Solve for x: 0x + 2y = -3 and -4x + 6y = 2.
solution: Determinant = 0*6 - 2*-4 = 8 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -2.75 | Answer: x = -2.75
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 23, 81, 16, 77, 51.
solution: Sum = 248 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 49.6 | Answer: 49.6

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 24, 32, 5, 32, 48.
solution: Mean = 28.2 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 15.63

question: Find the slope of the line through (-2, 5) and (1, 0).
solution: Given: x1 = -2, y1 = 5, x2 = 1, y2 = 0 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (0 - 5) / (1 - -2) | Answer: -1.667

question: Find the distance between the points (-9, -6) and (-4, -8).
solution: Given: x1 = -9, y1 = -6, x2 = -4, y2 = -8 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((5)^2 + (-2)^2) | Answer: 5.385 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (7,2), (-6,-6), (2,-2).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 6 sq units

question: Find the 21th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 3 and common difference 3.
solution: Given: a = 3, d = 3, n = 21 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 3 + (21 - 1)*3 | Answer: 63

question: Find the sum of the first 16 terms of an AP with first term -3 and common difference 8.
solution: Given: a = -3, d = 8, n = 16 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 16/2 [2*-3 + (16-1)*8] | Answer: 912

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 41000 at 13.1% per annum for 1 years.
solution: Given: P = 41000, R = 13.1, Tt = 1 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 41000 * 13.1 * 1 / 100 | Answer: 5371 currency units

question: Find the amount when 27000 is invested at 11.8% per annum compounded annually for 6 years.
solution: Given: P = 27000, R = 11.8, Tt = 6 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 27000 * (1 + 11.8/100)^6 | Answer: 52725 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (2, -3, -5) and (-5, 7, -1).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (-6, -5, -2) and (-4, -2, 6).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 56.18

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (1, -4, 5) and (6, -5, 5).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 31.94 degrees

question: Find the modulus of the complex number 12 + -3i.
solution: Given: a = 12, b = -3 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((12)^2 + (-3)^2) | Answer: 12.37

question: Evaluate f(x) = -3x^3 + 2x^2 + 6x - 1 at x = -2.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-167 with initial guess x0=10, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.8 and ordinates 10, 4, 1, 18, 11, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 208 and 326.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 208 and 326 | Answer: GCD = 2

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 8 and 76.
solution: Given: a = 8, b = 76 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 8*76 / 4 | Answer: 152
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 43 mm carries an axial tensile load of 16 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 37 mm and length 2400 mm carries an axial load of 46 kN. Take E = 200 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 32 mm transmits a torque of 2350 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 32, Tt = 2350 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2350*1000) / (pi*(32)^3) | Answer: 365.2 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 35 mm and length 900 mm carries a torque of 950 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (35)^4 / 32 = 147324 mm^4 | theta = (950*1000)(900) / (80000 * 147324) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 4.156 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 48 mm wide and 70 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 48, h = 70 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 48*(70)^2 / 6 | Answer: 39200 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (42 mm x 170 mm) carries a bending moment of 39 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (52 mm x 140 mm) has effective length 2100 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 460 MPa is designed for a working stress of 170 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 460, sw = 170 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 460 / 170 | Answer: 2.706

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 700 mm and wall thickness 13 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.5 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 700, t = 13, P = 1.5 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.5*700 / (2*13) | Answer: 40.38 MPa

question: 6 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 85 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6, dT = 85 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 6 * 0.718 * 85 | Answer: 366.2 kJ

question: 1.9 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 25 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.9, dT = 25 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 1.9 * 1.005 * 25 | Answer: 47.74 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.1 m^3 at 510 K with mass 5 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 3.1, Tk = 510, m = 5 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 5*0.287*510 / 3.1 | Answer: 236.1 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4.8 kg of air expands isothermally at 490 K from volume V1 to 5*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.8, Tk = 490, ratio = 5 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4.8*0.287*490*ln(5) | Answer: 1086 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.09 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 2, D = 0.09 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*2*0.09 / 0.001 | Answer: 180000

question: Water flows at 2.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 250 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 4.8 m. Taking Cv = 0.96, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 4.8, cv = 0.96 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.96*sqrt(2*9.81*4.8) | Answer: 9.316 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 220 mm) water flows at 0.9 m/s. It contracts to diameter 110 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 220, d2 = 110, V1 = 0.9 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 0.9*(220/110)^2 | Answer: 3.6 m/s

question: Water flows at 3.1 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.12 m and length 430 m. With friction factor f = 0.033, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 37 teeth drives a gear of 113 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1400 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 37, z2 = 113, N1 = 1400 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1400*37 / 113 | Answer: 458.4 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 120 mm rotates at 200 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 120, N = 200 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.12)*200 / 60 | Answer: 1.257 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 2.5 kW at 200 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 2.5, N = 200 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(2.5*1000) / (2*pi*200) | Answer: 119.4 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 7.6 kg rotates at radius 0.32 m at 550 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 7200 N/m and mass 2.9 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 7200, m = 2.9 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(7200/2.9) | Answer: 7.93 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 9.1 m^2 and thickness 0.36 m has conductivity k = 7.4 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 75 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 9.1, L = 0.36, k = 7.4, dT = 75 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 7.4*9.1*75 / 0.36 | Answer: 14029 W

question: A surface of area 3.9 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 65 W/m^2-K to surroundings 100 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 3.9, h = 65, dT = 100 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 65*3.9*100 | Answer: 25350 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 190 m/min, feed = 0.41 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 190, f = 0.41, d = 2 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*190*0.41*2 | Answer: 155800 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 210 mm is turned at 550 rpm with a feed of 0.15 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 210, N = 550, f = 0.15 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 210 / (0.15*550) | Answer: 2.545 min

question: A resistor of 154 ohm carries a current of 9.6 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 154, I = 9.6 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 9.6 * 154 | Answer: 1478 V

question: Three resistors 45 ohm, 65 ohm and 5 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 45, R2 = 65, R3 = 5 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 45 + 65 + 5 | Answer: 115 ohm

question: Two resistors 73 ohm and 110 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 73, R2 = 110 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 73*110 / (73+110) | Answer: 43.88 ohm

question: A device draws 5.9 A at 195 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 195, I = 5.9 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 195 * 5.9 | Answer: 115 W

question: A current of 10.5 A flows through a 50 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 10.5, R = 50 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (10.5)^2 * 50 | Answer: 5512 W

question: Two capacitors 47.6 uF and 11 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 47.6, C2 = 11 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 47.6*11 / (47.6+11) | Answer: 8.935 uF

question: A resistor 71 kohm and capacitor 9.2 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 71, C = 9.2 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (71k)(9.2u) = 653.2 ms | Answer: 653.2 ms

question: An inductor 333.4 mH is in series with 53 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 333.4, R = 53 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (333.4e-3) / 53 | Answer: 6.291 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 123.8 mH inductor at 1000 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 123.8, f = 1000 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (1000)(123.8e-3) | Answer: 777.9 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 48.9 uF capacitor at 660 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 48.9, f = 660 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (660)(48.9e-6)) | Answer: 4.931 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 95 ohm, XL = 26 ohm and XC = 72 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 95, XL = 26, XC = 72 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(95^2 + (26 - 72)^2) | Answer: 105.6 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 99.3 mH and C = 3.6 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 99.3, C = 3.6 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(99.3e-3 * 3.6e-6)) | Answer: 266.2 Hz

question: A capacitor of 14 uF is charged to 75 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 14, V = 75 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*14e-6*(75)^2 | Answer: 39.38 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 140 V with 540 primary turns and 180 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 140, N1 = 540, N2 = 180 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 140 * 180/540 | Answer: 46.67 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 190 V and draws an armature current of 35 A. If the armature resistance is 0.15 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 190, Ia = 35, Ra = 0.15 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 190 - 35*0.15 | Answer: 184.8 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 20 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.78. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 20, VL = 415, pf = 0.78 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*20*0.78 / 1000 | Answer: 11.21 kW

question: A load has real power 70 kW and apparent power 145 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 70, S = 145 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 70 / 145 | Answer: 0.4828

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 24 V across R1 = 43 ohm and R2 = 28 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 24, R1 = 43, R2 = 28 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 24*28 / (43+28) | Answer: 9.465 V

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9298. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 9298 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(9298) | Answer: 39.68 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.8 m carries a central point load of 70 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 9.8, W = 70 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 70*9.8 / 4 | Answer: 171.5 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 3.6 m carries a UDL of 14 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.6, w = 14 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 14*(3.6)^2 / 2 | Answer: 90.72 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.8 m carries a point load 55 kN at distance 3.3 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 5.8, a = 3.3, W = 55 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 55*(5.8 - 3.3) / 5.8 | Answer: 23.71 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 6.5 m) carries a central point load 75 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 550e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=75000 N, L=6500.0 mm, E=200000 MPa, I=550e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 3.901 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 420 mm, clear cover 35 mm and main bars of diameter 25 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 420, c = 35, dia = 25 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 420 - 35 - 25/2 | Answer: 372.5 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 23.3 m^2 carrying a factored load of 9 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 23.3, w = 9 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 9 * 23.3 | Answer: 209.7 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 5.2 m, unit weight 20 kN/m^3, phi = 35 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 2e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1.2, area = 1.5e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 2, i = 1.2, A = 1.5 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (2e-4)*1.2*(1.5e-3) | Answer: 360 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.6 m, bed slope 0.004 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.023. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4 m under a head of 0.7 m. Taking Cd = 0.6 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
solution: Given: L = 4, H = 0.7, cd = 0.6 | Formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2) | Substitute: Q = (2/3)*0.6*sqrt(2*9.81)*4*(0.7)^1.5 | Answer: 4.151 m^3/s
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 3.9 m wide carries a discharge of 13.2 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 410 m and design speed 70 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 410, V = 70 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (70)^2 / (127*410) | Answer: 0.0941
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 910 m^3 treats a flow of 45 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 910, Q = 45 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 910 / 45 | Answer: 20.22 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 340 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.17 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 3 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 340, k = 0.17, t = 3 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 340*(1 - e^(-0.17*3)) | Answer: 135.8 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.87, rainfall intensity 95 mm/h over a catchment of 13.5 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.87, i = 95, A = 13.5 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.87*95*13.5 / 360 | Answer: 3.099 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.05 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 720 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.05, M = 720 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 720*(30+0.05)/30 | Answer: 721.2 m

question: Convert the decimal number 3863 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 3863 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: F17 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10101010 and 00101000.
solution: XOR: 10000010 | Count of 1s = 2 | Answer: 2
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 520 megabits is sent over a link of 13 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 520, B = 13 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 520 / 13 | Answer: 40 s

question: A link has bandwidth 69 Mbps and round-trip time 110 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 69, R = 110 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 69e6 * 110e-3 bits = 7590 kb | Answer: 7590 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.93, cache access time 4 ns and main-memory access time 100 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.93, tc = 4, tm = 100 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.93*4 + (1 - 0.93)*100 | Answer: 10.72 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 22730 elements?
solution: Given: n = 22730 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(22730)) + 1 | Answer: 15

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.018, memory access time 190 ns and page-fault service time 8 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 8 ms = 8000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.018)*190 + 0.018*8000000.0 ns | Answer: 144.2 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.1 m^3 at 240 kPa and 300 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.1, P = 240, Tk = 300 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (240e3)*2.1 / (8.314*300) | Answer: 202.1 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 7e10 /s and activation energy 50 kJ/mol at 310 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 7, Ea = 50, Tk = 310 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 7e10 * exp(-50e3 / (8.314*310)) | Answer: 262.9 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.91 and bottoms xW = 0.05, with relative volatility alpha = 2.8. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.91, xw = 0.05, al = 2.8 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.91/0.09)(0.95/0.05)] / ln(2.8) | Answer: 5.107 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.75 and x = 0.33. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.75, x = 0.33 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.75/0.25) / (0.33/0.67) | Answer: 6.091

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.28 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 115 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.28, Psat = 115 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.28 * 115 | Answer: 32.2 kPa

question: A stream of 7.7 kg/s with specific heat 1.7 kJ/kg-K is heated through 50 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 7.7, cp = 1.7, dT = 50 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 7.7*1.7*50 | Answer: 654.5 kW

question: A reactor of volume 13.8 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 0.5 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 13.8, Q = 0.5 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 13.8 / 0.5 | Answer: 27.6 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 8.3e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 5 mm with a concentration difference of 160 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 8.3, L = 5, dC = 160 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (8.3e-9)*160 / (5e-3) | Answer: 265.6 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 9.4 min and steady-state gain 2.8. For a step input of magnitude 9, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 9.4, K = 2.8, M = 9 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 2.8 * 9 | Answer: 25.2 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 100 m^2 flies at 150 m/s (air density 1 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.5. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 100, V = 150, rho = 1, CL = 0.5 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1*(150)^2*100*0.5 / 1000 | Answer: 562.5 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 60 m^2 flies at 250 m/s (density 1.225 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.05. Find the drag force in kN.
A specimen under stress 380 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.8e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 380, eps = 2.8 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 380 / (2.8e-3) MPa = 135.7 GPa | Answer: 135.7 GPa

question: A block of mass 10 kg has a volume of 4.6e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 10, V = 4.6 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 10 / (4.6e-3) | Answer: 2174 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2200 mm is heated through 65 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 17e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2200, dT = 65, al = 17 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2200*17e-6*65 | Answer: 2.431 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 65 ohm, R2 = 185 ohm and R3 = 125 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 65, R2 = 185, R3 = 125 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 185*125 / 65 | Answer: 355.8 ohm

question: Annual demand is 12000 units, ordering cost 220 per order and holding cost 35 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 12000, S = 220, H = 35 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*12000*220 / 35) | Answer: 388.4 units

question: An asset costs 500000 with salvage value 4000 after 17 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 500000, Sv = 4000, n = 17 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (500000 - 4000) / 17 | Answer: 29176 per year

question: A product sells for 240 per unit with variable cost 10 per unit and fixed costs 95000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 240, V = 10, F = 95000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 95000 / (240 - 10) | Answer: 413 units

question: Find the present worth of 120000 received 5 years from now at an interest rate of 10% per year.
solution: Given: F = 120000, n = 5, i = 10 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 120000 / (1 + 0.1)^5 | Answer: 74511 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.97, 0.91 and 0.95 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.97, r2 = 0.91, r3 = 0.95 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.97*0.91*0.95 | Answer: 0.8386

question: A process produces 5 defective items in a batch of 6000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 5, N = 6000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 5/6000 * 1e6 | Answer: 833.3 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = -3x^3 - 7x^2 + 2x + 8 evaluated at x = -3.
For f(x) = 4x^3 + 8x^2 - 9x + 8, find f''(x) at x = -5.
Evaluate the definite integral of (3x^2 + 4x + 5) dx from x = 2 to x = 3.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 3x^3/3 + 4x^2/2 + 5x | Evaluate F(3) - F(2) | Answer: 34
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of x^2 + 10x - 6 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[0, -2], [7, -8]].
solution: Given: a = 0, b = -2, c = 7, d = -8 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (0)(-8) - (-2)(7) | Answer: 14

question: Find the determinant of [[-5, 4, -2], [0, -3, -1], [-3, -3, -1]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 30

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[2, -2], [-2, -5]].
solution: Trace tr = -3, Determinant = -14 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 2.531

question: Solve for x: 3x + -3y = -10 and -5x + 0y = 4.
solution: Determinant = 3*0 - -3*-5 = -15 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -0.8 | Answer: x = -0.8
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 66, 76, 21, 35, 7.
solution: Sum = 205 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 41 | Answer: 41

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 3, 27, 25, 27, 38.
solution: Mean = 24 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 12.81

question: Find the slope of the line through (1, -7) and (-9, -9).
solution: Given: x1 = 1, y1 = -7, x2 = -9, y2 = -9 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (-9 - -7) / (-9 - 1) | Answer: 0.2

question: Find the distance between the points (-5, 7) and (-2, -3).
solution: Given: x1 = -5, y1 = 7, x2 = -2, y2 = -3 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((3)^2 + (-10)^2) | Answer: 10.44 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (2,-8), (-7,4), (3,-1).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 37.5 sq units

question: Find the 21th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 7 and common difference 5.
solution: Given: a = 7, d = 5, n = 21 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 7 + (21 - 1)*5 | Answer: 107

question: Find the sum of the first 40 terms of an AP with first term -4 and common difference 4.
solution: Given: a = -4, d = 4, n = 40 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 40/2 [2*-4 + (40-1)*4] | Answer: 2960

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 13000 at 13.7% per annum for 3 years.
solution: Given: P = 13000, R = 13.7, Tt = 3 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 13000 * 13.7 * 3 / 100 | Answer: 5343 currency units

question: Find the amount when 11000 is invested at 7.8% per annum compounded annually for 4 years.
solution: Given: P = 11000, R = 7.8, Tt = 4 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 11000 * (1 + 7.8/100)^4 | Answer: 14855 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (1, 8, -5) and (-5, 8, 0).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (0, -1, -1) and (-1, -4, 5).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 9.11

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (6, -5, 6) and (2, -6, -3).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 69.63 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -2x^3 - 7x^2 + 2x + 8 at x = -4.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-13 with initial guess x0=10, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=0.6 and ordinates 14, 13, 12, 5, 8, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 557 and 147.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 557 and 147 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 24 and 37.
solution: Given: a = 24, b = 37 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 24*37 / 1 | Answer: 888
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 18 mm carries an axial tensile load of 6 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 31 mm and length 1600 mm carries an axial load of 49 kN. Take E = 70 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 75 mm transmits a torque of 1800 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 75, Tt = 1800 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(1800*1000) / (pi*(75)^3) | Answer: 21.73 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 27 mm and length 2000 mm carries a torque of 1600 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (27)^4 / 32 = 52174 mm^4 | theta = (1600*1000)(2000) / (80000 * 52174) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 43.93 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 61 mm wide and 260 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 61, h = 260 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 61*(260)^2 / 6 | Answer: 687267 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (66 mm x 130 mm) carries a bending moment of 28 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (66 mm x 130 mm) has effective length 2600 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)
