solution: Given: d = 1250, t = 6, P = 1.9 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.9*1250 / (2*6) | Answer: 197.9 MPa

question: 7.6 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 180 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 7.6, dT = 180 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 7.6 * 0.718 * 180 | Answer: 982.2 kJ

question: 6.2 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 60 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.2, dT = 60 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 6.2 * 1.005 * 60 | Answer: 373.9 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1.2 m^3 at 380 K with mass 5.6 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1.2, Tk = 380, m = 5.6 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 5.6*0.287*380 / 1.2 | Answer: 508.9 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4 kg of air expands isothermally at 350 K from volume V1 to 3*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4, Tk = 350, ratio = 3 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4*0.287*350*ln(3) | Answer: 441.4 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 1.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.25 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 1.4, D = 0.25 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*1.4*0.25 / 0.001 | Answer: 350000

question: Water flows at 2.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 220 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 4.8 m. Taking Cv = 0.95, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 4.8, cv = 0.95 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.95*sqrt(2*9.81*4.8) | Answer: 9.219 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 370 mm) water flows at 0.9 m/s. It contracts to diameter 110 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
Water flows at 3.1 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.13 m and length 360 m. With friction factor f = 0.02, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 26 teeth drives a gear of 70 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1150 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 26, z2 = 70, N1 = 1150 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1150*26 / 70 | Answer: 427.1 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 460 mm rotates at 300 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 460, N = 300 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.46)*300 / 60 | Answer: 7.226 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 49.8 kW at 1350 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 49.8, N = 1350 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(49.8*1000) / (2*pi*1350) | Answer: 352.3 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 5.2 kg rotates at radius 0.41 m at 1200 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 2800 N/m and mass 16.7 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 2800, m = 16.7 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(2800/16.7) | Answer: 2.061 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 8.3 m^2 and thickness 0.26 m has conductivity k = 25.4 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 50 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 8.3, L = 0.26, k = 25.4, dT = 50 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 25.4*8.3*50 / 0.26 | Answer: 40542 W

question: A surface of area 4.6 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 30 W/m^2-K to surroundings 75 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 4.6, h = 30, dT = 75 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 30*4.6*75 | Answer: 10350 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 60 m/min, feed = 0.24 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.9 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 60, f = 0.24, d = 2.9 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*60*0.24*2.9 | Answer: 41760 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 250 mm is turned at 300 rpm with a feed of 0.28 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 250, N = 300, f = 0.28 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 250 / (0.28*300) | Answer: 2.976 min

question: A resistor of 58 ohm carries a current of 3.4 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 58, I = 3.4 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 3.4 * 58 | Answer: 197.2 V

question: Three resistors 46 ohm, 14 ohm and 71 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 46, R2 = 14, R3 = 71 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 46 + 14 + 71 | Answer: 131 ohm

question: Two resistors 45 ohm and 53 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 45, R2 = 53 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 45*53 / (45+53) | Answer: 24.34 ohm

question: A device draws 8.2 A at 165 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 165, I = 8.2 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 165 * 8.2 | Answer: 1353 W

question: A current of 7.7 A flows through a 27 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 7.7, R = 27 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (7.7)^2 * 27 | Answer: 1601 W

question: Two capacitors 15 uF and 7.4 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 15, C2 = 7.4 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 15*7.4 / (15+7.4) | Answer: 4.955 uF

question: A resistor 44 kohm and capacitor 19.4 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 44, C = 19.4 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (44k)(19.4u) = 853.6 ms | Answer: 853.6 ms

question: An inductor 218.9 mH is in series with 179 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 218.9, R = 179 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (218.9e-3) / 179 | Answer: 1.223 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 26.9 mH inductor at 410 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 26.9, f = 410 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (410)(26.9e-3) | Answer: 69.3 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 1.7 uF capacitor at 370 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 1.7, f = 370 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (370)(1.7e-6)) | Answer: 253 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 49 ohm, XL = 68 ohm and XC = 25 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 49, XL = 68, XC = 25 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(49^2 + (68 - 25)^2) | Answer: 65.19 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 28.6 mH and C = 8.4 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 28.6, C = 8.4 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(28.6e-3 * 8.4e-6)) | Answer: 324.7 Hz

question: A capacitor of 7.3 uF is charged to 220 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 7.3, V = 220 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*7.3e-6*(220)^2 | Answer: 176.7 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 350 V with 670 primary turns and 440 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 350, N1 = 670, N2 = 440 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 350 * 440/670 | Answer: 229.9 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 340 V and draws an armature current of 19 A. If the armature resistance is 1.31 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 340, Ia = 19, Ra = 1.31 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 340 - 19*1.31 | Answer: 315.1 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 115 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.78. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 115, VL = 433, pf = 0.78 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*115*0.78 / 1000 | Answer: 67.27 kW

question: A load has real power 150 kW and apparent power 215 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 150, S = 215 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 150 / 215 | Answer: 0.6977

question: A machine delivers 35 kW output while drawing 37 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 35, Pi = 37 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 35/37 * 100 | Answer: 94.59 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 15 V across R1 = 25 ohm and R2 = 31 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 15, R1 = 25, R2 = 31 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 15*31 / (25+31) | Answer: 8.304 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 190 kohm and Rin = 36 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 190, Rin = 36 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 190 / 36 | Answer: 5.278

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 70 kohm and Rg = 5 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 70, Rg = 5 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 70/5 | Answer: 15

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 5766. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 5766 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(5766) | Answer: 37.61 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.4 m carries a central point load of 100 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 9.4, W = 100 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 100*9.4 / 4 | Answer: 235 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.3 m carries a UDL of 60 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 7.3, w = 60 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 60*(7.3)^2 / 8 | Answer: 399.7 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 1.1 m carries a point load 50 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 1.1, W = 50 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 50*1.1 | Answer: 55 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.3 m carries a point load 20 kN at distance 2.3 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 9.3, a = 2.3, W = 20 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 20*(9.3 - 2.3) / 9.3 | Answer: 15.05 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 6.8 m) carries a central point load 45 kN. With E = 30 GPa and I = 390e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=45000 N, L=6800.0 mm, E=30000 MPa, I=390e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 25.19 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 550 mm, clear cover 40 mm and main bars of diameter 16 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 550, c = 40, dia = 16 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 550 - 40 - 16/2 | Answer: 502 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 17.8 m^2 carrying a factored load of 17.3 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 17.8, w = 17.3 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 17.3 * 17.8 | Answer: 307.9 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 4.1 m, unit weight 16 kN/m^3, phi = 38 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 3.5e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.9, area = 3.3e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 3.5, i = 0.9, A = 3.3 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (3.5e-4)*0.9*(3.3e-3) | Answer: 104 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.8 m, bed slope 0.008 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.016. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.8 m under a head of 0.8 m. Taking Cd = 0.61 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.2 m wide carries a discharge of 9.5 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 510 m and design speed 90 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 510, V = 90 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (90)^2 / (127*510) | Answer: 0.1251
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 420 m^3 treats a flow of 20 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 420, Q = 20 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 420 / 20 | Answer: 21 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 230 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.35 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 6 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 230, k = 0.35, t = 6 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 230*(1 - e^(-0.35*6)) | Answer: 201.8 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.58, rainfall intensity 60 mm/h over a catchment of 56.2 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.58, i = 60, A = 56.2 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.58*60*56.2 / 360 | Answer: 5.433 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.07 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 790 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.07, M = 790 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 790*(20+0.07)/20 | Answer: 792.8 m

question: Convert the decimal number 3108 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 3108 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: C24 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 00100100 and 10010100.
solution: XOR: 10110000 | Count of 1s = 3 | Answer: 3
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 120 megabits is sent over a link of 100 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 120, B = 100 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 120 / 100 | Answer: 1.2 s

question: A link has bandwidth 76 Mbps and round-trip time 10 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 76, R = 10 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 76e6 * 10e-3 bits = 760 kb | Answer: 760 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.91, cache access time 8 ns and main-memory access time 100 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.91, tc = 8, tm = 100 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.91*8 + (1 - 0.91)*100 | Answer: 16.28 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 788879 elements?
solution: Given: n = 788879 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(788879)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.009, memory access time 140 ns and page-fault service time 4 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 4 ms = 4000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.009)*140 + 0.009*4000000.0 ns | Answer: 36.14 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 0.2 m^3 at 250 kPa and 470 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 0.2, P = 250, Tk = 470 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (250e3)*0.2 / (8.314*470) | Answer: 12.8 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 3e10 /s and activation energy 75 kJ/mol at 360 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 3, Ea = 75, Tk = 360 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 3e10 * exp(-75e3 / (8.314*360)) | Answer: 0.3931 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.92 and bottoms xW = 0.02, with relative volatility alpha = 1.8. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.92, xw = 0.02, al = 1.8 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.92/0.08)(0.98/0.02)] / ln(1.8) | Answer: 10.78 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.77 and x = 0.47. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.77, x = 0.47 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.77/0.23) / (0.47/0.53) | Answer: 3.775

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.19 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 115 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.19, Psat = 115 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.19 * 115 | Answer: 21.85 kPa

question: A stream of 6.9 kg/s with specific heat 1.9 kJ/kg-K is heated through 95 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 6.9, cp = 1.9, dT = 95 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 6.9*1.9*95 | Answer: 1245 kW

question: A reactor of volume 7.5 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 1 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 7.5, Q = 1 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 7.5 / 1 | Answer: 7.5 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 5.5e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 3 mm with a concentration difference of 170 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 5.5, L = 3, dC = 170 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (5.5e-9)*170 / (3e-3) | Answer: 311.7 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 2.5 min and steady-state gain 3.9. For a step input of magnitude 13, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 2.5, K = 3.9, M = 13 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 3.9 * 13 | Answer: 50.7 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 60 m^2 flies at 160 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.9. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 60, V = 160, rho = 0.7, CL = 0.9 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.7*(160)^2*60*0.9 / 1000 | Answer: 483.8 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 70 m^2 flies at 230 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.08. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 70, V = 230, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.08 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(230)^2*70*0.08 / 1000 | Answer: 59.25 kN

question: A specimen under stress 150 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.9e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 150, eps = 2.9 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 150 / (2.9e-3) MPa = 51.72 GPa | Answer: 51.72 GPa

question: A block of mass 36 kg has a volume of 4.1e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 36, V = 4.1 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 36 / (4.1e-3) | Answer: 878 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2600 mm is heated through 135 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 17e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2600, dT = 135, al = 17 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2600*17e-6*135 | Answer: 5.967 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 170 ohm, R2 = 45 ohm and R3 = 160 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 170, R2 = 45, R3 = 160 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 45*160 / 170 | Answer: 42.35 ohm

question: Annual demand is 41000 units, ordering cost 290 per order and holding cost 27 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 41000, S = 290, H = 27 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*41000*290 / 27) | Answer: 938.5 units

question: An asset costs 470000 with salvage value 36000 after 12 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 470000, Sv = 36000, n = 12 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (470000 - 36000) / 12 | Answer: 36167 per year

question: A product sells for 310 per unit with variable cost 10 per unit and fixed costs 150000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 310, V = 10, F = 150000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 150000 / (310 - 10) | Answer: 500 units

question: Find the present worth of 90000 received 3 years from now at an interest rate of 5% per year.
solution: Given: F = 90000, n = 3, i = 5 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 90000 / (1 + 0.05)^3 | Answer: 77745 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.99, 0.92 and 0.9 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.99, r2 = 0.92, r3 = 0.9 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.99*0.92*0.9 | Answer: 0.8197

question: A process produces 3 defective items in a batch of 14000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 3, N = 14000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 3/14000 * 1e6 | Answer: 214.3 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = -x^3 - 8x^2 - 6x + 1 evaluated at x = -2.
For f(x) = -2x^3 - 8x^2 - 6x - 6, find f''(x) at x = 0.
Evaluate the definite integral of (x^2 - 6x) dx from x = 2 to x = 5.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 1x^3/3 + -6x^2/2 + 0x | Evaluate F(5) - F(2) | Answer: -24

question: Find the larger real root of 2x^2 + 8x - 9 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[-1, 6], [6, 9]].
solution: Given: a = -1, b = 6, c = 6, d = 9 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (-1)(9) - (6)(6) | Answer: -45

question: Find the determinant of [[4, -4, 2], [1, 0, -2], [4, -1, -5]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 2

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[6, 6], [6, 1]].
solution: Trace tr = 7, Determinant = -30 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 10

question: Solve for x: 2x + 5y = -5 and 2x + 2y = -1.
solution: Determinant = 2*2 - 5*2 = -6 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 0.8333 | Answer: x = 0.8333

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 76, 71, 48, 24, 31.
solution: Sum = 250 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 50 | Answer: 50

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 30, 32, 46, 25, 31.
solution: Mean = 32.8 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 7.855

question: Find the slope of the line through (3, 1) and (-3, -3).
solution: Given: x1 = 3, y1 = 1, x2 = -3, y2 = -3 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (-3 - 1) / (-3 - 3) | Answer: 0.6667

question: Find the distance between the points (3, 0) and (-6, 6).
solution: Given: x1 = 3, y1 = 0, x2 = -6, y2 = 6 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((-9)^2 + (6)^2) | Answer: 10.82 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (4,-5), (-4,5), (-1,1).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 1 sq units

question: Find the 28th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 5 and common difference 2.
solution: Given: a = 5, d = 2, n = 28 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 5 + (28 - 1)*2 | Answer: 59

question: Find the sum of the first 8 terms of an AP with first term -4 and common difference -1.
solution: Given: a = -4, d = -1, n = 8 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 8/2 [2*-4 + (8-1)*-1] | Answer: -60

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 9000 at 12.9% per annum for 2 years.
solution: Given: P = 9000, R = 12.9, Tt = 2 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 9000 * 12.9 * 2 / 100 | Answer: 2322 currency units

question: Find the amount when 22500 is invested at 4.9% per annum compounded annually for 5 years.
solution: Given: P = 22500, R = 4.9, Tt = 5 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 22500 * (1 + 4.9/100)^5 | Answer: 2858 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (-8, -2, 5) and (7, -8, -6).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (2, -6, 3) and (0, 6, -6).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 24.74

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (6, 6, -5) and (5, -1, -1).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 55.48 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -4x^3 + 5x^2 + 9x - 3 at x = 4.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-156 with initial guess x0=10, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.1 and ordinates 3, 9, 7, 9, 20, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 246 and 517.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 246 and 517 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 50 and 12.
solution: Given: a = 50, b = 12 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 50*12 / 2 | Answer: 300
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 17 mm carries an axial tensile load of 40 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 39 mm and length 800 mm carries an axial load of 12 kN. Take E = 200 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 28 mm transmits a torque of 2350 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 28, Tt = 2350 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2350*1000) / (pi*(28)^3) | Answer: 545.2 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 41 mm and length 500 mm carries a torque of 1150 N-m. With G = 45 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (41)^4 / 32 = 277418 mm^4 | theta = (1150*1000)(500) / (45000 * 277418) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 2.639 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 30 mm wide and 150 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 30, h = 150 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 30*(150)^2 / 6 | Answer: 112500 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (48 mm x 200 mm) carries a bending moment of 40 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (70 mm x 150 mm) has effective length 2300 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 380 MPa is designed for a working stress of 120 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 380, sw = 120 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 380 / 120 | Answer: 3.167

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 550 mm and wall thickness 8 mm carries an internal pressure of 2.2 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 550, t = 8, P = 2.2 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 2.2*550 / (2*8) | Answer: 75.62 MPa

question: 6.7 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 40 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.7, dT = 40 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 6.7 * 0.718 * 40 | Answer: 192.4 kJ

question: 1.2 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 200 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.2, dT = 200 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 1.2 * 1.005 * 200 | Answer: 241.2 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 0.5 m^3 at 520 K with mass 1.2 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 0.5, Tk = 520, m = 1.2 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 1.2*0.287*520 / 0.5 | Answer: 358.2 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 2.8 kg of air expands isothermally at 310 K from volume V1 to 3*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.8, Tk = 310, ratio = 3 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 2.8*0.287*310*ln(3) | Answer: 273.7 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 1.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.14 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 1.8, D = 0.14 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*1.8*0.14 / 0.001 | Answer: 252000

question: Water flows at 0.6 m/s through a pipe of diameter 280 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 3.9 m. Taking Cv = 0.96, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 3.9, cv = 0.96 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.96*sqrt(2*9.81*3.9) | Answer: 8.398 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 290 mm) water flows at 2.9 m/s. It contracts to diameter 80 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 290, d2 = 80, V1 = 2.9 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2.9*(290/80)^2 | Answer: 38.11 m/s

question: Water flows at 2.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.28 m and length 140 m. With friction factor f = 0.026, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 15 teeth drives a gear of 53 teeth. If the pinion runs at 950 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 15, z2 = 53, N1 = 950 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 950*15 / 53 | Answer: 268.9 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 300 mm rotates at 550 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 300, N = 550 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.3)*550 / 60 | Answer: 8.639 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 4.7 kW at 800 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 4.7, N = 800 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(4.7*1000) / (2*pi*800) | Answer: 56.1 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 0.9 kg rotates at radius 0.22 m at 700 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 10800 N/m and mass 16.4 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 10800, m = 16.4 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(10800/16.4) | Answer: 4.084 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 7 m^2 and thickness 0.27 m has conductivity k = 6.8 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 175 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 7, L = 0.27, k = 6.8, dT = 175 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 6.8*7*175 / 0.27 | Answer: 30852 W

question: A surface of area 2.7 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 120 W/m^2-K to surroundings 30 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 2.7, h = 120, dT = 30 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 120*2.7*30 | Answer: 9720 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 190 m/min, feed = 0.24 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2.9 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 190, f = 0.24, d = 2.9 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*190*0.24*2.9 | Answer: 132240 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 270 mm is turned at 200 rpm with a feed of 0.15 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 270, N = 200, f = 0.15 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 270 / (0.15*200) | Answer: 9 min

question: A resistor of 85 ohm carries a current of 5 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 85, I = 5 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 5 * 85 | Answer: 425 V

question: Three resistors 24 ohm, 25 ohm and 64 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 24, R2 = 25, R3 = 64 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 24 + 25 + 64 | Answer: 113 ohm

question: Two resistors 11 ohm and 87 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 11, R2 = 87 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 11*87 / (11+87) | Answer: 9.765 ohm

question: A device draws 13.5 A at 160 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 160, I = 13.5 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 160 * 13.5 | Answer: 2160 W

question: A current of 1.3 A flows through a 105 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 1.3, R = 105 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (1.3)^2 * 105 | Answer: 177.5 W

question: Two capacitors 46.9 uF and 41.7 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 46.9, C2 = 41.7 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 46.9*41.7 / (46.9+41.7) | Answer: 22.07 uF

question: A resistor 1 kohm and capacitor 16.5 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 1, C = 16.5 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (1k)(16.5u) = 16.5 ms | Answer: 16.5 ms

question: An inductor 118.6 mH is in series with 28 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 118.6, R = 28 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (118.6e-3) / 28 | Answer: 4.236 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 132.6 mH inductor at 600 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 132.6, f = 600 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (600)(132.6e-3) | Answer: 499.9 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 43.9 uF capacitor at 530 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 43.9, f = 530 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (530)(43.9e-6)) | Answer: 6.84 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 34 ohm, XL = 10 ohm and XC = 71 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 34, XL = 10, XC = 71 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(34^2 + (10 - 71)^2) | Answer: 69.84 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 45.3 mH and C = 9.6 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 45.3, C = 9.6 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(45.3e-3 * 9.6e-6)) | Answer: 241.3 Hz

question: A capacitor of 21.5 uF is charged to 145 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 21.5, V = 145 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*21.5e-6*(145)^2 | Answer: 226 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 190 V with 850 primary turns and 300 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 190, N1 = 850, N2 = 300 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 190 * 300/850 | Answer: 67.06 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 250 V and draws an armature current of 49 A. If the armature resistance is 0.96 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 250, Ia = 49, Ra = 0.96 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 250 - 49*0.96 | Answer: 203 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 165 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.92. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 165, VL = 433, pf = 0.92 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*165*0.92 / 1000 | Answer: 113.8 kW

question: A load has real power 115 kW and apparent power 135 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 115, S = 135 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 115 / 135 | Answer: 0.8519

question: A machine delivers 40 kW output while drawing 142 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 40, Pi = 142 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 40/142 * 100 | Answer: 28.17 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 19 V across R1 = 27 ohm and R2 = 35 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 19, R1 = 27, R2 = 35 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 19*35 / (27+35) | Answer: 10.73 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 110 kohm and Rin = 42 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 110, Rin = 42 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 110 / 42 | Answer: 2.619

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 20 kohm and Rg = 30 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 20, Rg = 30 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 20/30 | Answer: 1.667

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 4473. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 4473 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(4473) | Answer: 36.51 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 7 m carries a central point load of 80 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 7, W = 80 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 80*7 / 4 | Answer: 140 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.1 m carries a UDL of 25 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 9.1, w = 25 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 25*(9.1)^2 / 8 | Answer: 258.8 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 4 m carries a point load 5 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4, W = 5 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 5*4 | Answer: 20 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.4 m carries a UDL of 38 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.4, w = 38 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 38*(2.4)^2 / 2 | Answer: 109.4 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.8 m carries a point load 90 kN at distance 1.2 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 7.8, a = 1.2, W = 90 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 90*(7.8 - 1.2) / 7.8 | Answer: 76.15 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 6.6 m) carries a central point load 40 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 150e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=40000 N, L=6600.0 mm, E=200000 MPa, I=150e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 7.986 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 4.9 m carries a UDL of 33 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.9, w = 33 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 33*(4.9)^2 / 12 | Answer: 66.03 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 520 mm, clear cover 25 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 520, c = 25, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 520 - 25 - 12/2 | Answer: 489 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 33.7 m^2 carrying a factored load of 19.9 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 33.7, w = 19.9 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 19.9 * 33.7 | Answer: 670.6 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 5.5 m, unit weight 19 kN/m^3, phi = 30 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 5.4e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.4, area = 2e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 5.4, i = 0.4, A = 2 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (5.4e-4)*0.4*(2e-3) | Answer: 432 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 2.3 m, bed slope 0.004 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.019. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1 m under a head of 0.7 m. Taking Cd = 0.62 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.

question: A rectangular channel 4.6 m wide carries a discharge of 29.3 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 710 m^3 treats a flow of 110 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 710, Q = 110 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 710 / 110 | Answer: 6.455 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 280 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.29 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 8 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 280, k = 0.29, t = 8 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 280*(1 - e^(-0.29*8)) | Answer: 252.5 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.6, rainfall intensity 60 mm/h over a catchment of 28 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.6, i = 60, A = 28 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.6*60*28 / 360 | Answer: 2.8 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.06 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 250 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.06, M = 250 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 250*(30+0.06)/30 | Answer: 250.5 m

question: Convert the decimal number 2324 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 2324 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 914 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 00010000 and 00001110.
solution: XOR: 00011110 | Count of 1s = 4 | Answer: 4
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 100 megabits is sent over a link of 78 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 100, B = 78 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 100 / 78 | Answer: 1.282 s

question: A link has bandwidth 15 Mbps and round-trip time 30 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 15, R = 30 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 15e6 * 30e-3 bits = 450 kb | Answer: 450 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.9, cache access time 10 ns and main-memory access time 90 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.9, tc = 10, tm = 90 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.9*10 + (1 - 0.9)*90 | Answer: 18 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 720312 elements?
solution: Given: n = 720312 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(720312)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.017, memory access time 140 ns and page-fault service time 5 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 5 ms = 5000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.017)*140 + 0.017*5000000.0 ns | Answer: 85.14 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.6 m^3 at 250 kPa and 450 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.6, P = 250, Tk = 450 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (250e3)*2.6 / (8.314*450) | Answer: 173.7 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 2e10 /s and activation energy 65 kJ/mol at 330 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 2, Ea = 65, Tk = 330 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 2e10 * exp(-65e3 / (8.314*330)) | Answer: 1.028 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.95 and bottoms xW = 0.03, with relative volatility alpha = 2.2. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.95, xw = 0.03, al = 2.2 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.95/0.05)(0.97/0.03)] / ln(2.2) | Answer: 8.143 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.65 and x = 0.44. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.65, x = 0.44 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.65/0.35) / (0.44/0.56) | Answer: 2.364

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.6 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 75 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.6, Psat = 75 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.6 * 75 | Answer: 45 kPa

question: A stream of 5 kg/s with specific heat 1.5 kJ/kg-K is heated through 60 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 5, cp = 1.5, dT = 60 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 5*1.5*60 | Answer: 450 kW

question: A reactor of volume 12.8 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 5 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 12.8, Q = 5 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 12.8 / 5 | Answer: 2.56 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 8.6e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 2 mm with a concentration difference of 110 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 8.6, L = 2, dC = 110 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (8.6e-9)*110 / (2e-3) | Answer: 473 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 7.1 min and steady-state gain 1.6. For a step input of magnitude 3, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 7.1, K = 1.6, M = 3 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 1.6 * 3 | Answer: 4.8 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 95 m^2 flies at 90 m/s (air density 0.4 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.9. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 95, V = 90, rho = 0.4, CL = 0.9 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.4*(90)^2*95*0.9 / 1000 | Answer: 138.5 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 40 m^2 flies at 260 m/s (density 1.225 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.03. Find the drag force in kN.
A specimen under stress 360 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.7e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 360, eps = 2.7 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 360 / (2.7e-3) MPa = 133.3 GPa | Answer: 133.3 GPa

question: A block of mass 44 kg has a volume of 5.5e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 44, V = 5.5 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 44 / (5.5e-3) | Answer: 8000 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2700 mm is heated through 45 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2700, dT = 45, al = 23 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2700*23e-6*45 | Answer: 2.795 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 30 ohm, R2 = 10 ohm and R3 = 450 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 30, R2 = 10, R3 = 450 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 10*450 / 30 | Answer: 150 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.06 when the true value is 100. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.06, true = 100 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.06 - 100| / 100 * 100 | Answer: 90.94 %

question: Annual demand is 3000 units, ordering cost 210 per order and holding cost 28 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 3000, S = 210, H = 28 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*3000*210 / 28) | Answer: 212.1 units

question: An asset costs 210000 with salvage value 2000 after 16 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 210000, Sv = 2000, n = 16 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (210000 - 2000) / 16 | Answer: 13000 per year

question: A product sells for 160 per unit with variable cost 130 per unit and fixed costs 30000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 160, V = 130, F = 30000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 30000 / (160 - 130) | Answer: 1000 units

question: Find the present worth of 150000 received 6 years from now at an interest rate of 6% per year.
solution: Given: F = 150000, n = 6, i = 6 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 150000 / (1 + 0.06)^6 | Answer: 105744 currency units

question: A process produces 26 defective items in a batch of 11000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 26, N = 11000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 26/11000 * 1e6 | Answer: 2364 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = x^3 - 6x^2 + 9x + 9 evaluated at x = 4.
For f(x) = 6x^3 - 4x^2 - 5x + 1, find f''(x) at x = 1.
Evaluate the definite integral of (3x^2 + 4x + 4) dx from x = 1 to x = 3.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 3x^3/3 + 4x^2/2 + 4x | Evaluate F(3) - F(1) | Answer: 50

question: Find the larger real root of 6x^2 + 4x - 8 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[3, 8], [-2, 5]].
solution: Given: a = 3, b = 8, c = -2, d = 5 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (3)(5) - (8)(-2) | Answer: 31

question: Find the determinant of [[5, 3, 3], [5, 4, 3], [-2, -4, 2]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 16

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[-6, -6], [-6, 1]].
solution: Trace tr = -5, Determinant = -42 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 4.446

question: Solve for x: 2x + 4y = -5 and -3x + -2y = 0.
solution: Determinant = 2*-2 - 4*-3 = 8 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 1.25 | Answer: x = 1.25

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 75, 34, 89, 18, 80.
solution: Sum = 296 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 59.2 | Answer: 59.2

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 46, 43, 41, 25, 1.
solution: Mean = 31.2 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 18.74

question: Find the slope of the line through (-2, -8) and (-9, 9).
Find the distance between the points (-1, 4) and (2, 5).
solution: Given: x1 = -1, y1 = 4, x2 = 2, y2 = 5 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((3)^2 + (1)^2) | Answer: 3.162 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (8,-1), (-8,-2), (4,4).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 42 sq units

question: Find the 35th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -1 and common difference 3.
solution: Given: a = -1, d = 3, n = 35 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -1 + (35 - 1)*3 | Answer: 101

question: Find the sum of the first 11 terms of an AP with first term -8 and common difference 2.
solution: Given: a = -8, d = 2, n = 11 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 11/2 [2*-8 + (11-1)*2] | Answer: 22

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 17500 at 9.7% per annum for 10 years.
solution: Given: P = 17500, R = 9.7, Tt = 10 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 17500 * 9.7 * 10 / 100 | Answer: 16975 currency units

question: Find the amount when 1000 is invested at 6% per annum compounded annually for 3 years.
solution: Given: P = 1000, R = 6, Tt = 3 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 1000 * (1 + 6/100)^3 | Answer: 1191 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (2, -7, 5) and (-3, 4, 5).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (2, -5, 2) and (-4, 6, -6).

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (-6, 6, 4) and (3, -3, 1).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 141.5 degrees

question: Find the modulus of the complex number -5 + 9i.
solution: Given: a = -5, b = 9 | Formula: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) | Substitute: |z| = sqrt((-5)^2 + (9)^2) | Answer: 10.3

question: Evaluate f(x) = -4x^3 - 6x^2 - 6x - 4 at x = 0.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-20 with initial guess x0=5, find x1 (one iteration).
solution: Given: N = 20, x0 = 5 | Formula: x1 = x0 - (x0^2 - N)/(2 x0) | Substitute: x1 = 5 - ((5)^2 - 20)/(2*5) | Answer: 4.5

question: Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.4 and ordinates 9, 16, 3, 6, 10, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 115 and 95.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 115 and 95 | Answer: GCD = 5

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 43 and 45.
solution: Given: a = 43, b = 45 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 43*45 / 1 | Answer: 1935
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 46 mm carries an axial tensile load of 75 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 24 mm and length 2400 mm carries an axial load of 76 kN. Take E = 110 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 43 mm transmits a torque of 1350 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 43, Tt = 1350 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(1350*1000) / (pi*(43)^3) | Answer: 86.48 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 35 mm and length 1500 mm carries a torque of 850 N-m. With G = 45 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (35)^4 / 32 = 147324 mm^4 | theta = (850*1000)(1500) / (45000 * 147324) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 11.02 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 58 mm wide and 290 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 58, h = 290 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 58*(290)^2 / 6 | Answer: 812967 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (62 mm x 190 mm) carries a bending moment of 39 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (65 mm x 120 mm) has effective length 2500 mm and E = 200 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 700 MPa is designed for a working stress of 90 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 700, sw = 90 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 700 / 90 | Answer: 7.778

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1050 mm and wall thickness 14 mm carries an internal pressure of 1 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1050, t = 14, P = 1 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1*1050 / (2*14) | Answer: 37.5 MPa

question: 4.1 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 25 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.1, dT = 25 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 4.1 * 0.718 * 25 | Answer: 73.59 kJ

question: 4 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 140 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4, dT = 140 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 4 * 1.005 * 140 | Answer: 562.8 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1.5 m^3 at 400 K with mass 3.4 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1.5, Tk = 400, m = 3.4 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 3.4*0.287*400 / 1.5 | Answer: 260.2 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4.7 kg of air expands isothermally at 330 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.7, Tk = 330, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4.7*0.287*330*ln(4) | Answer: 617.1 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.9 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.33 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.9, D = 0.33 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.9*0.33 / 0.001 | Answer: 1287000

question: Water flows at 3.6 m/s through a pipe of diameter 220 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 14.5 m. Taking Cv = 0.98, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 14.5, cv = 0.98 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.98*sqrt(2*9.81*14.5) | Answer: 16.53 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 320 mm) water flows at 0.9 m/s. It contracts to diameter 50 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 320, d2 = 50, V1 = 0.9 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 0.9*(320/50)^2 | Answer: 36.86 m/s

question: Water flows at 1 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.48 m and length 160 m. With friction factor f = 0.024, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 32 teeth drives a gear of 114 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1050 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 32, z2 = 114, N1 = 1050 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1050*32 / 114 | Answer: 294.7 rpm

question: A shaft transmits 38.1 kW at 700 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 38.1, N = 700 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(38.1*1000) / (2*pi*700) | Answer: 519.8 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 3.8 kg rotates at radius 0.43 m at 700 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 13800 N/m and mass 12.7 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 13800, m = 12.7 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(13800/12.7) | Answer: 5.246 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 2.6 m^2 and thickness 0.3 m has conductivity k = 15.7 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 110 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 2.6, L = 0.3, k = 15.7, dT = 110 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 15.7*2.6*110 / 0.3 | Answer: 14967 W

question: A surface of area 4.8 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 30 W/m^2-K to surroundings 35 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 4.8, h = 30, dT = 35 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 30*4.8*35 | Answer: 5040 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 250 m/min, feed = 0.22 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.7 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 250, f = 0.22, d = 1.7 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*250*0.22*1.7 | Answer: 93500 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 280 mm is turned at 1050 rpm with a feed of 0.32 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 280, N = 1050, f = 0.32 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 280 / (0.32*1050) | Answer: 0.8333 min

question: A resistor of 15 ohm carries a current of 9.5 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 15, I = 9.5 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 9.5 * 15 | Answer: 142.5 V

question: Three resistors 98 ohm, 96 ohm and 36 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 98, R2 = 96, R3 = 36 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 98 + 96 + 36 | Answer: 230 ohm

question: Two resistors 101 ohm and 49 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 101, R2 = 49 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 101*49 / (101+49) | Answer: 32.99 ohm

question: A device draws 7 A at 55 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 55, I = 7 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 55 * 7 | Answer: 385 W

question: A current of 2.6 A flows through a 73 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 2.6, R = 73 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (2.6)^2 * 73 | Answer: 493.5 W

question: Two capacitors 28 uF and 26.8 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 28, C2 = 26.8 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 28*26.8 / (28+26.8) | Answer: 13.69 uF

question: A resistor 15 kohm and capacitor 9 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 15, C = 9 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (15k)(9u) = 135 ms | Answer: 135 ms

question: An inductor 228.7 mH is in series with 131 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 228.7, R = 131 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (228.7e-3) / 131 | Answer: 1.746 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 90.3 mH inductor at 720 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 90.3, f = 720 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (720)(90.3e-3) | Answer: 408.5 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 26.2 uF capacitor at 850 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 26.2, f = 850 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (850)(26.2e-6)) | Answer: 7.147 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 7 ohm, XL = 16 ohm and XC = 106 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 7, XL = 16, XC = 106 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(7^2 + (16 - 106)^2) | Answer: 90.27 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 38.2 mH and C = 1.9 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 38.2, C = 1.9 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(38.2e-3 * 1.9e-6)) | Answer: 590.8 Hz

question: A capacitor of 19.1 uF is charged to 330 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 19.1, V = 330 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*19.1e-6*(330)^2 | Answer: 104 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 390 V with 380 primary turns and 320 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 390, N1 = 380, N2 = 320 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 390 * 320/380 | Answer: 328.4 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 430 V and draws an armature current of 37 A. If the armature resistance is 0.62 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 430, Ia = 37, Ra = 0.62 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 430 - 37*0.62 | Answer: 407.1 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 135 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.87. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 135, VL = 433, pf = 0.87 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*135*0.87 / 1000 | Answer: 88.08 kW

question: A load has real power 85 kW and apparent power 105 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 85, S = 105 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 85 / 105 | Answer: 0.8095

question: A machine delivers 20 kW output while drawing 197 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 20, Pi = 197 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 20/197 * 100 | Answer: 10.15 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 12 V across R1 = 32 ohm and R2 = 2 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 12, R1 = 32, R2 = 2 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 12*2 / (32+2) | Answer: 0.7059 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 30 kohm and Rin = 23 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 30, Rin = 23 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 30 / 23 | Answer: 1.304

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 20 kohm and Rg = 21 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 20, Rg = 21 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 20/21 | Answer: 1.952

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 5100. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 5100 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(5100) | Answer: 37.08 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.9 m carries a central point load of 65 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.9, W = 65 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 65*4.9 / 4 | Answer: 79.62 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.6 m carries a point load 30 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.6, W = 30 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 30*5.6 | Answer: 168 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 1.3 m carries a UDL of 36 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 1.3, w = 36 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 36*(1.3)^2 / 2 | Answer: 30.42 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.2 m carries a point load 80 kN at distance 2 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 7.2, a = 2, W = 80 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 80*(7.2 - 2) / 7.2 | Answer: 57.78 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 4.4 m) carries a central point load 70 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 440e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=70000 N, L=4400.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=440e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 11.29 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 310 mm, clear cover 40 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 310, c = 40, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 310 - 40 - 12/2 | Answer: 264 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 25.8 m^2 carrying a factored load of 9.7 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 25.8, w = 9.7 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 9.7 * 25.8 | Answer: 250.3 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 5.7 m, unit weight 20 kN/m^3, phi = 32 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 7.8e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.6, area = 3e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 7.8, i = 0.6, A = 3 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (7.8e-4)*0.6*(3e-3) | Answer: 1404 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1.4 m, bed slope 0.009 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.023. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.6 m under a head of 0.8 m. Taking Cd = 0.62 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 3 m wide carries a discharge of 23.8 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 780 m^3 treats a flow of 25 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 780, Q = 25 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 780 / 25 | Answer: 31.2 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 340 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.21 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 4 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 340, k = 0.21, t = 4 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 340*(1 - e^(-0.21*4)) | Answer: 193.2 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.78, rainfall intensity 45 mm/h over a catchment of 16.8 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.78, i = 45, A = 16.8 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.78*45*16.8 / 360 | Answer: 1.638 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.08 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 350 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.08, M = 350 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 350*(30+0.08)/30 | Answer: 350.9 m

question: Convert the decimal number 2316 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 2316 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 90C (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 01101000 and 01001101.
solution: XOR: 00100101 | Count of 1s = 3 | Answer: 3
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 770 megabits is sent over a link of 7 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 770, B = 7 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 770 / 7 | Answer: 110 s

question: A link has bandwidth 8 Mbps and round-trip time 120 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 8, R = 120 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 8e6 * 120e-3 bits = 960 kb | Answer: 960 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.8, cache access time 6 ns and main-memory access time 90 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.8, tc = 6, tm = 90 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.8*6 + (1 - 0.8)*90 | Answer: 22.8 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 691927 elements?
solution: Given: n = 691927 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(691927)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.007, memory access time 180 ns and page-fault service time 5 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 5 ms = 5000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.007)*180 + 0.007*5000000.0 ns | Answer: 35.18 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 0.3 m^3 at 150 kPa and 550 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 0.3, P = 150, Tk = 550 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (150e3)*0.3 / (8.314*550) | Answer: 9.841 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 9e10 /s and activation energy 50 kJ/mol at 450 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 9, Ea = 50, Tk = 450 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 9e10 * exp(-50e3 / (8.314*450)) | Answer: 141314 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.96 and bottoms xW = 0.03, with relative volatility alpha = 2.3. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.96, xw = 0.03, al = 2.3 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.96/0.04)(0.97/0.03)] / ln(2.3) | Answer: 7.989 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.62 and x = 0.49. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.62, x = 0.49 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.62/0.38) / (0.49/0.51) | Answer: 1.698

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.67 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 50 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.67, Psat = 50 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.67 * 50 | Answer: 33.5 kPa

question: A stream of 8.9 kg/s with specific heat 2.4 kJ/kg-K is heated through 55 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 8.9, cp = 2.4, dT = 55 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 8.9*2.4*55 | Answer: 1175 kW

question: A reactor of volume 18.4 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 2.4 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 18.4, Q = 2.4 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 18.4 / 2.4 | Answer: 7.667 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 6.6e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 4 mm with a concentration difference of 180 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 6.6, L = 4, dC = 180 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (6.6e-9)*180 / (4e-3) | Answer: 297 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 9.4 min and steady-state gain 2.8. For a step input of magnitude 6, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 9.4, K = 2.8, M = 6 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 2.8 * 6 | Answer: 16.8 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 95 m^2 flies at 80 m/s (air density 0.4 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.3. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 95, V = 80, rho = 0.4, CL = 1.3 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.4*(80)^2*95*1.3 / 1000 | Answer: 158.1 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 95 m^2 flies at 140 m/s (density 1 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.05. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 95, V = 140, rho = 1, CD = 0.05 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*1*(140)^2*95*0.05 / 1000 | Answer: 46.55 kN

question: A specimen under stress 110 MPa shows an elastic strain of 1.1e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 110, eps = 1.1 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 110 / (1.1e-3) MPa = 100 GPa | Answer: 100 GPa

question: A block of mass 14 kg has a volume of 1.5e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 14, V = 1.5 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 14 / (1.5e-3) | Answer: 9333 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2300 mm is heated through 65 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 11e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2300, dT = 65, al = 11 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2300*11e-6*65 | Answer: 1.645 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 80 ohm, R2 = 10 ohm and R3 = 405 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 80, R2 = 10, R3 = 405 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 10*405 / 80 | Answer: 50.62 ohm

question: A measurement reads 10.64 when the true value is 20. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 10.64, true = 20 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |10.64 - 20| / 20 * 100 | Answer: 46.8 %

question: Annual demand is 43500 units, ordering cost 120 per order and holding cost 30 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 43500, S = 120, H = 30 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*43500*120 / 30) | Answer: 589.9 units

question: An asset costs 270000 with salvage value 8000 after 18 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 270000, Sv = 8000, n = 18 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (270000 - 8000) / 18 | Answer: 14556 per year

question: A product sells for 300 per unit with variable cost 40 per unit and fixed costs 85000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 300, V = 40, F = 85000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 85000 / (300 - 40) | Answer: 326.9 units

question: Find the present worth of 35000 received 10 years from now at an interest rate of 11% per year.
solution: Given: F = 35000, n = 10, i = 11 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 35000 / (1 + 0.11)^10 | Answer: 12326 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.97, 0.92 and 0.94 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.97, r2 = 0.92, r3 = 0.94 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.97*0.92*0.94 | Answer: 0.8389

question: A process produces 29 defective items in a batch of 10000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 29, N = 10000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 29/10000 * 1e6 | Answer: 2900 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 2x^3 - x^2 + 8x - 8 evaluated at x = -2.
For f(x) = 3x^3 - 4x^2 + 5x + 2, find f''(x) at x = 3.
Evaluate the definite integral of (3x^2 + 6x - 1) dx from x = 0 to x = 6.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 3x^3/3 + 6x^2/2 + -1x | Evaluate F(6) - F(0) | Answer: 318
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 6x^2 + 2x = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[-5, 5], [3, -2]].
solution: Given: a = -5, b = 5, c = 3, d = -2 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (-5)(-2) - (5)(3) | Answer: -5

question: Find the determinant of [[-4, -6, -2], [5, 3, 1], [6, -5, 1]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 48

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[1, -2], [-3, 8]].
solution: Trace tr = 9, Determinant = 2 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 8.772

question: Solve for x: -3x + 4y = -6 and 3x + 2y = 4.
solution: Determinant = -3*2 - 4*3 = -18 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 1.556 | Answer: x = 1.556
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 76, 10, 28, 55, 70.
solution: Sum = 239 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 47.8 | Answer: 47.8

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 38, 45, 37, 13, 39.
solution: Mean = 34.4 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 12.36

question: Find the slope of the line through (-2, -4) and (5, 1).
solution: Given: x1 = -2, y1 = -4, x2 = 5, y2 = 1 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (1 - -4) / (5 - -2) | Answer: 0.7143

question: Find the distance between the points (-3, 1) and (-7, 6).
solution: Given: x1 = -3, y1 = 1, x2 = -7, y2 = 6 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((-4)^2 + (5)^2) | Answer: 6.403 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (6,0), (8,-5), (7,4).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 6.5 sq units

question: Find the 17th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -5 and common difference 0.
solution: Given: a = -5, d = 0, n = 17 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -5 + (17 - 1)*0 | Answer: -5

question: Find the sum of the first 39 terms of an AP with first term 14 and common difference 5.
solution: Given: a = 14, d = 5, n = 39 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 39/2 [2*14 + (39-1)*5] | Answer: 4251

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 26500 at 11.5% per annum for 2 years.
solution: Given: P = 26500, R = 11.5, Tt = 2 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 26500 * 11.5 * 2 / 100 | Answer: 6095 currency units

question: Find the amount when 29500 is invested at 10.2% per annum compounded annually for 2 years.
solution: Given: P = 29500, R = 10.2, Tt = 2 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 29500 * (1 + 10.2/100)^2 | Answer: 35825 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (-4, -5, 4) and (1, -7, 8).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (3, 2, 6) and (2, -6, 2).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 46.04

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (-3, 0, -2) and (-4, -3, -5).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 30.35 degrees

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number 5 + 2i.
solution: Given: a = 5, b = 2 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(2, 5) | Answer: 21.8 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = 4x^3 + 5x^2 + 8x at x = -5.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-78 with initial guess x0=5, find x1 (one iteration).
solution: Given: N = 78, x0 = 5 | Formula: x1 = x0 - (x0^2 - N)/(2 x0) | Substitute: x1 = 5 - ((5)^2 - 78)/(2*5) | Answer: 10.3

question: Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.6 and ordinates 3, 18, 16, 6, 15, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 599 and 346.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 599 and 346 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 52 and 28.
solution: Given: a = 52, b = 28 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 52*28 / 4 | Answer: 364
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 56 mm carries an axial tensile load of 112 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 39 mm and length 2500 mm carries an axial load of 43 kN. Take E = 70 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 59 mm transmits a torque of 850 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 59, Tt = 850 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(850*1000) / (pi*(59)^3) | Answer: 21.08 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 69 mm and length 1500 mm carries a torque of 900 N-m. With G = 77 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (69)^4 / 32 = 2225339 mm^4 | theta = (900*1000)(1500) / (77000 * 2225339) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.4514 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 140 mm wide and 100 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
