question: Two resistors 104 ohm and 91 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 104, R2 = 91 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 104*91 / (104+91) | Answer: 48.53 ohm

question: A device draws 14.6 A at 155 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 155, I = 14.6 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 155 * 14.6 | Answer: 2263 W

question: A current of 0.9 A flows through a 99 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 0.9, R = 99 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (0.9)^2 * 99 | Answer: 80.19 W

question: Two capacitors 47.1 uF and 36.9 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 47.1, C2 = 36.9 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 47.1*36.9 / (47.1+36.9) | Answer: 20.69 uF

question: A resistor 17 kohm and capacitor 11.4 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 17, C = 11.4 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (17k)(11.4u) = 193.8 ms | Answer: 193.8 ms

question: An inductor 400.9 mH is in series with 144 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 400.9, R = 144 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (400.9e-3) / 144 | Answer: 2.784 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 82.1 mH inductor at 180 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 82.1, f = 180 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (180)(82.1e-3) | Answer: 92.85 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 28.6 uF capacitor at 550 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 28.6, f = 550 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (550)(28.6e-6)) | Answer: 10.12 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 59 ohm, XL = 38 ohm and XC = 59 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 59, XL = 38, XC = 59 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(59^2 + (38 - 59)^2) | Answer: 62.63 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 28.4 mH and C = 1.3 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 28.4, C = 1.3 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(28.4e-3 * 1.3e-6)) | Answer: 828.3 Hz

question: A capacitor of 65.8 uF is charged to 160 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 65.8, V = 160 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*65.8e-6*(160)^2 | Answer: 842.2 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 370 V with 640 primary turns and 370 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 370, N1 = 640, N2 = 370 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 370 * 370/640 | Answer: 213.9 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 320 V and draws an armature current of 44 A. If the armature resistance is 0.47 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 320, Ia = 44, Ra = 0.47 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 320 - 44*0.47 | Answer: 299.3 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 70 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.78. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 70, VL = 415, pf = 0.78 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*70*0.78 / 1000 | Answer: 39.25 kW

question: A load has real power 125 kW and apparent power 190 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 125, S = 190 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 125 / 190 | Answer: 0.6579

question: A machine delivers 55 kW output while drawing 212 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 55, Pi = 212 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 55/212 * 100 | Answer: 25.94 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 12 V across R1 = 8 ohm and R2 = 5 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 12, R1 = 8, R2 = 5 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 12*5 / (8+5) | Answer: 4.615 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 50 kohm and Rin = 22 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 50, Rin = 22 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 50 / 22 | Answer: 2.273

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 70 kohm and Rg = 2 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 70, Rg = 2 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 70/2 | Answer: 36

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 4722. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 4722 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(4722) | Answer: 36.74 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 8.8 m carries a central point load of 70 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.8, W = 70 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 70*8.8 / 4 | Answer: 154 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 8.2 m carries a UDL of 20 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.2, w = 20 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 20*(8.2)^2 / 8 | Answer: 168.1 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.9 m carries a point load 40 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.9, W = 40 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 40*5.9 | Answer: 236 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 3 m carries a UDL of 20 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3, w = 20 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 20*(3)^2 / 2 | Answer: 90 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.2 m carries a point load 65 kN at distance 3.6 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 9.2, a = 3.6, W = 65 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 65*(9.2 - 3.6) / 9.2 | Answer: 39.57 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 4.2 m) carries a central point load 75 kN. With E = 30 GPa and I = 400e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=75000 N, L=4200.0 mm, E=30000 MPa, I=400e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 9.647 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 4.3 m carries a UDL of 15 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.3, w = 15 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 15*(4.3)^2 / 12 | Answer: 23.11 kN-m

question: A column supports a floor area of 36.1 m^2 carrying a factored load of 8.2 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 36.1, w = 8.2 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 8.2 * 36.1 | Answer: 296 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 4.8 m, unit weight 18 kN/m^3, phi = 36 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 5.7e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.8, area = 7.4e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 5.7, i = 0.8, A = 7.4 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (5.7e-4)*0.8*(7.4e-3) | Answer: 3374 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.5 m, bed slope 0.006 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.019. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4 m under a head of 1.1 m. Taking Cd = 0.6 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
solution: Given: L = 4, H = 1.1, cd = 0.6 | Formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2) | Substitute: Q = (2/3)*0.6*sqrt(2*9.81)*4*(1.1)^1.5 | Answer: 8.176 m^3/s
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 2.2 m wide carries a discharge of 19.4 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 580 m^3 treats a flow of 95 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 580, Q = 95 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 580 / 95 | Answer: 6.105 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 310 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.24 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 3 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 310, k = 0.24, t = 3 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 310*(1 - e^(-0.24*3)) | Answer: 159.1 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.35, rainfall intensity 30 mm/h over a catchment of 16 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.35, i = 30, A = 16 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.35*30*16 / 360 | Answer: 0.4667 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.01 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 710 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.01, M = 710 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 710*(30+0.01)/30 | Answer: 710.2 m

question: Convert the decimal number 82 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 82 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 52 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10110010 and 00100011.
solution: XOR: 10010001 | Count of 1s = 3 | Answer: 3
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 240 megabits is sent over a link of 71 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 240, B = 71 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 240 / 71 | Answer: 3.38 s

question: A link has bandwidth 89 Mbps and round-trip time 30 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 89, R = 30 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 89e6 * 30e-3 bits = 2670 kb | Answer: 2670 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.97, cache access time 3 ns and main-memory access time 60 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.97, tc = 3, tm = 60 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.97*3 + (1 - 0.97)*60 | Answer: 4.71 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 282346 elements?
solution: Given: n = 282346 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(282346)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.015, memory access time 130 ns and page-fault service time 5 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 5 ms = 5000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.015)*130 + 0.015*5000000.0 ns | Answer: 75.13 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 1 m^3 at 150 kPa and 350 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 1, P = 150, Tk = 350 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (150e3)*1 / (8.314*350) | Answer: 51.55 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.29 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 11 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.29, t = 11 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.29*11) | Answer: 0.9588

question: For a reaction with A = 4e10 /s and activation energy 65 kJ/mol at 310 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 4, Ea = 65, Tk = 310 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 4e10 * exp(-65e3 / (8.314*310)) | Answer: 0.4459 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.98 and bottoms xW = 0.09, with relative volatility alpha = 3.4. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.98, xw = 0.09, al = 3.4 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.98/0.02)(0.91/0.09)] / ln(3.4) | Answer: 5.071 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.74 and x = 0.46. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.74, x = 0.46 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.74/0.26) / (0.46/0.54) | Answer: 3.341

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.51 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 45 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.51, Psat = 45 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.51 * 45 | Answer: 22.95 kPa

question: A stream of 7.3 kg/s with specific heat 1.9 kJ/kg-K is heated through 65 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 7.3, cp = 1.9, dT = 65 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 7.3*1.9*65 | Answer: 901.5 kW

question: A reactor of volume 12.9 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 1.2 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 12.9, Q = 1.2 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 12.9 / 1.2 | Answer: 10.75 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 4.2e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 2 mm with a concentration difference of 190 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 4.2, L = 2, dC = 190 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (4.2e-9)*190 / (2e-3) | Answer: 399 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 3.6 min and steady-state gain 1.9. For a step input of magnitude 9, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 3.6, K = 1.9, M = 9 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 1.9 * 9 | Answer: 17.1 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 55 m^2 flies at 150 m/s (air density 1.225 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.5. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 55, V = 150, rho = 1.225, CL = 0.5 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1.225*(150)^2*55*0.5 / 1000 | Answer: 379 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 100 m^2 flies at 190 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.08. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 100, V = 190, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.08 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(190)^2*100*0.08 / 1000 | Answer: 57.76 kN

question: A specimen under stress 380 MPa shows an elastic strain of 0.9e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 380, eps = 0.9 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 380 / (0.9e-3) MPa = 422.2 GPa | Answer: 422.2 GPa

question: A block of mass 37 kg has a volume of 1.6e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 37, V = 1.6 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 37 / (1.6e-3) | Answer: 23125 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 600 mm is heated through 55 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 11e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 600, dT = 55, al = 11 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 600*11e-6*55 | Answer: 0.363 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 80 ohm, R2 = 95 ohm and R3 = 495 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 80, R2 = 95, R3 = 495 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 95*495 / 80 | Answer: 587.8 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.92 when the true value is 100. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.92, true = 100 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.92 - 100| / 100 * 100 | Answer: 90.08 %

question: Annual demand is 48000 units, ordering cost 130 per order and holding cost 23 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 48000, S = 130, H = 23 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*48000*130 / 23) | Answer: 736.6 units

question: An asset costs 240000 with salvage value 34000 after 10 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 240000, Sv = 34000, n = 10 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (240000 - 34000) / 10 | Answer: 20600 per year

question: A product sells for 210 per unit with variable cost 160 per unit and fixed costs 155000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 210, V = 160, F = 155000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 155000 / (210 - 160) | Answer: 3100 units

question: Find the present worth of 80000 received 4 years from now at an interest rate of 7% per year.
solution: Given: F = 80000, n = 4, i = 7 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 80000 / (1 + 0.07)^4 | Answer: 61032 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.91, 0.99 and 0.9 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.91, r2 = 0.99, r3 = 0.9 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.91*0.99*0.9 | Answer: 0.8108

question: A process produces 3 defective items in a batch of 16500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 3, N = 16500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 3/16500 * 1e6 | Answer: 181.8 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = -x^3 - 2x^2 + 4x + 9 evaluated at x = -4.
For f(x) = -5x^3 + 7x + 8, find f''(x) at x = -5.
Evaluate the definite integral of (3x^2 + 6x + 4) dx from x = -4 to x = 4.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 3x^3/3 + 6x^2/2 + 4x | Evaluate F(4) - F(-4) | Answer: 160
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 6x^2 + 8x - 5 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[9, -7], [-6, 3]].
solution: Given: a = 9, b = -7, c = -6, d = 3 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (9)(3) - (-7)(-6) | Answer: -15

question: Find the determinant of [[-3, -1, -3], [4, 0, 3], [-5, -2, 5]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 41

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[0, -6], [-3, 6]].
solution: Trace tr = 6, Determinant = -18 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 8.196

question: Solve for x: -1x + -5y = -11 and 6x + -2y = -10.
solution: Determinant = -1*-2 - -5*6 = 32 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -0.875 | Answer: x = -0.875
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 78, 52, 73, 2, 83.
solution: Sum = 288 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 57.6 | Answer: 57.6

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 25, 15, 35, 30, 3.
solution: Mean = 21.6 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 12.76

question: Find the slope of the line through (6, -9) and (-2, 5).
solution: Given: x1 = 6, y1 = -9, x2 = -2, y2 = 5 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (5 - -9) / (-2 - 6) | Answer: -1.75

question: Find the distance between the points (-5, -5) and (4, 0).
solution: Given: x1 = -5, y1 = -5, x2 = 4, y2 = 0 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((9)^2 + (5)^2) | Answer: 10.3 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-4,-2), (1,0), (-6,-8).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 13 sq units

question: Find the 23th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 11 and common difference 3.
solution: Given: a = 11, d = 3, n = 23 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 11 + (23 - 1)*3 | Answer: 77

question: Find the sum of the first 20 terms of an AP with first term 2 and common difference 1.
solution: Given: a = 2, d = 1, n = 20 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 20/2 [2*2 + (20-1)*1] | Answer: 230

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 8000 at 13.7% per annum for 1 years.
solution: Given: P = 8000, R = 13.7, Tt = 1 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 8000 * 13.7 * 1 / 100 | Answer: 1096 currency units

question: Find the amount when 17000 is invested at 4.5% per annum compounded annually for 4 years.
solution: Given: P = 17000, R = 4.5, Tt = 4 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 17000 * (1 + 4.5/100)^4 | Answer: 20273 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (4, -6, 5) and (5, -2, -6).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (3, 1, -4) and (-6, -6, 6).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 22.45

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (5, -4, -6) and (-6, -6, 1).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 99.21 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -3x^3 + 5x^2 + x + 5 at x = 0.
solution: Given: a = -3, b = 5, c = 1, d = 5, x0 = 0 | Formula: f(x0) = a x0^3 + b x0^2 + c x0 + d | Substitute: f(0) = -3(0)^3 + 5(0)^2 + 1(0) + 5 | Answer: 5

question: Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-157 with initial guess x0=8, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=0.9 and ordinates 4, 10, 5, 5, 13, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 29 and 525.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 29 and 525 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 58 and 16.
solution: Given: a = 58, b = 16 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 58*16 / 2 | Answer: 464
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 60 mm carries an axial tensile load of 111 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 35 mm and length 3000 mm carries an axial load of 54 kN. Take E = 200 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 43 mm transmits a torque of 1600 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 43, Tt = 1600 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(1600*1000) / (pi*(43)^3) | Answer: 102.5 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 64 mm and length 900 mm carries a torque of 1300 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (64)^4 / 32 = 1647099 mm^4 | theta = (1300*1000)(900) / (80000 * 1647099) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.5087 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 124 mm wide and 230 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 124, h = 230 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 124*(230)^2 / 6 | Answer: 1093267 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (43 mm x 220 mm) carries a bending moment of 5 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (42 mm x 100 mm) has effective length 3700 mm and E = 200 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 660 MPa is designed for a working stress of 90 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 660, sw = 90 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 660 / 90 | Answer: 7.333

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 950 mm and wall thickness 15 mm carries an internal pressure of 2.7 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 950, t = 15, P = 2.7 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 2.7*950 / (2*15) | Answer: 85.5 MPa

question: 7.7 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 140 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 7.7, dT = 140 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 7.7 * 0.718 * 140 | Answer: 774 kJ

question: 6.8 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 90 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.8, dT = 90 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 6.8 * 1.005 * 90 | Answer: 615.1 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1.7 m^3 at 600 K with mass 4.5 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1.7, Tk = 600, m = 4.5 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 4.5*0.287*600 / 1.7 | Answer: 455.8 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 3.8 kg of air expands isothermally at 340 K from volume V1 to 3*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.8, Tk = 340, ratio = 3 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 3.8*0.287*340*ln(3) | Answer: 407.4 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.37 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.8, D = 0.37 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.8*0.37 / 0.001 | Answer: 1406000

question: Water flows at 0.7 m/s through a pipe of diameter 260 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
In a pipe (diameter 270 mm) water flows at 0.8 m/s. It contracts to diameter 50 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 270, d2 = 50, V1 = 0.8 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 0.8*(270/50)^2 | Answer: 23.33 m/s

question: Water flows at 1 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.38 m and length 180 m. With friction factor f = 0.04, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 18 teeth drives a gear of 96 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1000 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 18, z2 = 96, N1 = 1000 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1000*18 / 96 | Answer: 187.5 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 190 mm rotates at 350 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 190, N = 350 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.19)*350 / 60 | Answer: 3.482 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 45.5 kW at 850 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 45.5, N = 850 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(45.5*1000) / (2*pi*850) | Answer: 511.2 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 2.2 kg rotates at radius 0.15 m at 200 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 11200 N/m and mass 5.8 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 11200, m = 5.8 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(11200/5.8) | Answer: 6.994 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 4 m^2 and thickness 0.29 m has conductivity k = 16.4 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 70 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 4, L = 0.29, k = 16.4, dT = 70 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 16.4*4*70 / 0.29 | Answer: 15834 W

question: A surface of area 3.5 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 125 W/m^2-K to surroundings 55 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 3.5, h = 125, dT = 55 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 125*3.5*55 | Answer: 24062 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 210 m/min, feed = 0.37 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.9 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 210, f = 0.37, d = 1.9 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*210*0.37*1.9 | Answer: 147630 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 200 mm is turned at 650 rpm with a feed of 0.22 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 200, N = 650, f = 0.22 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 200 / (0.22*650) | Answer: 1.399 min

question: A resistor of 138 ohm carries a current of 0.2 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 138, I = 0.2 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 0.2 * 138 | Answer: 27.6 V

question: Three resistors 77 ohm, 73 ohm and 52 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 77, R2 = 73, R3 = 52 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 77 + 73 + 52 | Answer: 202 ohm

question: Two resistors 116 ohm and 62 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 116, R2 = 62 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 116*62 / (116+62) | Answer: 40.4 ohm

question: A device draws 11.3 A at 165 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 165, I = 11.3 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 165 * 11.3 | Answer: 1865 W

question: A current of 2.2 A flows through a 143 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 2.2, R = 143 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (2.2)^2 * 143 | Answer: 692.1 W

question: Two capacitors 11.9 uF and 17.5 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 11.9, C2 = 17.5 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 11.9*17.5 / (11.9+17.5) | Answer: 7.083 uF

question: A resistor 90 kohm and capacitor 8 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 90, C = 8 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (90k)(8u) = 720 ms | Answer: 720 ms

question: An inductor 271.4 mH is in series with 46 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 271.4, R = 46 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (271.4e-3) / 46 | Answer: 5.9 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 153.3 mH inductor at 700 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 153.3, f = 700 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (700)(153.3e-3) | Answer: 674.2 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 11.6 uF capacitor at 950 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 11.6, f = 950 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (950)(11.6e-6)) | Answer: 14.44 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 8 ohm, XL = 119 ohm and XC = 128 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 8, XL = 119, XC = 128 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(8^2 + (119 - 128)^2) | Answer: 12.04 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 24.8 mH and C = 2.7 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 24.8, C = 2.7 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(24.8e-3 * 2.7e-6)) | Answer: 615.1 Hz

question: A capacitor of 2.8 uF is charged to 35 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 2.8, V = 35 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*2.8e-6*(35)^2 | Answer: 1.715 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 410 V with 540 primary turns and 480 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 410, N1 = 540, N2 = 480 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 410 * 480/540 | Answer: 364.4 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 420 V and draws an armature current of 55 A. If the armature resistance is 0.18 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 420, Ia = 55, Ra = 0.18 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 420 - 55*0.18 | Answer: 410.1 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 35 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.74. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 35, VL = 415, pf = 0.74 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*35*0.74 / 1000 | Answer: 18.62 kW

question: A load has real power 35 kW and apparent power 140 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 35, S = 140 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 35 / 140 | Answer: 0.25

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 11 V across R1 = 25 ohm and R2 = 22 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 11, R1 = 25, R2 = 22 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 11*22 / (25+22) | Answer: 5.149 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 140 kohm and Rin = 8 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 140, Rin = 8 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 140 / 8 | Answer: 17.5

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 160 kohm and Rg = 2 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 160, Rg = 2 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 160/2 | Answer: 81

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 5557. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 5557 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(5557) | Answer: 37.45 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 4 m carries a central point load of 45 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4, W = 45 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 45*4 / 4 | Answer: 45 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.2 m carries a UDL of 50 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 7.2, w = 50 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 50*(7.2)^2 / 8 | Answer: 324 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.5 m carries a UDL of 38 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.5, w = 38 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 38*(5.5)^2 / 2 | Answer: 574.8 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.4 m carries a point load 75 kN at distance 1.6 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 4.4, a = 1.6, W = 75 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 75*(4.4 - 1.6) / 4.4 | Answer: 47.73 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 6 m) carries a central point load 10 kN. With E = 30 GPa and I = 310e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=10000 N, L=6000.0 mm, E=30000 MPa, I=310e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 4.839 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 310 mm, clear cover 45 mm and main bars of diameter 20 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 310, c = 45, dia = 20 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 310 - 45 - 20/2 | Answer: 255 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 39.8 m^2 carrying a factored load of 11 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 39.8, w = 11 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 11 * 39.8 | Answer: 437.8 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 3.1 m, unit weight 18 kN/m^3, phi = 33 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 7.6e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.2, area = 7.2e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 7.6, i = 0.2, A = 7.2 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (7.6e-4)*0.2*(7.2e-3) | Answer: 1094 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 2.5 m, bed slope 0.009 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.026. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.1 m under a head of 0.5 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 2.7 m wide carries a discharge of 18.4 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 360 m^3 treats a flow of 200 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 360, Q = 200 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 360 / 200 | Answer: 1.8 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 340 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.32 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 7 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 340, k = 0.32, t = 7 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 340*(1 - e^(-0.32*7)) | Answer: 303.8 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.8, rainfall intensity 55 mm/h over a catchment of 20.7 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.8, i = 55, A = 20.7 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.8*55*20.7 / 360 | Answer: 2.53 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.04 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 480 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.04, M = 480 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 480*(20+0.04)/20 | Answer: 481 m

question: Convert the decimal number 974 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 974 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 3CE (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 01000110 and 00101100.
solution: XOR: 01101010 | Count of 1s = 4 | Answer: 4
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 830 megabits is sent over a link of 79 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 830, B = 79 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 830 / 79 | Answer: 10.51 s

question: A link has bandwidth 42 Mbps and round-trip time 80 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 42, R = 80 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 42e6 * 80e-3 bits = 3360 kb | Answer: 3360 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.84, cache access time 10 ns and main-memory access time 70 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.84, tc = 10, tm = 70 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.84*10 + (1 - 0.84)*70 | Answer: 19.6 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 120902 elements?
solution: Given: n = 120902 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(120902)) + 1 | Answer: 17

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.015, memory access time 200 ns and page-fault service time 7 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 7 ms = 7000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.015)*200 + 0.015*7000000.0 ns | Answer: 105.2 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 1.1 m^3 at 470 kPa and 330 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 1.1, P = 470, Tk = 330 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (470e3)*1.1 / (8.314*330) | Answer: 188.4 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.3 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 16 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.3, t = 16 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.3*16) | Answer: 0.9918

question: For a reaction with A = 7e10 /s and activation energy 70 kJ/mol at 300 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 7, Ea = 70, Tk = 300 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 7e10 * exp(-70e3 / (8.314*300)) | Answer: 0.04535 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.91 and bottoms xW = 0.03, with relative volatility alpha = 2.8. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.91, xw = 0.03, al = 2.8 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.91/0.09)(0.97/0.03)] / ln(2.8) | Answer: 5.623 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.68 and x = 0.29. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.68, x = 0.29 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.68/0.32) / (0.29/0.71) | Answer: 5.203

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.79 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 80 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.79, Psat = 80 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.79 * 80 | Answer: 63.2 kPa

question: A stream of 1.2 kg/s with specific heat 3.4 kJ/kg-K is heated through 55 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 1.2, cp = 3.4, dT = 55 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 1.2*3.4*55 | Answer: 224.4 kW

question: A reactor of volume 17.3 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 3.4 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 17.3, Q = 3.4 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 17.3 / 3.4 | Answer: 5.088 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 7.7e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 2 mm with a concentration difference of 100 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 7.7, L = 2, dC = 100 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (7.7e-9)*100 / (2e-3) | Answer: 385 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 1.3 min and steady-state gain 2.9. For a step input of magnitude 2, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 1.3, K = 2.9, M = 2 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 2.9 * 2 | Answer: 5.8 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 45 m^2 flies at 80 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.8. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 45, V = 80, rho = 0.7, CL = 0.8 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.7*(80)^2*45*0.8 / 1000 | Answer: 80.64 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 15 m^2 flies at 260 m/s (density 1.225 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.09. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 15, V = 260, rho = 1.225, CD = 0.09 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*1.225*(260)^2*15*0.09 / 1000 | Answer: 55.9 kN

question: A block of mass 32 kg has a volume of 3.3e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 32, V = 3.3 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 32 / (3.3e-3) | Answer: 9697 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 1400 mm is heated through 25 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 12e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 1400, dT = 25, al = 12 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 1400*12e-6*25 | Answer: 0.42 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 195 ohm, R2 = 25 ohm and R3 = 250 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 195, R2 = 25, R3 = 250 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 25*250 / 195 | Answer: 32.05 ohm

question: A measurement reads 10.76 when the true value is 100. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 10.76, true = 100 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |10.76 - 100| / 100 * 100 | Answer: 89.24 %

question: Annual demand is 12000 units, ordering cost 70 per order and holding cost 6 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 12000, S = 70, H = 6 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*12000*70 / 6) | Answer: 529.2 units

question: An asset costs 160000 with salvage value 30000 after 14 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 160000, Sv = 30000, n = 14 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (160000 - 30000) / 14 | Answer: 9286 per year

question: A product sells for 210 per unit with variable cost 20 per unit and fixed costs 170000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 210, V = 20, F = 170000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 170000 / (210 - 20) | Answer: 894.7 units

question: Find the present worth of 40000 received 9 years from now at an interest rate of 7% per year.
solution: Given: F = 40000, n = 9, i = 7 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 40000 / (1 + 0.07)^9 | Answer: 21757 currency units

question: A process produces 3 defective items in a batch of 20000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 3, N = 20000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 3/20000 * 1e6 | Answer: 150 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 4x^3 + 2x^2 + 3x - 5 evaluated at x = 5.
For f(x) = 6x^3 - 2x^2 - x + 2, find f''(x) at x = 1.
Evaluate the definite integral of (3x^2 + 5x + 5) dx from x = -1 to x = 5.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 3x^3/3 + 5x^2/2 + 5x | Evaluate F(5) - F(-1) | Answer: 216
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 6x^2 + 3x - 7 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[7, 2], [8, 2]].
solution: Given: a = 7, b = 2, c = 8, d = 2 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (7)(2) - (2)(8) | Answer: -2

question: Find the determinant of [[2, 5, -6], [3, -5, -1], [3, 3, -5]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -28

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[-8, -8], [-3, 2]].
solution: Trace tr = -6, Determinant = -40 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 4

question: Solve for x: 1x + 2y = 1 and 6x + 1y = -10.
solution: Determinant = 1*1 - 2*6 = -11 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -1.909 | Answer: x = -1.909
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 12, 96, 38, 28, 57.
solution: Sum = 231 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 46.2 | Answer: 46.2

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 2, 10, 28, 30, 15.
solution: Mean = 17 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 11.92

question: Find the slope of the line through (7, 0) and (-6, -2).
solution: Given: x1 = 7, y1 = 0, x2 = -6, y2 = -2 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (-2 - 0) / (-6 - 7) | Answer: 0.1538

question: Find the distance between the points (-7, 5) and (-4, 9).
solution: Given: x1 = -7, y1 = 5, x2 = -4, y2 = 9 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((3)^2 + (4)^2) | Answer: 5 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (1,-4), (-3,-3), (-5,-4).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 3 sq units

question: Find the 19th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -16 and common difference 8.
solution: Given: a = -16, d = 8, n = 19 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -16 + (19 - 1)*8 | Answer: 128

question: Find the sum of the first 38 terms of an AP with first term 6 and common difference 6.
solution: Given: a = 6, d = 6, n = 38 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 38/2 [2*6 + (38-1)*6] | Answer: 4446

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 15000 at 9.6% per annum for 6 years.
solution: Given: P = 15000, R = 9.6, Tt = 6 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 15000 * 9.6 * 6 / 100 | Answer: 8640 currency units

question: Find the amount when 31000 is invested at 10.1% per annum compounded annually for 5 years.
solution: Given: P = 31000, R = 10.1, Tt = 5 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 31000 * (1 + 10.1/100)^5 | Answer: 50153 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (0, -5, -5) and (4, 1, -6).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (6, -3, 6) and (-6, -1, -2).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 36

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (3, -1, 4) and (-2, -3, 3).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 67.89 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = 3x^3 + 3x^2 + 4x + 1 at x = 2.
solution: Given: a = 3, b = 3, c = 4, d = 1, x0 = 2 | Formula: f(x0) = a x0^3 + b x0^2 + c x0 + d | Substitute: f(2) = 3(2)^3 + 3(2)^2 + 4(2) + 1 | Answer: 45

question: Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-174 with initial guess x0=7, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.2 and ordinates 1, 20, 1, 1, 9, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 324 and 175.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 324 and 175 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 78 and 73.
solution: Given: a = 78, b = 73 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 78*73 / 1 | Answer: 5694
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 15 mm carries an axial tensile load of 100 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 38 mm and length 2300 mm carries an axial load of 25 kN. Take E = 210 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 26 mm transmits a torque of 1250 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 26, Tt = 1250 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(1250*1000) / (pi*(26)^3) | Answer: 362.2 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 62 mm and length 900 mm carries a torque of 500 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (62)^4 / 32 = 1450663 mm^4 | theta = (500*1000)(900) / (80000 * 1450663) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.2222 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 99 mm wide and 270 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 99, h = 270 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 99*(270)^2 / 6 | Answer: 1202850 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (67 mm x 90 mm) carries a bending moment of 3 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (53 mm x 160 mm) has effective length 2500 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 440 MPa is designed for a working stress of 100 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 440, sw = 100 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 440 / 100 | Answer: 4.4

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 400 mm and wall thickness 16 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.7 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 400, t = 16, P = 1.7 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.7*400 / (2*16) | Answer: 21.25 MPa

question: 1.4 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 165 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.4, dT = 165 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 1.4 * 0.718 * 165 | Answer: 165.9 kJ

question: 5.6 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 105 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 5.6, dT = 105 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 5.6 * 1.005 * 105 | Answer: 590.9 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1 m^3 at 390 K with mass 5.1 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1, Tk = 390, m = 5.1 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 5.1*0.287*390 / 1 | Answer: 570.8 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 2 kg of air expands isothermally at 330 K from volume V1 to 2*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2, Tk = 330, ratio = 2 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 2*0.287*330*ln(2) | Answer: 131.3 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 1.6 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.21 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 1.6, D = 0.21 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*1.6*0.21 / 0.001 | Answer: 336000

question: Water flows at 2.2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 110 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
In a pipe (diameter 340 mm) water flows at 1.7 m/s. It contracts to diameter 110 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
Water flows at 3.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.3 m and length 290 m. With friction factor f = 0.026, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 37 teeth drives a gear of 62 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1200 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 37, z2 = 62, N1 = 1200 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1200*37 / 62 | Answer: 716.1 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 550 mm rotates at 1500 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 550, N = 1500 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.55)*1500 / 60 | Answer: 43.2 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 49.5 kW at 850 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 49.5, N = 850 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(49.5*1000) / (2*pi*850) | Answer: 556.1 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 5.3 kg rotates at radius 0.3 m at 450 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 3100 N/m and mass 11 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 3100, m = 11 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(3100/11) | Answer: 2.672 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 8.9 m^2 and thickness 0.14 m has conductivity k = 16.1 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 165 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 8.9, L = 0.14, k = 16.1, dT = 165 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 16.1*8.9*165 / 0.14 | Answer: 168878 W

question: A surface of area 1.3 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 40 W/m^2-K to surroundings 80 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 1.3, h = 40, dT = 80 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 40*1.3*80 | Answer: 4160 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 210 m/min, feed = 0.11 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.2 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 210, f = 0.11, d = 1.2 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*210*0.11*1.2 | Answer: 27720 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 120 mm is turned at 800 rpm with a feed of 0.15 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 120, N = 800, f = 0.15 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 120 / (0.15*800) | Answer: 1 min

question: A resistor of 12 ohm carries a current of 6.9 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 12, I = 6.9 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 6.9 * 12 | Answer: 82.8 V

question: Three resistors 62 ohm, 62 ohm and 10 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 62, R2 = 62, R3 = 10 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 62 + 62 + 10 | Answer: 134 ohm

question: Two resistors 41 ohm and 118 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 41, R2 = 118 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 41*118 / (41+118) | Answer: 30.43 ohm

question: A device draws 2.2 A at 215 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 215, I = 2.2 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 215 * 2.2 | Answer: 473 W

question: A current of 2.1 A flows through a 55 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 2.1, R = 55 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (2.1)^2 * 55 | Answer: 242.6 W

question: Two capacitors 4.7 uF and 21.5 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 4.7, C2 = 21.5 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 4.7*21.5 / (4.7+21.5) | Answer: 3.857 uF

question: A resistor 60 kohm and capacitor 10.4 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 60, C = 10.4 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (60k)(10.4u) = 624 ms | Answer: 624 ms

question: An inductor 167.5 mH is in series with 175 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 167.5, R = 175 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (167.5e-3) / 175 | Answer: 0.9571 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 106 mH inductor at 290 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 106, f = 290 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (290)(106e-3) | Answer: 193.1 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 42.7 uF capacitor at 660 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 42.7, f = 660 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (660)(42.7e-6)) | Answer: 5.647 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 99 ohm, XL = 74 ohm and XC = 96 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 99, XL = 74, XC = 96 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(99^2 + (74 - 96)^2) | Answer: 101.4 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 87.3 mH and C = 1.1 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 87.3, C = 1.1 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(87.3e-3 * 1.1e-6)) | Answer: 513.6 Hz

question: A capacitor of 56.4 uF is charged to 215 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 56.4, V = 215 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*56.4e-6*(215)^2 | Answer: 1304 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 370 V with 960 primary turns and 330 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 370, N1 = 960, N2 = 330 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 370 * 330/960 | Answer: 127.2 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 330 V and draws an armature current of 8 A. If the armature resistance is 0.55 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 330, Ia = 8, Ra = 0.55 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 330 - 8*0.55 | Answer: 325.6 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 105 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.76. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 105, VL = 415, pf = 0.76 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*105*0.76 / 1000 | Answer: 57.36 kW

question: A load has real power 145 kW and apparent power 175 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 145, S = 175 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 145 / 175 | Answer: 0.8286

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 17 V across R1 = 45 ohm and R2 = 23 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 17, R1 = 45, R2 = 23 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 17*23 / (45+23) | Answer: 5.75 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 60 kohm and Rin = 19 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 60, Rin = 19 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 60 / 19 | Answer: 3.158

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 150 kohm and Rg = 4 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 150, Rg = 4 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 150/4 | Answer: 38.5

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 6477. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 6477 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(6477) | Answer: 38.11 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 3.7 m carries a central point load of 115 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.7, W = 115 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 115*3.7 / 4 | Answer: 106.4 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 3.5 m carries a UDL of 30 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.5, w = 30 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 30*(3.5)^2 / 8 | Answer: 45.94 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.2 m carries a UDL of 28 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.2, w = 28 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 28*(2.2)^2 / 2 | Answer: 67.76 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 8.4 m carries a point load 30 kN at distance 3.4 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 8.4, a = 3.4, W = 30 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 30*(8.4 - 3.4) / 8.4 | Answer: 17.86 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 3.1 m) carries a central point load 75 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 480e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=75000 N, L=3100.0 mm, E=200000 MPa, I=480e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 0.4849 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 4.2 m carries a UDL of 36 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.2, w = 36 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 36*(4.2)^2 / 12 | Answer: 52.92 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 400 mm, clear cover 45 mm and main bars of diameter 25 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 400, c = 45, dia = 25 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 400 - 45 - 25/2 | Answer: 342.5 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 16.4 m^2 carrying a factored load of 19.3 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 16.4, w = 19.3 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 19.3 * 16.4 | Answer: 316.5 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 3.7 m, unit weight 18 kN/m^3, phi = 30 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 1.1e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.6, area = 6e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 1.1, i = 0.6, A = 6 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (1.1e-4)*0.6*(6e-3) | Answer: 396 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 2.2 m, bed slope 0.004 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.015. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 3.6 m under a head of 1.1 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.5 m wide carries a discharge of 14.4 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 160 m^3 treats a flow of 150 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 160, Q = 150 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 160 / 150 | Answer: 1.067 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 320 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.3 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 3 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 320, k = 0.3, t = 3 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 320*(1 - e^(-0.3*3)) | Answer: 189.9 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.86, rainfall intensity 45 mm/h over a catchment of 42 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.86, i = 45, A = 42 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.86*45*42 / 360 | Answer: 4.515 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.02 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 600 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.02, M = 600 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 600*(30+0.02)/30 | Answer: 600.4 m

question: Convert the decimal number 153 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 153 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 99 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10101111 and 11100110.
solution: XOR: 01001001 | Count of 1s = 3 | Answer: 3
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 40 megabits is sent over a link of 6 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 40, B = 6 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 40 / 6 | Answer: 6.667 s

question: A link has bandwidth 28 Mbps and round-trip time 200 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 28, R = 200 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 28e6 * 200e-3 bits = 5600 kb | Answer: 5600 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.97, cache access time 7 ns and main-memory access time 160 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.97, tc = 7, tm = 160 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.97*7 + (1 - 0.97)*160 | Answer: 11.59 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 332018 elements?
solution: Given: n = 332018 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(332018)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.002, memory access time 170 ns and page-fault service time 10 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 10 ms = 10000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.002)*170 + 0.002*10000000.0 ns | Answer: 20.17 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.3 m^3 at 210 kPa and 550 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.3, P = 210, Tk = 550 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (210e3)*2.3 / (8.314*550) | Answer: 105.6 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 1e10 /s and activation energy 50 kJ/mol at 430 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 1, Ea = 50, Tk = 430 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 1e10 * exp(-50e3 / (8.314*430)) | Answer: 8433 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.93 and bottoms xW = 0.06, with relative volatility alpha = 2. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.93, xw = 0.06, al = 2 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.93/0.07)(0.94/0.06)] / ln(2) | Answer: 7.701 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.65 and x = 0.27. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.65, x = 0.27 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.65/0.35) / (0.27/0.73) | Answer: 5.021

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.25 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 110 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.25, Psat = 110 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.25 * 110 | Answer: 27.5 kPa

question: A stream of 3.4 kg/s with specific heat 2.8 kJ/kg-K is heated through 55 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 3.4, cp = 2.8, dT = 55 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 3.4*2.8*55 | Answer: 523.6 kW

question: A reactor of volume 8.6 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 0.4 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 8.6, Q = 0.4 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 8.6 / 0.4 | Answer: 21.5 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 5.3e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 5 mm with a concentration difference of 180 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 5.3, L = 5, dC = 180 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (5.3e-9)*180 / (5e-3) | Answer: 190.8 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 6.4 min and steady-state gain 3.7. For a step input of magnitude 20, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 6.4, K = 3.7, M = 20 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 3.7 * 20 | Answer: 74 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 75 m^2 flies at 160 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.3. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 75, V = 160, rho = 0.7, CL = 0.3 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.7*(160)^2*75*0.3 / 1000 | Answer: 201.6 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 25 m^2 flies at 80 m/s (density 1 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.05. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 25, V = 80, rho = 1, CD = 0.05 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*1*(80)^2*25*0.05 / 1000 | Answer: 4 kN

question: A specimen under stress 250 MPa shows an elastic strain of 1.2e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 250, eps = 1.2 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 250 / (1.2e-3) MPa = 208.3 GPa | Answer: 208.3 GPa

question: A block of mass 31 kg has a volume of 4.4e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 31, V = 4.4 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 31 / (4.4e-3) | Answer: 7045 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 1500 mm is heated through 115 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 17e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 1500, dT = 115, al = 17 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 1500*17e-6*115 | Answer: 2.932 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 35 ohm, R2 = 190 ohm and R3 = 40 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 35, R2 = 190, R3 = 40 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 190*40 / 35 | Answer: 217.1 ohm

question: A measurement reads 10.13 when the true value is 100. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 10.13, true = 100 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |10.13 - 100| / 100 * 100 | Answer: 89.87 %

question: Annual demand is 40500 units, ordering cost 280 per order and holding cost 20 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 40500, S = 280, H = 20 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*40500*280 / 20) | Answer: 1065 units

question: An asset costs 210000 with salvage value 24000 after 19 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 210000, Sv = 24000, n = 19 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (210000 - 24000) / 19 | Answer: 9789 per year

question: A product sells for 460 per unit with variable cost 40 per unit and fixed costs 15000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 460, V = 40, F = 15000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 15000 / (460 - 40) | Answer: 35.71 units

question: Find the present worth of 70000 received 5 years from now at an interest rate of 11% per year.
solution: Given: F = 70000, n = 5, i = 11 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 70000 / (1 + 0.11)^5 | Answer: 41542 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.92, 0.91 and 0.9 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.92, r2 = 0.91, r3 = 0.9 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.92*0.91*0.9 | Answer: 0.7535

question: A process produces 29 defective items in a batch of 7000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 29, N = 7000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 29/7000 * 1e6 | Answer: 4143 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 2x^3 - 5x^2 + 2x - 2 evaluated at x = -4.
For f(x) = -5x^3 + 2x^2 - 2x + 5, find f''(x) at x = 2.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-x^2 + 2x - 3) dx from x = -4 to x = 4.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -1x^3/3 + 2x^2/2 + -3x | Evaluate F(4) - F(-4) | Answer: -66.67
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 2x^2 - 5x - 3 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[-9, 2], [7, 8]].
solution: Given: a = -9, b = 2, c = 7, d = 8 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (-9)(8) - (2)(7) | Answer: -86

question: Find the determinant of [[2, 5, -2], [2, 6, -3], [4, -5, -6]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -34

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[-5, -3], [-7, 1]].
solution: Trace tr = -4, Determinant = -26 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 3.477

question: Solve for x: -3x + 3y = 8 and 2x + -1y = -4.
solution: Determinant = -3*-1 - 3*2 = -3 | x = (e d - b f) / det = -1.333 | Answer: x = -1.333
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 39, 79, 65, 5, 13.
solution: Sum = 201 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 40.2 | Answer: 40.2

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 2, 17, 31, 16, 43.
solution: Mean = 21.8 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 15.67

question: Find the slope of the line through (-1, 3) and (-3, 2).
solution: Given: x1 = -1, y1 = 3, x2 = -3, y2 = 2 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (2 - 3) / (-3 - -1) | Answer: 0.5

question: Find the distance between the points (-5, -1) and (3, -9).
solution: Given: x1 = -5, y1 = -1, x2 = 3, y2 = -9 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((8)^2 + (-8)^2) | Answer: 11.31 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-8,3), (-2,0), (2,2).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 12 sq units

question: Find the 7th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -2 and common difference -3.
solution: Given: a = -2, d = -3, n = 7 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -2 + (7 - 1)*-3 | Answer: -20

question: Find the sum of the first 15 terms of an AP with first term -11 and common difference -3.
solution: Given: a = -11, d = -3, n = 15 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 15/2 [2*-11 + (15-1)*-3] | Answer: -480

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 44000 at 12% per annum for 10 years.
solution: Given: P = 44000, R = 12, Tt = 10 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 44000 * 12 * 10 / 100 | Answer: 52800 currency units

question: Find the amount when 5000 is invested at 10.8% per annum compounded annually for 6 years.
solution: Given: P = 5000, R = 10.8, Tt = 6 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 5000 * (1 + 10.8/100)^6 | Answer: 9251 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (4, 8, -2) and (4, 0, 7).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (6, 2, 5) and (-4, 5, -2).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 48.47

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (6, -5, 4) and (-1, -2, -1).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 90 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -4x^3 - 2x^2 - 3 at x = 3.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-92 with initial guess x0=3, find x1 (one iteration).
solution: Given: N = 92, x0 = 3 | Formula: x1 = x0 - (x0^2 - N)/(2 x0) | Substitute: x1 = 3 - ((3)^2 - 92)/(2*3) | Answer: 16.83

question: Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.8 and ordinates 9, 4, 9, 0, 6, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 441 and 441.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 441 and 441 | Answer: GCD = 441

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 15 and 38.
solution: Given: a = 15, b = 38 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 15*38 / 1 | Answer: 570
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 30 mm carries an axial tensile load of 46 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 36 mm and length 1000 mm carries an axial load of 79 kN. Take E = 200 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 20 mm transmits a torque of 2400 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 20, Tt = 2400 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(2400*1000) / (pi*(20)^3) | Answer: 1528 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 64 mm and length 700 mm carries a torque of 500 N-m. With G = 77 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (64)^4 / 32 = 1647099 mm^4 | theta = (500*1000)(700) / (77000 * 1647099) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.1581 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 150 mm wide and 60 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 150, h = 60 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 150*(60)^2 / 6 | Answer: 90000 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (89 mm x 250 mm) carries a bending moment of 30 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (45 mm x 90 mm) has effective length 2400 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 870 MPa is designed for a working stress of 60 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 870, sw = 60 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 870 / 60 | Answer: 14.5

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1200 mm and wall thickness 17 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.3 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1200, t = 17, P = 1.3 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.3*1200 / (2*17) | Answer: 45.88 MPa

question: 1.1 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 100 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.1, dT = 100 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 1.1 * 0.718 * 100 | Answer: 78.98 kJ

question: 6.8 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 100 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.8, dT = 100 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 6.8 * 1.005 * 100 | Answer: 683.4 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 2.6 m^3 at 600 K with mass 3.6 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 2.6, Tk = 600, m = 3.6 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 3.6*0.287*600 / 2.6 | Answer: 238.4 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 3.9 kg of air expands isothermally at 440 K from volume V1 to 2*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.9, Tk = 440, ratio = 2 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 3.9*0.287*440*ln(2) | Answer: 341.4 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.6 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.18 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.6, D = 0.18 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.6*0.18 / 0.001 | Answer: 648000

question: Water flows at 3.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 200 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
In a pipe (diameter 310 mm) water flows at 1.3 m/s. It contracts to diameter 140 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
Water flows at 1.2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.3 m and length 340 m. With friction factor f = 0.037, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 25 teeth drives a gear of 93 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1350 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 25, z2 = 93, N1 = 1350 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1350*25 / 93 | Answer: 362.9 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 590 mm rotates at 1450 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 590, N = 1450 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.59)*1450 / 60 | Answer: 44.79 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 37.2 kW at 1150 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 37.2, N = 1150 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(37.2*1000) / (2*pi*1150) | Answer: 308.9 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 1.6 kg rotates at radius 0.16 m at 1150 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 8100 N/m and mass 15.3 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 8100, m = 15.3 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(8100/15.3) | Answer: 3.662 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 9.6 m^2 and thickness 0.34 m has conductivity k = 18 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 180 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 9.6, L = 0.34, k = 18, dT = 180 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 18*9.6*180 / 0.34 | Answer: 91482 W

question: A surface of area 1.5 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 105 W/m^2-K to surroundings 135 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 1.5, h = 105, dT = 135 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 105*1.5*135 | Answer: 21262 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 220 m/min, feed = 0.16 mm/rev, depth of cut = 2 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 220, f = 0.16, d = 2 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*220*0.16*2 | Answer: 70400 mm^3/min
