solution: Given: v = 180, f = 0.26, d = 2.8 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*180*0.26*2.8 | Answer: 131040 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 370 mm is turned at 950 rpm with a feed of 0.2 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 370, N = 950, f = 0.2 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 370 / (0.2*950) | Answer: 1.947 min

question: A resistor of 164 ohm carries a current of 7.4 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 164, I = 7.4 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 7.4 * 164 | Answer: 1214 V

question: Three resistors 49 ohm, 53 ohm and 46 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 49, R2 = 53, R3 = 46 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 49 + 53 + 46 | Answer: 148 ohm

question: Two resistors 33 ohm and 33 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 33, R2 = 33 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 33*33 / (33+33) | Answer: 16.5 ohm

question: A device draws 9.6 A at 85 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 85, I = 9.6 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 85 * 9.6 | Answer: 816 W

question: A current of 8.5 A flows through a 86 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 8.5, R = 86 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (8.5)^2 * 86 | Answer: 6214 W

question: Two capacitors 43.4 uF and 23.7 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 43.4, C2 = 23.7 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 43.4*23.7 / (43.4+23.7) | Answer: 15.33 uF

question: A resistor 89 kohm and capacitor 18.1 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 89, C = 18.1 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (89k)(18.1u) = 1611 ms | Answer: 1611 ms

question: An inductor 152.5 mH is in series with 8 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 152.5, R = 8 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (152.5e-3) / 8 | Answer: 19.06 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 155.4 mH inductor at 760 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 155.4, f = 760 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (760)(155.4e-3) | Answer: 742.1 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 5.4 uF capacitor at 750 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 5.4, f = 750 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (750)(5.4e-6)) | Answer: 39.3 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 59 ohm, XL = 67 ohm and XC = 104 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 59, XL = 67, XC = 104 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(59^2 + (67 - 104)^2) | Answer: 69.64 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 97.5 mH and C = 7.1 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 97.5, C = 7.1 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(97.5e-3 * 7.1e-6)) | Answer: 191.3 Hz

question: A capacitor of 63.1 uF is charged to 310 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 63.1, V = 310 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*63.1e-6*(310)^2 | Answer: 3032 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 300 V with 880 primary turns and 90 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 300, N1 = 880, N2 = 90 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 300 * 90/880 | Answer: 30.68 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 360 V and draws an armature current of 55 A. If the armature resistance is 0.73 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 360, Ia = 55, Ra = 0.73 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 360 - 55*0.73 | Answer: 319.9 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 95 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.75. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 95, VL = 415, pf = 0.75 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*95*0.75 / 1000 | Answer: 51.21 kW

question: A load has real power 55 kW and apparent power 165 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 55, S = 165 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 55 / 165 | Answer: 0.3333

question: A machine delivers 165 kW output while drawing 207 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 165, Pi = 207 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 165/207 * 100 | Answer: 79.71 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 11 V across R1 = 12 ohm and R2 = 48 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 11, R1 = 12, R2 = 48 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 11*48 / (12+48) | Answer: 8.8 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 70 kohm and Rin = 41 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 70, Rin = 41 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 70 / 41 | Answer: 1.707

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 10 kohm and Rg = 1 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 10, Rg = 1 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 10/1 | Answer: 11

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 471. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 471 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(471) | Answer: 26.73 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.2 m carries a central point load of 60 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.2, W = 60 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 60*4.2 / 4 | Answer: 63 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 3.3 m carries a UDL of 5 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 3.3, w = 5 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 5*(3.3)^2 / 8 | Answer: 6.806 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.9 m carries a UDL of 22 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.9, w = 22 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 22*(5.9)^2 / 2 | Answer: 382.9 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.2 m carries a point load 65 kN at distance 3.4 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 6.2, a = 3.4, W = 65 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 65*(6.2 - 3.4) / 6.2 | Answer: 29.35 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 5.2 m) carries a central point load 25 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 50e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=25000 N, L=5200.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=50e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 58.59 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 8.5 m carries a UDL of 12 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8.5, w = 12 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 12*(8.5)^2 / 12 | Answer: 72.25 kN-m

question: A column supports a floor area of 32.1 m^2 carrying a factored load of 10.9 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 32.1, w = 10.9 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 10.9 * 32.1 | Answer: 349.9 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 5.5 m, unit weight 19 kN/m^3, phi = 32 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 6.4e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1, area = 7.3e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 6.4, i = 1, A = 7.3 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (6.4e-4)*1*(7.3e-3) | Answer: 4672 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.9 m, bed slope 0.004 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.017. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4.9 m under a head of 1.2 m. Taking Cd = 0.61 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 5.3 m wide carries a discharge of 16.8 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A highway curve has radius 470 m and design speed 85 km/h. Ignoring friction, find the superelevation required (as a ratio).
solution: Given: R = 470, V = 85 | Formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m) | Substitute: e = (85)^2 / (127*470) | Answer: 0.121
formula: e = V^2 / (127 R)  (V in km/h, R in m)

question: A tank of volume 200 m^3 treats a flow of 35 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 200, Q = 35 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 200 / 35 | Answer: 5.714 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 270 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.25 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 3 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 270, k = 0.25, t = 3 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 270*(1 - e^(-0.25*3)) | Answer: 142.5 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.62, rainfall intensity 70 mm/h over a catchment of 54.2 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.62, i = 70, A = 54.2 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.62*70*54.2 / 360 | Answer: 6.534 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.02 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 370 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.02, M = 370 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 370*(20+0.02)/20 | Answer: 370.4 m

question: Convert the decimal number 583 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 583 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 247 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 11011011 and 10101101.
solution: XOR: 01110110 | Count of 1s = 5 | Answer: 5
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 960 megabits is sent over a link of 16 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 960, B = 16 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 960 / 16 | Answer: 60 s

question: A link has bandwidth 8 Mbps and round-trip time 100 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 8, R = 100 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 8e6 * 100e-3 bits = 800 kb | Answer: 800 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.84, cache access time 3 ns and main-memory access time 60 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.84, tc = 3, tm = 60 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.84*3 + (1 - 0.84)*60 | Answer: 12.12 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 513506 elements?
solution: Given: n = 513506 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(513506)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.001, memory access time 180 ns and page-fault service time 4 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 4 ms = 4000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.001)*180 + 0.001*4000000.0 ns | Answer: 4.18 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 0.8 m^3 at 300 kPa and 360 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 0.8, P = 300, Tk = 360 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (300e3)*0.8 / (8.314*360) | Answer: 80.19 mol

question: A first-order reaction has rate constant k = 0.33 /min. Find the fractional conversion after 6 minutes.
solution: Given: k = 0.33, t = 6 | Formula: X = 1 - e^(-k t) | Substitute: X = 1 - e^(-0.33*6) | Answer: 0.8619

question: For a reaction with A = 9e10 /s and activation energy 70 kJ/mol at 440 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 9, Ea = 70, Tk = 440 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 9e10 * exp(-70e3 / (8.314*440)) | Answer: 440.4 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.91 and bottoms xW = 0.06, with relative volatility alpha = 1.8. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.91, xw = 0.06, al = 1.8 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.91/0.09)(0.94/0.06)] / ln(1.8) | Answer: 8.617 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.77 and x = 0.42. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.77, x = 0.42 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.77/0.23) / (0.42/0.58) | Answer: 4.623

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.2 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 90 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.2, Psat = 90 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.2 * 90 | Answer: 18 kPa

question: A stream of 6.6 kg/s with specific heat 4 kJ/kg-K is heated through 30 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 6.6, cp = 4, dT = 30 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 6.6*4*30 | Answer: 792 kW

question: A reactor of volume 16.1 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 1.1 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 16.1, Q = 1.1 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 16.1 / 1.1 | Answer: 14.64 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 7.4e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 2 mm with a concentration difference of 40 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 7.4, L = 2, dC = 40 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (7.4e-9)*40 / (2e-3) | Answer: 148 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 9.4 min and steady-state gain 3.2. For a step input of magnitude 19, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 9.4, K = 3.2, M = 19 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 3.2 * 19 | Answer: 60.8 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 70 m^2 flies at 100 m/s (air density 0.4 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.6. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 70, V = 100, rho = 0.4, CL = 0.6 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.4*(100)^2*70*0.6 / 1000 | Answer: 84 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 85 m^2 flies at 160 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.06. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 85, V = 160, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.06 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(160)^2*85*0.06 / 1000 | Answer: 26.11 kN

question: A block of mass 20 kg has a volume of 4.8e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 20, V = 4.8 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 20 / (4.8e-3) | Answer: 4167 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2600 mm is heated through 125 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 11e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2600, dT = 125, al = 11 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2600*11e-6*125 | Answer: 3.575 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 130 ohm, R2 = 70 ohm and R3 = 100 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 130, R2 = 70, R3 = 100 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 70*100 / 130 | Answer: 53.85 ohm

question: Annual demand is 22500 units, ordering cost 250 per order and holding cost 8 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 22500, S = 250, H = 8 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*22500*250 / 8) | Answer: 1186 units

question: An asset costs 240000 with salvage value 30000 after 16 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 240000, Sv = 30000, n = 16 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (240000 - 30000) / 16 | Answer: 13125 per year

question: A product sells for 310 per unit with variable cost 40 per unit and fixed costs 45000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 310, V = 40, F = 45000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 45000 / (310 - 40) | Answer: 166.7 units

question: Find the present worth of 80000 received 7 years from now at an interest rate of 8% per year.
solution: Given: F = 80000, n = 7, i = 8 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 80000 / (1 + 0.08)^7 | Answer: 46679 currency units

question: A process produces 3 defective items in a batch of 1500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 3, N = 1500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 3/1500 * 1e6 | Answer: 2000 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 5x^3 + 6x^2 + 8x + 1 evaluated at x = 3.
For f(x) = 2x^3 - 3x^2 - 9x - 9, find f''(x) at x = 0.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-x^2 + x - 4) dx from x = 2 to x = 6.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -1x^3/3 + 1x^2/2 + -4x | Evaluate F(6) - F(2) | Answer: -69.33
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 5x^2 - 3 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[6, 5], [-1, -2]].
solution: Given: a = 6, b = 5, c = -1, d = -2 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (6)(-2) - (5)(-1) | Answer: -7

question: Find the determinant of [[-6, 1, -2], [-3, -4, 5], [3, -5, 0]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -189

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[0, 0], [-4, 8]].
solution: Trace tr = 8, Determinant = 0 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 8

question: Solve for x: -3x + -5y = 12 and 3x + 2y = 10.
solution: Determinant = -3*2 - -5*3 = 9 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 8.222 | Answer: x = 8.222
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 32, 88, 55, 55, 87.
solution: Sum = 317 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 63.4 | Answer: 63.4

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 27, 18, 23, 34, 12.
solution: Mean = 22.8 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 8.408

question: Find the slope of the line through (-9, -2) and (7, 4).
solution: Given: x1 = -9, y1 = -2, x2 = 7, y2 = 4 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (4 - -2) / (7 - -9) | Answer: 0.375

question: Find the distance between the points (-4, -2) and (-4, 0).
solution: Given: x1 = -4, y1 = -2, x2 = -4, y2 = 0 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((0)^2 + (2)^2) | Answer: 2 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (2,1), (-4,5), (-6,-8).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 43 sq units

question: Find the 7th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 1 and common difference -9.
solution: Given: a = 1, d = -9, n = 7 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 1 + (7 - 1)*-9 | Answer: -53

question: Find the sum of the first 8 terms of an AP with first term 13 and common difference 7.
solution: Given: a = 13, d = 7, n = 8 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 8/2 [2*13 + (8-1)*7] | Answer: 300

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 10000 at 14.9% per annum for 3 years.
solution: Given: P = 10000, R = 14.9, Tt = 3 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 10000 * 14.9 * 3 / 100 | Answer: 4470 currency units

question: Find the amount when 38000 is invested at 11.7% per annum compounded annually for 4 years.
solution: Given: P = 38000, R = 11.7, Tt = 4 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 38000 * (1 + 11.7/100)^4 | Answer: 59156 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (6, 3, 0) and (-8, -3, -5).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (5, 5, 0) and (-4, 3, 0).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 35

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (-1, 3, 5) and (5, 1, 2).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 75.71 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -2x^3 + 8x + 5 at x = 4.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-199 with initial guess x0=6, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=0.6 and ordinates 2, 11, 10, 16, 10, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 190 and 574.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 190 and 574 | Answer: GCD = 2

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 8 and 33.
solution: Given: a = 8, b = 33 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 8*33 / 1 | Answer: 264
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 44 mm carries an axial tensile load of 43 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 24 mm and length 2000 mm carries an axial load of 24 kN. Take E = 110 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 35 mm transmits a torque of 1750 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 35, Tt = 1750 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(1750*1000) / (pi*(35)^3) | Answer: 207.9 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 66 mm and length 1800 mm carries a torque of 300 N-m. With G = 45 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (66)^4 / 32 = 186284 mm^4 | theta = (300*1000)(1800) / (45000 * 186284) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.3691 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 57 mm wide and 90 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 57, h = 90 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 57*(90)^2 / 6 | Answer: 76950 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (54 mm x 120 mm) carries a bending moment of 34 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (33 mm x 100 mm) has effective length 3700 mm and E = 200 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 610 MPa is designed for a working stress of 70 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 610, sw = 70 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 610 / 70 | Answer: 8.714

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1500 mm and wall thickness 18 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.7 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1500, t = 18, P = 1.7 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.7*1500 / (2*18) | Answer: 70.83 MPa

question: 7.2 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 195 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 7.2, dT = 195 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 7.2 * 0.718 * 195 | Answer: 1008 kJ

question: 4.6 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 55 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.6, dT = 55 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 4.6 * 1.005 * 55 | Answer: 254.3 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.3 m^3 at 570 K with mass 2 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 3.3, Tk = 570, m = 2 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 2*0.287*570 / 3.3 | Answer: 99.15 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4.5 kg of air expands isothermally at 450 K from volume V1 to 2*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.5, Tk = 450, ratio = 2 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4.5*0.287*450*ln(2) | Answer: 402.8 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 4.9 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.08 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 4.9, D = 0.08 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*4.9*0.08 / 0.001 | Answer: 392000

question: Water flows at 2.7 m/s through a pipe of diameter 170 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 1.3 m. Taking Cv = 0.97, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 1.3, cv = 0.97 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.97*sqrt(2*9.81*1.3) | Answer: 4.899 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 290 mm) water flows at 1.7 m/s. It contracts to diameter 130 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 290, d2 = 130, V1 = 1.7 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 1.7*(290/130)^2 | Answer: 8.46 m/s

question: Water flows at 2.6 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.23 m and length 190 m. With friction factor f = 0.034, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 39 teeth drives a gear of 109 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1250 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 39, z2 = 109, N1 = 1250 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1250*39 / 109 | Answer: 447.2 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 520 mm rotates at 1300 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 520, N = 1300 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.52)*1300 / 60 | Answer: 35.4 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 19.4 kW at 700 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 19.4, N = 700 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(19.4*1000) / (2*pi*700) | Answer: 264.7 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 5.4 kg rotates at radius 0.54 m at 550 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 6600 N/m and mass 11.3 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 6600, m = 11.3 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(6600/11.3) | Answer: 3.846 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 6.3 m^2 and thickness 0.36 m has conductivity k = 20.5 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 200 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 6.3, L = 0.36, k = 20.5, dT = 200 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 20.5*6.3*200 / 0.36 | Answer: 71750 W

question: A surface of area 1 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 145 W/m^2-K to surroundings 70 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 1, h = 145, dT = 70 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 145*1*70 | Answer: 10150 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 220 m/min, feed = 0.24 mm/rev, depth of cut = 0.6 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 220, f = 0.24, d = 0.6 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*220*0.24*0.6 | Answer: 31680 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 210 mm is turned at 750 rpm with a feed of 0.35 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 210, N = 750, f = 0.35 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 210 / (0.35*750) | Answer: 0.8 min

question: A resistor of 73 ohm carries a current of 4 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 73, I = 4 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 4 * 73 | Answer: 292 V

question: Three resistors 53 ohm, 43 ohm and 5 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 53, R2 = 43, R3 = 5 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 53 + 43 + 5 | Answer: 101 ohm

question: Two resistors 27 ohm and 60 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 27, R2 = 60 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 27*60 / (27+60) | Answer: 18.62 ohm

question: A device draws 2 A at 135 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 135, I = 2 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 135 * 2 | Answer: 270 W

question: A current of 10.1 A flows through a 102 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 10.1, R = 102 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (10.1)^2 * 102 | Answer: 10405 W

question: Two capacitors 48 uF and 13.1 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 48, C2 = 13.1 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 48*13.1 / (48+13.1) | Answer: 10.29 uF

question: A resistor 80 kohm and capacitor 4.6 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 80, C = 4.6 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (80k)(4.6u) = 368 ms | Answer: 368 ms

question: An inductor 326.9 mH is in series with 100 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 326.9, R = 100 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (326.9e-3) / 100 | Answer: 3.269 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 54.6 mH inductor at 1000 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 54.6, f = 1000 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (1000)(54.6e-3) | Answer: 343.1 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 27.6 uF capacitor at 100 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 27.6, f = 100 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (100)(27.6e-6)) | Answer: 57.66 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 78 ohm, XL = 88 ohm and XC = 142 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 78, XL = 88, XC = 142 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(78^2 + (88 - 142)^2) | Answer: 94.87 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 2.1 mH and C = 1.7 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 2.1, C = 1.7 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(2.1e-3 * 1.7e-6)) | Answer: 2664 Hz

question: A capacitor of 88.4 uF is charged to 95 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 88.4, V = 95 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*88.4e-6*(95)^2 | Answer: 398.9 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 310 V with 280 primary turns and 150 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 310, N1 = 280, N2 = 150 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 310 * 150/280 | Answer: 166.1 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 230 V and draws an armature current of 55 A. If the armature resistance is 1.3 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 230, Ia = 55, Ra = 1.3 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 230 - 55*1.3 | Answer: 158.5 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 165 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.92. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 165, VL = 415, pf = 0.92 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*165*0.92 / 1000 | Answer: 109.1 kW

question: A load has real power 90 kW and apparent power 210 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 90, S = 210 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 90 / 210 | Answer: 0.4286

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 7 V across R1 = 23 ohm and R2 = 36 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 7, R1 = 23, R2 = 36 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 7*36 / (23+36) | Answer: 4.271 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 210 kohm and Rin = 31 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 210, Rin = 31 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 210 / 31 | Answer: 6.774

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9658. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 9658 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(9658) | Answer: 39.85 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 10 m carries a central point load of 50 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 10, W = 50 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 50*10 / 4 | Answer: 125 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.2 m carries a UDL of 5 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.2, w = 5 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 5*(4.2)^2 / 8 | Answer: 11.03 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 1.2 m carries a UDL of 24 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 1.2, w = 24 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 24*(1.2)^2 / 2 | Answer: 17.28 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.6 m carries a point load 75 kN at distance 1.4 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 5.6, a = 1.4, W = 75 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 75*(5.6 - 1.4) / 5.6 | Answer: 56.25 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 3.3 m) carries a central point load 45 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 390e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=45000 N, L=3300.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=390e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 3.455 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 6.4 m carries a UDL of 30 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6.4, w = 30 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 30*(6.4)^2 / 12 | Answer: 102.4 kN-m

question: A column supports a floor area of 31.7 m^2 carrying a factored load of 17.3 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 31.7, w = 17.3 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 17.3 * 31.7 | Answer: 548.4 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 6.6 m, unit weight 18 kN/m^3, phi = 32 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 4.6e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1.3, area = 7.8e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 4.6, i = 1.3, A = 7.8 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (4.6e-4)*1.3*(7.8e-3) | Answer: 4664 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 2.1 m, bed slope 0.005 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.013. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 2.4 m under a head of 1.2 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 5.7 m wide carries a discharge of 28.4 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 530 m^3 treats a flow of 130 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 530, Q = 130 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 530 / 130 | Answer: 4.077 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 250 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.31 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 8 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 250, k = 0.31, t = 8 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 250*(1 - e^(-0.31*8)) | Answer: 229.1 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.77, rainfall intensity 75 mm/h over a catchment of 57.7 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.77, i = 75, A = 57.7 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.77*75*57.7 / 360 | Answer: 9.256 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.04 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 140 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.04, M = 140 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 140*(20+0.04)/20 | Answer: 140.3 m

question: Convert the decimal number 2542 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 2542 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 9EE (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10011111 and 00111011.
solution: XOR: 10100100 | Count of 1s = 3 | Answer: 3
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 980 megabits is sent over a link of 92 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 980, B = 92 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 980 / 92 | Answer: 10.65 s

question: A link has bandwidth 63 Mbps and round-trip time 180 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 63, R = 180 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 63e6 * 180e-3 bits = 11340 kb | Answer: 11340 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.84, cache access time 5 ns and main-memory access time 170 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.84, tc = 5, tm = 170 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.84*5 + (1 - 0.84)*170 | Answer: 31.4 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 101852 elements?
solution: Given: n = 101852 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(101852)) + 1 | Answer: 17

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.006, memory access time 130 ns and page-fault service time 7 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 7 ms = 7000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.006)*130 + 0.006*7000000.0 ns | Answer: 42.13 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 0.3 m^3 at 120 kPa and 480 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 0.3, P = 120, Tk = 480 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (120e3)*0.3 / (8.314*480) | Answer: 9.021 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 6e10 /s and activation energy 50 kJ/mol at 470 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 6, Ea = 50, Tk = 470 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 6e10 * exp(-50e3 / (8.314*470)) | Answer: 16637 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.97 and bottoms xW = 0.04, with relative volatility alpha = 2.7. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.97, xw = 0.04, al = 2.7 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.97/0.03)(0.96/0.04)] / ln(2.7) | Answer: 6.699 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.9 and x = 0.47. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.9, x = 0.47 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.9/0.1) / (0.47/0.53) | Answer: 10.15

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.37 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 55 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.37, Psat = 55 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.37 * 55 | Answer: 20.35 kPa

question: A stream of 10 kg/s with specific heat 3.2 kJ/kg-K is heated through 25 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 10, cp = 3.2, dT = 25 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 10*3.2*25 | Answer: 800 kW

question: A reactor of volume 19.8 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 1.3 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 19.8, Q = 1.3 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 19.8 / 1.3 | Answer: 15.23 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 2.3e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 3 mm with a concentration difference of 190 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 2.3, L = 3, dC = 190 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (2.3e-9)*190 / (3e-3) | Answer: 145.7 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 5.3 min and steady-state gain 3.6. For a step input of magnitude 10, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 5.3, K = 3.6, M = 10 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 3.6 * 10 | Answer: 36 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 115 m^2 flies at 180 m/s (air density 0.4 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.9. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 115, V = 180, rho = 0.4, CL = 0.9 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.4*(180)^2*115*0.9 / 1000 | Answer: 670.7 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 80 m^2 flies at 130 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.06. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 80, V = 130, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.06 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(130)^2*80*0.06 / 1000 | Answer: 16.22 kN

question: A specimen under stress 200 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.1e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 200, eps = 2.1 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 200 / (2.1e-3) MPa = 95.24 GPa | Answer: 95.24 GPa

question: A block of mass 44 kg has a volume of 4.1e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 44, V = 4.1 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 44 / (4.1e-3) | Answer: 10732 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2400 mm is heated through 100 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 17e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2400, dT = 100, al = 17 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2400*17e-6*100 | Answer: 4.08 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 55 ohm, R2 = 160 ohm and R3 = 110 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 55, R2 = 160, R3 = 110 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 160*110 / 55 | Answer: 320 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.87 when the true value is 100. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.87, true = 100 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.87 - 100| / 100 * 100 | Answer: 90.13 %

question: Annual demand is 32500 units, ordering cost 150 per order and holding cost 14 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 32500, S = 150, H = 14 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*32500*150 / 14) | Answer: 834.5 units

question: An asset costs 250000 with salvage value 20000 after 9 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 250000, Sv = 20000, n = 9 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (250000 - 20000) / 9 | Answer: 25556 per year

question: A product sells for 350 per unit with variable cost 70 per unit and fixed costs 50000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 350, V = 70, F = 50000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 50000 / (350 - 70) | Answer: 178.6 units

question: Find the present worth of 80000 received 2 years from now at an interest rate of 9% per year.
solution: Given: F = 80000, n = 2, i = 9 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 80000 / (1 + 0.09)^2 | Answer: 67334 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.92, 0.96 and 0.94 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.92, r2 = 0.96, r3 = 0.94 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.92*0.96*0.94 | Answer: 0.8302

question: A process produces 1 defective items in a batch of 3000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 1, N = 3000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 1/3000 * 1e6 | Answer: 333.3 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = -2x^3 - x^2 - 6x - 3 evaluated at x = -5.
For f(x) = 6x^3 + 2x^2 + 5x, find f''(x) at x = 2.
Evaluate the definite integral of (2x^2 + 5x + 4) dx from x = 2 to x = 5.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 2x^3/3 + 5x^2/2 + 4x | Evaluate F(5) - F(2) | Answer: 142.5
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of x^2 + 2x - 4 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[5, -8], [6, 0]].
solution: Given: a = 5, b = -8, c = 6, d = 0 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (5)(0) - (-8)(6) | Answer: 48

question: Find the determinant of [[6, 6, 5], [-3, 5, 4], [-3, 1, 3]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 108

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[-6, 1], [5, -4]].
solution: Trace tr = -10, Determinant = 19 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: -2.551

question: Solve for x: -1x + -3y = 11 and -3x + -6y = -4.
solution: Determinant = -1*-6 - -3*-3 = -3 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 26 | Answer: x = 26
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 10, 57, 63, 97, 49.
solution: Sum = 276 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 55.2 | Answer: 55.2

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 7, 40, 16, 8, 46.
solution: Mean = 23.4 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 18.35

question: Find the slope of the line through (7, 9) and (-3, 8).
solution: Given: x1 = 7, y1 = 9, x2 = -3, y2 = 8 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (8 - 9) / (-3 - 7) | Answer: 0.1

question: Find the distance between the points (3, 3) and (-6, 0).
solution: Given: x1 = 3, y1 = 3, x2 = -6, y2 = 0 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((-9)^2 + (-3)^2) | Answer: 9.487 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (5,-4), (-7,4), (-8,-6).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 64 sq units

question: Find the 16th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 16 and common difference -8.
solution: Given: a = 16, d = -8, n = 16 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 16 + (16 - 1)*-8 | Answer: -104

question: Find the sum of the first 7 terms of an AP with first term -5 and common difference -3.
solution: Given: a = -5, d = -3, n = 7 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 7/2 [2*-5 + (7-1)*-3] | Answer: -98

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 1000 at 14% per annum for 7 years.
solution: Given: P = 1000, R = 14, Tt = 7 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 1000 * 14 * 7 / 100 | Answer: 980 currency units

question: Find the amount when 5500 is invested at 10.4% per annum compounded annually for 4 years.
solution: Given: P = 5500, R = 10.4, Tt = 4 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 5500 * (1 + 10.4/100)^4 | Answer: 817 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (6, 8, 0) and (-6, -3, -7).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (0, 2, 1) and (3, -4, 6).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 17.35

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (5, -4, -4) and (5, 2, 0).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 65.28 degrees

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number 12 + -1i.
solution: Given: a = 12, b = -1 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(-1, 12) | Answer: -4.764 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = x^3 - x^2 - 2x + 4 at x = -4.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-84 with initial guess x0=14, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.5 and ordinates 8, 0, 18, 7, 17, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 287 and 131.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 287 and 131 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 23 and 69.
solution: Given: a = 23, b = 69 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 23*69 / 23 | Answer: 69
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 15 mm carries an axial tensile load of 35 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 40 mm and length 2600 mm carries an axial load of 83 kN. Take E = 200 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 79 mm transmits a torque of 1750 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 79, Tt = 1750 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(1750*1000) / (pi*(79)^3) | Answer: 18.08 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 70 mm and length 2000 mm carries a torque of 450 N-m. With G = 77 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (70)^4 / 32 = 2357176 mm^4 | theta = (450*1000)(2000) / (77000 * 2357176) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.2841 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 93 mm wide and 170 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 93, h = 170 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 93*(170)^2 / 6 | Answer: 447950 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (40 mm x 240 mm) carries a bending moment of 25 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (64 mm x 130 mm) has effective length 3600 mm and E = 200 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 560 MPa is designed for a working stress of 60 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 560, sw = 60 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 560 / 60 | Answer: 9.333

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1050 mm and wall thickness 15 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.7 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1050, t = 15, P = 1.7 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.7*1050 / (2*15) | Answer: 59.5 MPa

question: 2.4 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 125 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.4, dT = 125 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 2.4 * 0.718 * 125 | Answer: 215.4 kJ

question: 3.6 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 40 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.6, dT = 40 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 3.6 * 1.005 * 40 | Answer: 144.7 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1.9 m^3 at 550 K with mass 2.1 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1.9, Tk = 550, m = 2.1 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 2.1*0.287*550 / 1.9 | Answer: 174.5 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4.1 kg of air expands isothermally at 360 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.1, Tk = 360, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4.1*0.287*360*ln(4) | Answer: 587.3 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 1.2 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.1 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 1.2, D = 0.1 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*1.2*0.1 / 0.001 | Answer: 120000

question: Water flows at 3.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 60 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 16.9 m. Taking Cv = 0.97, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 16.9, cv = 0.97 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.97*sqrt(2*9.81*16.9) | Answer: 17.66 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 400 mm) water flows at 2.7 m/s. It contracts to diameter 120 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 400, d2 = 120, V1 = 2.7 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2.7*(400/120)^2 | Answer: 30 m/s

question: Water flows at 1.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.32 m and length 500 m. With friction factor f = 0.038, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 16 teeth drives a gear of 51 teeth. If the pinion runs at 350 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 16, z2 = 51, N1 = 350 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 350*16 / 51 | Answer: 109.8 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 270 mm rotates at 200 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 270, N = 200 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.27)*200 / 60 | Answer: 2.827 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 6 kW at 300 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 6, N = 300 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(6*1000) / (2*pi*300) | Answer: 191 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 8.9 kg rotates at radius 0.34 m at 1200 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 18800 N/m and mass 10.8 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 18800, m = 10.8 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(18800/10.8) | Answer: 6.64 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 3.1 m^2 and thickness 0.39 m has conductivity k = 46.9 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 185 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 3.1, L = 0.39, k = 46.9, dT = 185 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 46.9*3.1*185 / 0.39 | Answer: 68967 W

question: A surface of area 5.8 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 180 W/m^2-K to surroundings 110 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 5.8, h = 180, dT = 110 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 180*5.8*110 | Answer: 114840 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 230 m/min, feed = 0.4 mm/rev, depth of cut = 0.6 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 230, f = 0.4, d = 0.6 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*230*0.4*0.6 | Answer: 55200 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 310 mm is turned at 600 rpm with a feed of 0.11 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 310, N = 600, f = 0.11 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 310 / (0.11*600) | Answer: 4.697 min

question: A resistor of 6 ohm carries a current of 6.9 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 6, I = 6.9 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 6.9 * 6 | Answer: 41.4 V

question: Three resistors 10 ohm, 68 ohm and 79 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 10, R2 = 68, R3 = 79 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 10 + 68 + 79 | Answer: 157 ohm

question: Two resistors 3 ohm and 25 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 3, R2 = 25 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 3*25 / (3+25) | Answer: 2.679 ohm

question: A device draws 0.2 A at 215 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 215, I = 0.2 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 215 * 0.2 | Answer: 43 W

question: A current of 10.5 A flows through a 120 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 10.5, R = 120 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (10.5)^2 * 120 | Answer: 13230 W

question: Two capacitors 47.1 uF and 9.3 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 47.1, C2 = 9.3 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 47.1*9.3 / (47.1+9.3) | Answer: 7.766 uF

question: A resistor 55 kohm and capacitor 7.7 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 55, C = 7.7 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (55k)(7.7u) = 423.5 ms | Answer: 423.5 ms

question: An inductor 187.8 mH is in series with 27 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 187.8, R = 27 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (187.8e-3) / 27 | Answer: 6.956 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 76.6 mH inductor at 780 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 76.6, f = 780 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (780)(76.6e-3) | Answer: 375.4 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 24.8 uF capacitor at 420 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 24.8, f = 420 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (420)(24.8e-6)) | Answer: 15.28 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 52 ohm, XL = 120 ohm and XC = 49 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 52, XL = 120, XC = 49 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(52^2 + (120 - 49)^2) | Answer: 88.01 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 67.2 mH and C = 3.9 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 67.2, C = 3.9 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(67.2e-3 * 3.9e-6)) | Answer: 310.9 Hz

question: A capacitor of 71.7 uF is charged to 100 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 71.7, V = 100 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*71.7e-6*(100)^2 | Answer: 358.5 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 240 V with 560 primary turns and 250 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 240, N1 = 560, N2 = 250 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 240 * 250/560 | Answer: 107.1 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 210 V and draws an armature current of 39 A. If the armature resistance is 1.48 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 210, Ia = 39, Ra = 1.48 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 210 - 39*1.48 | Answer: 152.3 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 155 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.71. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 155, VL = 433, pf = 0.71 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*155*0.71 / 1000 | Answer: 82.54 kW

question: A load has real power 60 kW and apparent power 100 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 60, S = 100 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 60 / 100 | Answer: 0.6

question: A machine delivers 10 kW output while drawing 162 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 10, Pi = 162 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 10/162 * 100 | Answer: 6.173 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 20 V across R1 = 39 ohm and R2 = 15 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 20, R1 = 39, R2 = 15 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 20*15 / (39+15) | Answer: 5.556 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 160 kohm and Rin = 36 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 160, Rin = 36 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 160 / 36 | Answer: 4.444

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 90 kohm and Rg = 6 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 90, Rg = 6 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 90/6 | Answer: 16

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9846. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 9846 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(9846) | Answer: 39.93 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.5 m carries a central point load of 10 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.5, W = 10 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 10*4.5 / 4 | Answer: 11.25 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.7 m carries a UDL of 10 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 9.7, w = 10 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 10*(9.7)^2 / 8 | Answer: 117.6 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 4.8 m carries a UDL of 36 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.8, w = 36 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 36*(4.8)^2 / 2 | Answer: 414.7 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.9 m carries a point load 55 kN at distance 1.3 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 4.9, a = 1.3, W = 55 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 55*(4.9 - 1.3) / 4.9 | Answer: 40.41 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 7.8 m) carries a central point load 10 kN. With E = 30 GPa and I = 600e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=10000 N, L=7800.0 mm, E=30000 MPa, I=600e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 5.492 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 320 mm, clear cover 30 mm and main bars of diameter 20 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 320, c = 30, dia = 20 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 320 - 30 - 20/2 | Answer: 280 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 11.5 m^2 carrying a factored load of 11.9 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 11.5, w = 11.9 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 11.9 * 11.5 | Answer: 136.8 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 4.8 m, unit weight 16 kN/m^3, phi = 28 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 1.2e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1, area = 6.8e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 1.2, i = 1, A = 6.8 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (1.2e-4)*1*(6.8e-3) | Answer: 816 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1.6 m, bed slope 0.01 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.016. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4.5 m under a head of 0.4 m. Taking Cd = 0.6 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.8 m wide carries a discharge of 22.8 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 460 m^3 treats a flow of 140 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 460, Q = 140 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 460 / 140 | Answer: 3.286 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 160 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.3 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 8 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 160, k = 0.3, t = 8 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 160*(1 - e^(-0.3*8)) | Answer: 145.5 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.6, rainfall intensity 75 mm/h over a catchment of 39.4 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.6, i = 75, A = 39.4 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.6*75*39.4 / 360 | Answer: 4.925 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.02 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 470 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.02, M = 470 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 470*(30+0.02)/30 | Answer: 470.3 m

question: Convert the decimal number 1360 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 1360 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 550 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 01110010 and 10000011.
solution: XOR: 11110001 | Count of 1s = 5 | Answer: 5
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 300 megabits is sent over a link of 72 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 300, B = 72 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 300 / 72 | Answer: 4.167 s

question: A link has bandwidth 83 Mbps and round-trip time 180 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 83, R = 180 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 83e6 * 180e-3 bits = 14940 kb | Answer: 14940 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.91, cache access time 4 ns and main-memory access time 160 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.91, tc = 4, tm = 160 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.91*4 + (1 - 0.91)*160 | Answer: 18.04 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 396565 elements?
solution: Given: n = 396565 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(396565)) + 1 | Answer: 19

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.019, memory access time 120 ns and page-fault service time 5 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 5 ms = 5000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.019)*120 + 0.019*5000000.0 ns | Answer: 95.12 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 2.8 m^3 at 380 kPa and 340 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 2.8, P = 380, Tk = 340 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (380e3)*2.8 / (8.314*340) | Answer: 376.4 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 1e10 /s and activation energy 80 kJ/mol at 470 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 1, Ea = 80, Tk = 470 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 1e10 * exp(-80e3 / (8.314*470)) | Answer: 12.84 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.93 and bottoms xW = 0.07, with relative volatility alpha = 2.4. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.93, xw = 0.07, al = 2.4 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.93/0.07)(0.93/0.07)] / ln(2.4) | Answer: 5.909 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.67 and x = 0.21. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.67, x = 0.21 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.67/0.33) / (0.21/0.79) | Answer: 7.638

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.51 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 105 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.51, Psat = 105 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.51 * 105 | Answer: 53.55 kPa

question: A stream of 1.8 kg/s with specific heat 2.2 kJ/kg-K is heated through 90 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 1.8, cp = 2.2, dT = 90 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 1.8*2.2*90 | Answer: 356.4 kW

question: A reactor of volume 3.7 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 2.2 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 3.7, Q = 2.2 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 3.7 / 2.2 | Answer: 1.682 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 1.1e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 2 mm with a concentration difference of 40 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 1.1, L = 2, dC = 40 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (1.1e-9)*40 / (2e-3) | Answer: 22 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 2.3 min and steady-state gain 1.8. For a step input of magnitude 7, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 2.3, K = 1.8, M = 7 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 1.8 * 7 | Answer: 12.6 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 95 m^2 flies at 120 m/s (air density 1 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.6. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 95, V = 120, rho = 1, CL = 0.6 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1*(120)^2*95*0.6 / 1000 | Answer: 410.4 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 40 m^2 flies at 90 m/s (density 0.7 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.04. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 40, V = 90, rho = 0.7, CD = 0.04 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.7*(90)^2*40*0.04 / 1000 | Answer: 4.536 kN

question: A specimen under stress 260 MPa shows an elastic strain of 2.7e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 260, eps = 2.7 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 260 / (2.7e-3) MPa = 96.3 GPa | Answer: 96.3 GPa

question: A block of mass 42 kg has a volume of 2.7e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 42, V = 2.7 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 42 / (2.7e-3) | Answer: 15556 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2200 mm is heated through 30 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2200, dT = 30, al = 23 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2200*23e-6*30 | Answer: 1.518 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 90 ohm, R2 = 35 ohm and R3 = 345 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 90, R2 = 35, R3 = 345 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 35*345 / 90 | Answer: 134.2 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.16 when the true value is 20. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.16, true = 20 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.16 - 20| / 20 * 100 | Answer: 54.2 %

question: Annual demand is 33500 units, ordering cost 100 per order and holding cost 3 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 33500, S = 100, H = 3 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*33500*100 / 3) | Answer: 1494 units

question: An asset costs 130000 with salvage value 34000 after 8 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 130000, Sv = 34000, n = 8 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (130000 - 34000) / 8 | Answer: 12000 per year

question: A product sells for 500 per unit with variable cost 110 per unit and fixed costs 200000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 500, V = 110, F = 200000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 200000 / (500 - 110) | Answer: 512.8 units

question: Find the present worth of 160000 received 8 years from now at an interest rate of 6% per year.
solution: Given: F = 160000, n = 8, i = 6 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 160000 / (1 + 0.06)^8 | Answer: 100386 currency units

question: A process produces 14 defective items in a batch of 9500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 14, N = 9500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 14/9500 * 1e6 | Answer: 1474 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 3x^3 - 6x^2 + 6x + 1 evaluated at x = 1.
For f(x) = -5x^3 + 3x^2 + 9x - 2, find f''(x) at x = 3.
Evaluate the definite integral of (-5x^2 + 6x + 2) dx from x = -2 to x = 6.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = -5x^3/3 + 6x^2/2 + 2x | Evaluate F(6) - F(-2) | Answer: -261.3
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 6x^2 + 12x - 11 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[8, -8], [-6, 8]].
solution: Given: a = 8, b = -8, c = -6, d = 8 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (8)(8) - (-8)(-6) | Answer: 16

question: Find the determinant of [[6, -5, -4], [-2, 5, -5], [-2, -4, 2]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -202

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[3, 7], [4, -5]].
solution: Trace tr = -2, Determinant = -43 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 5.633

question: Solve for x: -3x + -4y = -10 and -1x + 3y = 7.
solution: Determinant = -3*3 - -4*-1 = -13 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 0.1538 | Answer: x = 0.1538
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 62, 35, 35, 70, 93.
solution: Sum = 295 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 59 | Answer: 59

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 6, 7, 39, 46, 39.
solution: Mean = 27.4 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 19.3

question: Find the slope of the line through (7, -7) and (-4, -3).
Find the distance between the points (6, -1) and (-1, -9).
solution: Given: x1 = 6, y1 = -1, x2 = -1, y2 = -9 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((-7)^2 + (-8)^2) | Answer: 10.63 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-5,1), (-8,7), (-7,8).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 4.5 sq units

question: Find the 17th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 2 and common difference -2.
solution: Given: a = 2, d = -2, n = 17 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 2 + (17 - 1)*-2 | Answer: -30

question: Find the sum of the first 13 terms of an AP with first term -7 and common difference 1.
solution: Given: a = -7, d = 1, n = 13 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 13/2 [2*-7 + (13-1)*1] | Answer: -13

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 44500 at 11.2% per annum for 2 years.
solution: Given: P = 44500, R = 11.2, Tt = 2 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 44500 * 11.2 * 2 / 100 | Answer: 9968 currency units

question: Find the amount when 27500 is invested at 4.8% per annum compounded annually for 6 years.
solution: Given: P = 27500, R = 4.8, Tt = 6 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 27500 * (1 + 4.8/100)^6 | Answer: 36433 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (6, -1, 2) and (8, -2, 4).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (0, -6, -2) and (4, -1, 4).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 36.28

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (4, -1, -4) and (-5, 5, 3).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 147 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -2x^3 + 3x^2 + 9x + 8 at x = -5.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-33 with initial guess x0=15, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.1 and ordinates 6, 9, 18, 7, 11, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 299 and 425.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 299 and 425 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 44 and 74.
solution: Given: a = 44, b = 74 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 44*74 / 2 | Answer: 1628
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 13 mm carries an axial tensile load of 119 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 15 mm and length 1500 mm carries an axial load of 59 kN. Take E = 210 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 24 mm transmits a torque of 600 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 24, Tt = 600 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(600*1000) / (pi*(24)^3) | Answer: 221 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 37 mm and length 1800 mm carries a torque of 450 N-m. With G = 77 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (37)^4 / 32 = 183995 mm^4 | theta = (450*1000)(1800) / (77000 * 183995) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 3.276 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 139 mm wide and 230 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 139, h = 230 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 139*(230)^2 / 6 | Answer: 1225517 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (90 mm x 180 mm) carries a bending moment of 16 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (33 mm x 90 mm) has effective length 1800 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 320 MPa is designed for a working stress of 240 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 320, sw = 240 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 320 / 240 | Answer: 1.333

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1500 mm and wall thickness 7 mm carries an internal pressure of 0.6 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1500, t = 7, P = 0.6 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 0.6*1500 / (2*7) | Answer: 64.29 MPa

question: 2.3 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 170 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.3, dT = 170 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 2.3 * 0.718 * 170 | Answer: 280.7 kJ

question: 6 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 140 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6, dT = 140 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 6 * 1.005 * 140 | Answer: 844.2 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 3.7 m^3 at 600 K with mass 3.9 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 3.7, Tk = 600, m = 3.9 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 3.9*0.287*600 / 3.7 | Answer: 181.5 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 1.1 kg of air expands isothermally at 450 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.1, Tk = 450, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 1.1*0.287*450*ln(4) | Answer: 196.9 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.9 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.29 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.9, D = 0.29 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.9*0.29 / 0.001 | Answer: 1131000

question: Water flows at 2.5 m/s through a pipe of diameter 110 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 13.8 m. Taking Cv = 0.97, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 13.8, cv = 0.97 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.97*sqrt(2*9.81*13.8) | Answer: 15.96 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 270 mm) water flows at 2.9 m/s. It contracts to diameter 60 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 270, d2 = 60, V1 = 2.9 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2.9*(270/60)^2 | Answer: 58.73 m/s

question: Water flows at 2.7 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.45 m and length 470 m. With friction factor f = 0.037, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 21 teeth drives a gear of 101 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1300 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 21, z2 = 101, N1 = 1300 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1300*21 / 101 | Answer: 270.3 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 590 mm rotates at 900 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 590, N = 900 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.59)*900 / 60 | Answer: 27.8 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 4.7 kW at 900 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 4.7, N = 900 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(4.7*1000) / (2*pi*900) | Answer: 49.87 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 4.9 kg rotates at radius 0.53 m at 250 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 10500 N/m and mass 14.3 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 10500, m = 14.3 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(10500/14.3) | Answer: 4.313 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 6.9 m^2 and thickness 0.21 m has conductivity k = 27 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 180 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 6.9, L = 0.21, k = 27, dT = 180 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 27*6.9*180 / 0.21 | Answer: 159686 W

question: A surface of area 2.5 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 70 W/m^2-K to surroundings 50 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 2.5, h = 70, dT = 50 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 70*2.5*50 | Answer: 8750 W
