question: In turning, cutting speed = 120 m/min, feed = 0.28 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.4 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 120, f = 0.28, d = 1.4 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*120*0.28*1.4 | Answer: 47040 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 180 mm is turned at 850 rpm with a feed of 0.34 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 180, N = 850, f = 0.34 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 180 / (0.34*850) | Answer: 0.6228 min

question: A resistor of 39 ohm carries a current of 6.2 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 39, I = 6.2 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 6.2 * 39 | Answer: 241.8 V

question: Three resistors 54 ohm, 8 ohm and 71 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 54, R2 = 8, R3 = 71 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 54 + 8 + 71 | Answer: 133 ohm

question: Two resistors 28 ohm and 16 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 28, R2 = 16 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 28*16 / (28+16) | Answer: 10.18 ohm

question: A device draws 12.3 A at 90 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 90, I = 12.3 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 90 * 12.3 | Answer: 1107 W

question: A current of 7.3 A flows through a 100 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 7.3, R = 100 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (7.3)^2 * 100 | Answer: 5329 W

question: Two capacitors 49.9 uF and 29.8 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 49.9, C2 = 29.8 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 49.9*29.8 / (49.9+29.8) | Answer: 18.66 uF

question: A resistor 2 kohm and capacitor 15.6 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 2, C = 15.6 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (2k)(15.6u) = 31.2 ms | Answer: 31.2 ms

question: An inductor 74.8 mH is in series with 154 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 74.8, R = 154 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (74.8e-3) / 154 | Answer: 0.4857 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 136.3 mH inductor at 230 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 136.3, f = 230 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (230)(136.3e-3) | Answer: 197 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 31.2 uF capacitor at 760 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 31.2, f = 760 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (760)(31.2e-6)) | Answer: 6.712 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 43 ohm, XL = 139 ohm and XC = 112 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 43, XL = 139, XC = 112 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(43^2 + (139 - 112)^2) | Answer: 50.77 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 7.3 mH and C = 3.8 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 7.3, C = 3.8 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(7.3e-3 * 3.8e-6)) | Answer: 955.6 Hz

question: A capacitor of 41.7 uF is charged to 375 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 41.7, V = 375 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*41.7e-6*(375)^2 | Answer: 2932 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 160 V with 250 primary turns and 220 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 160, N1 = 250, N2 = 220 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 160 * 220/250 | Answer: 140.8 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 440 V and draws an armature current of 49 A. If the armature resistance is 0.62 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 440, Ia = 49, Ra = 0.62 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 440 - 49*0.62 | Answer: 409.6 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 145 A at 400 V (line) with a power factor of 0.83. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 145, VL = 400, pf = 0.83 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*400*145*0.83 / 1000 | Answer: 83.38 kW

question: A load has real power 70 kW and apparent power 105 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 70, S = 105 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 70 / 105 | Answer: 0.6667

question: A machine delivers 45 kW output while drawing 147 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 45, Pi = 147 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 45/147 * 100 | Answer: 30.61 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 12 V across R1 = 23 ohm and R2 = 16 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 12, R1 = 23, R2 = 16 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 12*16 / (23+16) | Answer: 4.923 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 60 kohm and Rin = 8 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 60, Rin = 8 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 60 / 8 | Answer: 7.5

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 60 kohm and Rg = 2 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 60, Rg = 2 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 60/2 | Answer: 31

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9482. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 9482 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(9482) | Answer: 39.77 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 5.3 m carries a central point load of 45 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.3, W = 45 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 45*5.3 / 4 | Answer: 59.62 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 4.9 m carries a UDL of 16 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.9, w = 16 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 16*(4.9)^2 / 2 | Answer: 192.1 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 9 m carries a point load 25 kN at distance 3.7 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 9, a = 3.7, W = 25 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 25*(9 - 3.7) / 9 | Answer: 14.72 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 7.5 m) carries a central point load 65 kN. With E = 30 GPa and I = 520e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=65000 N, L=7500.0 mm, E=30000 MPa, I=520e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 36.62 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 27.1 m^2 carrying a factored load of 9.4 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 27.1, w = 9.4 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 9.4 * 27.1 | Answer: 254.7 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 3 m, unit weight 20 kN/m^3, phi = 35 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 1.5e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1, area = 4.5e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 1.5, i = 1, A = 4.5 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (1.5e-4)*1*(4.5e-3) | Answer: 675 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 1.2 m, bed slope 0.004 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.014. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1.3 m under a head of 1.1 m. Taking Cd = 0.6 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 4.5 m wide carries a discharge of 12.7 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 490 m^3 treats a flow of 30 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 490, Q = 30 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 490 / 30 | Answer: 16.33 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 250 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.16 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 8 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 250, k = 0.16, t = 8 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 250*(1 - e^(-0.16*8)) | Answer: 180.5 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.32, rainfall intensity 120 mm/h over a catchment of 41.2 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.32, i = 120, A = 41.2 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.32*120*41.2 / 360 | Answer: 4.395 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.01 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 180 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.01, M = 180 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 180*(20+0.01)/20 | Answer: 180.1 m

question: Convert the decimal number 724 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 724 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 2D4 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 11110100 and 01100011.
solution: XOR: 10010111 | Count of 1s = 5 | Answer: 5
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 510 megabits is sent over a link of 14 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 510, B = 14 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 510 / 14 | Answer: 36.43 s

question: A link has bandwidth 97 Mbps and round-trip time 40 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 97, R = 40 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 97e6 * 40e-3 bits = 3880 kb | Answer: 3880 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.95, cache access time 1 ns and main-memory access time 200 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.95, tc = 1, tm = 200 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.95*1 + (1 - 0.95)*200 | Answer: 10.95 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 913884 elements?
solution: Given: n = 913884 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(913884)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.012, memory access time 140 ns and page-fault service time 8 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 8 ms = 8000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.012)*140 + 0.012*8000000.0 ns | Answer: 96.14 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 0.4 m^3 at 360 kPa and 350 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 0.4, P = 360, Tk = 350 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (360e3)*0.4 / (8.314*350) | Answer: 49.49 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 1e10 /s and activation energy 60 kJ/mol at 500 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 1, Ea = 60, Tk = 500 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 1e10 * exp(-60e3 / (8.314*500)) | Answer: 539 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.91 and bottoms xW = 0.08, with relative volatility alpha = 3. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.91, xw = 0.08, al = 3 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.91/0.09)(0.92/0.08)] / ln(3) | Answer: 4.329 stages

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.61 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 110 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.61, Psat = 110 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.61 * 110 | Answer: 67.1 kPa

question: A stream of 4.6 kg/s with specific heat 1.1 kJ/kg-K is heated through 45 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 4.6, cp = 1.1, dT = 45 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 4.6*1.1*45 | Answer: 227.7 kW

question: A reactor of volume 18.4 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 1.2 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 18.4, Q = 1.2 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 18.4 / 1.2 | Answer: 15.33 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 5.7e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 5 mm with a concentration difference of 130 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 5.7, L = 5, dC = 130 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (5.7e-9)*130 / (5e-3) | Answer: 148.2 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 2.7 min and steady-state gain 1.4. For a step input of magnitude 10, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 2.7, K = 1.4, M = 10 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 1.4 * 10 | Answer: 14 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 55 m^2 flies at 80 m/s (air density 1 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.4. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 55, V = 80, rho = 1, CL = 0.4 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*1*(80)^2*55*0.4 / 1000 | Answer: 70.4 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 65 m^2 flies at 130 m/s (density 0.4 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.08. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 65, V = 130, rho = 0.4, CD = 0.08 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*0.4*(130)^2*65*0.08 / 1000 | Answer: 17.58 kN

question: A block of mass 7 kg has a volume of 4.2e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 7, V = 4.2 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 7 / (4.2e-3) | Answer: 1667 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 1600 mm is heated through 95 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 23e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 1600, dT = 95, al = 23 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 1600*23e-6*95 | Answer: 3.496 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 175 ohm, R2 = 125 ohm and R3 = 15 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 175, R2 = 125, R3 = 15 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 125*15 / 175 | Answer: 10.71 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.11 when the true value is 20. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.11, true = 20 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.11 - 20| / 20 * 100 | Answer: 54.45 %

question: Annual demand is 27000 units, ordering cost 100 per order and holding cost 10 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 27000, S = 100, H = 10 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*27000*100 / 10) | Answer: 734.8 units

question: An asset costs 270000 with salvage value 38000 after 20 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 270000, Sv = 38000, n = 20 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (270000 - 38000) / 20 | Answer: 11600 per year

question: A product sells for 270 per unit with variable cost 160 per unit and fixed costs 110000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 270, V = 160, F = 110000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 110000 / (270 - 160) | Answer: 1000 units

question: Find the present worth of 140000 received 5 years from now at an interest rate of 10% per year.
solution: Given: F = 140000, n = 5, i = 10 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 140000 / (1 + 0.1)^5 | Answer: 86929 currency units

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.92, 0.96 and 0.99 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.
solution: Given: r1 = 0.92, r2 = 0.96, r3 = 0.99 | Formula: R_series = r1 * r2 * r3 | Substitute: R = 0.92*0.96*0.99 | Answer: 0.8744

question: A process produces 13 defective items in a batch of 12500. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 13, N = 12500 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 13/12500 * 1e6 | Answer: 1040 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = 4x^3 + x^2 - 7x - 4 evaluated at x = 4.
For f(x) = x^3 - 4x^2 + 9x - 6, find f''(x) at x = -5.
Evaluate the definite integral of (2x + 7) dx from x = -1 to x = 5.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 0x^3/3 + 2x^2/2 + 7x | Evaluate F(5) - F(-1) | Answer: 66
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 5x^2 + 5x - 3 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[-4, -8], [3, -8]].
solution: Given: a = -4, b = -8, c = 3, d = -8 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (-4)(-8) - (-8)(3) | Answer: 56

question: Find the determinant of [[-5, -4, -6], [-3, 4, -1], [3, 6, -5]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: 322

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[8, -3], [-7, -3]].
solution: Trace tr = 5, Determinant = -45 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 9.659

question: Solve for x: -4x + 1y = -5 and 5x + 5y = 5.
solution: Determinant = -4*5 - 1*5 = -25 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 1.2 | Answer: x = 1.2
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 61, 44, 98, 83, 40.
solution: Sum = 326 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 65.2 | Answer: 65.2

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 25, 37, 17, 37, 39.
solution: Mean = 31 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 9.592

question: Find the slope of the line through (-5, -3) and (8, -5).
Find the distance between the points (-9, -6) and (4, -8).
solution: Given: x1 = -9, y1 = -6, x2 = 4, y2 = -8 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((13)^2 + (-2)^2) | Answer: 13.15 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-1,2), (-3,1), (-8,4).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 5.5 sq units

question: Find the 6th term of an arithmetic progression with first term -10 and common difference -1.
solution: Given: a = -10, d = -1, n = 6 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = -10 + (6 - 1)*-1 | Answer: -15

question: Find the sum of the first 13 terms of an AP with first term -4 and common difference -4.
solution: Given: a = -4, d = -4, n = 13 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 13/2 [2*-4 + (13-1)*-4] | Answer: -364

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 41000 at 14.2% per annum for 10 years.
solution: Given: P = 41000, R = 14.2, Tt = 10 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 41000 * 14.2 * 10 / 100 | Answer: 58220 currency units

question: Find the amount when 10500 is invested at 8% per annum compounded annually for 5 years.
solution: Given: P = 10500, R = 8, Tt = 5 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 10500 * (1 + 8/100)^5 | Answer: 15428 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (-7, -2, -1) and (7, -8, 0).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (2, 6, -6) and (-2, 3, 3).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 40.69

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (3, 3, 4) and (4, 2, 6).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 15.73 degrees

question: Find the argument (in degrees) of the complex number 12 + -6i.
solution: Given: a = 12, b = -6 | Formula: arg(z) = atan2(b, a) | Substitute: arg = atan2(-6, 12) | Answer: -26.57 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = 4x^3 - 7x^2 + 3x - 1 at x = 5.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-46 with initial guess x0=2, find x1 (one iteration).
solution: Given: N = 46, x0 = 2 | Formula: x1 = x0 - (x0^2 - N)/(2 x0) | Substitute: x1 = 2 - ((2)^2 - 46)/(2*2) | Answer: 12.5

question: Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.1 and ordinates 11, 1, 2, 3, 10, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 555 and 460.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 555 and 460 | Answer: GCD = 5

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 37 and 52.
solution: Given: a = 37, b = 52 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 37*52 / 1 | Answer: 1924
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 28 mm carries an axial tensile load of 8 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 40 mm and length 1900 mm carries an axial load of 81 kN. Take E = 200 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 21 mm transmits a torque of 1650 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 21, Tt = 1650 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(1650*1000) / (pi*(21)^3) | Answer: 907.4 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 49 mm and length 1000 mm carries a torque of 1350 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (49)^4 / 32 = 565958 mm^4 | theta = (1350*1000)(1000) / (80000 * 565958) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 1.708 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 58 mm wide and 300 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 58, h = 300 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 58*(300)^2 / 6 | Answer: 870000 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (45 mm x 170 mm) carries a bending moment of 10 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (61 mm x 110 mm) has effective length 2800 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 590 MPa is designed for a working stress of 140 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 590, sw = 140 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 590 / 140 | Answer: 4.214

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 450 mm and wall thickness 19 mm carries an internal pressure of 0.7 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 450, t = 19, P = 0.7 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 0.7*450 / (2*19) | Answer: 8.289 MPa

question: 6.4 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 170 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.4, dT = 170 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 6.4 * 0.718 * 170 | Answer: 781.2 kJ

question: 6.1 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 70 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 6.1, dT = 70 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 6.1 * 1.005 * 70 | Answer: 429.1 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1.2 m^3 at 540 K with mass 4.3 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1.2, Tk = 540, m = 4.3 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 4.3*0.287*540 / 1.2 | Answer: 555.3 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 3.8 kg of air expands isothermally at 490 K from volume V1 to 3*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 3.8, Tk = 490, ratio = 3 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 3.8*0.287*490*ln(3) | Answer: 587.1 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 3.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.26 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 3.4, D = 0.26 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*3.4*0.26 / 0.001 | Answer: 884000

question: Water issues from an orifice under a head of 18.6 m. Taking Cv = 0.96, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 18.6, cv = 0.96 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.96*sqrt(2*9.81*18.6) | Answer: 18.34 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 160 mm) water flows at 2 m/s. It contracts to diameter 130 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
solution: Given: d1 = 160, d2 = 130, V1 = 2 | Formula: A1 V1 = A2 V2  =>  V2 = V1 (d1/d2)^2 | Substitute: V2 = 2*(160/130)^2 | Answer: 3.03 m/s

question: Water flows at 2.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.38 m and length 390 m. With friction factor f = 0.035, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 16 teeth drives a gear of 70 teeth. If the pinion runs at 900 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 16, z2 = 70, N1 = 900 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 900*16 / 70 | Answer: 205.7 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 220 mm rotates at 550 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 220, N = 550 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.22)*550 / 60 | Answer: 6.336 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 46.2 kW at 600 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 46.2, N = 600 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(46.2*1000) / (2*pi*600) | Answer: 735.3 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 4.9 kg rotates at radius 0.42 m at 350 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 15300 N/m and mass 13.2 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 15300, m = 13.2 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(15300/13.2) | Answer: 5.418 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 1.9 m^2 and thickness 0.18 m has conductivity k = 14.6 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 60 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 1.9, L = 0.18, k = 14.6, dT = 60 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 14.6*1.9*60 / 0.18 | Answer: 9247 W

question: A surface of area 5.4 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 200 W/m^2-K to surroundings 30 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 5.4, h = 200, dT = 30 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 200*5.4*30 | Answer: 32400 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 210 m/min, feed = 0.11 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.1 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 210, f = 0.11, d = 1.1 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*210*0.11*1.1 | Answer: 25410 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 400 mm is turned at 950 rpm with a feed of 0.39 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 400, N = 950, f = 0.39 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 400 / (0.39*950) | Answer: 1.08 min

question: A resistor of 135 ohm carries a current of 1.4 A. Find the voltage across it.

question: Three resistors 28 ohm, 61 ohm and 90 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 28, R2 = 61, R3 = 90 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 28 + 61 + 90 | Answer: 179 ohm

question: Two resistors 39 ohm and 66 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 39, R2 = 66 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 39*66 / (39+66) | Answer: 24.51 ohm

question: A device draws 13.8 A at 120 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 120, I = 13.8 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 120 * 13.8 | Answer: 1656 W

question: A current of 11.2 A flows through a 8 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 11.2, R = 8 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (11.2)^2 * 8 | Answer: 1004 W

question: Two capacitors 14.7 uF and 35.8 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 14.7, C2 = 35.8 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 14.7*35.8 / (14.7+35.8) | Answer: 10.42 uF

question: A resistor 76 kohm and capacitor 4.1 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.

question: An inductor 15.1 mH is in series with 185 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 15.1, R = 185 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (15.1e-3) / 185 | Answer: 0.08162 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 77.9 mH inductor at 990 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 77.9, f = 990 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (990)(77.9e-3) | Answer: 484.6 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 44.7 uF capacitor at 230 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 44.7, f = 230 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (230)(44.7e-6)) | Answer: 15.48 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 73 ohm, XL = 133 ohm and XC = 97 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 73, XL = 133, XC = 97 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(73^2 + (133 - 97)^2) | Answer: 81.39 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 64.4 mH and C = 2 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 64.4, C = 2 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(64.4e-3 * 2e-6)) | Answer: 443.5 Hz

question: A capacitor of 46.5 uF is charged to 295 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 46.5, V = 295 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*46.5e-6*(295)^2 | Answer: 2023 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 280 V with 980 primary turns and 30 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 280, N1 = 980, N2 = 30 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 280 * 30/980 | Answer: 8.571 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 440 V and draws an armature current of 18 A. If the armature resistance is 0.21 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 440, Ia = 18, Ra = 0.21 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 440 - 18*0.21 | Answer: 436.2 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 70 A at 415 V (line) with a power factor of 0.9. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 70, VL = 415, pf = 0.9 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*415*70*0.9 / 1000 | Answer: 45.28 kW

question: A load has real power 125 kW and apparent power 150 kVA. Find the power factor.

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 25 V across R1 = 34 ohm and R2 = 47 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 120 kohm and Rin = 23 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 80 kohm and Rg = 37 kohm. Find the voltage gain.

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9594. Express the gain in decibels (power).

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.2 m carries a central point load of 10 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.

question: A simply supported beam of span 7.4 m carries a UDL of 5 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 7.4, w = 5 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 5*(7.4)^2 / 8 | Answer: 34.23 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.7 m carries a point load 70 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.7, W = 70 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 70*5.7 | Answer: 399 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 5.1 m carries a UDL of 16 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 5.1, w = 16 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 16*(5.1)^2 / 2 | Answer: 208.1 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4 m carries a point load 30 kN at distance 1.3 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.

question: A simply supported beam (span 5.5 m) carries a central point load 15 kN. With E = 200 GPa and I = 420e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.

question: A fixed beam of span 6.8 m carries a UDL of 9 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.

question: An RC beam has overall depth 420 mm, clear cover 50 mm and main bars of diameter 16 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.

question: A column supports a floor area of 25.1 m^2 carrying a factored load of 14.7 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.

solution: Given: k = 7.7, i = 0.9, A = 2.4 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (7.7e-4)*0.9*(2.4e-3) | Answer: 1663 mm^3/s

question: A tank of volume 390 m^3 treats a flow of 105 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 390, Q = 105 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 390 / 105 | Answer: 3.714 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 280 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.16 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 5 days.

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.81, rainfall intensity 55 mm/h over a catchment of 22.9 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.01 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 500 m with this tape.

question: A file of 770 megabits is sent over a link of 34 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.

question: A link has bandwidth 90 Mbps and round-trip time 140 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 90, R = 140 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 90e6 * 140e-3 bits = 12600 kb | Answer: 12600 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.87, cache access time 4 ns and main-memory access time 150 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.87, tc = 4, tm = 150 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.87*4 + (1 - 0.87)*150 | Answer: 22.98 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 823087 elements?

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.015, memory access time 170 ns and page-fault service time 3 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 0.3 m^3 at 260 kPa and 320 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 0.3, P = 260, Tk = 320 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (260e3)*0.3 / (8.314*320) | Answer: 29.32 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 7e10 /s and activation energy 65 kJ/mol at 370 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.94 and bottoms xW = 0.09, with relative volatility alpha = 3.1. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.94, xw = 0.09, al = 3.1 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.94/0.06)(0.91/0.09)] / ln(3.1) | Answer: 4.477 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.85 and x = 0.35. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.62 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 105 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.

question: A stream of 4.1 kg/s with specific heat 1.1 kJ/kg-K is heated through 10 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.

question: A reactor of volume 11.3 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 1.6 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 8.2e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 1 mm with a concentration difference of 20 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.

question: A first-order process has time constant 7.1 min and steady-state gain 3.4. For a step input of magnitude 6, find the final (steady-state) change in output.

question: An aircraft wing of area 65 m^2 flies at 180 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 0.9. Find the lift force in kN.

question: An aircraft of wing area 95 m^2 flies at 240 m/s (density 1 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.08. Find the drag force in kN.

question: A specimen under stress 170 MPa shows an elastic strain of 0.7e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.

question: A block of mass 45 kg has a volume of 3.9e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.

question: A rod of length 1000 mm is heated through 110 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 11e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 75 ohm, R2 = 65 ohm and R3 = 115 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).

question: A measurement reads 10.39 when the true value is 100. Find the percentage error.

question: Annual demand is 30500 units, ordering cost 150 per order and holding cost 2 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).

question: An asset costs 120000 with salvage value 38000 after 19 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.

question: A product sells for 250 per unit with variable cost 30 per unit and fixed costs 45000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 250, V = 30, F = 45000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 45000 / (250 - 30) | Answer: 204.5 units

question: Find the present worth of 140000 received 4 years from now at an interest rate of 9% per year.

question: Three components with reliabilities 0.98, 0.96 and 0.94 are connected in series. Find the system reliability.

question: A process produces 14 defective items in a batch of 1000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 14, N = 1000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 14/1000 * 1e6 | Answer: 14000 PPM

question: A circular rod of diameter 17 mm carries an axial tensile load of 14 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 31 mm and length 2900 mm carries an axial load of 86 kN. Take E = 210 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 36 mm transmits a torque of 300 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 36, Tt = 300 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(300*1000) / (pi*(36)^3) | Answer: 32.75 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 29 mm and length 1100 mm carries a torque of 550 N-m. With G = 45 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (29)^4 / 32 = 69437 mm^4 | theta = (550*1000)(1100) / (45000 * 69437) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 11.09 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 55 mm wide and 300 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 55, h = 300 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 55*(300)^2 / 6 | Answer: 825000 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (67 mm x 130 mm) carries a bending moment of 37 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (70 mm x 150 mm) has effective length 3500 mm and E = 210 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 780 MPa is designed for a working stress of 130 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 780, sw = 130 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 780 / 130 | Answer: 6

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 1100 mm and wall thickness 13 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.1 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 1100, t = 13, P = 1.1 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.1*1100 / (2*13) | Answer: 46.54 MPa

question: 4.1 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 30 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.1, dT = 30 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 4.1 * 0.718 * 30 | Answer: 88.31 kJ

question: 2.3 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 170 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.3, dT = 170 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 2.3 * 1.005 * 170 | Answer: 393 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 1.8 m^3 at 600 K with mass 5.8 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 1.8, Tk = 600, m = 5.8 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 5.8*0.287*600 / 1.8 | Answer: 554.9 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 1.2 kg of air expands isothermally at 480 K from volume V1 to 5*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.2, Tk = 480, ratio = 5 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 1.2*0.287*480*ln(5) | Answer: 266.1 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 1.4 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.36 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 1.4, D = 0.36 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*1.4*0.36 / 0.001 | Answer: 504000

question: Water flows at 3 m/s through a pipe of diameter 140 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 4.2 m. Taking Cv = 0.95, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 4.2, cv = 0.95 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.95*sqrt(2*9.81*4.2) | Answer: 8.624 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 250 mm) water flows at 1.4 m/s. It contracts to diameter 120 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
Water flows at 2.6 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.37 m and length 460 m. With friction factor f = 0.029, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 29 teeth drives a gear of 70 teeth. If the pinion runs at 1150 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 29, z2 = 70, N1 = 1150 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 1150*29 / 70 | Answer: 476.4 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 480 mm rotates at 1150 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 480, N = 1150 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.48)*1150 / 60 | Answer: 28.9 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 14 kW at 550 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 14, N = 550 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(14*1000) / (2*pi*550) | Answer: 243.1 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 8.4 kg rotates at radius 0.41 m at 1200 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 6900 N/m and mass 6.8 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 6900, m = 6.8 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(6900/6.8) | Answer: 5.07 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 8.5 m^2 and thickness 0.39 m has conductivity k = 21.9 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 35 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 8.5, L = 0.39, k = 21.9, dT = 35 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 21.9*8.5*35 / 0.39 | Answer: 16706 W

question: A surface of area 3.2 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 55 W/m^2-K to surroundings 120 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 3.2, h = 55, dT = 120 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 55*3.2*120 | Answer: 21120 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 100 m/min, feed = 0.42 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.7 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 100, f = 0.42, d = 1.7 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*100*0.42*1.7 | Answer: 71400 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 430 mm is turned at 450 rpm with a feed of 0.23 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 430, N = 450, f = 0.23 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 430 / (0.23*450) | Answer: 4.155 min

question: A resistor of 132 ohm carries a current of 6.7 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 132, I = 6.7 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 6.7 * 132 | Answer: 884.4 V

question: Three resistors 72 ohm, 81 ohm and 15 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 72, R2 = 81, R3 = 15 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 72 + 81 + 15 | Answer: 168 ohm

question: Two resistors 119 ohm and 12 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 119, R2 = 12 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 119*12 / (119+12) | Answer: 10.9 ohm

question: A device draws 4.8 A at 30 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 30, I = 4.8 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 30 * 4.8 | Answer: 144 W

question: A current of 9.4 A flows through a 43 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 9.4, R = 43 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (9.4)^2 * 43 | Answer: 3799 W

question: Two capacitors 43.6 uF and 38.7 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 43.6, C2 = 38.7 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 43.6*38.7 / (43.6+38.7) | Answer: 20.5 uF

question: A resistor 99 kohm and capacitor 14.7 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 99, C = 14.7 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (99k)(14.7u) = 1455 ms | Answer: 1455 ms

question: An inductor 379.8 mH is in series with 105 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 379.8, R = 105 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (379.8e-3) / 105 | Answer: 3.617 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 65.5 mH inductor at 830 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 65.5, f = 830 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (830)(65.5e-3) | Answer: 341.6 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 4.9 uF capacitor at 370 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 4.9, f = 370 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (370)(4.9e-6)) | Answer: 87.79 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 85 ohm, XL = 26 ohm and XC = 121 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 85, XL = 26, XC = 121 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(85^2 + (26 - 121)^2) | Answer: 127.5 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 29.1 mH and C = 0.4 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 29.1, C = 0.4 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(29.1e-3 * 0.4e-6)) | Answer: 1475 Hz

question: A capacitor of 85.9 uF is charged to 385 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 85.9, V = 385 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*85.9e-6*(385)^2 | Answer: 6366 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 390 V with 770 primary turns and 340 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 390, N1 = 770, N2 = 340 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 390 * 340/770 | Answer: 172.2 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 310 V and draws an armature current of 56 A. If the armature resistance is 0.58 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 310, Ia = 56, Ra = 0.58 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 310 - 56*0.58 | Answer: 277.5 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 185 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.75. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 185, VL = 433, pf = 0.75 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*185*0.75 / 1000 | Answer: 104.1 kW

question: A load has real power 65 kW and apparent power 205 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 65, S = 205 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 65 / 205 | Answer: 0.3171

question: A machine delivers 30 kW output while drawing 187 kW input. Find its efficiency (%).
solution: Given: Po = 30, Pi = 187 | Formula: eta = (P_out / P_in) * 100 | Substitute: eta = 30/187 * 100 | Answer: 16.04 %

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 27 V across R1 = 1 ohm and R2 = 28 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 27, R1 = 1, R2 = 28 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 27*28 / (1+28) | Answer: 26.07 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 70 kohm and Rin = 32 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 70, Rin = 32 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 70 / 32 | Answer: 2.188

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 1529. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 1529 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(1529) | Answer: 31.84 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 8 m carries a central point load of 65 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 8, W = 65 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 65*8 / 4 | Answer: 130 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 4.8 m carries a UDL of 18 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 4.8, w = 18 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 18*(4.8)^2 / 2 | Answer: 207.4 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 6.5 m carries a point load 80 kN at distance 1.4 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 6.5, a = 1.4, W = 80 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 80*(6.5 - 1.4) / 6.5 | Answer: 62.77 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 3.2 m) carries a central point load 80 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 230e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=80000 N, L=3200.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=230e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 9.498 mm

question: An RC beam has overall depth 350 mm, clear cover 35 mm and main bars of diameter 12 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 350, c = 35, dia = 12 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 350 - 35 - 12/2 | Answer: 309 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 13.2 m^2 carrying a factored load of 11.4 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 13.2, w = 11.4 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 11.4 * 13.2 | Answer: 150.5 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 4.5 m, unit weight 18 kN/m^3, phi = 34 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 5.1e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 1.5, area = 2.7e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 5.1, i = 1.5, A = 2.7 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (5.1e-4)*1.5*(2.7e-3) | Answer: 2066 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 0.9 m, bed slope 0.002 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.019. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 4.2 m under a head of 0.3 m. Taking Cd = 0.61 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 2.2 m wide carries a discharge of 26.5 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 930 m^3 treats a flow of 10 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 930, Q = 10 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 930 / 10 | Answer: 93 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 320 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.23 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 5 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 320, k = 0.23, t = 5 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 320*(1 - e^(-0.23*5)) | Answer: 218.7 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.75, rainfall intensity 110 mm/h over a catchment of 31.9 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.75, i = 110, A = 31.9 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.75*110*31.9 / 360 | Answer: 7.31 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 30 m is actually 0.05 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 280 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 30, e = 0.05, M = 280 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 280*(30+0.05)/30 | Answer: 280.5 m

question: Convert the decimal number 597 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 597 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: 255 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 10011001 and 01011010.
solution: XOR: 11000011 | Count of 1s = 4 | Answer: 4
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 340 megabits is sent over a link of 18 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 340, B = 18 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 340 / 18 | Answer: 18.89 s

question: A link has bandwidth 22 Mbps and round-trip time 190 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 22, R = 190 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 22e6 * 190e-3 bits = 4180 kb | Answer: 4180 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.91, cache access time 3 ns and main-memory access time 50 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.91, tc = 3, tm = 50 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.91*3 + (1 - 0.91)*50 | Answer: 7.23 ns

question: In the worst case, how many comparisons does binary search make on a sorted array of 907562 elements?
solution: Given: n = 907562 | Formula: comparisons = floor(log2(n)) + 1 | Substitute: floor(log2(907562)) + 1 | Answer: 20

question: A demand-paging system has page-fault rate 0.008, memory access time 100 ns and page-fault service time 7 ms. Find the effective access time in microseconds.
solution: Service time = 7 ms = 7000000.0 ns | EAT = (1 - 0.008)*100 + 0.008*7000000.0 ns | Answer: 56.1 microseconds
formula: EAT = (1 - pf) * ma + pf * (page-fault service time)

question: Find the number of moles of an ideal gas occupying 0.5 m^3 at 150 kPa and 490 K (R = 8.314 J/mol-K).
solution: Given: V = 0.5, P = 150, Tk = 490 | Formula: n = P V / (R T) | Substitute: n = (150e3)*0.5 / (8.314*490) | Answer: 18.41 mol

question: For a reaction with A = 4e10 /s and activation energy 65 kJ/mol at 320 K, find the rate constant (per second). Take R = 8.314 J/mol-K.
solution: Given: A = 4, Ea = 65, Tk = 320 | Formula: k = A exp(-Ea / (R T)) | Substitute: k = 4e10 * exp(-65e3 / (8.314*320)) | Answer: 0.9807 /s

question: In a binary distillation, distillate mole fraction xD = 0.91 and bottoms xW = 0.04, with relative volatility alpha = 2.8. Find the minimum number of theoretical stages (Fenske).
solution: Given: xd = 0.91, xw = 0.04, al = 2.8 | Formula: Nmin = ln[(xD/(1-xD)) ((1-xW)/xW)] / ln(alpha) | Substitute: Nmin = ln[(0.91/0.09)(0.96/0.04)] / ln(2.8) | Answer: 5.334 stages

question: Vapour and liquid mole fractions of the light component are y = 0.55 and x = 0.23. Find the relative volatility alpha (binary).
solution: Given: y = 0.55, x = 0.23 | Formula: alpha = [y/(1-y)] / [x/(1-x)] | Substitute: alpha = (0.55/0.45) / (0.23/0.77) | Answer: 4.092

question: A liquid has mole fraction 0.44 of a component whose pure-component vapour pressure is 55 kPa. Using Raoult's law, find its partial pressure in kPa.
solution: Given: x = 0.44, Psat = 55 | Formula: p_i = x_i Psat | Substitute: p_i = 0.44 * 55 | Answer: 24.2 kPa

question: A stream of 3.7 kg/s with specific heat 1.2 kJ/kg-K is heated through 75 deg C. Find the heat duty in kW.
solution: Given: m = 3.7, cp = 1.2, dT = 75 | Formula: Q = m cp dT | Substitute: Q = 3.7*1.2*75 | Answer: 333 kW

question: A reactor of volume 3.6 m^3 is fed at a volumetric rate of 2.6 m^3/min. Find the mean residence time in minutes.
solution: Given: V = 3.6, Q = 2.6 | Formula: tau = V / Q | Substitute: tau = 3.6 / 2.6 | Answer: 1.385 min

question: Steady diffusion occurs with D = 6.6e-9 m^2/s across a film of thickness 3 mm with a concentration difference of 50 mol/m^3. Find the molar flux in micromol/m^2-s.
solution: Given: D = 6.6, L = 3, dC = 50 | Formula: J = D (dC / L) | Substitute: J = (6.6e-9)*50 / (3e-3) | Answer: 110 micromol/m^2-s

question: A first-order process has time constant 2.9 min and steady-state gain 1.9. For a step input of magnitude 19, find the final (steady-state) change in output.
solution: Given: tau = 2.9, K = 1.9, M = 19 | Formula: Delta y(inf) = K * M | Substitute: Delta y = 1.9 * 19 | Answer: 36.1 units

question: An aircraft wing of area 60 m^2 flies at 60 m/s (air density 0.7 kg/m^3) with lift coefficient 1.2. Find the lift force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 60, V = 60, rho = 0.7, CL = 1.2 | Formula: L = 0.5 rho V^2 S CL | Substitute: L = 0.5*0.7*(60)^2*60*1.2 / 1000 | Answer: 90.72 kN

question: An aircraft of wing area 75 m^2 flies at 190 m/s (density 1 kg/m^3) with drag coefficient 0.06. Find the drag force in kN.
solution: Given: S = 75, V = 190, rho = 1, CD = 0.06 | Formula: D = 0.5 rho V^2 S CD | Substitute: D = 0.5*1*(190)^2*75*0.06 / 1000 | Answer: 81.22 kN

question: A specimen under stress 280 MPa shows an elastic strain of 1.4e-3. Find the Young's modulus in GPa.
solution: Given: sig = 280, eps = 1.4 | Formula: E = stress / strain | Substitute: E = 280 / (1.4e-3) MPa = 200 GPa | Answer: 200 GPa

question: A block of mass 42 kg has a volume of 2.9e-3 m^3. Find its density in kg/m^3.
solution: Given: m = 42, V = 2.9 | Formula: density = mass / volume | Substitute: rho = 42 / (2.9e-3) | Answer: 14483 kg/m^3

question: A rod of length 2400 mm is heated through 105 deg C. With coefficient of thermal expansion 17e-6 /deg C, find the change in length in mm.
solution: Given: L = 2400, dT = 105, al = 17 | Formula: dL = L alpha dT | Substitute: dL = 2400*17e-6*105 | Answer: 4.284 mm

question: A Wheatstone bridge is balanced with R1 = 195 ohm, R2 = 85 ohm and R3 = 495 ohm. Find the unknown resistance R4 (R1/R2 = R3/R4).
solution: Given: R1 = 195, R2 = 85, R3 = 495 | Formula: R4 = R2 R3 / R1 | Substitute: R4 = 85*495 / 195 | Answer: 215.8 ohm

question: A measurement reads 9.01 when the true value is 50. Find the percentage error.
solution: Given: meas = 9.01, true = 50 | Formula: % error = |measured - true| / true * 100 | Substitute: % error = |9.01 - 50| / 50 * 100 | Answer: 81.98 %

question: Annual demand is 28000 units, ordering cost 290 per order and holding cost 21 per unit per year. Find the economic order quantity (EOQ).
solution: Given: D = 28000, S = 290, H = 21 | Formula: EOQ = sqrt(2 D S / H) | Substitute: EOQ = sqrt(2*28000*290 / 21) | Answer: 879.4 units

question: An asset costs 170000 with salvage value 16000 after 18 years. Find the annual straight-line depreciation.
solution: Given: C = 170000, Sv = 16000, n = 18 | Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Salvage) / life | Substitute: D = (170000 - 16000) / 18 | Answer: 8556 per year

question: A product sells for 490 per unit with variable cost 20 per unit and fixed costs 195000. Find the break-even quantity in units.
solution: Given: P = 490, V = 20, F = 195000 | Formula: Q_be = Fixed cost / (Price - Variable cost) | Substitute: Q = 195000 / (490 - 20) | Answer: 414.9 units

question: Find the present worth of 90000 received 10 years from now at an interest rate of 10% per year.
solution: Given: F = 90000, n = 10, i = 10 | Formula: PW = F / (1 + i)^n | Substitute: PW = 90000 / (1 + 0.1)^10 | Answer: 34699 currency units

question: A process produces 28 defective items in a batch of 2000. Find the defect rate in parts per million (PPM).
solution: Given: def = 28, N = 2000 | Formula: PPM = (defects / total) * 1e6 | Substitute: PPM = 28/2000 * 1e6 | Answer: 14000 PPM

question: Find the derivative of f(x) = -5x^3 - 4x^2 - 9x - 4 evaluated at x = -4.
For f(x) = 2x^3 - 8x^2 + 9x - 9, find f''(x) at x = -1.
Evaluate the definite integral of (2) dx from x = 1 to x = 5.
solution: Antiderivative F(x) = 0x^3/3 + 0x^2/2 + 2x | Evaluate F(5) - F(1) | Answer: 8
formula: integral = a x^3/3 + b x^2/2 + c x

question: Find the larger real root of 2x^2 + 9x - 1 = 0.
Find the determinant of the 2x2 matrix [[1, 1], [3, 1]].
solution: Given: a = 1, b = 1, c = 3, d = 1 | Formula: det = ad - bc | Substitute: det = (1)(1) - (1)(3) | Answer: -2

question: Find the determinant of [[-2, 3, -6], [0, 1, 2], [-6, -1, -4]].
solution: Expand along the first row: | det = a(ei - fh) - b(di - fg) + c(dh - eg) | Answer: -68

question: Find the larger eigenvalue of [[6, -8], [-3, -7]].
solution: Trace tr = -1, Determinant = -66 | lambda = (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)) / 2 | Answer: 7.639

question: Solve for x: -3x + -4y = -12 and 3x + -3y = 8.
solution: Determinant = -3*-3 - -4*3 = 21 | x = (e d - b f) / det = 3.238 | Answer: x = 3.238
formula: x = (e d - b f) / (a d - b c)  [Cramer's rule]

question: Find the arithmetic mean of the data set: 35, 16, 5, 73, 53.
solution: Sum = 182 | Mean = Sum / 5 = 36.4 | Answer: 36.4

question: Find the sample standard deviation of: 1, 26, 21, 29, 36.
solution: Mean = 22.6 | Compute squared deviations, sum them, divide by (n-1)=4, take the square root | Answer: s = 13.24

question: Find the slope of the line through (8, 8) and (-3, -4).
solution: Given: x1 = 8, y1 = 8, x2 = -3, y2 = -4 | Formula: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) | Substitute: m = (-4 - 8) / (-3 - 8) | Answer: 1.091

question: Find the distance between the points (-7, -2) and (0, 8).
solution: Given: x1 = -7, y1 = -2, x2 = 0, y2 = 8 | Formula: d = sqrt((x2-x1)^2 + (y2-y1)^2) | Substitute: d = sqrt((7)^2 + (10)^2) | Answer: 12.21 units

question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (-6,-7), (8,-3), (-1,7).
solution: Apply the shoelace formula: | Area = 0.5 |x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2)| | Answer: 88 sq units

question: Find the 7th term of an arithmetic progression with first term 3 and common difference -1.
solution: Given: a = 3, d = -1, n = 7 | Formula: a_n = a + (n - 1) d | Substitute: a_n = 3 + (7 - 1)*-1 | Answer: -3

question: Find the sum of the first 36 terms of an AP with first term 8 and common difference 1.
solution: Given: a = 8, d = 1, n = 36 | Formula: S_n = n/2 [2a + (n - 1) d] | Substitute: S_n = 36/2 [2*8 + (36-1)*1] | Answer: 918

question: Find the simple interest on a principal of 28000 at 10.4% per annum for 8 years.
solution: Given: P = 28000, R = 10.4, Tt = 8 | Formula: SI = P R T / 100 | Substitute: SI = 28000 * 10.4 * 8 / 100 | Answer: 23296 currency units

question: Find the amount when 35000 is invested at 11% per annum compounded annually for 3 years.
solution: Given: P = 35000, R = 11, Tt = 3 | Formula: A = P (1 + R/100)^T | Substitute: A = 35000 * (1 + 11/100)^3 | Answer: 47867 currency units

question: Find the dot product of vectors (6, 7, 3) and (1, -7, 3).
formula: a . b = a1 b1 + a2 b2 + a3 b3

question: Find the magnitude of the cross product of (-6, 4, -6) and (5, -4, 3).
solution: Cross product c = a x b, then take its magnitude | Answer: 17.44

question: Find the angle (in degrees) between (5, 3, -3) and (-2, -4, 4).
solution: Compute a.b, |a| and |b|, then theta = arccos(a.b/(|a||b|)) | Answer: 149.8 degrees

question: Evaluate f(x) = -2x^3 - 4x^2 - 5x - 7 at x = 0.
Using Newton-Raphson for f(x)=x^2-65 with initial guess x0=15, find x1 (one iteration).
Using the trapezoidal rule with step h=1.2 and ordinates 15, 14, 9, 4, 9, estimate the integral.
Find the greatest common divisor (GCD) of 382 and 451.
solution: Apply the Euclidean algorithm to 382 and 451 | Answer: GCD = 1

question: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of 25 and 56.
solution: Given: a = 25, b = 56 | Formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b) | Substitute: LCM = 25*56 / 1 | Answer: 1400
formula: LCM(a, b) = a b / GCD(a, b)

question: A circular rod of diameter 38 mm carries an axial tensile load of 112 kN. Find the direct stress in MPa.
A rod of diameter 37 mm and length 1400 mm carries an axial load of 57 kN. Take E = 70 GPa. Find the elongation in mm.
A solid shaft of diameter 63 mm transmits a torque of 1300 N-m. Find the maximum torsional shear stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 63, Tt = 1300 | Formula: tau = 16 T / (pi d^3) | Substitute: tau = 16*(1300*1000) / (pi*(63)^3) | Answer: 26.48 MPa

question: A shaft of diameter 66 mm and length 900 mm carries a torque of 800 N-m. With G = 80 GPa, find the angle of twist in degrees.
solution: J = pi (66)^4 / 32 = 186284 mm^4 | theta = (800*1000)(900) / (80000 * 186284) rad | Convert to degrees. Answer: 0.2768 degrees
formula: theta = T L / (G J),  J = pi d^4 / 32

question: A rectangular beam section is 71 mm wide and 170 mm deep. Find its section modulus about the horizontal axis in mm^3.
solution: Given: b = 71, h = 170 | Formula: Z = b h^2 / 6 | Substitute: Z = 71*(170)^2 / 6 | Answer: 341983 mm^3

question: A rectangular cross-section beam (113 mm x 80 mm) carries a bending moment of 20 kN-m. Find the maximum bending stress in MPa.
formula: sigma = M / Z,  Z = b h^2 / 6

question: A rectangular column (65 mm x 100 mm) has effective length 2700 mm and E = 200 GPa. Find the Euler buckling load in kN (buckling about the weak axis).
formula: Pcr = pi^2 E I / Le^2,  I = h b^3 / 12 (weak axis)

question: A component of ultimate strength 470 MPa is designed for a working stress of 220 MPa. Find the factor of safety.
solution: Given: su = 470, sw = 220 | Formula: FoS = ultimate strength / working stress | Substitute: FoS = 470 / 220 | Answer: 2.136

question: A thin cylindrical shell of internal diameter 450 mm and wall thickness 6 mm carries an internal pressure of 1.4 MPa. Find the hoop (circumferential) stress in MPa.
solution: Given: d = 450, t = 6, P = 1.4 | Formula: sigma_h = P d / (2 t) | Substitute: sigma_h = 1.4*450 / (2*6) | Answer: 52.5 MPa

question: 1.5 kg of air is heated at constant volume through 145 deg C. Taking cv = 0.718 kJ/kg-K, find the change in internal energy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 1.5, dT = 145 | Formula: dU = m cv dT | Substitute: dU = 1.5 * 0.718 * 145 | Answer: 156.2 kJ

question: 2.3 kg of air is heated at constant pressure through 25 deg C. Taking cp = 1.005 kJ/kg-K, find the change in enthalpy in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 2.3, dT = 25 | Formula: dH = m cp dT | Substitute: dH = 2.3 * 1.005 * 25 | Answer: 57.79 kJ

question: Air (R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K) occupies 2.2 m^3 at 570 K with mass 3.9 kg. Find the pressure in kPa (ideal gas).
solution: Given: V = 2.2, Tk = 570, m = 3.9 | Formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V | Substitute: p = 3.9*0.287*570 / 2.2 | Answer: 290 kPa
formula: p V = m R T  =>  p = m R T / V

question: 4.3 kg of air expands isothermally at 350 K from volume V1 to 4*V1. Take R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K. Find the work done in kJ.
solution: Given: m = 4.3, Tk = 350, ratio = 4 | Formula: W = m R T ln(V2/V1) | Substitute: W = 4.3*0.287*350*ln(4) | Answer: 598.8 kJ

question: Water (rho = 1000 kg/m^3, mu = 0.001 Pa-s) flows at 1.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.05 m. Find the Reynolds number.
solution: Given: V = 1.8, D = 0.05 | Formula: Re = rho V D / mu | Substitute: Re = 1000*1.8*0.05 / 0.001 | Answer: 90000

question: Water flows at 1.7 m/s through a pipe of diameter 60 mm. Find the volumetric discharge in litres/second.
Water issues from an orifice under a head of 13.7 m. Taking Cv = 0.98, find the actual jet velocity in m/s (g = 9.81).
solution: Given: h = 13.7, cv = 0.98 | Formula: V = Cv sqrt(2 g h) | Substitute: V = 0.98*sqrt(2*9.81*13.7) | Answer: 16.07 m/s

question: In a pipe (diameter 160 mm) water flows at 0.9 m/s. It contracts to diameter 130 mm. Find the velocity in the smaller pipe (m/s).
Water flows at 2.8 m/s through a pipe of diameter 0.13 m and length 110 m. With friction factor f = 0.038, find the head loss due to friction in m (Darcy, g = 9.81).
formula: hf = f L V^2 / (2 g D)

question: A pinion of 31 teeth drives a gear of 74 teeth. If the pinion runs at 600 rpm, find the gear speed in rpm.
solution: Given: z1 = 31, z2 = 74, N1 = 600 | Formula: N1 z1 = N2 z2  =>  N2 = N1 z1 / z2 | Substitute: N2 = 600*31 / 74 | Answer: 251.4 rpm

question: A pulley of diameter 410 mm rotates at 750 rpm. Find the belt (peripheral) speed in m/s.
solution: Given: D = 410, N = 750 | Formula: v = pi D N / 60 | Substitute: v = pi*(0.41)*750 / 60 | Answer: 16.1 m/s

question: A shaft transmits 36.6 kW at 1200 rpm. Find the mean torque transmitted in N-m.
solution: Given: P = 36.6, N = 1200 | Formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W) | Substitute: T = 60*(36.6*1000) / (2*pi*1200) | Answer: 291.3 N-m
formula: T = 60 P / (2 pi N)  (P in W)

question: A mass of 5.8 kg rotates at radius 0.17 m at 550 rpm. Find the centrifugal force in N.
formula: F = m w^2 r,  w = 2 pi N / 60

question: A spring-mass system has stiffness 3400 N/m and mass 14.7 kg. Find the natural frequency in Hz.
solution: Given: k = 3400, m = 14.7 | Formula: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(k/m) | Substitute: fn = (1/2pi) sqrt(3400/14.7) | Answer: 2.42 Hz

question: A plane wall of area 9.3 m^2 and thickness 0.26 m has conductivity k = 15.1 W/m-K. The temperature difference across it is 175 deg C. Find the heat conduction rate in W.
solution: Given: A = 9.3, L = 0.26, k = 15.1, dT = 175 | Formula: Q = k A dT / L | Substitute: Q = 15.1*9.3*175 / 0.26 | Answer: 9452 W

question: A surface of area 1.1 m^2 loses heat by convection with h = 40 W/m^2-K to surroundings 95 deg C cooler. Find the heat loss in W.
solution: Given: A = 1.1, h = 40, dT = 95 | Formula: Q = h A dT | Substitute: Q = 40*1.1*95 | Answer: 4180 W

question: In turning, cutting speed = 120 m/min, feed = 0.29 mm/rev, depth of cut = 1.5 mm. Find the material removal rate in mm^3/min.
solution: Given: v = 120, f = 0.29, d = 1.5 | Formula: MRR = 1000 v f d | Substitute: MRR = 1000*120*0.29*1.5 | Answer: 52200 mm^3/min

question: A workpiece of length 210 mm is turned at 1000 rpm with a feed of 0.13 mm/rev. Find the machining time for one pass in minutes.
solution: Given: L = 210, N = 1000, f = 0.13 | Formula: t = L / (f N) | Substitute: t = 210 / (0.13*1000) | Answer: 1.615 min

question: A resistor of 62 ohm carries a current of 4.6 A. Find the voltage across it.
solution: Given: R = 62, I = 4.6 | Formula: V = I R | Substitute: V = 4.6 * 62 | Answer: 285.2 V

question: Three resistors 87 ohm, 50 ohm and 71 ohm are connected in series. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 87, R2 = 50, R3 = 71 | Formula: Req = R1 + R2 + R3 | Substitute: Req = 87 + 50 + 71 | Answer: 208 ohm

question: Two resistors 6 ohm and 61 ohm are connected in parallel. Find the equivalent resistance.
solution: Given: R1 = 6, R2 = 61 | Formula: Req = R1 R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Req = 6*61 / (6+61) | Answer: 5.463 ohm

question: A device draws 12.6 A at 25 V. Find the power consumed.
solution: Given: V = 25, I = 12.6 | Formula: P = V I | Substitute: P = 25 * 12.6 | Answer: 315 W

question: A current of 0.9 A flows through a 23 ohm resistor. Find the power dissipated.
solution: Given: I = 0.9, R = 23 | Formula: P = I^2 R | Substitute: P = (0.9)^2 * 23 | Answer: 18.63 W

question: Two capacitors 1.7 uF and 7.6 uF are connected in series. Find the equivalent capacitance in uF.
solution: Given: C1 = 1.7, C2 = 7.6 | Formula: Ceq = C1 C2 / (C1 + C2) | Substitute: Ceq = 1.7*7.6 / (1.7+7.6) | Answer: 1.389 uF

question: A resistor 34 kohm and capacitor 8 uF form a series RC circuit. Find the time constant in ms.
solution: Given: R = 34, C = 8 | Formula: tau = R C | Substitute: tau = (34k)(8u) = 272 ms | Answer: 272 ms

question: An inductor 255.1 mH is in series with 9 ohm. Find the time constant of the RL circuit in ms.
solution: Given: L = 255.1, R = 9 | Formula: tau = L / R | Substitute: tau = (255.1e-3) / 9 | Answer: 28.34 ms

question: Find the inductive reactance of a 23.8 mH inductor at 950 Hz.
solution: Given: L = 23.8, f = 950 | Formula: XL = 2 pi f L | Substitute: XL = 2 pi (950)(23.8e-3) | Answer: 142.1 ohm

question: Find the capacitive reactance of a 8.2 uF capacitor at 630 Hz.
solution: Given: C = 8.2, f = 630 | Formula: XC = 1 / (2 pi f C) | Substitute: XC = 1 / (2 pi (630)(8.2e-6)) | Answer: 30.81 ohm

question: A series RLC circuit has R = 56 ohm, XL = 79 ohm and XC = 113 ohm. Find the magnitude of the impedance.
solution: Given: R = 56, XL = 79, XC = 113 | Formula: Z = sqrt(R^2 + (XL - XC)^2) | Substitute: Z = sqrt(56^2 + (79 - 113)^2) | Answer: 65.51 ohm

question: Find the resonant frequency of a series circuit with L = 11.6 mH and C = 3.9 uF (in Hz).
solution: Given: L = 11.6, C = 3.9 | Formula: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(L C)) | Substitute: f0 = 1 / (2 pi sqrt(11.6e-3 * 3.9e-6)) | Answer: 748.3 Hz

question: A capacitor of 67.8 uF is charged to 340 V. Find the energy stored in millijoules.
solution: Given: C = 67.8, V = 340 | Formula: E = 0.5 C V^2 | Substitute: E = 0.5*67.8e-6*(340)^2 | Answer: 3919 mJ

question: A transformer has primary voltage 160 V with 670 primary turns and 340 secondary turns. Find the secondary voltage.
solution: Given: V1 = 160, N1 = 670, N2 = 340 | Formula: V2 = V1 (N2 / N1) | Substitute: V2 = 160 * 340/670 | Answer: 81.19 V

question: A DC motor is supplied at 410 V and draws an armature current of 35 A. If the armature resistance is 0.81 ohm, find the back EMF.
solution: Given: V = 410, Ia = 35, Ra = 0.81 | Formula: Eb = V - Ia Ra | Substitute: Eb = 410 - 35*0.81 | Answer: 381.6 V

question: A balanced 3-phase load draws a line current of 165 A at 433 V (line) with a power factor of 0.84. Find the total real power in kW.
solution: Given: IL = 165, VL = 433, pf = 0.84 | Formula: P = sqrt(3) VL IL cos(phi) | Substitute: P = sqrt(3)*433*165*0.84 / 1000 | Answer: 103.9 kW

question: A load has real power 85 kW and apparent power 195 kVA. Find the power factor.
solution: Given: P = 85, S = 195 | Formula: pf = P / S | Substitute: pf = 85 / 195 | Answer: 0.4359

question: In a voltage divider, Vin = 18 V across R1 = 20 ohm and R2 = 18 ohm in series. Find the output voltage across R2.
solution: Given: Vin = 18, R1 = 20, R2 = 18 | Formula: Vout = Vin R2 / (R1 + R2) | Substitute: Vout = 18*18 / (20+18) | Answer: 8.526 V

question: An inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 60 kohm and Rin = 24 kohm. Find the voltage gain (magnitude).
solution: Given: Rf = 60, Rin = 24 | Formula: |A| = Rf / Rin | Substitute: |A| = 60 / 24 | Answer: 2.5

question: A non-inverting op-amp amplifier has Rf = 100 kohm and Rg = 32 kohm. Find the voltage gain.
solution: Given: Rf = 100, Rg = 32 | Formula: A = 1 + Rf / Rg | Substitute: A = 1 + 100/32 | Answer: 4.125

question: An amplifier has an output/input power ratio of 9024. Express the gain in decibels (power).
solution: Given: ratio = 9024 | Formula: Gain(dB) = 10 log10(Pout/Pin) | Substitute: Gain = 10 log10(9024) | Answer: 39.55 dB

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.4 m carries a central point load of 25 kN. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 9.4, W = 25 | Formula: Mmax = W L / 4 | Substitute: Mmax = 25*9.4 / 4 | Answer: 58.75 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 9.3 m carries a UDL of 35 kN/m. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 9.3, w = 35 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 8 | Substitute: Mmax = 35*(9.3)^2 / 8 | Answer: 378.4 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2 m carries a point load 35 kN at its free end. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2, W = 35 | Formula: Mmax = W L | Substitute: Mmax = 35*2 | Answer: 70 kN-m

question: A cantilever of length 2.9 m carries a UDL of 4 kN/m over its whole length. Find the maximum bending moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 2.9, w = 4 | Formula: Mmax = w L^2 / 2 | Substitute: Mmax = 4*(2.9)^2 / 2 | Answer: 16.82 kN-m

question: A simply supported beam of span 4.9 m carries a point load 80 kN at distance 1.5 m from the left support. Find the left reaction in kN.
solution: Given: L = 4.9, a = 1.5, W = 80 | Formula: R_left = W (L - a) / L | Substitute: R_left = 80*(4.9 - 1.5) / 4.9 | Answer: 55.51 kN

question: A simply supported beam (span 6.5 m) carries a central point load 10 kN. With E = 25 GPa and I = 440e6 mm^4, find the maximum deflection in mm.
solution: Use consistent N-mm units: W=10000 N, L=6500.0 mm, E=25000 MPa, I=440e6 mm^4 | delta = W L^3 / (48 E I) | Answer: 5.201 mm

question: A fixed beam of span 6.6 m carries a UDL of 45 kN/m. Find the magnitude of the fixed-end moment in kN-m.
solution: Given: L = 6.6, w = 45 | Formula: M = w L^2 / 12 | Substitute: M = 45*(6.6)^2 / 12 | Answer: 163.3 kN-m

question: An RC beam has overall depth 460 mm, clear cover 35 mm and main bars of diameter 25 mm. Find the effective depth in mm.
solution: Given: D = 460, c = 35, dia = 25 | Formula: d = D - cover - (bar diameter)/2 | Substitute: d = 460 - 35 - 25/2 | Answer: 412.5 mm

question: A column supports a floor area of 33.9 m^2 carrying a factored load of 9.6 kN/m^2. Find the total factored axial load in kN.
solution: Given: A = 33.9, w = 9.6 | Formula: P = w * tributary area | Substitute: P = 9.6 * 33.9 | Answer: 325.4 kN

question: A smooth vertical wall retains cohesionless backfill of height 3.9 m, unit weight 19 kN/m^3, phi = 36 degrees. Find the total active thrust per metre run (kN/m).
formula: Pa = 0.5 Ka gamma H^2,  Ka = (1 - sin phi)/(1 + sin phi)

question: In a constant-head permeameter, k = 1.2e-4 m/s, hydraulic gradient i = 0.9, area = 3.6e-3 m^2. Find the seepage discharge in mm^3/s.
solution: Given: k = 1.2, i = 0.9, A = 3.6 | Formula: q = k i A | Substitute: q = (1.2e-4)*0.9*(3.6e-3) | Answer: 388.8 mm^3/s

question: An open channel has hydraulic radius 2.2 m, bed slope 0.004 (as a fraction) and Manning's n = 0.016. Find the mean velocity in m/s.
Water flows over a rectangular weir of crest length 1 m under a head of 0.3 m. Taking Cd = 0.63 (g = 9.81), find the discharge in m^3/s.
formula: Q = (2/3) Cd sqrt(2 g) L H^(3/2)

question: A rectangular channel 3.2 m wide carries a discharge of 17.8 m^3/s. Find the critical depth in m (g = 9.81).
A tank of volume 850 m^3 treats a flow of 70 m^3/h. Find the hydraulic retention time in hours.
solution: Given: V = 850, Q = 70 | Formula: HRT = Volume / Flow rate | Substitute: HRT = 850 / 70 | Answer: 12.14 h

question: The ultimate BOD of a sample is 330 mg/L and the deoxygenation rate constant k = 0.28 /day. Find the BOD exerted in 7 days.
solution: Given: L0 = 330, k = 0.28, t = 7 | Formula: BOD_t = L0 (1 - e^(-k t)) | Substitute: BOD_t = 330*(1 - e^(-0.28*7)) | Answer: 283.5 mg/L

question: Using the rational method with runoff coefficient C = 0.59, rainfall intensity 105 mm/h over a catchment of 32.3 hectares, find the peak runoff in m^3/s.
solution: Given: C = 0.59, i = 105, A = 32.3 | Formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares) | Substitute: Q = 0.59*105*32.3 / 360 | Answer: 5.558 m^3/s
formula: Q = C i A / 360  (i in mm/h, A in hectares)

question: A tape of nominal length 20 m is actually 0.07 m too long. Find the correct length of a line measured as 310 m with this tape.
solution: Given: L = 20, e = 0.07, M = 310 | Formula: True length = Measured * (L + e) / L | Substitute: True = 310*(20+0.07)/20 | Answer: 311.1 m

question: Convert the decimal number 2937 to hexadecimal (uppercase).
solution: Divide 2937 by 16 repeatedly, recording remainders | Answer: B79 (hex)
formula: Repeatedly divide by 16 and read remainders bottom-up

question: Compute the Hamming distance between the 8-bit words 01011110 and 11010100.
solution: XOR: 10001010 | Count of 1s = 3 | Answer: 3
formula: Hamming distance = number of differing bit positions

question: A file of 700 megabits is sent over a link of 98 Mbps. Find the transmission time in seconds.
solution: Given: S = 700, B = 98 | Formula: t = size / bandwidth | Substitute: t = 700 / 98 | Answer: 7.143 s

question: A link has bandwidth 39 Mbps and round-trip time 60 ms. Find the bandwidth-delay product in kilobits.
solution: Given: B = 39, R = 60 | Formula: BDP = bandwidth * RTT | Substitute: BDP = 39e6 * 60e-3 bits = 2340 kb | Answer: 2340 kilobits

question: A cache has a hit ratio of 0.85, cache access time 7 ns and main-memory access time 100 ns. Find the effective (average) memory access time in ns.
solution: Given: h = 0.85, tc = 7, tm = 100 | Formula: EAT = h * tc + (1 - h) * tm | Substitute: EAT = 0.85*7 + (1 - 0.85)*100 | Answer: 20.95 ns
